verses.textZh: 大卫的儿子以色列王所罗门的箴言：
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的儿子以色列王所罗门的箴言：
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王大卫儿子所罗门的箴言：
verses.textEnNiv: The proverbs of Solomon son of David, king of Israel:
verses.textEnEsv: The proverbs of Solomon, son of David, king of Israel:
verses.textEnNkjv: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel:
verses.textEnNlt: These are the proverbs of Solomon, David’s son, king of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel:
verses.textEn: The proverbs of Solomon son of David, king of Israel:

verses.textZh: 要使人晓得智慧和教训， 了解充满哲理的言语；
verses.textZhCnvs: 要使人晓得智慧和教训， 了解充满哲理的言语；
verses.textZhCuv: 要使人晓得智慧和训诲， 分辨通达的言语，
verses.textEnNiv: for gaining wisdom and instruction; for understanding words of insight;
verses.textEnEsv: To know wisdom and instruction, to understand words of insight,
verses.textEnNkjv: To know wisdom and instruction, To perceive the words of understanding,
verses.textEnNlt: Their purpose is to teach people wisdom and discipline, to help them understand the insights of the wise.
verses.textEnNasb: To know wisdom and instruction, To discern the sayings of understanding,
verses.textEn: for gaining wisdom and instruction; for understanding words of insight;

verses.textZh: 使人领受明慧的教训， 就是公义、公正和正直；
verses.textZhCnvs: 使人领受明慧的教训， 就是公义、公正和正直；
verses.textZhCuv: 使人处事领受智慧、 仁义、公平、正直的训诲，
verses.textEnNiv: for receiving instruction in prudent behavior, doing what is right and just and fair;
verses.textEnEsv: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;
verses.textEnNkjv: To receive the instruction of wisdom, Justice, judgment, and equity;
verses.textEnNlt: Their purpose is to teach people to live disciplined and successful lives, to help them do what is right, just, and fair.
verses.textEnNasb: To receive instruction in wise behavior, Righteousness, justice, and integrity;
verses.textEn: for receiving instruction in prudent behavior, doing what is right and just and fair;

verses.textZh: 使愚蒙人变成精明， 使少年人获得知识和明辨的能力；
verses.textZhCnvs: 使愚蒙人变成精明， 使少年人获得知识和明辨的能力；
verses.textZhCuv: 使愚人灵明， 使少年人有知识和谋略，
verses.textEnNiv: for giving prudence to those who are simple, knowledge and discretion to the young—
verses.textEnEsv: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the youth—
verses.textEnNkjv: To give prudence to the simple, To the young man knowledge and discretion—
verses.textEnNlt: These proverbs will give insight to the simple, knowledge and discernment to the young.
verses.textEnNasb: To give prudence to the naive, To the youth knowledge and discretion,
verses.textEn: for giving prudence to those who are simple, knowledge and discretion to the young—

verses.textZh: 使智慧人听了，可以增长学问， 使聪明人听了，可以获得智谋；
verses.textZhCnvs: 使智慧人听了，可以增长学问， 使聪明人听了，可以获得智谋；
verses.textZhCuv: 使智慧人听见，增长学问， 使聪明人得着智谋，
verses.textEnNiv: let the wise listen and add to their learning, and let the discerning get guidance—
verses.textEnEsv: Let the wise hear and increase in learning, and the one who understands obtain guidance,
verses.textEnNkjv: A wise man will hear and increase learning, And a man of understanding will attain wise counsel,
verses.textEnNlt: Let the wise listen to these proverbs and become even wiser. Let those with understanding receive guidance
verses.textEnNasb: A wise person will hear and increase in learning, And a person of understanding will acquire wise counsel,
verses.textEn: let the wise listen and add to their learning, and let the discerning get guidance—

verses.textZh: 使人明白箴言和譬喻， 懂得智慧人的言词和他们的隐语。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使人明白箴言和譬喻， 懂得智慧人的言词和他们的隐语。
verses.textZhCuv: 使人明白箴言和譬喻， 懂得智慧人的言词和谜语。
verses.textEnNiv: for understanding proverbs and parables, the sayings and riddles of the wise.
verses.textEnEsv: to understand a proverb and a saying, the words of the wise and their riddles.
verses.textEnNkjv: To understand a proverb and an enigma, The words of the wise and their riddles.
verses.textEnNlt: by exploring the meaning in these proverbs and parables, the words of the wise and their riddles.
verses.textEnNasb: To understand a proverb and a saying, The words of the wise and their riddles.
verses.textEn: for understanding proverbs and parables, the sayings and riddles of the wise.

verses.textZh: 敬畏耶和华是知识的开端， 但愚妄人藐视智慧和教训。
verses.textZhCnvs: 敬畏耶和华是知识的开端， 但愚妄人藐视智慧和教训。
verses.textZhCuv: 敬畏耶和华是知识的开端； 愚妄人藐视智慧和训诲。
verses.textEnNiv: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
verses.textEnEsv: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge; fools despise wisdom and instruction.
verses.textEnNkjv: The fear of the Lordis the beginning of knowledge, But fools despise wisdom and instruction.
verses.textEnNlt: Fear of the Lord is the foundation of true knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and discipline.
verses.textEnNasb: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge; Fools despise wisdom and instruction.
verses.textEn: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and instruction.

verses.textZh: 我儿，要听从你父亲的教训， 不可离弃你母亲的训诲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我儿，要听从你父亲的教训， 不可离弃你母亲的训诲。
verses.textZhCuv: 我儿，要听你父亲的训诲， 不可离弃你母亲的法则 ；
verses.textEnNiv: Listen, my son, to your father’s instruction and do not forsake your mother’s teaching.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear, my son, your father’s instruction, and forsake not your mother’s teaching,
verses.textEnNkjv: My son, hear the instruction of your father, And do not forsake the law of your mother;
verses.textEnNlt: My child, listen when your father corrects you. Don’t neglect your mother’s instruction.
verses.textEnNasb: Listen, my son, to your father’s instruction, And do not ignore your mother’s teaching;
verses.textEn: Listen, my son, to your father’s instruction and do not forsake your mother’s teaching.

verses.textZh: 因为这些要作你头上的华冠， 作你颈上的金炼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为这些要作你头上的华冠， 作你颈上的金炼。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为这要作你头上的华冠， 你项上的金链。
verses.textEnNiv: They are a garland to grace your head and a chain to adorn your neck.
verses.textEnEsv: for they are a graceful garland for your head and pendants for your neck.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they willbe a graceful ornament on your head, And chains about your neck.
verses.textEnNlt: What you learn from them will crown you with grace and be a chain of honor around your neck.
verses.textEnNasb: For they are a graceful wreath for your head And necklaces for your neck.
verses.textEn: They are a garland to grace your head and a chain to adorn your neck.

verses.textZh: 我儿，如果坏人引诱你， 你不可随从他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我儿，如果坏人引诱你， 你不可随从他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我儿，恶人若引诱你， 你不可随从。
verses.textEnNiv: My son, if sinful men entice you, do not give in to them.
verses.textEnEsv: My son, if sinners entice you, do not consent.
verses.textEnNkjv: My son, if sinners entice you, Do not consent.
verses.textEnNlt: My child, if sinners entice you, turn your back on them!
verses.textEnNasb: My son, if sinners entice you, Do not consent.
verses.textEn: My son, if sinful men entice you, do not give in to them.

verses.textZh: 如果他们说："你跟我们来吧！ 我们要埋伏流人的血， 我们要无故地潜伏伤害无辜的人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他们说："你跟我们来吧！ 我们要埋伏流人的血， 我们要无故地潜伏伤害无辜的人；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们若说：你与我们同去， 我们要埋伏流人之血， 要蹲伏害无罪之人；
verses.textEnNiv: If they say, "Come along with us; let’s lie in wait for innocent blood, let’s ambush some harmless soul;
verses.textEnEsv: If they say, "Come with us, let us lie in wait for blood; let us ambush the innocent without reason;
verses.textEnNkjv: If they say, "Come with us, Let us lie in wait to shed blood; Let us lurk secretly for the innocent without cause;
verses.textEnNlt: They may say, "Come and join us. Let’s hide and kill someone! Just for fun, let’s ambush the innocent!
verses.textEnNasb: If they say, "Come with us, Let’s lie in wait for blood, Let’s ambush the innocent without cause;
verses.textEn: If they say, "Come along with us; let’s lie in wait for innocent blood, let’s ambush some harmless soul;

verses.textZh: 我们要好象阴间一般，把他们活生生吞下， 他们整个被我们吞下，如同下坑的人一样；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们要好象阴间一般，把他们活生生吞下， 他们整个被我们吞下，如同下坑的人一样；
verses.textZhCuv: 我们好像阴间，把他们活活吞下； 他们如同下坑的人， 被我们囫囵吞了；
verses.textEnNiv: let’s swallow them alive, like the grave, and whole, like those who go down to the pit;
verses.textEnEsv: like Sheol let us swallow them alive, and whole, like those who go down to the pit;
verses.textEnNkjv: Let us swallow them alive like Sheol, And whole, like those who go down to the Pit;
verses.textEnNlt: Let’s swallow them alive, like the grave ; let’s swallow them whole, like those who go down to the pit of death.
verses.textEnNasb: Let’s swallow them alive like Sheol, Even whole, like those who go down to the pit;
verses.textEn: let’s swallow them alive, like the grave, and whole, like those who go down to the pit;

verses.textZh: 这样，我们必得着各样贵重的财物， 把掠物装满我们的房子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，我们必得着各样贵重的财物， 把掠物装满我们的房子。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们必得各样宝物， 将所掳来的，装满房屋；
verses.textEnNiv: we will get all sorts of valuable things and fill our houses with plunder;
verses.textEnEsv: we shall find all precious goods, we shall fill our houses with plunder;
verses.textEnNkjv: We shall find all kinds of precious possessions, We shall fill our houses with spoil;
verses.textEnNlt: Think of the great things we’ll get! We’ll fill our houses with all the stuff we take.
verses.textEnNasb: We will find all kinds of precious wealth, We will fill our houses with plunder;
verses.textEn: we will get all sorts of valuable things and fill our houses with plunder;

verses.textZh: 加入我们的行列吧！ 我们大家共用一个钱袋。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 加入我们的行列吧！ 我们大家共用一个钱袋。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你与我们大家同分， 我们共用一个囊袋；
verses.textEnNiv: cast lots with us; we will all share the loot"—
verses.textEnEsv: throw in your lot among us; we will all have one purse"—
verses.textEnNkjv: Cast in your lot among us, Let us all have one purse"—
verses.textEnNlt: Come, throw in your lot with us; we’ll all share the loot."
verses.textEnNasb: Throw in your lot with us; We will all have one money bag,"
verses.textEn: cast lots with us; we will all share the loot"—

verses.textZh: 我儿，不可和他们走在一起， 禁止你的脚走他们的路；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我儿，不可和他们走在一起， 禁止你的脚走他们的路；
verses.textZhCuv: 我儿，不要与他们同行一道， 禁止你脚走他们的路。
verses.textEnNiv: my son, do not go along with them, do not set foot on their paths;
verses.textEnEsv: my son, do not walk in the way with them; hold back your foot from their paths,
verses.textEnNkjv: My son, do not walk in the way with them, Keep your foot from their path;
verses.textEnNlt: My child, don’t go along with them! Stay far away from their paths.
verses.textEnNasb: My son, do not walk on the way with them. Keep your feet from their path,
verses.textEn: my son, do not go along with them, do not set foot on their paths;

verses.textZh: 因为他们的脚奔向邪恶， 他们急于流人的血。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们的脚奔向邪恶， 他们急于流人的血。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，他们的脚奔跑行恶； 他们急速流人的血，
verses.textEnNiv: for their feet rush into evil, they are swift to shed blood.
verses.textEnEsv: for their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed blood.
verses.textEnNkjv: For their feet run to evil, And they make haste to shed blood.
verses.textEnNlt: They rush to commit evil deeds. They hurry to commit murder.
verses.textEnNasb: For their feet run to evil, And they are quick to shed blood.
verses.textEn: for their feet rush into evil, they are swift to shed blood.

verses.textZh: 在飞鸟眼前张设网罗， 是徒劳无功的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在飞鸟眼前张设网罗， 是徒劳无功的。
verses.textZhCuv: 好像飞鸟， 网罗设在眼前仍不躲避。
verses.textEnNiv: How useless to spread a net where every bird can see it!
verses.textEnEsv: For in vain is a net spread in the sight of any bird,
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely, in vain the net is spread In the sight of any bird;
verses.textEnNlt: If a bird sees a trap being set, it knows to stay away.
verses.textEnNasb: Indeed, it is useless to spread the baited net In the sight of any bird;
verses.textEn: How useless to spread a net where every bird can see it!

verses.textZh: 他们埋伏，是自流己血； 他们潜伏，是自害己命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们埋伏，是自流己血； 他们潜伏，是自害己命。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些人埋伏，是为自流己血； 蹲伏，是为自害己命。
verses.textEnNiv: These men lie in wait for their own blood; they ambush only themselves!
verses.textEnEsv: but these men lie in wait for their own blood; they set an ambush for their own lives.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they lie in wait for their own blood, They lurk secretly for their own lives.
verses.textEnNlt: But these people set an ambush for themselves; they are trying to get themselves killed.
verses.textEnNasb: But they lie in wait for their own blood; They ambush their own lives.
verses.textEn: These men lie in wait for their own blood; they ambush only themselves!

verses.textZh: 凡是贪爱不义之财的，所走的路都是这样； 那不义之财夺去了贪财者的性命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是贪爱不义之财的，所走的路都是这样； 那不义之财夺去了贪财者的性命。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡贪恋财利的，所行之路都是如此； 这贪恋之心乃夺去得财者之命。
verses.textEnNiv: Such are the paths of all who go after ill-gotten gain; it takes away the life of those who get it.
verses.textEnEsv: Such are the ways of everyone who is greedy for unjust gain; it takes away the life of its possessors.
verses.textEnNkjv: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain; It takes away the life of its owners.
verses.textEnNlt: Such is the fate of all who are greedy for money; it robs them of life.
verses.textEnNasb: Such are the ways of everyone who makes unjust gain; It takes away the life of its possessors.
verses.textEn: Such are the paths of all who go after ill-gotten gain; it takes away the life of those who get it.

verses.textZh: 智慧在街上呼喊， 在广场上扬声；
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧在街上呼喊， 在广场上扬声；
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧在街市上呼喊， 在宽阔处发声，
verses.textEnNiv: Out in the open wisdom calls aloud, she raises her voice in the public square;
verses.textEnEsv: Wisdom cries aloud in the street, in the markets she raises her voice;
verses.textEnNkjv: Wisdom calls aloud outside; She raises her voice in the open squares.
verses.textEnNlt: Wisdom shouts in the streets. She cries out in the public square.
verses.textEnNasb: Wisdom shouts in the street, She raises her voice in the public square;
verses.textEn: Out in the open wisdom calls aloud, she raises her voice in the public square;

verses.textZh: 在闹市中心呼叫， 在城门口发出言语，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 在闹市中心呼叫， 在城门口发出言语，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 在热闹街头喊叫， 在城门口，在城中发出言语，
verses.textEnNiv: on top of the wall she cries out, at the city gate she makes her speech:
verses.textEnEsv: at the head of the noisy streets she cries out; at the entrance of the city gates she speaks:
verses.textEnNkjv: She cries out in the chief concourses, At the openings of the gates in the city She speaks her words:
verses.textEnNlt: She calls to the crowds along the main street, to those gathered in front of the city gate:
verses.textEnNasb: At the head of the noisy streets she cries out; At the entrance of the gates in the city she declares her sayings:
verses.textEn: on top of the wall she cries out, at the city gate she makes her speech:

verses.textZh: "你们愚蒙人喜爱愚蒙， 好讥笑的人喜欢讥笑， 愚昧人恨恶知识，要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们愚蒙人喜爱愚蒙， 好讥笑的人喜欢讥笑， 愚昧人恨恶知识，要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 说：你们愚昧人喜爱愚昧， 亵慢人喜欢亵慢， 愚顽人恨恶知识，要到几时呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "How long will you who are simple love your simple ways? How long will mockers delight in mockery and fools hate knowledge?
verses.textEnEsv: "How long, O simple ones, will you love being simple? How long will scoffers delight in their scoffing and fools hate knowledge?
verses.textEnNkjv: "How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? For scorners delight in their scorning, And fools hate knowledge.
verses.textEnNlt: "How long, you simpletons, will you insist on being simpleminded? How long will you mockers relish your mocking? How long will you fools hate knowledge?
verses.textEnNasb: "How long, you naive ones, will you love simplistic thinking? And how long will scoffers delight themselves in scoffing And fools hate knowledge?
verses.textEn: "How long will you who are simple love your simple ways? How long will mockers delight in mockery and fools hate knowledge?

verses.textZh: 你们要因我的责备回转， 我就把我的心意 向你们倾吐， 把我的话指示你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要因我的责备回转， 我就把我的心意 向你们倾吐， 把我的话指示你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当因我的责备回转； 我要将我的灵浇灌你们， 将我的话指示你们。
verses.textEnNiv: Repent at my rebuke! Then I will pour out my thoughts to you, I will make known to you my teachings.
verses.textEnEsv: If you turn at my reproof, behold, I will pour out my spirit to you; I will make my words known to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Turn at my rebuke; Surely I will pour out my spirit on you; I will make my words known to you.
verses.textEnNlt: Come and listen to my counsel. I’ll share my heart with you and make you wise.
verses.textEnNasb: "Turn to my rebuke, Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you; I will make my words known to you.
verses.textEn: Repent at my rebuke! Then I will pour out my thoughts to you, I will make known to you my teachings.

verses.textZh: 我呼唤，你们不肯听从； 我伸手，没有人理会。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我呼唤，你们不肯听从； 我伸手，没有人理会。
verses.textZhCuv: 我呼唤，你们不肯听从； 我伸手，无人理会；
verses.textEnNiv: But since you refuse to listen when I call and no one pays attention when I stretch out my hand,
verses.textEnEsv: Because I have called and you refused to listen, have stretched out my hand and no one has heeded,
verses.textEnNkjv: Because I have called and you refused, I have stretched out my hand and no one regarded,
verses.textEnNlt: "I called you so often, but you wouldn’t come. I reached out to you, but you paid no attention.
verses.textEnNasb: "Because I called and you refused, I stretched out my hand and no one paid attention;
verses.textEn: But since you refuse to listen when I call and no one pays attention when I stretch out my hand,

verses.textZh: 你们既轻忽我的一切劝告， 不肯接受我的责备；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们既轻忽我的一切劝告， 不肯接受我的责备；
verses.textZhCuv: 反轻弃我一切的劝戒， 不肯受我的责备。
verses.textEnNiv: since you disregard all my advice and do not accept my rebuke,
verses.textEnEsv: because you have ignored all my counsel and would have none of my reproof,
verses.textEnNkjv: Because you disdained all my counsel, And would have none of my rebuke,
verses.textEnNlt: You ignored my advice and rejected the correction I offered.
verses.textEnNasb: And you neglected all my advice And did not want my rebuke;
verses.textEn: since you disregard all my advice and do not accept my rebuke,

verses.textZh: 所以你们遭难的时候，我就发笑； 惊恐临到你们的日子，我就嗤笑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你们遭难的时候，我就发笑； 惊恐临到你们的日子，我就嗤笑。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们遭灾难，我就发笑； 惊恐临到你们，我必嗤笑。
verses.textEnNiv: I in turn will laugh when disaster strikes you; I will mock when calamity overtakes you—
verses.textEnEsv: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when terror strikes you,
verses.textEnNkjv: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your terror comes,
verses.textEnNlt: So I will laugh when you are in trouble! I will mock you when disaster overtakes you—
verses.textEnNasb: I will also laugh at your disaster; I will mock when your dread comes,
verses.textEn: I in turn will laugh when disaster strikes you; I will mock when calamity overtakes you—

verses.textZh: 惊恐临到你们好象风暴， 灾难如同飓风来临， 患难困苦临到你们身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 惊恐临到你们好象风暴， 灾难如同飓风来临， 患难困苦临到你们身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 惊恐临到你们，好像狂风； 灾难来到，如同暴风； 急难痛苦临到你们身上。
verses.textEnNiv: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when disaster sweeps over you like a whirlwind, when distress and trouble overwhelm you.
verses.textEnEsv: when terror strikes you like a storm and your calamity comes like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come upon you.
verses.textEnNkjv: When your terror comes like a storm, And your destruction comes like a whirlwind, When distress and anguish come upon you.
verses.textEnNlt: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when disaster engulfs you like a cyclone, and anguish and distress overwhelm you.
verses.textEnNasb: When your dread comes like a storm And your disaster comes like a whirlwind, When distress and anguish come upon you.
verses.textEn: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when disaster sweeps over you like a whirlwind, when distress and trouble overwhelm you.

verses.textZh: 那时，他们必呼求我，我却不回答； 他们切切寻找我，却寻不见；
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，他们必呼求我，我却不回答； 他们切切寻找我，却寻不见；
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，你们必呼求我，我却不答应， 恳切地寻找我，却寻不见。
verses.textEnNiv: "Then they will call to me but I will not answer; they will look for me but will not find me,
verses.textEnEsv: Then they will call upon me, but I will not answer; they will seek me diligently but will not find me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then they will call on me, but I will not answer; They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me.
verses.textEnNlt: "When they cry for help, I will not answer. Though they anxiously search for me, they will not find me.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then they will call on me, but I will not answer; They will seek me diligently but will not find me,
verses.textEn: "Then they will call to me but I will not answer; they will look for me but will not find me,

verses.textZh: 因为他们恨恶知识， 不选择敬畏耶和华；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们恨恶知识， 不选择敬畏耶和华；
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，你们恨恶知识， 不喜爱敬畏耶和华，
verses.textEnNiv: since they hated knowledge and did not choose to fear the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Because they hated knowledge and did not choose the fear of the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: Because they hated knowledge And did not choose the fear of the Lord,
verses.textEnNlt: For they hated knowledge and chose not to fear the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Because they hated knowledge And did not choose the fear of the Lord.
verses.textEn: since they hated knowledge and did not choose to fear the Lord .

verses.textZh: 不接受我的劝告， 轻视我的一切责备；
verses.textZhCnvs: 不接受我的劝告， 轻视我的一切责备；
verses.textZhCuv: 不听我的劝戒， 藐视我一切的责备，
verses.textEnNiv: Since they would not accept my advice and spurned my rebuke,
verses.textEnEsv: would have none of my counsel and despised all my reproof,
verses.textEnNkjv: They would have none of my counsel And despised my every rebuke.
verses.textEnNlt: They rejected my advice and paid no attention when I corrected them.
verses.textEnNasb: "They did not accept my advice, They disdainfully rejected every rebuke from me.
verses.textEn: Since they would not accept my advice and spurned my rebuke,

verses.textZh: 所以，他们必自食其果， 必饱尝自己所设计谋的伤害。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，他们必自食其果， 必饱尝自己所设计谋的伤害。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以必吃自结的果子， 充满自设的计谋。
verses.textEnNiv: they will eat the fruit of their ways and be filled with the fruit of their schemes.
verses.textEnEsv: therefore they shall eat the fruit of their way, and have their fill of their own devices.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore they shall eat the fruit of their own way, And be filled to the full with their own fancies.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, they must eat the bitter fruit of living their own way, choking on their own schemes.
verses.textEnNasb: "So they shall eat of the fruit of their own way, And be filled with their own schemes.
verses.textEn: they will eat the fruit of their ways and be filled with the fruit of their schemes.

verses.textZh: 愚蒙人的背道必杀害他们自己， 愚昧人的安逸必毁灭他们自己；
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚蒙人的背道必杀害他们自己， 愚昧人的安逸必毁灭他们自己；
verses.textZhCuv: 愚昧人背道，必杀己身； 愚顽人安逸，必害己命。
verses.textEnNiv: For the waywardness of the simple will kill them, and the complacency of fools will destroy them;
verses.textEnEsv: For the simple are killed by their turning away, and the complacency of fools destroys them;
verses.textEnNkjv: For the turning away of the simple will slay them, And the complacency of fools will destroy them;
verses.textEnNlt: For simpletons turn away from me—to death. Fools are destroyed by their own complacency.
verses.textEnNasb: "For the faithlessness of the naive will kill them, And the complacency of fools will destroy them.
verses.textEn: For the waywardness of the simple will kill them, and the complacency of fools will destroy them;

verses.textZh: 唯有听从我的，必安然居住， 得享安宁，免受灾祸的惊恐。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 唯有听从我的，必安然居住， 得享安宁，免受灾祸的惊恐。"
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有听从我的，必安然居住， 得享安静，不怕灾祸。
verses.textEnNiv: but whoever listens to me will live in safety and be at ease, without fear of harm."
verses.textEnEsv: but whoever listens to me will dwell secure and will be at ease, without dread of disaster."
verses.textEnNkjv: But whoever listens to me will dwell safely, And will be secure, without fear of evil."
verses.textEnNlt: But all who listen to me will live in peace, untroubled by fear of harm."
verses.textEnNasb: "But whoever listens to me will live securely And will be at ease from the dread of evil."
verses.textEn: but whoever listens to me will live in safety and be at ease, without fear of harm."

verses.textZh: 我儿，如果你接受我的话， 把我的诫命珍藏在心里，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我儿，如果你接受我的话， 把我的诫命珍藏在心里，
verses.textZhCuv: 我儿，你若领受我的言语， 存记我的命令，
verses.textEnNiv: My son, if you accept my words and store up my commands within you,
verses.textEnEsv: My son, if you receive my words and treasure up my commandments with you,
verses.textEnNkjv: My son, if you receive my words, And treasure my commands within you,
verses.textEnNlt: My child, listen to what I say, and treasure my commands.
verses.textEnNasb: My son, if you will receive my words And treasure my commandments within you,
verses.textEn: My son, if you accept my words and store up my commands within you,

verses.textZh: 留心听智慧， 致力求聪明；
verses.textZhCnvs: 留心听智慧， 致力求聪明；
verses.textZhCuv: 侧耳听智慧， 专心求聪明，
verses.textEnNiv: turning your ear to wisdom and applying your heart to understanding—
verses.textEnEsv: making your ear attentive to wisdom and inclining your heart to understanding;
verses.textEnNkjv: So that you incline your ear to wisdom, And apply your heart to understanding;
verses.textEnNlt: Tune your ears to wisdom, and concentrate on understanding.
verses.textEnNasb: Make your ear attentive to wisdom; Incline your heart to understanding.
verses.textEn: turning your ear to wisdom and applying your heart to understanding—

verses.textZh: 如果你为求哲理而呼喊， 为求聪明而扬声；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你为求哲理而呼喊， 为求聪明而扬声；
verses.textZhCuv: 呼求明哲， 扬声求聪明，
verses.textEnNiv: indeed, if you call out for insight and cry aloud for understanding,
verses.textEnEsv: yes, if you call out for insight and raise your voice for understanding,
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, if you cry out for discernment, And lift up your voice for understanding,
verses.textEnNlt: Cry out for insight, and ask for understanding.
verses.textEnNasb: For if you cry out for insight, And raise your voice for understanding;
verses.textEn: indeed, if you call out for insight and cry aloud for understanding,

verses.textZh: 如果你寻找它如同寻找银子， 搜寻它好象搜寻宝藏；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你寻找它如同寻找银子， 搜寻它好象搜寻宝藏；
verses.textZhCuv: 寻找它，如寻找银子， 搜求它，如搜求隐藏的珍宝，
verses.textEnNiv: and if you look for it as for silver and search for it as for hidden treasure,
verses.textEnEsv: if you seek it like silver and search for it as for hidden treasures,
verses.textEnNkjv: If you seek her as silver, And search for her as for hidden treasures;
verses.textEnNlt: Search for them as you would for silver; seek them like hidden treasures.
verses.textEnNasb: If you seek her as silver And search for her as for hidden treasures;
verses.textEn: and if you look for it as for silver and search for it as for hidden treasure,

verses.textZh: 你就明白怎样敬畏耶和华， 并且获得对神的认识。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你就明白怎样敬畏耶和华， 并且获得对神的认识。
verses.textZhCuv: 你就明白敬畏耶和华， 得以认识神。
verses.textEnNiv: then you will understand the fear of the Lord and find the knowledge of God.
verses.textEnEsv: then you will understand the fear of the Lord and find the knowledge of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you will understand the fear of the Lord, And find the knowledge of God.
verses.textEnNlt: Then you will understand what it means to fear the Lord , and you will gain knowledge of God.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you will understand the fear of the Lord, And discover the knowledge of God.
verses.textEn: then you will understand the fear of the Lord and find the knowledge of God.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华赐人智慧， 知识和聪明都出自他的口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华赐人智慧， 知识和聪明都出自他的口。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，耶和华赐人智慧； 知识和聪明都由他口而出。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord gives wisdom; from his mouth come knowledge and understanding.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord gives wisdom; from his mouth come knowledge and understanding;
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord gives wisdom; From His mouth come knowledge and understanding;
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord grants wisdom! From his mouth come knowledge and understanding.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord gives wisdom; From His mouth come knowledge and understanding.
verses.textEn: For the Lord gives wisdom; from his mouth come knowledge and understanding.

verses.textZh: 他为正直人珍藏大智慧， 给行为完全的人作盾牌；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他为正直人珍藏大智慧， 给行为完全的人作盾牌；
verses.textZhCuv: 他给正直人存留真智慧， 给行为纯正的人作盾牌，
verses.textEnNiv: He holds success in store for the upright, he is a shield to those whose walk is blameless,
verses.textEnEsv: he stores up sound wisdom for the upright; he is a shield to those who walk in integrity,
verses.textEnNkjv: He stores up sound wisdom for the upright; Heis a shield to those who walk uprightly;
verses.textEnNlt: He grants a treasure of common sense to the honest. He is a shield to those who walk with integrity.
verses.textEnNasb: He stores up sound wisdom for the upright; He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,
verses.textEn: He holds success in store for the upright, he is a shield to those whose walk is blameless,

verses.textZh: 为要看顾正直人的路径， 护卫虔诚人的道路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为要看顾正直人的路径， 护卫虔诚人的道路。
verses.textZhCuv: 为要保守公平人的路， 护庇虔敬人的道。
verses.textEnNiv: for he guards the course of the just and protects the way of his faithful ones.
verses.textEnEsv: guarding the paths of justice and watching over the way of his saints.
verses.textEnNkjv: He guards the paths of justice, And preserves the way of His saints.
verses.textEnNlt: He guards the paths of the just and protects those who are faithful to him.
verses.textEnNasb: Guarding the paths of justice, And He watches over the way of His godly ones.
verses.textEn: for he guards the course of the just and protects the way of his faithful ones.

verses.textZh: 这样，你就明白公义、公正、正直， 以及一切善道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，你就明白公义、公正、正直， 以及一切善道。
verses.textZhCuv: 你也必明白仁义、公平、 正直、一切的善道。
verses.textEnNiv: Then you will understand what is right and just and fair—every good path.
verses.textEnEsv: Then you will understand righteousness and justice and equity, every good path;
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, Equity and every good path.
verses.textEnNlt: Then you will understand what is right, just, and fair, and you will find the right way to go.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you will discern righteousness, justice, And integrity, and every good path.
verses.textEn: Then you will understand what is right and just and fair—every good path.

verses.textZh: 智慧必进入你的心， 知识必使你欢悦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧必进入你的心， 知识必使你欢悦。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧必入你心； 你的灵要以知识为美。
verses.textEnNiv: For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
verses.textEnEsv: for wisdom will come into your heart, and knowledge will be pleasant to your soul;
verses.textEnNkjv: When wisdom enters your heart, And knowledge is pleasant to your soul,
verses.textEnNlt: For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will fill you with joy.
verses.textEnNasb: For wisdom will enter your heart, And knowledge will be delightful to your soul;
verses.textEn: For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

verses.textZh: 明辨的能力必护卫你， 聪明必看顾你；
verses.textZhCnvs: 明辨的能力必护卫你， 聪明必看顾你；
verses.textZhCuv: 谋略必护卫你； 聪明必保守你，
verses.textEnNiv: Discretion will protect you, and understanding will guard you.
verses.textEnEsv: discretion will watch over you, understanding will guard you,
verses.textEnNkjv: Discretion will preserve you; Understanding will keep you,
verses.textEnNlt: Wise choices will watch over you. Understanding will keep you safe.
verses.textEnNasb: Discretion will watch over you, Understanding will guard you,
verses.textEn: Discretion will protect you, and understanding will guard you.

verses.textZh: 要救你脱离邪恶的道路， 脱离说话乖谬的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要救你脱离邪恶的道路， 脱离说话乖谬的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 要救你脱离恶道 ， 脱离说乖谬话的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Wisdom will save you from the ways of wicked men, from men whose words are perverse,
verses.textEnEsv: delivering you from the way of evil, from men of perverted speech,
verses.textEnNkjv: To deliver you from the way of evil, From the man who speaks perverse things,
verses.textEnNlt: Wisdom will save you from evil people, from those whose words are twisted.
verses.textEnNasb: To rescue you from the way of evil, From a person who speaks perverse things;
verses.textEn: Wisdom will save you from the ways of wicked men, from men whose words are perverse,

verses.textZh: 那些人离弃正道， 走上黑暗的道路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些人离弃正道， 走上黑暗的道路。
verses.textZhCuv: 那等人舍弃正直的路， 行走黑暗的道，
verses.textEnNiv: who have left the straight paths to walk in dark ways,
verses.textEnEsv: who forsake the paths of uprightness to walk in the ways of darkness,
verses.textEnNkjv: From those who leave the paths of uprightness To walk in the ways of darkness;
verses.textEnNlt: These men turn from the right way to walk down dark paths.
verses.textEnNasb: From those who leave the paths of uprightness To walk in the ways of darkness;
verses.textEn: who have left the straight paths to walk in dark ways,

verses.textZh: 他们喜欢行恶， 喜悦恶人的乖谬。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们喜欢行恶， 喜悦恶人的乖谬。
verses.textZhCuv: 欢喜作恶， 喜爱恶人的乖僻，
verses.textEnNiv: who delight in doing wrong and rejoice in the perverseness of evil,
verses.textEnEsv: who rejoice in doing evil and delight in the perverseness of evil,
verses.textEnNkjv: Who rejoice in doing evil, And delight in the perversity of the wicked;
verses.textEnNlt: They take pleasure in doing wrong, and they enjoy the twisted ways of evil.
verses.textEnNasb: Who delight in doing evil And rejoice in the perversity of evil;
verses.textEn: who delight in doing wrong and rejoice in the perverseness of evil,

verses.textZh: 他们的道路弯曲， 他们的行径偏离正道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的道路弯曲， 他们的行径偏离正道。
verses.textZhCuv: 在他们的道中弯曲， 在他们的路上偏僻。
verses.textEnNiv: whose paths are crooked and who are devious in their ways.
verses.textEnEsv: men whose paths are crooked, and who are devious in their ways.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whose ways are crooked, And whoare devious in their paths;
verses.textEnNlt: Their actions are crooked, and their ways are wrong.
verses.textEnNasb: Whose paths are crooked, And who are devious in their ways;
verses.textEn: whose paths are crooked and who are devious in their ways.

verses.textZh: 智慧要救你脱离淫妇， 脱离说谄媚话的妓女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧要救你脱离淫妇， 脱离说谄媚话的妓女。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧要救你脱离淫妇， 就是那油嘴滑舌的外女。
verses.textEnNiv: Wisdom will save you also from the adulterous woman, from the wayward woman with her seductive words,
verses.textEnEsv: So you will be delivered from the forbidden woman, from the adulteress with her smooth words,
verses.textEnNkjv: To deliver you from the immoral woman, From the seductress who flatters with her words,
verses.textEnNlt: Wisdom will save you from the immoral woman, from the seductive words of the promiscuous woman.
verses.textEnNasb: To rescue you from the strange woman, From the foreign woman who flatters with her words,
verses.textEn: Wisdom will save you also from the adulterous woman, from the wayward woman with her seductive words,

verses.textZh: 她离弃年轻时的配偶， 忘记了神的约；
verses.textZhCnvs: 她离弃年轻时的配偶， 忘记了神的约；
verses.textZhCuv: 她离弃幼年的配偶， 忘了神的盟约。
verses.textEnNiv: who has left the partner of her youth and ignored the covenant she made before God.
verses.textEnEsv: who forsakes the companion of her youth and forgets the covenant of her God;
verses.textEnNkjv: Who forsakes the companion of her youth, And forgets the covenant of her God.
verses.textEnNlt: She has abandoned her husband and ignores the covenant she made before God.
verses.textEnNasb: Who leaves the companion of her youth And forgets the covenant of her God;
verses.textEn: who has left the partner of her youth and ignored the covenant she made before God.

verses.textZh: 她的家陷入死地， 她的路径下落阴间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她的家陷入死地， 她的路径下落阴间。
verses.textZhCuv: 她的家陷入死地； 她的路偏向阴间。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely her house leads down to death and her paths to the spirits of the dead.
verses.textEnEsv: for her house sinks down to death, and her paths to the departed;
verses.textEnNkjv: For her house leads down to death, And her paths to the dead;
verses.textEnNlt: Entering her house leads to death; it is the road to the grave.
verses.textEnNasb: For her house sinks down to death, And her tracks lead to the dead;
verses.textEn: Surely her house leads down to death and her paths to the spirits of the dead.

verses.textZh: 凡是进到她那里去的，都不能转回， 必得不着生路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是进到她那里去的，都不能转回， 必得不着生路。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡到她那里去的，不得转回， 也得不着生命的路。
verses.textEnNiv: None who go to her return or attain the paths of life.
verses.textEnEsv: none who go to her come back, nor do they regain the paths of life.
verses.textEnNkjv: None who go to her return, Nor do they regain the paths of life—
verses.textEnNlt: The man who visits her is doomed. He will never reach the paths of life.
verses.textEnNasb: None who go to her return, Nor do they reach the paths of life.
verses.textEn: None who go to her return or attain the paths of life.

verses.textZh: 因此，智慧必使你走在良善人的道上， 持守义人的路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，智慧必使你走在良善人的道上， 持守义人的路。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧必使你行善人的道， 守义人的路。
verses.textEnNiv: Thus you will walk in the ways of the good and keep to the paths of the righteous.
verses.textEnEsv: So you will walk in the way of the good and keep to the paths of the righteous.
verses.textEnNkjv: So you may walk in the way of goodness, And keep to the paths of righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: So follow the steps of the good, and stay on the paths of the righteous.
verses.textEnNasb: So you will walk in the way of good people And keep to the paths of the righteous.
verses.textEn: Thus you will walk in the ways of the good and keep to the paths of the righteous.

verses.textZh: 因为正直人必在地上安居， 完全人必在世上存留；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为正直人必在地上安居， 完全人必在世上存留；
verses.textZhCuv: 正直人必在世上居住； 完全人必在地上存留。
verses.textEnNiv: For the upright will live in the land, and the blameless will remain in it;
verses.textEnEsv: For the upright will inhabit the land, and those with integrity will remain in it,
verses.textEnNkjv: For the upright will dwell in the land, And the blameless will remain in it;
verses.textEnNlt: For only the godly will live in the land, and those with integrity will remain in it.
verses.textEnNasb: For the upright will live in the land, And the blameless will remain in it;
verses.textEn: For the upright will live in the land, and the blameless will remain in it;

verses.textZh: 但恶人必从地上除灭， 行事奸诈的必从世上拔除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但恶人必从地上除灭， 行事奸诈的必从世上拔除。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有恶人必然剪除； 奸诈的，必然拔出。
verses.textEnNiv: but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the unfaithful will be torn from it.
verses.textEnEsv: but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the treacherous will be rooted out of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the wicked will be cut off from the earth, And the unfaithful will be uprooted from it.
verses.textEnNlt: But the wicked will be removed from the land, and the treacherous will be uprooted.
verses.textEnNasb: But the wicked will be eliminated from the land, And the treacherous will be torn away from it.
verses.textEn: but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the unfaithful will be torn from it.

verses.textZh: 我儿，不可忘记我的训诲， 你的心要谨守我的诫命；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我儿，不可忘记我的训诲， 你的心要谨守我的诫命；
verses.textZhCuv: 我儿，不要忘记我的法则 ； 你心要谨守我的诫命；
verses.textEnNiv: My son, do not forget my teaching, but keep my commands in your heart,
verses.textEnEsv: My son, do not forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments,
verses.textEnNkjv: My son, do not forget my law, But let your heart keep my commands;
verses.textEnNlt: My child, never forget the things I have taught you. Store my commands in your heart.
verses.textEnNasb: My son, do not forget my teaching, But have your heart comply with my commandments;
verses.textEn: My son, do not forget my teaching, but keep my commands in your heart,

verses.textZh: 因为它们必把长久的日子、生命的岁数和平安，加给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为它们必把长久的日子、生命的岁数和平安，加给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为它必将长久的日子， 生命的年数与平安，加给你。
verses.textEnNiv: for they will prolong your life many years and bring you peace and prosperity.
verses.textEnEsv: for length of days and years of life and peace they will add to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For length of days and long life And peace they will add to you.
verses.textEnNlt: If you do this, you will live many years, and your life will be satisfying.
verses.textEnNasb: For length of days and years of life And peace they will add to you.
verses.textEn: for they will prolong your life many years and bring you peace and prosperity.

verses.textZh: 不可让慈爱诚实离开你， 要系在你的颈项上， 刻在你的心版上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可让慈爱诚实离开你， 要系在你的颈项上， 刻在你的心版上。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可使慈爱、诚实离开你， 要系在你颈项上，刻在你心版上。
verses.textEnNiv: Let love and faithfulness never leave you; bind them around your neck, write them on the tablet of your heart.
verses.textEnEsv: Let not steadfast love and faithfulness forsake you; bind them around your neck; write them on the tablet of your heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let not mercy and truth forsake you; Bind them around your neck, Write them on the tablet of your heart,
verses.textEnNlt: Never let loyalty and kindness leave you! Tie them around your neck as a reminder. Write them deep within your heart.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not let kindness and truth leave you; Bind them around your neck, Write them on the tablet of your heart.
verses.textEn: Let love and faithfulness never leave you; bind them around your neck, write them on the tablet of your heart.

verses.textZh: 这样，你在神和世人眼前， 必蒙恩宠，得着美名 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，你在神和世人眼前， 必蒙恩宠，得着美名 。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，你必在神和世人眼前 蒙恩宠，有聪明。
verses.textEnNiv: Then you will win favor and a good name in the sight of God and man.
verses.textEnEsv: So you will find favor and good success in the sight of God and man.
verses.textEnNkjv: And so find favor and high esteem In the sight of God and man.
verses.textEnNlt: Then you will find favor with both God and people, and you will earn a good reputation.
verses.textEnNasb: So you will find favor and a good reputation In the sight of God and man.
verses.textEn: Then you will win favor and a good name in the sight of God and man.

verses.textZh: 你要一心仰赖耶和华， 不可倚靠自己的聪明；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要一心仰赖耶和华， 不可倚靠自己的聪明；
verses.textZhCuv: 你要专心仰赖耶和华， 不可倚靠自己的聪明，
verses.textEnNiv: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding;
verses.textEnEsv: Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and do not lean on your own understanding.
verses.textEnNkjv: Trust in the Lord with all your heart, And lean not on your own understanding;
verses.textEnNlt: Trust in the Lord with all your heart; do not depend on your own understanding.
verses.textEnNasb: Trust in the Lord with all your heart And do not lean on your own understanding.
verses.textEn: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding;

verses.textZh: 在你一切所行的路上，都要承认他， 他必使你的路径平坦正直。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在你一切所行的路上，都要承认他， 他必使你的路径平坦正直。
verses.textZhCuv: 在你一切所行的事上都要认定他， 他必指引你的路。
verses.textEnNiv: in all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight.
verses.textEnEsv: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make straight your paths.
verses.textEnNkjv: In all your ways acknowledge Him, And He shall direct your paths.
verses.textEnNlt: Seek his will in all you do, and he will show you which path to take.
verses.textEnNasb: In all your ways acknowledge Him, And He will make your paths straight.
verses.textEn: in all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight.

verses.textZh: 不可自以为有智慧， 要敬畏耶和华，远离恶事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可自以为有智慧， 要敬畏耶和华，远离恶事。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要自以为有智慧； 要敬畏耶和华，远离恶事。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be wise in your own eyes; fear the Lord and shun evil.
verses.textEnEsv: Be not wise in your own eyes; fear the Lord , and turn away from evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not be wise in your own eyes; Fear the Lord and depart from evil.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t be impressed with your own wisdom. Instead, fear the Lord and turn away from evil.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not be wise in your own eyes; Fear the Lord and turn away from evil.
verses.textEn: Do not be wise in your own eyes; fear the Lord and shun evil.

verses.textZh: 这必使你的身体健康， 使你的骨头滋润。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这必使你的身体健康， 使你的骨头滋润。
verses.textZhCuv: 这便医治你的肚脐， 滋润你的百骨。
verses.textEnNiv: This will bring health to your body and nourishment to your bones.
verses.textEnEsv: It will be healing to your flesh and refreshment to your bones.
verses.textEnNkjv: It will be health to your flesh, And strength to your bones.
verses.textEnNlt: Then you will have healing for your body and strength for your bones.
verses.textEnNasb: It will be healing to your body And refreshment to your bones.
verses.textEn: This will bring health to your body and nourishment to your bones.

verses.textZh: 你要把你的财物， 和一切初熟的农作物，敬奉耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把你的财物， 和一切初熟的农作物，敬奉耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要以财物 和一切初熟的土产尊荣耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Honor the Lord with your wealth, with the firstfruits of all your crops;
verses.textEnEsv: Honor the Lord with your wealth and with the firstfruits of all your produce;
verses.textEnNkjv: Honor the Lord with your possessions, And with the firstfruits of all your increase;
verses.textEnNlt: Honor the Lord with your wealth and with the best part of everything you produce.
verses.textEnNasb: Honor the Lord from your wealth, And from the first of all your produce;
verses.textEn: Honor the Lord with your wealth, with the firstfruits of all your crops;

verses.textZh: 这样，你的仓库必充满有余， 你的榨酒池也必盈溢新酒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，你的仓库必充满有余， 你的榨酒池也必盈溢新酒。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，你的仓房必充满有余； 你的酒榨有新酒盈溢。
verses.textEnNiv: then your barns will be filled to overflowing, and your vats will brim over with new wine.
verses.textEnEsv: then your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will be bursting with wine.
verses.textEnNkjv: So your barns will be filled with plenty, And your vats will overflow with new wine.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he will fill your barns with grain, and your vats will overflow with good wine.
verses.textEnNasb: Then your barns will be filled with plenty, And your vats will overflow with new wine.
verses.textEn: then your barns will be filled to overflowing, and your vats will brim over with new wine.

verses.textZh: 我儿，不可轻看耶和华的管教， 也不可厌恶他的责备；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我儿，不可轻看耶和华的管教， 也不可厌恶他的责备；
verses.textZhCuv: 我儿，你不可轻看耶和华的管教 ， 也不可厌烦他的责备；
verses.textEnNiv: My son, do not despise the Lord ’s discipline, and do not resent his rebuke,
verses.textEnEsv: My son, do not despise the Lord ’s discipline or be weary of his reproof,
verses.textEnNkjv: My son, do not despise the chastening of the Lord, Nor detest His correction;
verses.textEnNlt: My child, don’t reject the Lord ’s discipline, and don’t be upset when he corrects you.
verses.textEnNasb: My son, do not reject the discipline of the Lord Or loathe His rebuke,
verses.textEn: My son, do not despise the Lord ’s discipline, and do not resent his rebuke,

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华所爱的，他必责备， 正如父亲责备他喜爱的儿子一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华所爱的，他必责备， 正如父亲责备他喜爱的儿子一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华所爱的，他必责备， 正如父亲责备所喜爱的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: because the Lord disciplines those he loves, as a father the son he delights in.
verses.textEnEsv: for the Lord reproves him whom he loves, as a father the son in whom he delights.
verses.textEnNkjv: For whom the Lord loves He corrects, Just as a father the son inwhom he delights.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord corrects those he loves, just as a father corrects a child in whom he delights.
verses.textEnNasb: For whom the Lord loves He disciplines, Just as a father disciplines the son in whom he delights.
verses.textEn: because the Lord disciplines those he loves, as a father the son he delights in.

verses.textZh: 得着智慧， 获致聪明的人，是有福的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 得着智慧， 获致聪明的人，是有福的。
verses.textZhCuv: 得智慧，得聪明的， 这人便为有福。
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed are those who find wisdom, those who gain understanding,
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed is the one who finds wisdom, and the one who gets understanding,
verses.textEnNkjv: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, And the man who gains understanding;
verses.textEnNlt: Joyful is the person who finds wisdom, the one who gains understanding.
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed is a person who finds wisdom, And one who obtains understanding.
verses.textEn: Blessed are those who find wisdom, those who gain understanding,

verses.textZh: 因为智慧的利润胜过银子的利润， 智慧的收益胜过黄金的收益。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为智慧的利润胜过银子的利润， 智慧的收益胜过黄金的收益。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为得智慧胜过得银子， 其利益强如精金，
verses.textEnNiv: for she is more profitable than silver and yields better returns than gold.
verses.textEnEsv: for the gain from her is better than gain from silver and her profit better than gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: For her proceeds are better than the profits of silver, And her gain than fine gold.
verses.textEnNlt: For wisdom is more profitable than silver, and her wages are better than gold.
verses.textEnNasb: For her profit is better than the profit of silver, And her produce better than gold.
verses.textEn: for she is more profitable than silver and yields better returns than gold.

verses.textZh: 智慧比红宝石更宝贵； 你一切所喜爱的，都不足与智慧比较。
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧比红宝石更宝贵； 你一切所喜爱的，都不足与智慧比较。
verses.textZhCuv: 比珍珠 宝贵； 你一切所喜爱的，都不足与比较。
verses.textEnNiv: She is more precious than rubies; nothing you desire can compare with her.
verses.textEnEsv: She is more precious than jewels, and nothing you desire can compare with her.
verses.textEnNkjv: She is more precious than rubies, And all the things you may desire cannot compare with her.
verses.textEnNlt: Wisdom is more precious than rubies; nothing you desire can compare with her.
verses.textEnNasb: She is more precious than jewels, And nothing you desire compares with her.
verses.textEn: She is more precious than rubies; nothing you desire can compare with her.

verses.textZh: 智慧的右手有长寿， 左手有财富和尊荣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧的右手有长寿， 左手有财富和尊荣。
verses.textZhCuv: 她右手有长寿， 左手有富贵。
verses.textEnNiv: Long life is in her right hand; in her left hand are riches and honor.
verses.textEnEsv: Long life is in her right hand; in her left hand are riches and honor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Length of days is in her right hand, In her left hand riches and honor.
verses.textEnNlt: She offers you long life in her right hand, and riches and honor in her left.
verses.textEnNasb: Long life is in her right hand; In her left hand are riches and honor.
verses.textEn: Long life is in her right hand; in her left hand are riches and honor.

verses.textZh: 智慧的道路尽是欢悦， 智慧的路径全是平安。
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧的道路尽是欢悦， 智慧的路径全是平安。
verses.textZhCuv: 她的道是安乐； 她的路全是平安。
verses.textEnNiv: Her ways are pleasant ways, and all her paths are peace.
verses.textEnEsv: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, And all her paths are peace.
verses.textEnNlt: She will guide you down delightful paths; all her ways are satisfying.
verses.textEnNasb: Her ways are pleasant ways, And all her paths are peace.
verses.textEn: Her ways are pleasant ways, and all her paths are peace.

verses.textZh: 对紧握智慧的人来说，智慧是生命树， 凡是紧抓智慧的，都是有福的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对紧握智慧的人来说，智慧是生命树， 凡是紧抓智慧的，都是有福的。
verses.textZhCuv: 她与持守她的作生命树； 持定她的，俱各有福。
verses.textEnNiv: She is a tree of life to those who take hold of her; those who hold her fast will be blessed.
verses.textEnEsv: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her; those who hold her fast are called blessed.
verses.textEnNkjv: She is a tree of life to those who take hold of her, And happy areall who retain her.
verses.textEnNlt: Wisdom is a tree of life to those who embrace her; happy are those who hold her tightly.
verses.textEnNasb: She is a tree of life to those who take hold of her, And happy are those who hold on to her.
verses.textEn: She is a tree of life to those who take hold of her; those who hold her fast will be blessed.

verses.textZh: 耶和华以智慧奠定大地， 以聪明坚立高天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华以智慧奠定大地， 以聪明坚立高天。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华以智慧立地， 以聪明定天，
verses.textEnNiv: By wisdom the Lord laid the earth’s foundations, by understanding he set the heavens in place;
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord by wisdom founded the earth; by understanding he established the heavens;
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord by wisdom founded the earth; By understanding He established the heavens;
verses.textEnNlt: By wisdom the Lord founded the earth; by understanding he created the heavens.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord founded the earth by wisdom, He established the heavens by understanding.
verses.textEn: By wisdom the Lord laid the earth’s foundations, by understanding he set the heavens in place;

verses.textZh: 因他的知识，深渊就裂开， 天空也滴下甘露。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因他的知识，深渊就裂开， 天空也滴下甘露。
verses.textZhCuv: 以知识使深渊裂开， 使天空滴下甘露。
verses.textEnNiv: by his knowledge the watery depths were divided, and the clouds let drop the dew.
verses.textEnEsv: by his knowledge the deeps broke open, and the clouds drop down the dew.
verses.textEnNkjv: By His knowledge the depths were broken up, And clouds drop down the dew.
verses.textEnNlt: By his knowledge the deep fountains of the earth burst forth, and the dew settles beneath the night sky.
verses.textEnNasb: By His knowledge the ocean depths were burst open, And the clouds drip with dew.
verses.textEn: by his knowledge the watery depths were divided, and the clouds let drop the dew.

verses.textZh: 我儿，要谨守大智慧和明辨的态度， 不可让它们离开你的眼目。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我儿，要谨守大智慧和明辨的态度， 不可让它们离开你的眼目。
verses.textZhCuv: 我儿，要谨守真智慧和谋略， 不可使她离开你的眼目。
verses.textEnNiv: My son, do not let wisdom and understanding out of your sight, preserve sound judgment and discretion;
verses.textEnEsv: My son, do not lose sight of these— keep sound wisdom and discretion,
verses.textEnNkjv: My son, let them not depart from your eyes— Keep sound wisdom and discretion;
verses.textEnNlt: My child, don’t lose sight of common sense and discernment. Hang on to them,
verses.textEnNasb: My son, see that they do not escape from your sight; Comply with sound wisdom and discretion,
verses.textEn: My son, do not let wisdom and understanding out of your sight, preserve sound judgment and discretion;

verses.textZh: 这样，它们就必作你的生命， 作你颈上的华饰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，它们就必作你的生命， 作你颈上的华饰。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，她必作你的生命， 颈项的美饰。
verses.textEnNiv: they will be life for you, an ornament to grace your neck.
verses.textEnEsv: and they will be life for your soul and adornment for your neck.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they will be life to your soul And grace to your neck.
verses.textEnNlt: for they will refresh your soul. They are like jewels on a necklace.
verses.textEnNasb: And they will be life to your soul And adornment to your neck.
verses.textEn: they will be life for you, an ornament to grace your neck.

verses.textZh: 你就可以安然走路， 你的脚必不致绊倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你就可以安然走路， 你的脚必不致绊倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 你就坦然行路， 不致碰脚。
verses.textEnNiv: Then you will go on your way in safety, and your foot will not stumble.
verses.textEnEsv: Then you will walk on your way securely, and your foot will not stumble.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you will walk safely in your way, And your foot will not stumble.
verses.textEnNlt: They keep you safe on your way, and your feet will not stumble.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you will walk in your way securely, And your foot will not stumble.
verses.textEn: Then you will go on your way in safety, and your foot will not stumble.

verses.textZh: 你躺下的时候，必不会惊恐； 你躺卧的时候，必睡得香甜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你躺下的时候，必不会惊恐； 你躺卧的时候，必睡得香甜。
verses.textZhCuv: 你躺下，必不惧怕； 你躺卧，睡得香甜。
verses.textEnNiv: When you lie down, you will not be afraid; when you lie down, your sleep will be sweet.
verses.textEnEsv: If you lie down, you will not be afraid; when you lie down, your sleep will be sweet.
verses.textEnNkjv: When you lie down, you will not be afraid; Yes, you will lie down and your sleep will be sweet.
verses.textEnNlt: You can go to bed without fear; you will lie down and sleep soundly.
verses.textEnNasb: When you lie down, you will not be afraid; When you lie down, your sleep will be sweet.
verses.textEn: When you lie down, you will not be afraid; when you lie down, your sleep will be sweet.

verses.textZh: 忽然而来的惊恐，你不要惧怕； 恶人的毁灭临到，你也不要恐惧；
verses.textZhCnvs: 忽然而来的惊恐，你不要惧怕； 恶人的毁灭临到，你也不要恐惧；
verses.textZhCuv: 忽然来的惊恐，不要害怕； 恶人遭毁灭，也不要恐惧。
verses.textEnNiv: Have no fear of sudden disaster or of the ruin that overtakes the wicked,
verses.textEnEsv: Do not be afraid of sudden terror or of the ruin of the wicked, when it comes,
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not be afraid of sudden terror, Nor of trouble from the wicked when it comes;
verses.textEnNlt: You need not be afraid of sudden disaster or the destruction that comes upon the wicked,
verses.textEnNasb: Do not be afraid of sudden danger, Nor of trouble from the wicked when it comes;
verses.textEn: Have no fear of sudden disaster or of the ruin that overtakes the wicked,

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华是你的倚靠， 他必护卫你的脚不陷入网罗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华是你的倚靠， 他必护卫你的脚不陷入网罗。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华是你所倚靠的； 他必保守你的脚不陷入网罗。
verses.textEnNiv: for the Lord will be at your side and will keep your foot from being snared.
verses.textEnEsv: for the Lord will be your confidence and will keep your foot from being caught.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord will be your confidence, And will keep your foot from being caught.
verses.textEnNlt: for the Lord is your security. He will keep your foot from being caught in a trap.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord will be your confidence, And will keep your foot from being caught.
verses.textEn: for the Lord will be at your side and will keep your foot from being snared.

verses.textZh: 如果你的手有行善的力量，就不可推辞， 要向那些需要帮助的人行善。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你的手有行善的力量，就不可推辞， 要向那些需要帮助的人行善。
verses.textZhCuv: 你手若有行善的力量，不可推辞， 就当向那应得的人施行。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in your power to act.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in your power to do it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due, When it is in the power of your hand to do so.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not withhold good from those who deserve it when it’s in your power to help them.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due, When it is in your power to do it.
verses.textEn: Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in your power to act.

verses.textZh: 你那里如果有现成的， 就不可对邻舍说： "你先回去，明天再来吧，到时，我必给你！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你那里如果有现成的， 就不可对邻舍说： "你先回去，明天再来吧，到时，我必给你！"
verses.textZhCuv: 你那里若有现成的，不可对邻舍说： 去吧，明天再来，我必给你。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not say to your neighbor, "Come back tomorrow and I’ll give it to you"— when you already have it with you.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not say to your neighbor, "Go, and come again, tomorrow I will give it"—when you have it with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not say to your neighbor, "Go, and come back, And tomorrow I will give it," When you have it with you.
verses.textEnNlt: If you can help your neighbor now, don’t say, "Come back tomorrow, and then I’ll help you."
verses.textEnNasb: Do not say to your neighbor, "Go, and come back, And tomorrow I will give it to you," When you have it with you.
verses.textEn: Do not say to your neighbor, "Come back tomorrow and I’ll give it to you"— when you already have it with you.

verses.textZh: 你的邻舍在你旁边安居， 你不可设计害他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的邻舍在你旁边安居， 你不可设计害他。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的邻舍既在你附近安居， 你不可设计害他。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not plot harm against your neighbor, who lives trustfully near you.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not plan evil against your neighbor, who dwells trustingly beside you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not devise evil against your neighbor, For he dwells by you for safety’s sake.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t plot harm against your neighbor, for those who live nearby trust you.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not devise harm against your neighbor, While he lives securely beside you.
verses.textEn: Do not plot harm against your neighbor, who lives trustfully near you.

verses.textZh: 如果人没有加害于你， 你不可无故与他相争。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果人没有加害于你， 你不可无故与他相争。
verses.textZhCuv: 人未曾加害与你， 不可无故与他相争。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not accuse anyone for no reason— when they have done you no harm.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not contend with a man for no reason, when he has done you no harm.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not strive with a man without cause, If he has done you no harm.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t pick a fight without reason, when no one has done you harm.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not contend with a person for no reason, If he has done you no harm.
verses.textEn: Do not accuse anyone for no reason— when they have done you no harm.

verses.textZh: 不要嫉妒强暴的人， 也不可选择他所行的一切道路；
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要嫉妒强暴的人， 也不可选择他所行的一切道路；
verses.textZhCuv: 不可嫉妒强暴的人， 也不可选择他所行的路。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not envy the violent or choose any of their ways.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not envy a man of violence and do not choose any of his ways,
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not envy the oppressor, And choose none of his ways;
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t envy violent people or copy their ways.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not envy a violent person, And do not choose any of his ways.
verses.textEn: Do not envy the violent or choose any of their ways.

verses.textZh: 因为偏离正道的人，是耶和华所厌恶的， 正直人却是他所亲爱的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为偏离正道的人，是耶和华所厌恶的， 正直人却是他所亲爱的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，乖僻人为耶和华所憎恶； 正直人为他所亲密。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord detests the perverse but takes the upright into his confidence.
verses.textEnEsv: for the devious person is an abomination to the Lord , but the upright are in his confidence.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the perverse personis an abomination to the Lord, But His secret counsel is with the upright.
verses.textEnNlt: Such wicked people are detestable to the Lord , but he offers his friendship to the godly.
verses.textEnNasb: For the devious are an abomination to the Lord; But He is intimate with the upright.
verses.textEn: For the Lord detests the perverse but takes the upright into his confidence.

verses.textZh: 耶和华咒诅恶人的家， 却赐福给义人的居所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华咒诅恶人的家， 却赐福给义人的居所。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华咒诅恶人的家庭， 赐福与义人的居所。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord ’s curse is on the house of the wicked, but he blesses the home of the righteous.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord ’s curse is on the house of the wicked, but he blesses the dwelling of the righteous.
verses.textEnNkjv: The curse of the Lordis on the house of the wicked, But He blesses the home of the just.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord curses the house of the wicked, but he blesses the home of the upright.
verses.textEnNasb: The curse of the Lord is on the house of the wicked, But He blesses the home of the righteous.
verses.textEn: The Lord ’s curse is on the house of the wicked, but he blesses the home of the righteous.

verses.textZh: 他讥笑那些好讥笑的人， 却赐恩给谦卑的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他讥笑那些好讥笑的人， 却赐恩给谦卑的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他讥诮那好讥诮的人， 赐恩给谦卑的人。
verses.textEnNiv: He mocks proud mockers but shows favor to the humble and oppressed.
verses.textEnEsv: Toward the scorners he is scornful, but to the humble he gives favor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely He scorns the scornful, But gives grace to the humble.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord mocks the mockers but is gracious to the humble.
verses.textEnNasb: Though He scoffs at the scoffers, Yet He gives grace to the needy.
verses.textEn: He mocks proud mockers but shows favor to the humble and oppressed.

verses.textZh: 智慧人必承受尊荣， 愚昧人必蒙受羞辱 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧人必承受尊荣， 愚昧人必蒙受羞辱 。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧人必承受尊荣； 愚昧人高升也成为羞辱。
verses.textEnNiv: The wise inherit honor, but fools get only shame.
verses.textEnEsv: The wise will inherit honor, but fools get disgrace.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wise shall inherit glory, But shame shall be the legacy of fools.
verses.textEnNlt: The wise inherit honor, but fools are put to shame!
verses.textEnNasb: The wise will inherit honor, But fools increase dishonor.
verses.textEn: The wise inherit honor, but fools get only shame.

verses.textZh: 孩子们，要听父亲的教训， 留心学习哲理；
verses.textZhCnvs: 孩子们，要听父亲的教训， 留心学习哲理；
verses.textZhCuv: 众子啊，要听父亲的教训， 留心得知聪明。
verses.textEnNiv: Listen, my sons, to a father’s instruction; pay attention and gain understanding.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear, O sons, a father’s instruction, and be attentive, that you may gain insight,
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear, my children, the instruction of a father, And give attention to know understanding;
verses.textEnNlt: My children, listen when your father corrects you. Pay attention and learn good judgment,
verses.textEnNasb: Listen, my sons, to the instruction of a father, And pay attention so that you may gain understanding,
verses.textEn: Listen, my sons, to a father’s instruction; pay attention and gain understanding.

verses.textZh: 因为我授予你们的，是美好的学问， 我的训诲，你们不可离弃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我授予你们的，是美好的学问， 我的训诲，你们不可离弃。
verses.textZhCuv: 因我所给你们的是好教训； 不可离弃我的法则 。
verses.textEnNiv: I give you sound learning, so do not forsake my teaching.
verses.textEnEsv: for I give you good precepts; do not forsake my teaching.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I give you good doctrine: Do not forsake my law.
verses.textEnNlt: for I am giving you good guidance. Don’t turn away from my instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: For I give you good teaching; Do not abandon my instruction.
verses.textEn: I give you sound learning, so do not forsake my teaching.

verses.textZh: 我在我父亲面前还是小孩子， 在我母亲面前是独一的娇儿的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在我父亲面前还是小孩子， 在我母亲面前是独一的娇儿的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 我在父亲面前为孝子， 在母亲眼中为独一的娇儿。
verses.textEnNiv: For I too was a son to my father, still tender, and cherished by my mother.
verses.textEnEsv: When I was a son with my father, tender, the only one in the sight of my mother,
verses.textEnNkjv: When I was my father’s son, Tender and the only one in the sight of my mother,
verses.textEnNlt: For I, too, was once my father’s son, tenderly loved as my mother’s only child.
verses.textEnNasb: When I was a son to my father, Tender and the only son in the sight of my mother,
verses.textEn: For I too was a son to my father, still tender, and cherished by my mother.

verses.textZh: 父亲教导我，对我说： "你的心要持守我的话， 你要遵守我的诫命，就可以存活；
verses.textZhCnvs: 父亲教导我，对我说： "你的心要持守我的话， 你要遵守我的诫命，就可以存活；
verses.textZhCuv: 父亲教训我说：你心要存记我的言语， 遵守我的命令，便得存活。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he taught me, and he said to me, "Take hold of my words with all your heart; keep my commands, and you will live.
verses.textEnEsv: he taught me and said to me, "Let your heart hold fast my words; keep my commandments, and live.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also taught me, and said to me: "Let your heart retain my words; Keep my commands, and live.
verses.textEnNlt: My father taught me, "Take my words to heart. Follow my commands, and you will live.
verses.textEnNasb: He taught me and said to me, "Let your heart take hold of my words; Keep my commandments and live;
verses.textEn: Then he taught me, and he said to me, "Take hold of my words with all your heart; keep my commands, and you will live.

verses.textZh: 要求取智慧和哲理， 不可忘记，也不可偏离我口中的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要求取智慧和哲理， 不可忘记，也不可偏离我口中的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 要得智慧，要得聪明，不可忘记， 也不可偏离我口中的言语。
verses.textEnNiv: Get wisdom, get understanding; do not forget my words or turn away from them.
verses.textEnEsv: Get wisdom; get insight; do not forget, and do not turn away from the words of my mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Get wisdom! Get understanding! Do not forget, nor turn away from the words of my mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: Get wisdom; develop good judgment. Don’t forget my words or turn away from them.
verses.textEnNasb: Acquire wisdom! Acquire understanding! Do not forget nor turn away from the words of my mouth.
verses.textEn: Get wisdom, get understanding; do not forget my words or turn away from them.

verses.textZh: 不可离弃智慧，智慧就必护卫你； 喜爱智慧，智慧就必看顾你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可离弃智慧，智慧就必护卫你； 喜爱智慧，智慧就必看顾你。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可离弃智慧，智慧就护卫你； 要爱她，她就保守你。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not forsake wisdom, and she will protect you; love her, and she will watch over you.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not forsake her, and she will keep you; love her, and she will guard you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not forsake her, and she will preserve you; Love her, and she will keep you.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t turn your back on wisdom, for she will protect you. Love her, and she will guard you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Do not abandon her, and she will guard you; Love her, and she will watch over you.
verses.textEn: Do not forsake wisdom, and she will protect you; love her, and she will watch over you.

verses.textZh: 智慧的开端 是求取智慧， 要用你所得的一切换取哲理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧的开端 是求取智慧， 要用你所得的一切换取哲理。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧为首； 所以，要得智慧。 在你一切所得之内必得聪明 。
verses.textEnNiv: The beginning of wisdom is this: Get wisdom. Though it cost all you have, get understanding.
verses.textEnEsv: The beginning of wisdom is this: Get wisdom, and whatever you get, get insight.
verses.textEnNkjv: Wisdom is the principal thing; Therefore get wisdom. And in all your getting, get understanding.
verses.textEnNlt: Getting wisdom is the wisest thing you can do! And whatever else you do, develop good judgment.
verses.textEnNasb: "The beginning of wisdom is: Acquire wisdom; And with all your possessions, acquire understanding.
verses.textEn: The beginning of wisdom is this: Get wisdom. Though it cost all you have, get understanding.

verses.textZh: 你要高举智慧，智慧就必使你高升； 你要怀抱智慧，智慧就必使你得尊荣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要高举智慧，智慧就必使你高升； 你要怀抱智慧，智慧就必使你得尊荣。
verses.textZhCuv: 高举智慧，她就使你高升； 怀抱智慧，她就使你尊荣。
verses.textEnNiv: Cherish her, and she will exalt you; embrace her, and she will honor you.
verses.textEnEsv: Prize her highly, and she will exalt you; she will honor you if you embrace her.
verses.textEnNkjv: Exalt her, and she will promote you; She will bring you honor, when you embrace her.
verses.textEnNlt: If you prize wisdom, she will make you great. Embrace her, and she will honor you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Prize her, and she will exalt you; She will honor you if you embrace her.
verses.textEn: Cherish her, and she will exalt you; embrace her, and she will honor you.

verses.textZh: 智慧必把华冠加在你头上， 把荣冕赐给你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧必把华冠加在你头上， 把荣冕赐给你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 她必将华冠加在你头上， 把荣冕交给你。
verses.textEnNiv: She will give you a garland to grace your head and present you with a glorious crown."
verses.textEnEsv: She will place on your head a graceful garland; she will bestow on you a beautiful crown."
verses.textEnNkjv: She will place on your head an ornament of grace; A crown of glory she will deliver to you."
verses.textEnNlt: She will place a lovely wreath on your head; she will present you with a beautiful crown."
verses.textEnNasb: "She will place on your head a garland of grace; She will present you with a crown of beauty."
verses.textEn: She will give you a garland to grace your head and present you with a glorious crown."

verses.textZh: 我儿，你要听，并要接受我所说的， 这样，你就必延年益寿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我儿，你要听，并要接受我所说的， 这样，你就必延年益寿。
verses.textZhCuv: 我儿，你要听受我的言语， 就必延年益寿。
verses.textEnNiv: Listen, my son, accept what I say, and the years of your life will be many.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear, my son, and accept my words, that the years of your life may be many.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear, my son, and receive my sayings, And the years of your life will be many.
verses.textEnNlt: My child, listen to me and do as I say, and you will have a long, good life.
verses.textEnNasb: Listen, my son, and accept my sayings, And the years of your life will be many.
verses.textEn: Listen, my son, accept what I say, and the years of your life will be many.

verses.textZh: 我指教你走智慧的道， 引导你行正直的路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我指教你走智慧的道， 引导你行正直的路。
verses.textZhCuv: 我已指教你走智慧的道， 引导你行正直的路。
verses.textEnNiv: I instruct you in the way of wisdom and lead you along straight paths.
verses.textEnEsv: I have taught you the way of wisdom; I have led you in the paths of uprightness.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have taught you in the way of wisdom; I have led you in right paths.
verses.textEnNlt: I will teach you wisdom’s ways and lead you in straight paths.
verses.textEnNasb: I have instructed you in the way of wisdom; I have led you in upright paths.
verses.textEn: I instruct you in the way of wisdom and lead you along straight paths.

verses.textZh: 你行走的时候，脚步必不会受阻碍； 你奔跑的时候，也不会跌倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你行走的时候，脚步必不会受阻碍； 你奔跑的时候，也不会跌倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 你行走，脚步必不致狭窄； 你奔跑，也不致跌倒。
verses.textEnNiv: When you walk, your steps will not be hampered; when you run, you will not stumble.
verses.textEnEsv: When you walk, your step will not be hampered, and if you run, you will not stumble.
verses.textEnNkjv: When you walk, your steps will not be hindered, And when you run, you will not stumble.
verses.textEnNlt: When you walk, you won’t be held back; when you run, you won’t stumble.
verses.textEnNasb: When you walk, your steps will not be hampered; And if you run, you will not stumble.
verses.textEn: When you walk, your steps will not be hampered; when you run, you will not stumble.

verses.textZh: 你要坚守教训，不可放松； 要谨守教训，因为那是你的生命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要坚守教训，不可放松； 要谨守教训，因为那是你的生命。
verses.textZhCuv: 要持定训诲，不可放松； 必当谨守，因为它是你的生命。
verses.textEnNiv: Hold on to instruction, do not let it go; guard it well, for it is your life.
verses.textEnEsv: Keep hold of instruction; do not let go; guard her, for she is your life.
verses.textEnNkjv: Take firm hold of instruction, do not let go; Keep her, for she is your life.
verses.textEnNlt: Take hold of my instructions; don’t let them go. Guard them, for they are the key to life.
verses.textEnNasb: Take hold of instruction; do not let go. Guard her, for she is your life.
verses.textEn: Hold on to instruction, do not let it go; guard it well, for it is your life.

verses.textZh: 不可走进恶人的路径， 不可踏上坏人的道路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可走进恶人的路径， 不可踏上坏人的道路。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可行恶人的路； 不要走坏人的道。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not set foot on the path of the wicked or walk in the way of evildoers.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not enter the path of the wicked, and do not walk in the way of the evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not enter the path of the wicked, And do not walk in the way of evil.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t do as the wicked do, and don’t follow the path of evildoers.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not enter the path of the wicked And do not proceed in the way of evil people.
verses.textEn: Do not set foot on the path of the wicked or walk in the way of evildoers.

verses.textZh: 要躲避，不可从那里经过， 要转身离去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要躲避，不可从那里经过， 要转身离去。
verses.textZhCuv: 要躲避，不可经过； 要转身而去。
verses.textEnNiv: Avoid it, do not travel on it; turn from it and go on your way.
verses.textEnEsv: Avoid it; do not go on it; turn away from it and pass on.
verses.textEnNkjv: Avoid it, do not travel on it; Turn away from it and pass on.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t even think about it; don’t go that way. Turn away and keep moving.
verses.textEnNasb: Avoid it, do not pass by it; Turn away from it and pass on.
verses.textEn: Avoid it, do not travel on it; turn from it and go on your way.

verses.textZh: 因为他们不行恶，就不能入睡； 不使人跌倒，就要失眠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们不行恶，就不能入睡； 不使人跌倒，就要失眠。
verses.textZhCuv: 这等人若不行恶，不得睡觉； 不使人跌倒，睡卧不安；
verses.textEnNiv: For they cannot rest until they do evil; they are robbed of sleep till they make someone stumble.
verses.textEnEsv: For they cannot sleep unless they have done wrong; they are robbed of sleep unless they have made someone stumble.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they do not sleep unless they have done evil; And their sleep is taken away unless they make someone fall.
verses.textEnNlt: For evil people can’t sleep until they’ve done their evil deed for the day. They can’t rest until they’ve caused someone to stumble.
verses.textEnNasb: For they cannot sleep unless they do evil; And they are robbed of sleep unless they make someone stumble.
verses.textEn: For they cannot rest until they do evil; they are robbed of sleep till they make someone stumble.

verses.textZh: 他们吃的，是奸恶的饭； 他们喝的，是强暴的酒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们吃的，是奸恶的饭； 他们喝的，是强暴的酒。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们以奸恶吃饼， 以强暴喝酒。
verses.textEnNiv: They eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.
verses.textEnEsv: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they eat the bread of wickedness, And drink the wine of violence.
verses.textEnNlt: They eat the food of wickedness and drink the wine of violence!
verses.textEnNasb: For they eat the bread of wickedness, And drink the wine of violence.
verses.textEn: They eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.

verses.textZh: 义人的路径却像黎明的曙光， 越来越明亮，直到日午。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人的路径却像黎明的曙光， 越来越明亮，直到日午。
verses.textZhCuv: 但义人的路好像黎明的光， 越照越明，直到日午。
verses.textEnNiv: The path of the righteous is like the morning sun, shining ever brighter till the full light of day.
verses.textEnEsv: But the path of the righteous is like the light of dawn, which shines brighter and brighter until full day.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the path of the just is like the shining sun, That shines ever brighter unto the perfect day.
verses.textEnNlt: The way of the righteous is like the first gleam of dawn, which shines ever brighter until the full light of day.
verses.textEnNasb: But the path of the righteous is like the light of dawn That shines brighter and brighter until the full day.
verses.textEn: The path of the righteous is like the morning sun, shining ever brighter till the full light of day.

verses.textZh: 恶人的道路幽暗， 他们不知道自己因甚么跌倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人的道路幽暗， 他们不知道自己因甚么跌倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人的道好像幽暗， 自己不知因什么跌倒。
verses.textEnNiv: But the way of the wicked is like deep darkness; they do not know what makes them stumble.
verses.textEnEsv: The way of the wicked is like deep darkness; they do not know over what they stumble.
verses.textEnNkjv: The way of the wicked is like darkness; They do not know what makes them stumble.
verses.textEnNlt: But the way of the wicked is like total darkness. They have no idea what they are stumbling over.
verses.textEnNasb: The way of the wicked is like darkness; They do not know over what they stumble.
verses.textEn: But the way of the wicked is like deep darkness; they do not know what makes them stumble.

verses.textZh: 我儿，要留心听我的话， 侧耳听我所说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我儿，要留心听我的话， 侧耳听我所说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我儿，要留心听我的言词， 侧耳听我的话语，
verses.textEnNiv: My son, pay attention to what I say; turn your ear to my words.
verses.textEnEsv: My son, be attentive to my words; incline your ear to my sayings.
verses.textEnNkjv: My son, give attention to my words; Incline your ear to my sayings.
verses.textEnNlt: My child, pay attention to what I say. Listen carefully to my words.
verses.textEnNasb: My son, pay attention to my words; Incline your ear to my sayings.
verses.textEn: My son, pay attention to what I say; turn your ear to my words.

verses.textZh: 不可让它们离开你的眼目， 要谨记在你的心中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可让它们离开你的眼目， 要谨记在你的心中。
verses.textZhCuv: 都不可离你的眼目， 要存记在你心中。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not let them out of your sight, keep them within your heart;
verses.textEnEsv: Let them not escape from your sight; keep them within your heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not let them depart from your eyes; Keep them in the midst of your heart;
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t lose sight of them. Let them penetrate deep into your heart,
verses.textEnNasb: They are not to escape from your sight; Keep them in the midst of your heart.
verses.textEn: Do not let them out of your sight, keep them within your heart;

verses.textZh: 因为得着它们就是得着生命， 整个人也得着医治。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为得着它们就是得着生命， 整个人也得着医治。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为得着它的，就得了生命， 又得了医全体的良药。
verses.textEnNiv: for they are life to those who find them and health to one’s whole body.
verses.textEnEsv: For they are life to those who find them, and healing to all their flesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they are life to those who find them, And health to all their flesh.
verses.textEnNlt: for they bring life to those who find them, and healing to their whole body.
verses.textEnNasb: For they are life to those who find them, And healing to all their body.
verses.textEn: for they are life to those who find them and health to one’s whole body.

verses.textZh: 你要谨守你的心，胜过谨守一切， 因为生命的泉源由此而出。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要谨守你的心，胜过谨守一切， 因为生命的泉源由此而出。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要保守你心，胜过保守一切 ， 因为一生的果效是由心发出。
verses.textEnNiv: Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it.
