verses.textEnEsv: Keep your heart with all vigilance, for from it flow the springs of life.
verses.textEnNkjv: Keep your heart with all diligence, For out of it spring the issues of life.
verses.textEnNlt: Guard your heart above all else, for it determines the course of your life.
verses.textEnNasb: Watch over your heart with all diligence, For from it flow the springs of life.
verses.textEn: Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it.

verses.textZh: 你要除掉欺诈的口， 远离乖谬的嘴唇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要除掉欺诈的口， 远离乖谬的嘴唇。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要除掉邪僻的口， 弃绝乖谬的嘴。
verses.textEnNiv: Keep your mouth free of perversity; keep corrupt talk far from your lips.
verses.textEnEsv: Put away from you crooked speech, and put devious talk far from you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Put away from you a deceitful mouth, And put perverse lips far from you.
verses.textEnNlt: Avoid all perverse talk; stay away from corrupt speech.
verses.textEnNasb: Rid yourself of a deceitful mouth And keep devious speech far from you.
verses.textEn: Keep your mouth free of perversity; keep corrupt talk far from your lips.

verses.textZh: 你双眼要向前正视， 你的眼睛要向前直望。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你双眼要向前正视， 你的眼睛要向前直望。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的眼目要向前正看； 你的眼睛 当向前直观。
verses.textEnNiv: Let your eyes look straight ahead; fix your gaze directly before you.
verses.textEnEsv: Let your eyes look directly forward, and your gaze be straight before you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let your eyes look straight ahead, And your eyelids look right before you.
verses.textEnNlt: Look straight ahead, and fix your eyes on what lies before you.
verses.textEnNasb: Let your eyes look directly ahead And let your gaze be fixed straight in front of you.
verses.textEn: Let your eyes look straight ahead; fix your gaze directly before you.

verses.textZh: 你要谨慎你脚下的路径， 你一切所行的就必稳妥。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要谨慎你脚下的路径， 你一切所行的就必稳妥。
verses.textZhCuv: 要修平你脚下的路， 坚定你一切的道。
verses.textEnNiv: Give careful thought to the paths for your feet and be steadfast in all your ways.
verses.textEnEsv: Ponder the path of your feet; then all your ways will be sure.
verses.textEnNkjv: Ponder the path of your feet, And let all your ways be established.
verses.textEnNlt: Mark out a straight path for your feet; stay on the safe path.
verses.textEnNasb: Watch the path of your feet, And all your ways will be established.
verses.textEn: Give careful thought to the paths for your feet and be steadfast in all your ways.

verses.textZh: 不可偏左偏右， 要使你的脚远离恶事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可偏左偏右， 要使你的脚远离恶事。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可偏向左右； 要使你的脚离开邪恶。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not turn to the right or the left; keep your foot from evil.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not swerve to the right or to the left; turn your foot away from evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not turn to the right or the left; Remove your foot from evil.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t get sidetracked; keep your feet from following evil.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not turn to the right or to the left; Turn your foot from evil.
verses.textEn: Do not turn to the right or the left; keep your foot from evil.

verses.textZh: 我儿，要留心听我的智慧， 侧耳听我的哲理，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我儿，要留心听我的智慧， 侧耳听我的哲理，
verses.textZhCuv: 我儿，要留心我智慧的话语， 侧耳听我聪明的言词，
verses.textEnNiv: My son, pay attention to my wisdom, turn your ear to my words of insight,
verses.textEnEsv: My son, be attentive to my wisdom; incline your ear to my understanding,
verses.textEnNkjv: My son, pay attention to my wisdom; Lend your ear to my understanding,
verses.textEnNlt: My son, pay attention to my wisdom; listen carefully to my wise counsel.
verses.textEnNasb: My son, pay attention to my wisdom, Incline your ear to my understanding,
verses.textEn: My son, pay attention to my wisdom, turn your ear to my words of insight,

verses.textZh: 好让你持守明辨的态度， 你的嘴唇谨守知识。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好让你持守明辨的态度， 你的嘴唇谨守知识。
verses.textZhCuv: 为要使你谨守谋略， 嘴唇保存知识。
verses.textEnNiv: that you may maintain discretion and your lips may preserve knowledge.
verses.textEnEsv: that you may keep discretion, and your lips may guard knowledge.
verses.textEnNkjv: That you may preserve discretion, And your lips may keep knowledge.
verses.textEnNlt: Then you will show discernment, and your lips will express what you’ve learned.
verses.textEnNasb: So that you may maintain discretion And your lips may comply with knowledge.
verses.textEn: that you may maintain discretion and your lips may preserve knowledge.

verses.textZh: 因为淫妇的嘴唇滴下蜂蜜， 她的口比油更滑；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为淫妇的嘴唇滴下蜂蜜， 她的口比油更滑；
verses.textZhCuv: 因为淫妇的嘴滴下蜂蜜； 她的口比油更滑，
verses.textEnNiv: For the lips of the adulterous woman drip honey, and her speech is smoother than oil;
verses.textEnEsv: For the lips of a forbidden woman drip honey, and her speech is smoother than oil,
verses.textEnNkjv: For the lips of an immoral woman drip honey, And her mouth is smoother than oil;
verses.textEnNlt: For the lips of an immoral woman are as sweet as honey, and her mouth is smoother than oil.
verses.textEnNasb: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey, And her speech is smoother than oil;
verses.textEn: For the lips of the adulterous woman drip honey, and her speech is smoother than oil;

verses.textZh: 至终却苦似苦菫， 快如两刃的剑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至终却苦似苦菫， 快如两刃的剑。
verses.textZhCuv: 至终却苦似茵陈， 快如两刃的刀。
verses.textEnNiv: but in the end she is bitter as gall, sharp as a double-edged sword.
verses.textEnEsv: but in the end she is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a two-edged sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: But in the end she is bitter as wormwood, Sharp as a two-edged sword.
verses.textEnNlt: But in the end she is as bitter as poison, as dangerous as a double-edged sword.
verses.textEnNasb: But in the end she is bitter as wormwood, Sharp as a two-edged sword.
verses.textEn: but in the end she is bitter as gall, sharp as a double-edged sword.

verses.textZh: 她的脚走下死地， 她的脚步踏向阴间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她的脚走下死地， 她的脚步踏向阴间。
verses.textZhCuv: 她的脚下入死地； 她脚步踏住阴间，
verses.textEnNiv: Her feet go down to death; her steps lead straight to the grave.
verses.textEnEsv: Her feet go down to death; her steps follow the path to Sheol;
verses.textEnNkjv: Her feet go down to death, Her steps lay hold of hell.
verses.textEnNlt: Her feet go down to death; her steps lead straight to the grave.
verses.textEnNasb: Her feet go down to death, Her steps take hold of Sheol.
verses.textEn: Her feet go down to death; her steps lead straight to the grave.

verses.textZh: 她不理会生命之路， 她的路径变迁无定，自己也不知道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她不理会生命之路， 她的路径变迁无定，自己也不知道。
verses.textZhCuv: 以致她找不着生命平坦的道。 她的路变迁不定， 自己还不知道。
verses.textEnNiv: She gives no thought to the way of life; her paths wander aimlessly, but she does not know it.
verses.textEnEsv: she does not ponder the path of life; her ways wander, and she does not know it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lest you ponder her path of life— Her ways are unstable; You do not know them.
verses.textEnNlt: For she cares nothing about the path to life. She staggers down a crooked trail and doesn’t realize it.
verses.textEnNasb: She does not ponder the path of life; Her ways are unstable, she does not know it.
verses.textEn: She gives no thought to the way of life; her paths wander aimlessly, but she does not know it.

verses.textZh: 孩子们，现在要听从我， 不可离弃我口中的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 孩子们，现在要听从我， 不可离弃我口中的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 众子啊，现在要听从我； 不可离弃我口中的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Now then, my sons, listen to me; do not turn aside from what I say.
verses.textEnEsv: And now, O sons, listen to me, and do not depart from the words of my mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore hear me now, my children, And do not depart from the words of my mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: So now, my sons, listen to me. Never stray from what I am about to say:
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, my sons, listen to me And do not turn away from the words of my mouth.
verses.textEn: Now then, my sons, listen to me; do not turn aside from what I say.

verses.textZh: 你的道路要远离她， 不可走近她的家门；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的道路要远离她， 不可走近她的家门；
verses.textZhCuv: 你所行的道要离她远， 不可就近她的房门，
verses.textEnNiv: Keep to a path far from her, do not go near the door of her house,
verses.textEnEsv: Keep your way far from her, and do not go near the door of her house,
verses.textEnNkjv: Remove your way far from her, And do not go near the door of her house,
verses.textEnNlt: Stay away from her! Don’t go near the door of her house!
verses.textEnNasb: Keep your way far from her, And do not go near the door of her house,
verses.textEn: Keep to a path far from her, do not go near the door of her house,

verses.textZh: 免得你的精力给了别人， 你的年日交给了残忍的人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 免得你的精力给了别人， 你的年日交给了残忍的人；
verses.textZhCuv: 恐怕将你的尊荣给别人， 将你的岁月给残忍的人；
verses.textEnNiv: lest you lose your honor to others and your dignity to one who is cruel,
verses.textEnEsv: lest you give your honor to others and your years to the merciless,
verses.textEnNkjv: Lest you give your honor to others, And your years to the cruel one;
verses.textEnNlt: If you do, you will lose your honor and will lose to merciless people all you have achieved.
verses.textEnNasb: Otherwise you will give your vigor to others, And your years to the cruel one;
verses.textEn: lest you lose your honor to others and your dignity to one who is cruel,

verses.textZh: 免得外人饱享你的财物， 你劳碌得来的归入别人的家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 免得外人饱享你的财物， 你劳碌得来的归入别人的家。
verses.textZhCuv: 恐怕外人满得你的力量， 你劳碌得来的，归入外人的家；
verses.textEnNiv: lest strangers feast on your wealth and your toil enrich the house of another.
verses.textEnEsv: lest strangers take their fill of your strength, and your labors go to the house of a foreigner,
verses.textEnNkjv: Lest aliens be filled with your wealth, And your labors go to the house of a foreigner;
verses.textEnNlt: Strangers will consume your wealth, and someone else will enjoy the fruit of your labor.
verses.textEnNasb: And strangers will be filled with your strength, And your hard-earned possessions will go to the house of a foreigner;
verses.textEn: lest strangers feast on your wealth and your toil enrich the house of another.

verses.textZh: 在你生命终结，你的肉体和身躯衰残的时候， 你就悲叹，
verses.textZhCnvs: 在你生命终结，你的肉体和身躯衰残的时候， 你就悲叹，
verses.textZhCuv: 终久，你皮肉和身体消毁， 你就悲叹，
verses.textEnNiv: At the end of your life you will groan, when your flesh and body are spent.
verses.textEnEsv: and at the end of your life you groan, when your flesh and body are consumed,
verses.textEnNkjv: And you mourn at last, When your flesh and your body are consumed,
verses.textEnNlt: In the end you will groan in anguish when disease consumes your body.
verses.textEnNasb: And you will groan in the end, When your flesh and your body are consumed;
verses.textEn: At the end of your life you will groan, when your flesh and body are spent.

verses.textZh: 说："我为甚么恨恶管教， 我的心为甚么轻视责备，
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："我为甚么恨恶管教， 我的心为甚么轻视责备，
verses.textZhCuv: 说：我怎么恨恶训诲， 心中藐视责备，
verses.textEnNiv: You will say, "How I hated discipline! How my heart spurned correction!
verses.textEnEsv: and you say, "How I hated discipline, and my heart despised reproof!
verses.textEnNkjv: And say: "How I have hated instruction, And my heart despised correction!
verses.textEnNlt: You will say, "How I hated discipline! If only I had not ignored all the warnings!
verses.textEnNasb: And you say, "How I hated instruction! And my heart disdainfully rejected rebuke!
verses.textEn: You will say, "How I hated discipline! How my heart spurned correction!

verses.textZh: 不听从我老师的话， 也不留心听那些教导我的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不听从我老师的话， 也不留心听那些教导我的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 也不听从我师傅的话， 又不侧耳听那教训我的人？
verses.textEnNiv: I would not obey my teachers or turn my ear to my instructors.
verses.textEnEsv: I did not listen to the voice of my teachers or incline my ear to my instructors.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, Nor inclined my ear to those who instructed me!
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, why didn’t I listen to my teachers? Why didn’t I pay attention to my instructors?
verses.textEnNasb: "I did not listen to the voice of my teachers, Nor incline my ear to my instructors!
verses.textEn: I would not obey my teachers or turn my ear to my instructors.

verses.textZh: 在众民的集会中， 我几乎落在万劫不复之地。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在众民的集会中， 我几乎落在万劫不复之地。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我在圣会里， 几乎落在诸般恶中。
verses.textEnNiv: And I was soon in serious trouble in the assembly of God’s people."
verses.textEnEsv: I am at the brink of utter ruin in the assembled congregation."
verses.textEnNkjv: I was on the verge of total ruin, In the midst of the assembly and congregation."
verses.textEnNlt: I have come to the brink of utter ruin, and now I must face public disgrace."
verses.textEnNasb: "I was almost in total ruin In the midst of the assembly and congregation."
verses.textEn: And I was soon in serious trouble in the assembly of God’s people."

verses.textZh: 你要喝自己池中的水， 饮自己井里的活水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要喝自己池中的水， 饮自己井里的活水。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要喝自己池中的水， 饮自己井里的活水。
verses.textEnNiv: Drink water from your own cistern, running water from your own well.
verses.textEnEsv: Drink water from your own cistern, flowing water from your own well.
verses.textEnNkjv: Drink water from your own cistern, And running water from your own well.
verses.textEnNlt: Drink water from your own well— share your love only with your wife.
verses.textEnNasb: Drink water from your own cistern, And fresh water from your own well.
verses.textEn: Drink water from your own cistern, running water from your own well.

verses.textZh: 你的泉源怎么可以外溢？ 你的河水怎么可以流在街上？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的泉源怎么可以外溢？ 你的河水怎么可以流在街上？
verses.textZhCuv: 你的泉源岂可涨溢在外？ 你的河水岂可流在街上？
verses.textEnNiv: Should your springs overflow in the streets, your streams of water in the public squares?
verses.textEnEsv: Should your springs be scattered abroad, streams of water in the streets?
verses.textEnNkjv: Should your fountains be dispersed abroad, Streams of water in the streets?
verses.textEnNlt: Why spill the water of your springs in the streets, having sex with just anyone?
verses.textEnNasb: Should your springs overflow into the street, Streams of water in the public squares?
verses.textEn: Should your springs overflow in the streets, your streams of water in the public squares?

verses.textZh: 它们要独归你一人所有， 不要让外人与你共享。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它们要独归你一人所有， 不要让外人与你共享。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟独归你一人， 不可与外人同用。
verses.textEnNiv: Let them be yours alone, never to be shared with strangers.
verses.textEnEsv: Let them be for yourself alone, and not for strangers with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let them be only your own, And not for strangers with you.
verses.textEnNlt: You should reserve it for yourselves. Never share it with strangers.
verses.textEnNasb: Let them be yours alone, And not for strangers with you.
verses.textEn: Let them be yours alone, never to be shared with strangers.

verses.textZh: 要使你的泉源蒙福， 要喜悦你年轻时所娶的妻子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要使你的泉源蒙福， 要喜悦你年轻时所娶的妻子。
verses.textZhCuv: 要使你的泉源蒙福； 要喜悦你幼年所娶的妻。
verses.textEnNiv: May your fountain be blessed, and may you rejoice in the wife of your youth.
verses.textEnEsv: Let your fountain be blessed, and rejoice in the wife of your youth,
verses.textEnNkjv: Let your fountain be blessed, And rejoice with the wife of your youth.
verses.textEnNlt: Let your wife be a fountain of blessing for you. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.
verses.textEnNasb: Let your fountain be blessed, And rejoice in the wife of your youth.
verses.textEn: May your fountain be blessed, and may you rejoice in the wife of your youth.

verses.textZh: 她像可爱的母鹿，人所喜悦的母山羊， 愿她的乳房时常使你满足， 愿她的爱情常常使你恋慕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她像可爱的母鹿，人所喜悦的母山羊， 愿她的乳房时常使你满足， 愿她的爱情常常使你恋慕。
verses.textZhCuv: 她如可爱的麀鹿，可喜的母鹿； 愿她的胸怀使你时时知足， 她的爱情使你常常恋慕。
verses.textEnNiv: A loving doe, a graceful deer— may her breasts satisfy you always, may you ever be intoxicated with her love.
verses.textEnEsv: a lovely deer, a graceful doe. Let her breasts fill you at all times with delight; be intoxicated always in her love.
verses.textEnNkjv: Asa loving deer and a graceful doe, Let her breasts satisfy you at all times; And always be enraptured with her love.
verses.textEnNlt: She is a loving deer, a graceful doe. Let her breasts satisfy you always. May you always be captivated by her love.
verses.textEnNasb: Like a loving doe and a graceful mountain goat, Let her breasts satisfy you at all times; Be exhilarated always with her love.
verses.textEn: A loving doe, a graceful deer— may her breasts satisfy you always, may you ever be intoxicated with her love.

verses.textZh: 我儿，为甚么恋慕淫妇？ 为甚么拥抱妓女的胸怀呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我儿，为甚么恋慕淫妇？ 为甚么拥抱妓女的胸怀呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我儿，你为何恋慕淫妇？ 为何抱外女的胸怀？
verses.textEnNiv: Why, my son, be intoxicated with another man’s wife? Why embrace the bosom of a wayward woman?
verses.textEnEsv: Why should you be intoxicated, my son, with a forbidden woman and embrace the bosom of an adulteress?
verses.textEnNkjv: For why should you, my son, be enraptured by an immoral woman, And be embraced in the arms of a seductress?
verses.textEnNlt: Why be captivated, my son, by an immoral woman, or fondle the breasts of a promiscuous woman?
verses.textEnNasb: For why should you, my son, be exhilarated with an adulteress, And embrace the breasts of a foreigner?
verses.textEn: Why, my son, be intoxicated with another man’s wife? Why embrace the bosom of a wayward woman?

verses.textZh: 因为人的道路都在耶和华眼前， 他也审察人的一切路径。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为人的道路都在耶和华眼前， 他也审察人的一切路径。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，人所行的道都在耶和华眼前； 他也修平人一切的路。
verses.textEnNiv: For your ways are in full view of the Lord , and he examines all your paths.
verses.textEnEsv: For a man’s ways are before the eyes of the Lord , and he ponders all his paths.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the Lord, And He ponders all his paths.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord sees clearly what a man does, examining every path he takes.
verses.textEnNasb: For the ways of everyone are before the eyes of the Lord, And He observes all his paths.
verses.textEn: For your ways are in full view of the Lord , and he examines all your paths.

verses.textZh: 恶人必被自己的罪孽捉住， 他必被自己罪恶的绳索缠住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人必被自己的罪孽捉住， 他必被自己罪恶的绳索缠住。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人必被自己的罪孽捉住； 他必被自己的罪恶如绳索缠绕。
verses.textEnNiv: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare them; the cords of their sins hold them fast.
verses.textEnEsv: The iniquities of the wicked ensnare him, and he is held fast in the cords of his sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: His own iniquities entrap the wicked man, And he is caught in the cords of his sin.
verses.textEnNlt: An evil man is held captive by his own sins; they are ropes that catch and hold him.
verses.textEnNasb: His own wrongdoings will trap the wicked, And he will be held by the ropes of his sin.
verses.textEn: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare them; the cords of their sins hold them fast.

verses.textZh: 他必因不受管教而死亡， 又因自己过分愚妄而走进歧途。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必因不受管教而死亡， 又因自己过分愚妄而走进歧途。
verses.textZhCuv: 他因不受训诲就必死亡； 又因愚昧过甚，必走差了路。
verses.textEnNiv: For lack of discipline they will die, led astray by their own great folly.
verses.textEnEsv: He dies for lack of discipline, and because of his great folly he is led astray.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall die for lack of instruction, And in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
verses.textEnNlt: He will die for lack of self-control; he will be lost because of his great foolishness.
verses.textEnNasb: He will die for lack of instruction, And in the greatness of his foolishness he will go astray.
verses.textEn: For lack of discipline they will die, led astray by their own great folly.

verses.textZh: 我儿，如果你作朋友的保证人， 替外人击掌担保；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我儿，如果你作朋友的保证人， 替外人击掌担保；
verses.textZhCuv: 我儿，你若为朋友作保， 替外人击掌，
verses.textEnNiv: My son, if you have put up security for your neighbor, if you have shaken hands in pledge for a stranger,
verses.textEnEsv: My son, if you have put up security for your neighbor, have given your pledge for a stranger,
verses.textEnNkjv: My son, if you become surety for your friend, If you have shaken hands in pledge for a stranger,
verses.textEnNlt: My child, if you have put up security for a friend’s debt or agreed to guarantee the debt of a stranger—
verses.textEnNasb: My son, if you have become a guarantor for your neighbor, Or have given a handshake for a stranger,
verses.textEn: My son, if you have put up security for your neighbor, if you have shaken hands in pledge for a stranger,

verses.textZh: 如果你给自己口里的话缠累， 给你口里的话绑住；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你给自己口里的话缠累， 给你口里的话绑住；
verses.textZhCuv: 你就被口中的话语缠住， 被嘴里的言语捉住。
verses.textEnNiv: you have been trapped by what you said, ensnared by the words of your mouth.
verses.textEnEsv: if you are snared in the words of your mouth, caught in the words of your mouth,
verses.textEnNkjv: You are snared by the words of your mouth; You are taken by the words of your mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: if you have trapped yourself by your agreement and are caught by what you said—
verses.textEnNasb: If you have been ensnared by the words of your mouth, Or caught by the words of your mouth,
verses.textEn: you have been trapped by what you said, ensnared by the words of your mouth.

verses.textZh: 我儿，既然你落在你朋友的手中， 就要这样行，好解救你自己， 你要自己降卑，去恳求你的朋友。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我儿，既然你落在你朋友的手中， 就要这样行，好解救你自己， 你要自己降卑，去恳求你的朋友。
verses.textZhCuv: 我儿，你既落在朋友手中， 就当这样行才可救自己： 你要自卑，去恳求你的朋友。
verses.textEnNiv: So do this, my son, to free yourself, since you have fallen into your neighbor’s hands: Go—to the point of exhaustion— and give your neighbor no rest!
verses.textEnEsv: then do this, my son, and save yourself, for you have come into the hand of your neighbor: go, hasten, and plead urgently with your neighbor.
verses.textEnNkjv: So do this, my son, and deliver yourself; For you have come into the hand of your friend: Go and humble yourself; Plead with your friend.
verses.textEnNlt: follow my advice and save yourself, for you have placed yourself at your friend’s mercy. Now swallow your pride; go and beg to have your name erased.
verses.textEnNasb: Then do this, my son, and save yourself: Since you have come into the hand of your neighbor, Go, humble yourself, and be urgent with your neighbor to free yourself.
verses.textEn: So do this, my son, to free yourself, since you have fallen into your neighbor’s hands: Go—to the point of exhaustion— and give your neighbor no rest!

verses.textZh: 不要让你的眼睛睡觉， 不要容你的眼睑打盹；
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要让你的眼睛睡觉， 不要容你的眼睑打盹；
verses.textZhCuv: 不要容你的眼睛睡觉； 不要容你的眼皮打盹。
verses.textEnNiv: Allow no sleep to your eyes, no slumber to your eyelids.
verses.textEnEsv: Give your eyes no sleep and your eyelids no slumber;
verses.textEnNkjv: Give no sleep to your eyes, Nor slumber to your eyelids.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t put it off; do it now! Don’t rest until you do.
verses.textEnNasb: Give no sleep to your eyes, Nor slumber to your eyelids;
verses.textEn: Allow no sleep to your eyes, no slumber to your eyelids.

verses.textZh: 要解救自己，像羚羊脱离猎人的手， 像飞鸟脱离捕鸟人的手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要解救自己，像羚羊脱离猎人的手， 像飞鸟脱离捕鸟人的手。
verses.textZhCuv: 要救自己，如鹿脱离猎户的手， 如鸟脱离捕鸟人的手。
verses.textEnNiv: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.
verses.textEnEsv: save yourself like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the hand of the fowler.
verses.textEnNkjv: Deliver yourself like a gazelle from the hand ofthehunter, And like a bird from the hand of the fowler.
verses.textEnNlt: Save yourself like a gazelle escaping from a hunter, like a bird fleeing from a net.
verses.textEnNasb: Save yourself like a gazelle from the hunter’s hand, And like a bird from the hand of the fowler.
verses.textEn: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.

verses.textZh: 懒惰人哪！你去看看蚂蚁， 察看牠们所行的，就可得着智慧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 懒惰人哪！你去看看蚂蚁， 察看牠们所行的，就可得着智慧。
verses.textZhCuv: 懒惰人哪， 你去察看蚂蚁的动作就可得智慧。
verses.textEnNiv: Go to the ant, you sluggard; consider its ways and be wise!
verses.textEnEsv: Go to the ant, O sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise.
verses.textEnNkjv: Go to the ant, you sluggard! Consider her ways and be wise,
verses.textEnNlt: Take a lesson from the ants, you lazybones. Learn from their ways and become wise!
verses.textEnNasb: Go to the ant, you lazy one, Observe its ways and be wise,
verses.textEn: Go to the ant, you sluggard; consider its ways and be wise!

verses.textZh: 蚂蚁没有元帅， 没有官长，也没有统治者，
verses.textZhCnvs: 蚂蚁没有元帅， 没有官长，也没有统治者，
verses.textZhCuv: 蚂蚁没有元帅， 没有官长，没有君王，
verses.textEnNiv: It has no commander, no overseer or ruler,
verses.textEnEsv: Without having any chief, officer, or ruler,
verses.textEnNkjv: Which, having no captain, Overseer or ruler,
verses.textEnNlt: Though they have no prince or governor or ruler to make them work,
verses.textEnNasb: Which, having no chief, Officer, or ruler,
verses.textEn: It has no commander, no overseer or ruler,

verses.textZh: 尚且在夏天预备食物， 在收割的时候积聚粮食。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尚且在夏天预备食物， 在收割的时候积聚粮食。
verses.textZhCuv: 尚且在夏天预备食物， 在收割时聚敛粮食。
verses.textEnNiv: yet it stores its provisions in summer and gathers its food at harvest.
verses.textEnEsv: she prepares her bread in summer and gathers her food in harvest.
verses.textEnNkjv: Provides her supplies in the summer, And gathers her food in the harvest.
verses.textEnNlt: they labor hard all summer, gathering food for the winter.
verses.textEnNasb: Prepares its food in the summer And gathers its provision in the harvest.
verses.textEn: yet it stores its provisions in summer and gathers its food at harvest.

verses.textZh: 懒惰人哪，你要睡到几时呢？ 你甚么时候才睡醒呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 懒惰人哪，你要睡到几时呢？ 你甚么时候才睡醒呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 懒惰人哪，你要睡到几时呢？ 你何时睡醒呢？
verses.textEnNiv: How long will you lie there, you sluggard? When will you get up from your sleep?
verses.textEnEsv: How long will you lie there, O sluggard? When will you arise from your sleep?
verses.textEnNkjv: How long will you slumber, O sluggard? When will you rise from your sleep?
verses.textEnNlt: But you, lazybones, how long will you sleep? When will you wake up?
verses.textEnNasb: How long will you lie down, you lazy one? When will you arise from your sleep?
verses.textEn: How long will you lie there, you sluggard? When will you get up from your sleep?

verses.textZh: 再睡片时，打盹片时， 抱着手躺卧片时，
verses.textZhCnvs: 再睡片时，打盹片时， 抱着手躺卧片时，
verses.textZhCuv: 再睡片时，打盹片时， 抱着手躺卧片时，
verses.textEnNiv: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest—
verses.textEnEsv: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest,
verses.textEnNkjv: A little sleep, a little slumber, A little folding of the hands to sleep—
verses.textEnNlt: A little extra sleep, a little more slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest—
verses.textEnNasb: "A little sleep, a little slumber, A little folding of the hands to rest,"
verses.textEn: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest—

verses.textZh: 你的贫穷就必像强盗来到， 你的缺乏就必像拿兵器的人来到。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的贫穷就必像强盗来到， 你的缺乏就必像拿兵器的人来到。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的贫穷就必如强盗速来， 你的缺乏仿佛拿兵器的人来到。
verses.textEnNiv: and poverty will come on you like a thief and scarcity like an armed man.
verses.textEnEsv: and poverty will come upon you like a robber, and want like an armed man.
verses.textEnNkjv: So shall your poverty come on you like a prowler, And your need like an armed man.
verses.textEnNlt: then poverty will pounce on you like a bandit; scarcity will attack you like an armed robber.
verses.textEnNasb: Then your poverty will come in like a drifter, And your need like an armed man.
verses.textEn: and poverty will come on you like a thief and scarcity like an armed man.

verses.textZh: 无赖汉、坏人 到处使用欺诈的口；
verses.textZhCnvs: 无赖汉、坏人 到处使用欺诈的口；
verses.textZhCuv: 无赖的恶徒， 行动就用乖僻的口，
verses.textEnNiv: A troublemaker and a villain, who goes about with a corrupt mouth,
verses.textEnEsv: A worthless person, a wicked man, goes about with crooked speech,
verses.textEnNkjv: A worthless person, a wicked man, Walks with a perverse mouth;
verses.textEnNlt: What are worthless and wicked people like? They are constant liars,
verses.textEnNasb: A worthless person, a wicked man, Is one who walks with a perverse mouth,
verses.textEn: A troublemaker and a villain, who goes about with a corrupt mouth,

verses.textZh: 他以眼传神，用脚示意， 用指头指点，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他以眼传神，用脚示意， 用指头指点，
verses.textZhCuv: 用眼传神， 用脚示意， 用指点划，
verses.textEnNiv: who winks maliciously with his eye, signals with his feet and motions with his fingers,
verses.textEnEsv: winks with his eyes, signals with his feet, points with his finger,
verses.textEnNkjv: He winks with his eyes, He shuffles his feet, He points with his fingers;
verses.textEnNlt: signaling their deceit with a wink of the eye, a nudge of the foot, or the wiggle of fingers.
verses.textEnNasb: Who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, Who points with his fingers;
verses.textEn: who winks maliciously with his eye, signals with his feet and motions with his fingers,

verses.textZh: 心存乖谬，图谋恶事， 常常散布纷争。
verses.textZhCnvs: 心存乖谬，图谋恶事， 常常散布纷争。
verses.textZhCuv: 心中乖僻， 常设恶谋， 布散纷争。
verses.textEnNiv: who plots evil with deceit in his heart— he always stirs up conflict.
verses.textEnEsv: with perverted heart devises evil, continually sowing discord;
verses.textEnNkjv: Perversity is in his heart, He devises evil continually, He sows discord.
verses.textEnNlt: Their perverted hearts plot evil, and they constantly stir up trouble.
verses.textEnNasb: Who, with perversion in his heart, continually devises evil, Who spreads strife.
verses.textEn: who plots evil with deceit in his heart— he always stirs up conflict.

verses.textZh: 因此，灾难必忽然临到， 他必突然毁灭，无法挽救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，灾难必忽然临到， 他必突然毁灭，无法挽救。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，灾难必忽然临到他身； 他必顷刻败坏，无法可治。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore disaster will overtake him in an instant; he will suddenly be destroyed—without remedy.
verses.textEnEsv: therefore calamity will come upon him suddenly; in a moment he will be broken beyond healing.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore his calamity shall come suddenly; Suddenly he shall be broken without remedy.
verses.textEnNlt: But they will be destroyed suddenly, broken in an instant beyond all hope of healing.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore his disaster will come suddenly; Instantly he will be broken and there will be no healing.
verses.textEn: Therefore disaster will overtake him in an instant; he will suddenly be destroyed—without remedy.

verses.textZh: 耶和华恨恶的事有六样， 连他心里厌恶的，共有七样，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华恨恶的事有六样， 连他心里厌恶的，共有七样，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华所恨恶的有六样， 连他心所憎恶的共有七样：
verses.textEnNiv: There are six things the Lord hates, seven that are detestable to him:
verses.textEnEsv: There are six things that the Lord hates, seven that are an abomination to him:
verses.textEnNkjv: These six things the Lord hates, Yes, seven are an abomination to Him:
verses.textEnNlt: There are six things the Lord hates— no, seven things he detests:
verses.textEnNasb: There are six things that the Lord hates, Seven that are an abomination to Him:
verses.textEn: There are six things the Lord hates, seven that are detestable to him:

verses.textZh: 就是高傲的眼、 说谎的舌头、 流无辜人血的手、
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是高傲的眼、 说谎的舌头、 流无辜人血的手、
verses.textZhCuv: 就是高傲的眼， 撒谎的舌， 流无辜人血的手，
verses.textEnNiv: haughty eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,
verses.textEnEsv: haughty eyes, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,
verses.textEnNkjv: A proud look, A lying tongue, Hands that shed innocent blood,
verses.textEnNlt: haughty eyes, a lying tongue, hands that kill the innocent,
verses.textEnNasb: Haughty eyes, a lying tongue, And hands that shed innocent blood,
verses.textEn: haughty eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,

verses.textZh: 图谋恶事的心、 快跑行恶的脚、
verses.textZhCnvs: 图谋恶事的心、 快跑行恶的脚、
verses.textZhCuv: 图谋恶计的心， 飞跑行恶的脚，
verses.textEnNiv: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are quick to rush into evil,
verses.textEnEsv: a heart that devises wicked plans, feet that make haste to run to evil,
verses.textEnNkjv: A heart that devises wicked plans, Feet that are swift in running to evil,
verses.textEnNlt: a heart that plots evil, feet that race to do wrong,
verses.textEnNasb: A heart that devises wicked plans, Feet that run rapidly to evil,
verses.textEn: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are quick to rush into evil,

verses.textZh: 说谎的假证人， 和在弟兄中散布纷争的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 说谎的假证人， 和在弟兄中散布纷争的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 吐谎言的假见证， 并弟兄中布散纷争的人。
verses.textEnNiv: a false witness who pours out lies and a person who stirs up conflict in the community.
verses.textEnEsv: a false witness who breathes out lies, and one who sows discord among brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: A false witness who speaks lies, And one who sows discord among brethren.
verses.textEnNlt: a false witness who pours out lies, a person who sows discord in a family.
verses.textEnNasb: A false witness who declares lies, And one who spreads strife among brothers.
verses.textEn: a false witness who pours out lies and a person who stirs up conflict in the community.

verses.textZh: 我儿，要谨守你父亲的诫命， 不可离弃你母亲的训诲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我儿，要谨守你父亲的诫命， 不可离弃你母亲的训诲。
verses.textZhCuv: 我儿，要谨守你父亲的诫命； 不可离弃你母亲的法则 ，
verses.textEnNiv: My son, keep your father’s command and do not forsake your mother’s teaching.
verses.textEnEsv: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and forsake not your mother’s teaching.
verses.textEnNkjv: My son, keep your father’s command, And do not forsake the law of your mother.
verses.textEnNlt: My son, obey your father’s commands, and don’t neglect your mother’s instruction.
verses.textEnNasb: My son, comply with the commandment of your father, And do not ignore the teaching of your mother;
verses.textEn: My son, keep your father’s command and do not forsake your mother’s teaching.

verses.textZh: 要把它们常常系在你的心上， 绑在你的颈项上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要把它们常常系在你的心上， 绑在你的颈项上。
verses.textZhCuv: 要常系在你心上， 挂在你项上。
verses.textEnNiv: Bind them always on your heart; fasten them around your neck.
verses.textEnEsv: Bind them on your heart always; tie them around your neck.
verses.textEnNkjv: Bind them continually upon your heart; Tie them around your neck.
verses.textEnNlt: Keep their words always in your heart. Tie them around your neck.
verses.textEnNasb: Bind them continually on your heart; Tie them around your neck.
verses.textEn: Bind them always on your heart; fasten them around your neck.

verses.textZh: 你行走的时候，它们必引导你； 你睡觉的时候，它们必保护你； 你醒来的时候，它们必和你交谈。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你行走的时候，它们必引导你； 你睡觉的时候，它们必保护你； 你醒来的时候，它们必和你交谈。
verses.textZhCuv: 你行走，它必引导你； 你躺卧，它必保守你； 你睡醒，它必与你谈论。
verses.textEnNiv: When you walk, they will guide you; when you sleep, they will watch over you; when you awake, they will speak to you.
verses.textEnEsv: When you walk, they will lead you; when you lie down, they will watch over you; and when you awake, they will talk with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: When you roam, they will lead you; When you sleep, they will keep you; And when you awake, they will speak with you.
verses.textEnNlt: When you walk, their counsel will lead you. When you sleep, they will protect you. When you wake up, they will advise you.
verses.textEnNasb: When you walk, they will guide you; When you sleep, they will watch over you; And when you awake, they will talk to you.
verses.textEn: When you walk, they will guide you; when you sleep, they will watch over you; when you awake, they will speak to you.

verses.textZh: 因为诫命是灯，训诲是光， 出于管教的责备是生命之道，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为诫命是灯，训诲是光， 出于管教的责备是生命之道，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为诫命是灯，法则 是光， 训诲的责备是生命的道，
verses.textEnNiv: For this command is a lamp, this teaching is a light, and correction and instruction are the way to life,
verses.textEnEsv: For the commandment is a lamp and the teaching a light, and the reproofs of discipline are the way of life,
verses.textEnNkjv: For the commandment is a lamp, And the law a light; Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,
verses.textEnNlt: For their command is a lamp and their instruction a light; their corrective discipline is the way to life.
verses.textEnNasb: For the commandment is a lamp and the teaching is light; And rebukes for discipline are the way of life
verses.textEn: For this command is a lamp, this teaching is a light, and correction and instruction are the way to life,

verses.textZh: 能保护你远离邪恶的女人， 远离妓女谄媚的舌头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 能保护你远离邪恶的女人， 远离妓女谄媚的舌头。
verses.textZhCuv: 能保你远离恶妇， 远离外女谄媚的舌头。
verses.textEnNiv: keeping you from your neighbor’s wife, from the smooth talk of a wayward woman.
verses.textEnEsv: to preserve you from the evil woman, from the smooth tongue of the adulteress.
verses.textEnNkjv: To keep you from the evil woman, From the flattering tongue of a seductress.
verses.textEnNlt: It will keep you from the immoral woman, from the smooth tongue of a promiscuous woman.
verses.textEnNasb: To keep you from the evil woman, From the smooth tongue of the foreign woman.
verses.textEn: keeping you from your neighbor’s wife, from the smooth talk of a wayward woman.

verses.textZh: 你心里不要贪恋她的美色， 也不要给她的媚眼勾引。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你心里不要贪恋她的美色， 也不要给她的媚眼勾引。
verses.textZhCuv: 你心中不要恋慕她的美色， 也不要被她眼皮勾引。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not lust in your heart after her beauty or let her captivate you with her eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not desire her beauty in your heart, and do not let her capture you with her eyelashes;
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not lust after her beauty in your heart, Nor let her allure you with her eyelids.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t lust for her beauty. Don’t let her coy glances seduce you.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not desire her beauty in your heart, Nor let her capture you with her eyelids.
verses.textEn: Do not lust in your heart after her beauty or let her captivate you with her eyes.

verses.textZh: 因为妓女使人只剩一块饼， 通奸的妇人 猎取人宝贵的生命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为妓女使人只剩一块饼， 通奸的妇人 猎取人宝贵的生命。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，妓女能使人只剩一块饼； 淫妇猎取人宝贵的生命。
verses.textEnNiv: For a prostitute can be had for a loaf of bread, but another man’s wife preys on your very life.
verses.textEnEsv: for the price of a prostitute is only a loaf of bread, but a married woman hunts down a precious life.
verses.textEnNkjv: For by means of a harlot Amanisreduced to a crust of bread; And an adulteress will prey upon his precious life.
verses.textEnNlt: For a prostitute will bring you to poverty, but sleeping with another man’s wife will cost you your life.
verses.textEnNasb: For the price of a prostitute reduces one to a loaf of bread, And an adulteress hunts for a precious life.
verses.textEn: For a prostitute can be had for a loaf of bread, but another man’s wife preys on your very life.

verses.textZh: 如果人把火藏在怀里， 他的衣服怎能不烧着呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果人把火藏在怀里， 他的衣服怎能不烧着呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 人若怀里搋火， 衣服岂能不烧呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Can a man scoop fire into his lap without his clothes being burned?
verses.textEnEsv: Can a man carry fire next to his chest and his clothes not be burned?
verses.textEnNkjv: Can a man take fire to his bosom, And his clothes not be burned?
verses.textEnNlt: Can a man scoop a flame into his lap and not have his clothes catch on fire?
verses.textEnNasb: Can anyone take fire in his lap And his clothes not be burned?
verses.textEn: Can a man scoop fire into his lap without his clothes being burned?

verses.textZh: 如果人在火炭上行走， 他的脚怎能不灼伤呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果人在火炭上行走， 他的脚怎能不灼伤呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 人若在火炭上走， 脚岂能不烫呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Can a man walk on hot coals without his feet being scorched?
verses.textEnEsv: Or can one walk on hot coals and his feet not be scorched?
verses.textEnNkjv: Can one walk on hot coals, And his feet not be seared?
verses.textEnNlt: Can he walk on hot coals and not blister his feet?
verses.textEnNasb: Or can a person walk on hot coals And his feet not be scorched?
verses.textEn: Can a man walk on hot coals without his feet being scorched?

verses.textZh: 凡是和别人的妻子通奸的，也是这样； 凡是亲近她的，都必不免受罚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是和别人的妻子通奸的，也是这样； 凡是亲近她的，都必不免受罚。
verses.textZhCuv: 亲近邻舍之妻的，也是如此； 凡挨近她的，不免受罚。
verses.textEnNiv: So is he who sleeps with another man’s wife; no one who touches her will go unpunished.
verses.textEnEsv: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife; none who touches her will go unpunished.
verses.textEnNkjv: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife; Whoever touches her shall not be innocent.
verses.textEnNlt: So it is with the man who sleeps with another man’s wife. He who embraces her will not go unpunished.
verses.textEnNasb: So is the one who goes in to his neighbor’s wife; Whoever touches her will not go unpunished.
verses.textEn: So is he who sleeps with another man’s wife; no one who touches her will go unpunished.

verses.textZh: 盗贼因饥饿偷窃充饥， 人不会鄙视他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 盗贼因饥饿偷窃充饥， 人不会鄙视他。
verses.textZhCuv: 贼因饥饿偷窃充饥， 人不藐视他，
verses.textEnNiv: People do not despise a thief if he steals to satisfy his hunger when he is starving.
verses.textEnEsv: People do not despise a thief if he steals to satisfy his appetite when he is hungry,
verses.textEnNkjv: People do not despise a thief If he steals to satisfy himself when he is starving.
verses.textEnNlt: Excuses might be found for a thief who steals because he is starving.
verses.textEnNasb: People do not despise a thief if he steals To satisfy himself when he is hungry;
verses.textEn: People do not despise a thief if he steals to satisfy his hunger when he is starving.

verses.textZh: 但如果他被捉住，就要七倍偿还， 要把他家里所有的财物都交出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但如果他被捉住，就要七倍偿还， 要把他家里所有的财物都交出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 若被找着，他必赔还七倍， 必将家中所有的尽都偿还。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet if he is caught, he must pay sevenfold, though it costs him all the wealth of his house.
verses.textEnEsv: but if he is caught, he will pay sevenfold; he will give all the goods of his house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet when he is found, he must restore sevenfold; He may have to give up all the substance of his house.
verses.textEnNlt: But if he is caught, he must pay back seven times what he stole, even if he has to sell everything in his house.
verses.textEnNasb: But when he is found, he must repay seven times as much; He must give up all the property of his house.
verses.textEn: Yet if he is caught, he must pay sevenfold, though it costs him all the wealth of his house.

verses.textZh: 和妇人通奸的，实在无知； 行这事的，是自我毁灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 和妇人通奸的，实在无知； 行这事的，是自我毁灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 与妇人行淫的，便是无知； 行这事的，必丧掉生命。
verses.textEnNiv: But a man who commits adultery has no sense; whoever does so destroys himself.
verses.textEnEsv: He who commits adultery lacks sense; he who does it destroys himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever commits adultery with a woman lacks understanding; He who does so destroys his own soul.
verses.textEnNlt: But the man who commits adultery is an utter fool, for he destroys himself.
verses.textEnNasb: One who commits adultery with a woman is lacking sense; He who would destroy himself commits it.
verses.textEn: But a man who commits adultery has no sense; whoever does so destroys himself.

verses.textZh: 他必遭受击打，被凌辱， 他的耻辱永不能涂抹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必遭受击打，被凌辱， 他的耻辱永不能涂抹。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必受伤损，必被凌辱； 他的羞耻不得涂抹。
verses.textEnNiv: Blows and disgrace are his lot, and his shame will never be wiped away.
verses.textEnEsv: He will get wounds and dishonor, and his disgrace will not be wiped away.
verses.textEnNkjv: Wounds and dishonor he will get, And his reproach will not be wiped away.
verses.textEnNlt: He will be wounded and disgraced. His shame will never be erased.
verses.textEnNasb: He will find wounds and disgrace, And his shame will not be removed.
verses.textEn: Blows and disgrace are his lot, and his shame will never be wiped away.

verses.textZh: 因为嫉妒激起了丈夫的烈怒， 使他在报仇的时候，必不留情。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为嫉妒激起了丈夫的烈怒， 使他在报仇的时候，必不留情。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为人的嫉恨成了烈怒， 报仇的时候决不留情。
verses.textEnNiv: For jealousy arouses a husband’s fury, and he will show no mercy when he takes revenge.
verses.textEnEsv: For jealousy makes a man furious, and he will not spare when he takes revenge.
verses.textEnNkjv: For jealousy is a husband’s fury; Therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.
verses.textEnNlt: For the woman’s jealous husband will be furious, and he will show no mercy when he takes revenge.
verses.textEnNasb: For jealousy enrages a man, And he will not have compassion on the day of vengeance.
verses.textEn: For jealousy arouses a husband’s fury, and he will show no mercy when he takes revenge.

verses.textZh: 任何赔偿，他都不接受， 纵使你馈送许多礼物，他也不肯罢休。
verses.textZhCnvs: 任何赔偿，他都不接受， 纵使你馈送许多礼物，他也不肯罢休。
verses.textZhCuv: 什么赎价，他都不顾； 你虽送许多礼物，他也不肯干休。
verses.textEnNiv: He will not accept any compensation; he will refuse a bribe, however great it is.
verses.textEnEsv: He will accept no compensation; he will refuse though you multiply gifts.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will accept no recompense, Nor will he be appeased though you give many gifts.
verses.textEnNlt: He will accept no compensation, nor be satisfied with a payoff of any size.
verses.textEnNasb: He will not accept any settlement, Nor will he be satisfied though you make it a large gift.
verses.textEn: He will not accept any compensation; he will refuse a bribe, however great it is.

verses.textZh: 我儿，要遵守我的话， 把我的诫命珍藏在心里；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我儿，要遵守我的话， 把我的诫命珍藏在心里；
verses.textZhCuv: 我儿，你要遵守我的言语， 将我的命令存记在心。
verses.textEnNiv: My son, keep my words and store up my commands within you.
verses.textEnEsv: My son, keep my words and treasure up my commandments with you;
verses.textEnNkjv: My son, keep my words, And treasure my commands within you.
verses.textEnNlt: Follow my advice, my son; always treasure my commands.
verses.textEnNasb: My son, keep my words And treasure my commandments within you.
verses.textEn: My son, keep my words and store up my commands within you.

verses.textZh: 遵守我的诫命，你就可以存活； 遵守我的训诲，好象护卫你眼中的瞳人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 遵守我的诫命，你就可以存活； 遵守我的训诲，好象护卫你眼中的瞳人。
verses.textZhCuv: 遵守我的命令就得存活； 保守我的法则 ， 好像保守眼中的瞳人，
verses.textEnNiv: Keep my commands and you will live; guard my teachings as the apple of your eye.
verses.textEnEsv: keep my commandments and live; keep my teaching as the apple of your eye;
verses.textEnNkjv: Keep my commands and live, And my law as the apple of your eye.
verses.textEnNlt: Obey my commands and live! Guard my instructions as you guard your own eyes.
verses.textEnNasb: Keep my commandments and live, And my teaching as the apple of your eye.
verses.textEn: Keep my commands and you will live; guard my teachings as the apple of your eye.

verses.textZh: 要把它们系在你的指头上， 刻在你的心版上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要把它们系在你的指头上， 刻在你的心版上。
verses.textZhCuv: 系在你指头上， 刻在你心版上。
verses.textEnNiv: Bind them on your fingers; write them on the tablet of your heart.
verses.textEnEsv: bind them on your fingers; write them on the tablet of your heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: Bind them on your fingers; Write them on the tablet of your heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Tie them on your fingers as a reminder. Write them deep within your heart.
verses.textEnNasb: Bind them on your fingers; Write them on the tablet of your heart.
verses.textEn: Bind them on your fingers; write them on the tablet of your heart.

verses.textZh: 要对智慧说："你是我的姊妹"， 要称呼聪明为亲人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 要对智慧说："你是我的姊妹"， 要称呼聪明为亲人；
verses.textZhCuv: 对智慧说：你是我的姊妹， 称呼聪明为你的亲人，
verses.textEnNiv: Say to wisdom, "You are my sister," and to insight, "You are my relative."
verses.textEnEsv: Say to wisdom, "You are my sister," and call insight your intimate friend,
verses.textEnNkjv: Say to wisdom, "You are my sister," And call understanding your nearest kin,
verses.textEnNlt: Love wisdom like a sister; make insight a beloved member of your family.
verses.textEnNasb: Say to wisdom, "You are my sister," And call understanding your intimate friend,
verses.textEn: Say to wisdom, "You are my sister," and to insight, "You are my relative."

verses.textZh: 这样行就可以保护你脱离淫乱的妇人， 脱离说谄媚话的妓女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样行就可以保护你脱离淫乱的妇人， 脱离说谄媚话的妓女。
verses.textZhCuv: 她就保你远离淫妇， 远离说谄媚话的外女。
verses.textEnNiv: They will keep you from the adulterous woman, from the wayward woman with her seductive words.
verses.textEnEsv: to keep you from the forbidden woman, from the adulteress with her smooth words.
verses.textEnNkjv: That they may keep you from the immoral woman, From the seductress who flatters with her words.
verses.textEnNlt: Let them protect you from an affair with an immoral woman, from listening to the flattery of a promiscuous woman.
verses.textEnNasb: So that they may keep you from an adulteress, From the foreigner who flatters with her words.
verses.textEn: They will keep you from the adulterous woman, from the wayward woman with her seductive words.

verses.textZh: 我在我家的窗户内， 透过窗棂往外观看，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在我家的窗户内， 透过窗棂往外观看，
verses.textZhCuv: 我曾在我房屋的窗户内， 从我窗棂之间往外观看：
verses.textEnNiv: At the window of my house I looked down through the lattice.
verses.textEnEsv: For at the window of my house I have looked out through my lattice,
verses.textEnNkjv: For at the window of my house I looked through my lattice,
verses.textEnNlt: While I was at the window of my house, looking through the curtain,
verses.textEnNasb: For at the window of my house I looked out through my lattice,
verses.textEn: At the window of my house I looked down through the lattice.

verses.textZh: 看见在愚蒙人中间， 在少年人 里面， 我发觉有一个无知的少年人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 看见在愚蒙人中间， 在少年人 里面， 我发觉有一个无知的少年人，
verses.textZhCuv: 见愚蒙人内，少年人中， 分明有一个无知的少年人，
verses.textEnNiv: I saw among the simple, I noticed among the young men, a youth who had no sense.
verses.textEnEsv: and I have seen among the simple, I have perceived among the youths, a young man lacking sense,
verses.textEnNkjv: And saw among the simple, I perceived among the youths, A young man devoid of understanding,
verses.textEnNlt: I saw some naive young men, and one in particular who lacked common sense.
verses.textEnNasb: And I saw among the naive, And discerned among the youths A young man lacking sense,
verses.textEn: I saw among the simple, I noticed among the young men, a youth who had no sense.

verses.textZh: 在街上经过，走近淫妇的住处， 向着她的家走去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 在街上经过，走近淫妇的住处， 向着她的家走去，
verses.textZhCuv: 从街上经过，走近淫妇的巷口， 直往通她家的路去，
verses.textEnNiv: He was going down the street near her corner, walking along in the direction of her house
verses.textEnEsv: passing along the street near her corner, taking the road to her house
verses.textEnNkjv: Passing along the street near her corner; And he took the path to her house
verses.textEnNlt: He was crossing the street near the house of an immoral woman, strolling down the path by her house.
verses.textEnNasb: Passing through the street near her corner; And he walks along the way to her house,
verses.textEn: He was going down the street near her corner, walking along in the direction of her house

verses.textZh: 那时是黄昏、傍晚， 是在夜里，天黑的时候。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时是黄昏、傍晚， 是在夜里，天黑的时候。
verses.textZhCuv: 在黄昏，或晚上， 或半夜，或黑暗之中。
verses.textEnNiv: at twilight, as the day was fading, as the dark of night set in.
verses.textEnEsv: in the twilight, in the evening, at the time of night and darkness.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the twilight, in the evening, In the black and dark night.
verses.textEnNlt: It was at twilight, in the evening, as deep darkness fell.
verses.textEnNasb: In the twilight, in the evening, In the middle of the night and the darkness.
verses.textEn: at twilight, as the day was fading, as the dark of night set in.

verses.textZh: 看哪！有一个妇人来迎接他， 是妓女的打扮，心存诡诈。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！有一个妇人来迎接他， 是妓女的打扮，心存诡诈。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，有一个妇人来迎接他， 是妓女的打扮，有诡诈的心思。
verses.textEnNiv: Then out came a woman to meet him, dressed like a prostitute and with crafty intent.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, the woman meets him, dressed as a prostitute, wily of heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there a woman met him, With the attire of a harlot, and a crafty heart.
verses.textEnNlt: The woman approached him, seductively dressed and sly of heart.
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, a woman comes to meet him, Dressed as a prostitute and cunning of heart.
verses.textEn: Then out came a woman to meet him, dressed like a prostitute and with crafty intent.

verses.textZh: 这妇人喧哗不停，不受约束； 她在家里停不住脚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这妇人喧哗不停，不受约束； 她在家里停不住脚。
verses.textZhCuv: 这妇人喧嚷，不守约束， 在家里停不住脚，
verses.textEnNiv: (She is unruly and defiant, her feet never stay at home;
verses.textEnEsv: She is loud and wayward; her feet do not stay at home;
verses.textEnNkjv: She was loud and rebellious, Her feet would not stay at home.
verses.textEnNlt: She was the brash, rebellious type, never content to stay at home.
verses.textEnNasb: She is boisterous and rebellious, Her feet do not remain at home;
verses.textEn: (She is unruly and defiant, her feet never stay at home;

verses.textZh: 她有时在街上，有时在广场上， 或在任何角落旁边藏伏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她有时在街上，有时在广场上， 或在任何角落旁边藏伏。
verses.textZhCuv: 有时在街市上，有时在宽阔处， 或在各巷口蹲伏，
verses.textEnNiv: now in the street, now in the squares, at every corner she lurks.)
verses.textEnEsv: now in the street, now in the market, and at every corner she lies in wait.
verses.textEnNkjv: At times shewas outside, at times in the open square, Lurking at every corner.
verses.textEnNlt: She is often in the streets and markets, soliciting at every corner.
verses.textEnNasb: She is now in the streets, now in the public squares, And lurks by every corner.
verses.textEn: now in the street, now in the squares, at every corner she lurks.)

verses.textZh: 她紧拉着那少年人，和他亲嘴， 厚颜无耻地对他说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 她紧拉着那少年人，和他亲嘴， 厚颜无耻地对他说：
verses.textZhCuv: 拉住那少年人，与他亲嘴， 脸无羞耻对他说：
verses.textEnNiv: She took hold of him and kissed him and with a brazen face she said:
verses.textEnEsv: She seizes him and kisses him, and with bold face she says to him,
verses.textEnNkjv: So she caught him and kissed him; With an impudent face she said to him:
verses.textEnNlt: She threw her arms around him and kissed him, and with a brazen look she said,
verses.textEnNasb: So she seizes him and kisses him, And with a brazen face she says to him:
verses.textEn: She took hold of him and kissed him and with a brazen face she said:

verses.textZh: "我曾许愿要献平安祭， 今天我刚还了我所许的愿。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我曾许愿要献平安祭， 今天我刚还了我所许的愿。
verses.textZhCuv: 平安祭在我这里， 今日才还了我所许的愿。
verses.textEnNiv: "Today I fulfilled my vows, and I have food from my fellowship offering at home.
verses.textEnEsv: "I had to offer sacrifices, and today I have paid my vows;
verses.textEnNkjv: "Ihave peace offerings with me; Today I have paid my vows.
verses.textEnNlt: "I’ve just made my peace offerings and fulfilled my vows.
verses.textEnNasb: " I was due to offer peace offerings; Today I have paid my vows.
verses.textEn: "Today I fulfilled my vows, and I have food from my fellowship offering at home.

verses.textZh: 因此，我出来迎接你， 切切寻找你，终于找到你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我出来迎接你， 切切寻找你，终于找到你。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，我出来迎接你， 恳切求见你的面，恰巧遇见了你。
verses.textEnNiv: So I came out to meet you; I looked for you and have found you!
verses.textEnEsv: so now I have come out to meet you, to seek you eagerly, and I have found you.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I came out to meet you, Diligently to seek your face, And I have found you.
verses.textEnNlt: You’re the one I was looking for! I came out to find you, and here you are!
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore I have come out to meet you, To seek your presence diligently, and I have found you.
verses.textEn: So I came out to meet you; I looked for you and have found you!

verses.textZh: 我已用毯子，埃及线织成的花纹布， 铺了我的床；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我已用毯子，埃及线织成的花纹布， 铺了我的床；
verses.textZhCuv: 我已经用绣花毯子 和埃及线织的花纹布铺了我的床。
verses.textEnNiv: I have covered my bed with colored linens from Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: I have spread my couch with coverings, colored linens from Egyptian linen;
verses.textEnNkjv: I have spread my bed with tapestry, Colored coverings of Egyptian linen.
verses.textEnNlt: My bed is spread with beautiful blankets, with colored sheets of Egyptian linen.
verses.textEnNasb: "I have spread my couch with coverings, With colored linens of Egypt.
verses.textEn: I have covered my bed with colored linens from Egypt.

verses.textZh: 又用没药、沉香和桂皮， 熏了我的榻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又用没药、沉香和桂皮， 熏了我的榻。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又用没药、沉香、桂皮 薰了我的榻。
verses.textEnNiv: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes and cinnamon.
verses.textEnEsv: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have perfumed my bed With myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
verses.textEnNlt: I’ve perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
verses.textEnNasb: "I have sprinkled my bed With myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
verses.textEn: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes and cinnamon.

verses.textZh: 来吧！我们来饱享爱情，直到天亮， 我们来在爱中尽情享乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 来吧！我们来饱享爱情，直到天亮， 我们来在爱中尽情享乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 你来，我们可以饱享爱情，直到早晨； 我们可以彼此亲爱欢乐。
verses.textEnNiv: Come, let’s drink deeply of love till morning; let’s enjoy ourselves with love!
verses.textEnEsv: Come, let us take our fill of love till morning; let us delight ourselves with love.
verses.textEnNkjv: Come, let us take our fill of love until morning; Let us delight ourselves with love.
verses.textEnNlt: Come, let’s drink our fill of love until morning. Let’s enjoy each other’s caresses,
verses.textEnNasb: "Come, let’s drink our fill of love until morning; Let’s delight ourselves with caresses.
verses.textEn: Come, let’s drink deeply of love till morning; let’s enjoy ourselves with love!

verses.textZh: 因为我丈夫不在家， 远行去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我丈夫不在家， 远行去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我丈夫不在家，出门行远路；
verses.textEnNiv: My husband is not at home; he has gone on a long journey.
verses.textEnEsv: For my husband is not at home; he has gone on a long journey;
verses.textEnNkjv: For my husband is not at home; He has gone on a long journey;
verses.textEnNlt: for my husband is not home. He’s away on a long trip.
verses.textEnNasb: "For my husband is not at home; He has gone on a long journey.
verses.textEn: My husband is not at home; he has gone on a long journey.

verses.textZh: 他手里带着钱袋， 要到月圆的时候才回家。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他手里带着钱袋， 要到月圆的时候才回家。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他手拿银囊，必到月望才回家。
verses.textEnNiv: He took his purse filled with money and will not be home till full moon."
verses.textEnEsv: he took a bag of money with him; at full moon he will come home."
verses.textEnNkjv: He has taken a bag of money with him, And will come home on the appointed day."
verses.textEnNlt: He has taken a wallet full of money with him and won’t return until later this month. "
verses.textEnNasb: "He has taken a bag of money with him. At the full moon he will come home."
verses.textEn: He took his purse filled with money and will not be home till full moon."

verses.textZh: 淫妇用许多花言巧语引诱他， 用谄媚的嘴唇勾引他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 淫妇用许多花言巧语引诱他， 用谄媚的嘴唇勾引他。
verses.textZhCuv: 淫妇用许多巧言诱他随从， 用谄媚的嘴逼他同行。
verses.textEnNiv: With persuasive words she led him astray; she seduced him with her smooth talk.
verses.textEnEsv: With much seductive speech she persuades him; with her smooth talk she compels him.
verses.textEnNkjv: With her enticing speech she caused him to yield, With her flattering lips she seduced him.
verses.textEnNlt: So she seduced him with her pretty speech and enticed him with her flattery.
verses.textEnNasb: With her many persuasions she entices him; With her flattering lips she seduces him.
verses.textEn: With persuasive words she led him astray; she seduced him with her smooth talk.

verses.textZh: 少年人就立刻跟随她， 好象牛走向屠房， 又像愚妄人带着锁炼去受刑罚，
verses.textZhCnvs: 少年人就立刻跟随她， 好象牛走向屠房， 又像愚妄人带着锁炼去受刑罚，
verses.textZhCuv: 少年人立刻跟随她，好像牛往宰杀之地； 又像愚昧人带锁链去受刑罚，
verses.textEnNiv: All at once he followed her like an ox going to the slaughter, like a deer stepping into a noose
verses.textEnEsv: All at once he follows her, as an ox goes to the slaughter, or as a stag is caught fast
verses.textEnNkjv: Immediately he went after her, as an ox goes to the slaughter, Or as a fool to the correction of the stocks,
verses.textEnNlt: He followed her at once, like an ox going to the slaughter. He was like a stag caught in a trap,
verses.textEnNasb: Suddenly he follows her As an ox goes to the slaughter, Or as one walks in ankle bracelets to the discipline of a fool,
verses.textEn: All at once he followed her like an ox going to the slaughter, like a deer stepping into a noose

verses.textZh: 直到箭矢射透他的肝； 他仿佛飞鸟投入网罗， 并不知道会丧失性命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 直到箭矢射透他的肝； 他仿佛飞鸟投入网罗， 并不知道会丧失性命。
verses.textZhCuv: 直等箭穿他的肝； 如同雀鸟急入网罗，却不知是自丧己命。
verses.textEnNiv: till an arrow pierces his liver, like a bird darting into a snare, little knowing it will cost him his life.
verses.textEnEsv: till an arrow pierces its liver; as a bird rushes into a snare; he does not know that it will cost him his life.
verses.textEnNkjv: Till an arrow struck his liver. As a bird hastens to the snare, He did not know it wouldcost his life.
verses.textEnNlt: awaiting the arrow that would pierce its heart. He was like a bird flying into a snare, little knowing it would cost him his life.
verses.textEnNasb: Until an arrow pierces through his liver; As a bird hurries to the snare, So he does not know that it will cost him his life.
verses.textEn: till an arrow pierces his liver, like a bird darting into a snare, little knowing it will cost him his life.

verses.textZh: 孩子们，现在你们要听从我， 留心听我口中的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 孩子们，现在你们要听从我， 留心听我口中的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 众子啊，现在要听从我， 留心听我口中的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Now then, my sons, listen to me; pay attention to what I say.
verses.textEnEsv: And now, O sons, listen to me, and be attentive to the words of my mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, listen to me, my children; Pay attention to the words of my mouth:
verses.textEnNlt: So listen to me, my sons, and pay attention to my words.
verses.textEnNasb: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, And pay attention to the words of my mouth.
verses.textEn: Now then, my sons, listen to me; pay attention to what I say.

verses.textZh: 你的心不可偏向淫妇的道路， 也不要迷恋她的路径。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的心不可偏向淫妇的道路， 也不要迷恋她的路径。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的心不可偏向淫妇的道， 不要入她的迷途。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not let your heart turn to her ways or stray into her paths.
verses.textEnEsv: Let not your heart turn aside to her ways; do not stray into her paths,
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not let your heart turn aside to her ways, Do not stray into her paths;
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t let your hearts stray away toward her. Don’t wander down her wayward path.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not let your heart turn aside to her ways, Do not stray into her paths.
verses.textEn: Do not let your heart turn to her ways or stray into her paths.

verses.textZh: 因为她使许多人倒毙， 被她杀害的实在无数。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为她使许多人倒毙， 被她杀害的实在无数。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，被她伤害仆倒的不少； 被她杀戮的而且甚多。
verses.textEnNiv: Many are the victims she has brought down; her slain are a mighty throng.
verses.textEnEsv: for many a victim has she laid low, and all her slain are a mighty throng.
verses.textEnNkjv: For she has cast down many wounded, And all who were slain by her were strong men.
verses.textEnNlt: For she has been the ruin of many; many men have been her victims.
verses.textEnNasb: For many are the victims she has brought to ruin, And numerous are all those slaughtered by her.
verses.textEn: Many are the victims she has brought down; her slain are a mighty throng.

verses.textZh: 她的家是通往阴间的路， 是下到死亡的宫房。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她的家是通往阴间的路， 是下到死亡的宫房。
verses.textZhCuv: 她的家是在阴间之路， 下到死亡之宫。
verses.textEnNiv: Her house is a highway to the grave, leading down to the chambers of death.
verses.textEnEsv: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the chambers of death.
verses.textEnNkjv: Her house is the way to hell, Descending to the chambers of death.
verses.textEnNlt: Her house is the road to the grave. Her bedroom is the den of death.
verses.textEnNasb: Her house is the way to Sheol, Descending to the chambers of death.
verses.textEn: Her house is a highway to the grave, leading down to the chambers of death.

verses.textZh: 智慧不是在呼唤， 聪明不是在发声吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧不是在呼唤， 聪明不是在发声吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧岂不呼叫？ 聪明岂不发声？
verses.textEnNiv: Does not wisdom call out? Does not understanding raise her voice?
verses.textEnEsv: Does not wisdom call? Does not understanding raise her voice?
verses.textEnNkjv: Does not wisdom cry out, And understanding lift up her voice?
verses.textEnNlt: Listen as Wisdom calls out! Hear as understanding raises her voice!
verses.textEnNasb: Does not wisdom call, And understanding raise her voice?
verses.textEn: Does not wisdom call out? Does not understanding raise her voice?

verses.textZh: 它在路旁高处的最高点， 在十字路口站着；
verses.textZhCnvs: 它在路旁高处的最高点， 在十字路口站着；
verses.textZhCuv: 她在道旁高处的顶上， 在十字路口站立，
verses.textEnNiv: At the highest point along the way, where the paths meet, she takes her stand;
verses.textEnEsv: On the heights beside the way, at the crossroads she takes her stand;
verses.textEnNkjv: She takes her stand on the top of the high hill, Beside the way, where the paths meet.
verses.textEnNlt: On the hilltop along the road, she takes her stand at the crossroads.
verses.textEnNasb: On top of the heights beside the way, Where the paths meet, she takes her stand;
verses.textEn: At the highest point along the way, where the paths meet, she takes her stand;

verses.textZh: 在城门旁，在城门口， 在进城门的空地上大声呼喊：
verses.textZhCnvs: 在城门旁，在城门口， 在进城门的空地上大声呼喊：
verses.textZhCuv: 在城门旁，在城门口， 在城门洞，大声说：
verses.textEnNiv: beside the gate leading into the city, at the entrance, she cries aloud:
verses.textEnEsv: beside the gates in front of the town, at the entrance of the portals she cries aloud:
verses.textEnNkjv: She cries out by the gates, at the entry of the city, At the entrance of the doors:
verses.textEnNlt: By the gates at the entrance to the town, on the road leading in, she cries aloud,
verses.textEnNasb: Beside the gates, at the opening to the city, At the entrance of the doors, she cries out:
verses.textEn: beside the gate leading into the city, at the entrance, she cries aloud:

verses.textZh: "众人哪！我向你们呼唤， 对世人发声。
verses.textZhCnvs: "众人哪！我向你们呼唤， 对世人发声。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人哪，我呼叫你们， 我向世人发声。
verses.textEnNiv: "To you, O people, I call out; I raise my voice to all mankind.
verses.textEnEsv: "To you, O men, I call, and my cry is to the children of man.
verses.textEnNkjv: "To you, O men, I call, And my voice is to the sons of men.
verses.textEnNlt: "I call to you, to all of you! I raise my voice to all people.
verses.textEnNasb: "To you, people, I call, And my voice is to mankind.
verses.textEn: "To you, O people, I call out; I raise my voice to all mankind.

verses.textZh: 愚蒙人哪！你们要学习精明； 愚昧人哪！你们心里要明白事理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚蒙人哪！你们要学习精明； 愚昧人哪！你们心里要明白事理。
verses.textZhCuv: 说：愚蒙人哪，你们要会悟灵明； 愚昧人哪，你们当心里明白。
verses.textEnNiv: You who are simple, gain prudence; you who are foolish, set your hearts on it.
verses.textEnEsv: O simple ones, learn prudence; O fools, learn sense.
verses.textEnNkjv: O you simple ones, understand prudence, And you fools, be of an understanding heart.
verses.textEnNlt: You simple people, use good judgment. You foolish people, show some understanding.
verses.textEnNasb: "You naive ones, understand prudence; And, you fools, understand wisdom!
verses.textEn: You who are simple, gain prudence; you who are foolish, set your hearts on it.

verses.textZh: 你们听着，因为我要讲论极美的事， 我要开口说正直的事；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们听着，因为我要讲论极美的事， 我要开口说正直的事；
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当听，因我要说极美的话； 我张嘴要论正直的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Listen, for I have trustworthy things to say; I open my lips to speak what is right.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear, for I will speak noble things, and from my lips will come what is right,
verses.textEnNkjv: Listen, for I will speak of excellent things, And from the opening of my lips willcome right things;
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to me! For I have important things to tell you. Everything I say is right,
verses.textEnNasb: "Listen, for I will speak noble things; And the opening of my lips will reveal right things.
verses.textEn: Listen, for I have trustworthy things to say; I open my lips to speak what is right.

verses.textZh: 我的口要论述真理， 我的嘴唇厌恶邪恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的口要论述真理， 我的嘴唇厌恶邪恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的口要发出真理； 我的嘴憎恶邪恶。
verses.textEnNiv: My mouth speaks what is true, for my lips detest wickedness.
verses.textEnEsv: for my mouth will utter truth; wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
verses.textEnNkjv: For my mouth will speak truth; Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
verses.textEnNlt: for I speak the truth and detest every kind of deception.
verses.textEnNasb: "For my mouth will proclaim truth; And wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
verses.textEn: My mouth speaks what is true, for my lips detest wickedness.

verses.textZh: 我口里的一切话都是公义的， 毫无弯曲欺诈。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我口里的一切话都是公义的， 毫无弯曲欺诈。
verses.textZhCuv: 我口中的言语都是公义， 并无弯曲乖僻。
verses.textEnNiv: All the words of my mouth are just; none of them is crooked or perverse.
verses.textEnEsv: All the words of my mouth are righteous; there is nothing twisted or crooked in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the words of my mouth are with righteousness; Nothing crooked or perverse is in them.
verses.textEnNlt: My advice is wholesome. There is nothing devious or crooked in it.
verses.textEnNasb: "All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; There is nothing crooked or perverted in them.
verses.textEn: All the words of my mouth are just; none of them is crooked or perverse.

verses.textZh: 我的话对明理的人，都是对的； 对得着知识的人，都是正直的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的话对明理的人，都是对的； 对得着知识的人，都是正直的。
verses.textZhCuv: 有聪明的，以为明显， 得知识的，以为正直。
verses.textEnNiv: To the discerning all of them are right; they are upright to those who have found knowledge.
verses.textEnEsv: They are all straight to him who understands, and right to those who find knowledge.
verses.textEnNkjv: They are all plain to him who understands, And right to those who find knowledge.
verses.textEnNlt: My words are plain to anyone with understanding, clear to those with knowledge.
verses.textEnNasb: "They are all straightforward to him who understands, And right to those who find knowledge.
verses.textEn: To the discerning all of them are right; they are upright to those who have found knowledge.

verses.textZh: 你们要接受我的教训，不要银子； 宁愿得着知识，胜过精金；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要接受我的教训，不要银子； 宁愿得着知识，胜过精金；
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当受我的教训，不受白银； 宁得知识，胜过黄金。
verses.textEnNiv: Choose my instruction instead of silver, knowledge rather than choice gold,
verses.textEnEsv: Take my instruction instead of silver, and knowledge rather than choice gold,
verses.textEnNkjv: Receive my instruction, and not silver, And knowledge rather than choice gold;
verses.textEnNlt: Choose my instruction rather than silver, and knowledge rather than pure gold.
verses.textEnNasb: "Accept my instruction and not silver, And knowledge rather than choice gold.
verses.textEn: Choose my instruction instead of silver, knowledge rather than choice gold,

verses.textZh: 因为智慧比红宝石更好， 你一切所喜爱的都不能和智慧比较。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为智慧比红宝石更好， 你一切所喜爱的都不能和智慧比较。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为智慧比珍珠 更美； 一切可喜爱的都不足与比较。
verses.textEnNiv: for wisdom is more precious than rubies, and nothing you desire can compare with her.
verses.textEnEsv: for wisdom is better than jewels, and all that you may desire cannot compare with her.
verses.textEnNkjv: For wisdom is better than rubies, And all the things one may desire cannot be compared with her.
verses.textEnNlt: For wisdom is far more valuable than rubies. Nothing you desire can compare with it.
verses.textEnNasb: "For wisdom is better than jewels; And all desirable things cannot compare with her.
verses.textEn: for wisdom is more precious than rubies, and nothing you desire can compare with her.

verses.textZh: 我─智慧─和精明同住， 我又获得知识和谋略。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我─智慧─和精明同住， 我又获得知识和谋略。
verses.textZhCuv: 我－智慧以灵明为居所， 又寻得知识和谋略。
verses.textEnNiv: "I, wisdom, dwell together with prudence; I possess knowledge and discretion.
verses.textEnEsv: "I, wisdom, dwell with prudence, and I find knowledge and discretion.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I, wisdom, dwell with prudence, And find out knowledge and discretion.
verses.textEnNlt: "I, Wisdom, live together with good judgment. I know where to discover knowledge and discernment.
verses.textEnNasb: "I, wisdom, dwell with prudence, And I find knowledge and discretion.
verses.textEn: "I, wisdom, dwell together with prudence; I possess knowledge and discretion.

verses.textZh: 敬畏耶和华就是恨恶邪恶； 骄傲、狂妄、邪恶的行为、 乖谬的口，我都恨恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 敬畏耶和华就是恨恶邪恶； 骄傲、狂妄、邪恶的行为、 乖谬的口，我都恨恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 敬畏耶和华在乎恨恶邪恶； 那骄傲、狂妄，并恶道， 以及乖谬的口，都为我所恨恶。
verses.textEnNiv: To fear the Lord is to hate evil; I hate pride and arrogance, evil behavior and perverse speech.
verses.textEnEsv: The fear of the Lord is hatred of evil. Pride and arrogance and the way of evil and perverted speech I hate.
verses.textEnNkjv: The fear of the Lordis to hate evil; Pride and arrogance and the evil way And the perverse mouth I hate.
verses.textEnNlt: All who fear the Lord will hate evil. Therefore, I hate pride and arrogance, corruption and perverse speech.
verses.textEnNasb: "The fear of the Lord is to hate evil; Pride, arrogance, the evil way, And the perverted mouth, I hate.
verses.textEn: To fear the Lord is to hate evil; I hate pride and arrogance, evil behavior and perverse speech.

verses.textZh: 我有才智和大智慧， 我有聪明，我有能力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我有才智和大智慧， 我有聪明，我有能力。
verses.textZhCuv: 我有谋略和真知识； 我乃聪明，我有能力。
verses.textEnNiv: Counsel and sound judgment are mine; I have insight, I have power.
verses.textEnEsv: I have counsel and sound wisdom; I have insight; I have strength.
verses.textEnNkjv: Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom; I am understanding, I have strength.
verses.textEnNlt: Common sense and success belong to me. Insight and strength are mine.
verses.textEnNasb: "Advice is mine and sound wisdom; I am understanding, power is mine.
verses.textEn: Counsel and sound judgment are mine; I have insight, I have power.

verses.textZh: 君王藉我掌权， 统治者藉我制定法纪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 君王藉我掌权， 统治者藉我制定法纪。
verses.textZhCuv: 帝王藉我坐国位； 君王藉我定公平。
verses.textEnNiv: By me kings reign and rulers issue decrees that are just;
verses.textEnEsv: By me kings reign, and rulers decree what is just;
verses.textEnNkjv: By me kings reign, And rulers decree justice.
verses.textEnNlt: Because of me, kings reign, and rulers make just decrees.
verses.textEnNasb: "By me kings reign, And rulers decree justice.
verses.textEn: By me kings reign and rulers issue decrees that are just;

verses.textZh: 领袖、贵族和所有公义的审判官， 都藉我治国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 领袖、贵族和所有公义的审判官， 都藉我治国。
verses.textZhCuv: 王子和首领， 世上一切的审判官，都是藉我掌权。
verses.textEnNiv: by me princes govern, and nobles—all who rule on earth.
verses.textEnEsv: by me princes rule, and nobles, all who govern justly.
verses.textEnNkjv: By me princes rule, and nobles, All the judges of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Rulers lead with my help, and nobles make righteous judgments.
verses.textEnNasb: "By me princes rule, and nobles, All who judge rightly.
verses.textEn: by me princes govern, and nobles—all who rule on earth.

verses.textZh: 爱我的，我必爱他； 殷切寻找我的，必定寻见。
verses.textZhCnvs: 爱我的，我必爱他； 殷切寻找我的，必定寻见。
verses.textZhCuv: 爱我的，我也爱他； 恳切寻求我的，必寻得见。
verses.textEnNiv: I love those who love me, and those who seek me find me.
verses.textEnEsv: I love those who love me, and those who seek me diligently find me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I love those who love me, And those who seek me diligently will find me.
verses.textEnNlt: "I love all who love me. Those who search will surely find me.
verses.textEnNasb: "I love those who love me; And those who diligently seek me will find me.
verses.textEn: I love those who love me, and those who seek me find me.

verses.textZh: 财富和尊荣是我的， 恒久的财产和公义也是我的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 财富和尊荣是我的， 恒久的财产和公义也是我的。
verses.textZhCuv: 丰富尊荣在我； 恒久的财并公义也在我。
verses.textEnNiv: With me are riches and honor, enduring wealth and prosperity.
verses.textEnEsv: Riches and honor are with me, enduring wealth and righteousness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Riches and honor are with me, Enduring riches and righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: I have riches and honor, as well as enduring wealth and justice.
verses.textEnNasb: "Riches and honor are with me, Enduring wealth and righteousness.
verses.textEn: With me are riches and honor, enduring wealth and prosperity.

verses.textZh: 我的果实胜过黄金，胜过精金， 我的出产胜过纯银。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的果实胜过黄金，胜过精金， 我的出产胜过纯银。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的果实胜过黄金，强如精金； 我的出产超乎高银。
verses.textEnNiv: My fruit is better than fine gold; what I yield surpasses choice silver.
verses.textEnEsv: My fruit is better than gold, even fine gold, and my yield than choice silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, And my revenue than choice silver.
verses.textEnNlt: My gifts are better than gold, even the purest gold, my wages better than sterling silver!
verses.textEnNasb: "My fruit is better than gold, even pure gold; And my yield better than choice silver.
verses.textEn: My fruit is better than fine gold; what I yield surpasses choice silver.

verses.textZh: 我走在公义的道上， 行在公正的路上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我走在公义的道上， 行在公正的路上，
verses.textZhCuv: 我在公义的道上走， 在公平的路中行，
verses.textEnNiv: I walk in the way of righteousness, along the paths of justice,
verses.textEnEsv: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the paths of justice,
verses.textEnNkjv: I traverse the way of righteousness, In the midst of the paths of justice,
verses.textEnNlt: I walk in righteousness, in paths of justice.
verses.textEnNasb: "I walk in the way of righteousness, In the midst of the paths of justice,
verses.textEn: I walk in the way of righteousness, along the paths of justice,

verses.textZh: 使爱我的承受财产， 使他们的府库满溢。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使爱我的承受财产， 使他们的府库满溢。
verses.textZhCuv: 使爱我的，承受货财， 并充满他们的府库。
verses.textEnNiv: bestowing a rich inheritance on those who love me and making their treasuries full.
verses.textEnEsv: granting an inheritance to those who love me, and filling their treasuries.
verses.textEnNkjv: That I may cause those who love me to inherit wealth, That I may fill their treasuries.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who love me inherit wealth. I will fill their treasuries.
verses.textEnNasb: To endow those who love me with wealth, That I may fill their treasuries.
verses.textEn: bestowing a rich inheritance on those who love me and making their treasuries full.

verses.textZh: 在耶和华创造的开始， 在太初创造一切以先，就有了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在耶和华创造的开始， 在太初创造一切以先，就有了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 在耶和华造化的起头， 在太初创造万物之先，就有了我。
verses.textEnNiv: "The Lord brought me forth as the first of his works, before his deeds of old;
verses.textEnEsv: "The Lord possessed me at the beginning of his work, the first of his acts of old.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Lord possessed me at the beginning of His way, Before His works of old.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord formed me from the beginning, before he created anything else.
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord created me at the beginning of His way, Before His works of old.
verses.textEn: "The Lord brought me forth as the first of his works, before his deeds of old;

verses.textZh: 在亘古、在太初， 在未有大地之前，我已经被立；
verses.textZhCnvs: 在亘古、在太初， 在未有大地之前，我已经被立；
verses.textZhCuv: 从亘古，从太初， 未有世界以前，我已被立。
verses.textEnNiv: I was formed long ages ago, at the very beginning, when the world came to be.
verses.textEnEsv: Ages ago I was set up, at the first, before the beginning of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have been established from everlasting, From the beginning, before there was ever an earth.
verses.textEnNlt: I was appointed in ages past, at the very first, before the earth began.
verses.textEnNasb: "From eternity I was established, From the beginning, from the earliest times of the earth.
verses.textEn: I was formed long ages ago, at the very beginning, when the world came to be.

verses.textZh: 没有深渊，没有大水的泉源以先， 我已经出生。
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有深渊，没有大水的泉源以先， 我已经出生。
verses.textZhCuv: 没有深渊， 没有大水的泉源，我已生出。
verses.textEnNiv: When there were no watery depths, I was given birth, when there were no springs overflowing with water;
verses.textEnEsv: When there were no depths I was brought forth, when there were no springs abounding with water.
verses.textEnNkjv: When therewere no depths I was brought forth, When therewere no fountains abounding with water.
verses.textEnNlt: I was born before the oceans were created, before the springs bubbled forth their waters.
verses.textEnNasb: "When there were no ocean depths, I was born, When there were no springs abounding with water.
verses.textEn: When there were no watery depths, I was given birth, when there were no springs overflowing with water;

verses.textZh: 大山未曾奠定， 小山未有以先，我已经出生。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大山未曾奠定， 小山未有以先，我已经出生。
verses.textZhCuv: 大山未曾奠定， 小山未有之先，我已生出。
verses.textEnNiv: before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was given birth,
verses.textEnEsv: Before the mountains had been shaped, before the hills, I was brought forth,
