verses.textEnNkjv: Before the mountains were settled, Before the hills, I was brought forth;
verses.textEnNlt: Before the mountains were formed, before the hills, I was born—
verses.textEnNasb: "Before the mountains were settled, Before the hills, I was born;
verses.textEn: before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was given birth,

verses.textZh: 那时，耶和华还没有造大地和田野， 也没有造地上的泥土。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，耶和华还没有造大地和田野， 也没有造地上的泥土。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华还没有创造大地和田野， 并世上的土质，我已生出。
verses.textEnNiv: before he made the world or its fields or any of the dust of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: before he had made the earth with its fields, or the first of the dust of the world.
verses.textEnNkjv: While as yet He had not made the earth or the fields, Or the primal dust of the world.
verses.textEnNlt: before he had made the earth and fields and the first handfuls of soil.
verses.textEnNasb: While He had not yet made the earth and the fields, Nor the first dust of the world.
verses.textEn: before he made the world or its fields or any of the dust of the earth.

verses.textZh: 他立定诸天的时候，我在那里； 他在渊面上界划地平线的时候，我在那里；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他立定诸天的时候，我在那里； 他在渊面上界划地平线的时候，我在那里；
verses.textZhCuv: 他立高天，我在那里； 他在渊面的周围，划出圆圈。
verses.textEnNiv: I was there when he set the heavens in place, when he marked out the horizon on the face of the deep,
verses.textEnEsv: When he established the heavens, I was there; when he drew a circle on the face of the deep,
verses.textEnNkjv: When He prepared the heavens, I was there, When He drew a circle on the face of the deep,
verses.textEnNlt: I was there when he established the heavens, when he drew the horizon on the oceans.
verses.textEnNasb: "When He established the heavens, I was there; When He inscribed a circle on the face of the deep,
verses.textEn: I was there when he set the heavens in place, when he marked out the horizon on the face of the deep,

verses.textZh: 他上使穹苍坚固， 下使深渊的水泉稳定；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他上使穹苍坚固， 下使深渊的水泉稳定；
verses.textZhCuv: 上使穹苍坚硬， 下使渊源稳固，
verses.textEnNiv: when he established the clouds above and fixed securely the fountains of the deep,
verses.textEnEsv: when he made firm the skies above, when he established the fountains of the deep,
verses.textEnNkjv: When He established the clouds above, When He strengthened the fountains of the deep,
verses.textEnNlt: I was there when he set the clouds above, when he established springs deep in the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: When He made firm the skies above, When the springs of the deep became fixed,
verses.textEn: when he established the clouds above and fixed securely the fountains of the deep,

verses.textZh: 他为海洋定出界限， 海水不能越过他的命令， 他又划定大地的根基；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他为海洋定出界限， 海水不能越过他的命令， 他又划定大地的根基；
verses.textZhCuv: 为沧海定出界限，使水不越过他的命令， 立定大地的根基。
verses.textEnNiv: when he gave the sea its boundary so the waters would not overstep his command, and when he marked out the foundations of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: when he assigned to the sea its limit, so that the waters might not transgress his command, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,
verses.textEnNkjv: When He assigned to the sea its limit, So that the waters would not transgress His command, When He marked out the foundations of the earth,
verses.textEnNlt: I was there when he set the limits of the seas, so they would not spread beyond their boundaries. And when he marked off the earth’s foundations,
verses.textEnNasb: When He set a boundary for the sea So that the water would not violate His command, When He marked out the foundations of the earth;
verses.textEn: when he gave the sea its boundary so the waters would not overstep his command, and when he marked out the foundations of the earth.

verses.textZh: 那时，我在他身边作工匠， 每天都充满喜乐， 时常在他面前欢笑，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，我在他身边作工匠， 每天都充满喜乐， 时常在他面前欢笑，
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，我在他那里为工师， 日日为他所喜爱， 常常在他面前踊跃，
verses.textEnNiv: Then I was constantly at his side. I was filled with delight day after day, rejoicing always in his presence,
verses.textEnEsv: then I was beside him, like a master workman, and I was daily his delight, rejoicing before him always,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I was beside Him as a master craftsman; And I was daily His delight, Rejoicing always before Him,
verses.textEnNlt: I was the architect at his side. I was his constant delight, rejoicing always in his presence.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I was beside Him, as a master workman; And I was His delight daily, Rejoicing always before Him,
verses.textEn: Then I was constantly at his side. I was filled with delight day after day, rejoicing always in his presence,

verses.textZh: 在他的大地上欢笑， 和世人一同喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他的大地上欢笑， 和世人一同喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 踊跃在他为人预备可住之地， 也喜悦住在世人之间。
verses.textEnNiv: rejoicing in his whole world and delighting in mankind.
verses.textEnEsv: rejoicing in his inhabited world and delighting in the children of man.
verses.textEnNkjv: Rejoicing in His inhabited world, And my delight was with the sons of men.
verses.textEnNlt: And how happy I was with the world he created; how I rejoiced with the human family!
verses.textEnNasb: Rejoicing in the world, His earth, And having my delight in the sons of mankind.
verses.textEn: rejoicing in his whole world and delighting in mankind.

verses.textZh: 孩子们，现在你们要听从我； 持守我道路的，是有福的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 孩子们，现在你们要听从我； 持守我道路的，是有福的。
verses.textZhCuv: 众子啊，现在要听从我， 因为谨守我道的，便为有福。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now then, my children, listen to me; blessed are those who keep my ways.
verses.textEnEsv: "And now, O sons, listen to me: blessed are those who keep my ways.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now therefore, listen to me, my children, For blessed arethosewho keep my ways.
verses.textEnNlt: "And so, my children, listen to me, for all who follow my ways are joyful.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now then, sons, listen to me, For blessed are those who keep my ways.
verses.textEn: "Now then, my children, listen to me; blessed are those who keep my ways.

verses.textZh: 你们要听从教训，要作智慧人， 不可离弃教训。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要听从教训，要作智慧人， 不可离弃教训。
verses.textZhCuv: 要听教训就得智慧， 不可弃绝。
verses.textEnNiv: Listen to my instruction and be wise; do not disregard it.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear instruction and be wise, and do not neglect it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear instruction and be wise, And do not disdain it.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to my instruction and be wise. Don’t ignore it.
verses.textEnNasb: "Listen to instruction and be wise, And do not neglect it.
verses.textEn: Listen to my instruction and be wise; do not disregard it.

verses.textZh: 听从我， 天天在我门口警醒仰望， 在我门框旁边守候的人，是有福的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 听从我， 天天在我门口警醒仰望， 在我门框旁边守候的人，是有福的。
verses.textZhCuv: 听从我、日日在我门口仰望、 在我门框旁边等候的，那人便为有福。
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed are those who listen to me, watching daily at my doors, waiting at my doorway.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed is the one who listens to me, watching daily at my gates, waiting beside my doors.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed is the man who listens to me, Watching daily at my gates, Waiting at the posts of my doors.
verses.textEnNlt: Joyful are those who listen to me, watching for me daily at my gates, waiting for me outside my home!
verses.textEnNasb: "Blessed is the person who listens to me, Watching daily at my gates, Waiting at my doorposts.
verses.textEn: Blessed are those who listen to me, watching daily at my doors, waiting at my doorway.

verses.textZh: 因为找到我的，就找到生命， 他也必得着耶和华的恩惠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为找到我的，就找到生命， 他也必得着耶和华的恩惠。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为寻得我的，就寻得生命， 也必蒙耶和华的恩惠。
verses.textEnNiv: For those who find me find life and receive favor from the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: For whoever finds me finds life and obtains favor from the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: For whoever finds me finds life, And obtains favor from the Lord;
verses.textEnNlt: For whoever finds me finds life and receives favor from the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "For one who finds me finds life, And obtains favor from the Lord.
verses.textEn: For those who find me find life and receive favor from the Lord .

verses.textZh: 得罪我的，是伤害自己； 凡是恨恶我的，就是喜爱死亡。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 得罪我的，是伤害自己； 凡是恨恶我的，就是喜爱死亡。"
verses.textZhCuv: 得罪我的，却害了自己的性命； 恨恶我的，都喜爱死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: But those who fail to find me harm themselves; all who hate me love death."
verses.textEnEsv: but he who fails to find me injures himself; all who hate me love death."
verses.textEnNkjv: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul; All those who hate me love death."
verses.textEnNlt: But those who miss me injure themselves. All who hate me love death."
verses.textEnNasb: "But one who sins against me injures himself; All those who hate me love death."
verses.textEn: But those who fail to find me harm themselves; all who hate me love death."

verses.textZh: 智慧建造自己的房屋， 凿成七根柱子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧建造自己的房屋， 凿成七根柱子。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧建造房屋， 凿成七根柱子，
verses.textEnNiv: Wisdom has built her house; she has set up its seven pillars.
verses.textEnEsv: Wisdom has built her house; she has hewn her seven pillars.
verses.textEnNkjv: Wisdom has built her house, She has hewn out her seven pillars;
verses.textEnNlt: Wisdom has built her house; she has carved its seven columns.
verses.textEnNasb: Wisdom has built her house, She has carved out her seven pillars;
verses.textEn: Wisdom has built her house; she has set up its seven pillars.

verses.textZh: 它宰杀牲口，调配美酒， 摆设筵席。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它宰杀牲口，调配美酒， 摆设筵席。
verses.textZhCuv: 宰杀牲畜， 调和旨酒， 设摆筵席；
verses.textEnNiv: She has prepared her meat and mixed her wine; she has also set her table.
verses.textEnEsv: She has slaughtered her beasts; she has mixed her wine; she has also set her table.
verses.textEnNkjv: She has slaughtered her meat, She has mixed her wine, She has also furnished her table.
verses.textEnNlt: She has prepared a great banquet, mixed the wines, and set the table.
verses.textEnNasb: She has prepared her food, she has mixed her wine; She has also set her table;
verses.textEn: She has prepared her meat and mixed her wine; she has also set her table.

verses.textZh: 它差派几个使女出去， 自己又在城里的高处呼喊：
verses.textZhCnvs: 它差派几个使女出去， 自己又在城里的高处呼喊：
verses.textZhCuv: 打发使女出去， 自己在城中至高处呼叫，
verses.textEnNiv: She has sent out her servants, and she calls from the highest point of the city,
verses.textEnEsv: She has sent out her young women to call from the highest places in the town,
verses.textEnNkjv: She has sent out her maidens, She cries out from the highest places of the city,
verses.textEnNlt: She has sent her servants to invite everyone to come. She calls out from the heights overlooking the city.
verses.textEnNasb: She has sent out her attendants, she calls out From the tops of the heights of the city:
verses.textEn: She has sent out her servants, and she calls from the highest point of the city,

verses.textZh: "谁是愚蒙人， 可以到这里来！" 又对无知的人说：
verses.textZhCnvs: "谁是愚蒙人， 可以到这里来！" 又对无知的人说：
verses.textZhCuv: 说：谁是愚蒙人，可以转到这里来！ 又对那无知的人说：
verses.textEnNiv: "Let all who are simple come to my house!" To those who have no sense she says,
verses.textEnEsv: "Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!" To him who lacks sense she says,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!" Asfor him who lacks understanding, she says to him,
verses.textEnNlt: "Come in with me," she urges the simple. To those who lack good judgment, she says,
verses.textEnNasb: "Whoever is naive, let him turn in here!" To him who lacks understanding she says,
verses.textEn: "Let all who are simple come to my house!" To those who have no sense she says,

verses.textZh: "你们都来，吃我的饼， 喝我调配的酒。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们都来，吃我的饼， 喝我调配的酒。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们来，吃我的饼， 喝我调和的酒。
verses.textEnNiv: "Come, eat my food and drink the wine I have mixed.
verses.textEnEsv: "Come, eat of my bread and drink of the wine I have mixed.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Come, eat of my bread And drink of the wine I have mixed.
verses.textEnNlt: "Come, eat my food, and drink the wine I have mixed.
verses.textEnNasb: "Come, eat of my food And drink of the wine I have mixed.
verses.textEn: "Come, eat my food and drink the wine I have mixed.

verses.textZh: 愚蒙人哪！你们要丢弃愚蒙，就可以存活， 并且要走在智慧的道路上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚蒙人哪！你们要丢弃愚蒙，就可以存活， 并且要走在智慧的道路上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们愚蒙人，要舍弃愚蒙， 就得存活，并要走光明的道。
verses.textEnNiv: Leave your simple ways and you will live; walk in the way of insight."
verses.textEnEsv: Leave your simple ways, and live, and walk in the way of insight."
verses.textEnNkjv: Forsake foolishness and live, And go in the way of understanding.
verses.textEnNlt: Leave your simple ways behind, and begin to live; learn to use good judgment."
verses.textEnNasb: " Abandon your foolishness and live, And proceed in the way of understanding."
verses.textEn: Leave your simple ways and you will live; walk in the way of insight."

verses.textZh: 纠正好讥笑人的，必自招耻辱； 责备恶人的，必遭受羞辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 纠正好讥笑人的，必自招耻辱； 责备恶人的，必遭受羞辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 指斥亵慢人的，必受辱骂； 责备恶人的，必被玷污。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever corrects a mocker invites insults; whoever rebukes the wicked incurs abuse.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever corrects a scoffer gets himself abuse, and he who reproves a wicked man incurs injury.
verses.textEnNkjv: "He who corrects a scoffer gets shame for himself, And he who rebukes a wicked manonly harms himself.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who rebukes a mocker will get an insult in return. Anyone who corrects the wicked will get hurt.
verses.textEnNasb: One who corrects a scoffer gets dishonor for himself, And one who rebukes a wicked person gets insults for himself.
verses.textEn: Whoever corrects a mocker invites insults; whoever rebukes the wicked incurs abuse.

verses.textZh: 你不要责备好讥笑人的， 免得他恨你； 要责备智慧人，他必爱你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不要责备好讥笑人的， 免得他恨你； 要责备智慧人，他必爱你。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要责备亵慢人，恐怕他恨你； 要责备智慧人，他必爱你。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not rebuke mockers or they will hate you; rebuke the wise and they will love you.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not reprove a scoffer, or he will hate you; reprove a wise man, and he will love you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not correct a scoffer, lest he hate you; Rebuke a wise man, and he will love you.
verses.textEnNlt: So don’t bother correcting mockers; they will only hate you. But correct the wise, and they will love you.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not rebuke a scoffer, or he will hate you; Rebuke a wise person and he will love you.
verses.textEn: Do not rebuke mockers or they will hate you; rebuke the wise and they will love you.

verses.textZh: 教导智慧人，他就越有智慧； 指教义人，他就增加学问。
verses.textZhCnvs: 教导智慧人，他就越有智慧； 指教义人，他就增加学问。
verses.textZhCuv: 教导智慧人，他就越发有智慧； 指示义人，他就增长学问。
verses.textEnNiv: Instruct the wise and they will be wiser still; teach the righteous and they will add to their learning.
verses.textEnEsv: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be still wiser; teach a righteous man, and he will increase in learning.
verses.textEnNkjv: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be still wiser; Teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.
verses.textEnNlt: Instruct the wise, and they will be even wiser. Teach the righteous, and they will learn even more.
verses.textEnNasb: Give instruction to a wise person and he will become still wiser; Teach a righteous person and he will increase his insight.
verses.textEn: Instruct the wise and they will be wiser still; teach the righteous and they will add to their learning.

verses.textZh: 敬畏耶和华是智慧的开端， 认识至圣者就是聪明。
verses.textZhCnvs: 敬畏耶和华是智慧的开端， 认识至圣者就是聪明。
verses.textZhCuv: 敬畏耶和华是智慧的开端； 认识至圣者便是聪明。
verses.textEnNiv: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
verses.textEnEsv: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, and the knowledge of the Holy One is insight.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The fear of the Lordis the beginning of wisdom, And the knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
verses.textEnNlt: Fear of the Lord is the foundation of wisdom. Knowledge of the Holy One results in good judgment.
verses.textEnNasb: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, And the knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
verses.textEn: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

verses.textZh: 因为借着我，你的日子就必增多， 你一生的年岁也必加添。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为借着我，你的日子就必增多， 你一生的年岁也必加添。
verses.textZhCuv: 你藉着我，日子必增多， 年岁也必加添。
verses.textEnNiv: For through wisdom your days will be many, and years will be added to your life.
verses.textEnEsv: For by me your days will be multiplied, and years will be added to your life.
verses.textEnNkjv: For by me your days will be multiplied, And years of life will be added to you.
verses.textEnNlt: Wisdom will multiply your days and add years to your life.
verses.textEnNasb: For by me your days will be multiplied, And years of life will be added to you.
verses.textEn: For through wisdom your days will be many, and years will be added to your life.

verses.textZh: 如果你有智慧，你的智慧必使你得益； 如果你讥笑人，你就必独自担当一切后果。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你有智慧，你的智慧必使你得益； 如果你讥笑人，你就必独自担当一切后果。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若有智慧，是与自己有益； 你若亵慢，就必独自担当。
verses.textEnNiv: If you are wise, your wisdom will reward you; if you are a mocker, you alone will suffer.
verses.textEnEsv: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself; if you scoff, you alone will bear it.
verses.textEnNkjv: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself, And if you scoff, you will bear it alone."
verses.textEnNlt: If you become wise, you will be the one to benefit. If you scorn wisdom, you will be the one to suffer.
verses.textEnNasb: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself, And if you scoff, you alone will suffer from it.
verses.textEn: If you are wise, your wisdom will reward you; if you are a mocker, you alone will suffer.

verses.textZh: 愚昧的妇人喧哗不停， 她是愚蒙，一无所知。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚昧的妇人喧哗不停， 她是愚蒙，一无所知。
verses.textZhCuv: 愚昧的妇人喧嚷； 她是愚蒙，一无所知。
verses.textEnNiv: Folly is an unruly woman; she is simple and knows nothing.
verses.textEnEsv: The woman Folly is loud; she is seductive and knows nothing.
verses.textEnNkjv: A foolish woman is clamorous; Sheis simple, and knows nothing.
verses.textEnNlt: The woman named Folly is brash. She is ignorant and doesn’t know it.
verses.textEnNasb: A woman of foolishness is boisterous, She has a lack of understanding and knows nothing.
verses.textEn: Folly is an unruly woman; she is simple and knows nothing.

verses.textZh: 她坐在自己的家门口， 坐在城中高处的座位上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 她坐在自己的家门口， 坐在城中高处的座位上，
verses.textZhCuv: 她坐在自己的家门口， 坐在城中高处的座位上，
verses.textEnNiv: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat at the highest point of the city,
verses.textEnEsv: She sits at the door of her house; she takes a seat on the highest places of the town,
verses.textEnNkjv: For she sits at the door of her house, On a seat by the highest places of the city,
verses.textEnNlt: She sits in her doorway on the heights overlooking the city.
verses.textEnNasb: She sits at the doorway of her house, On a seat by the high places of the city,
verses.textEn: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat at the highest point of the city,

verses.textZh: 向过路的人呼叫， 就是向往前直行的人呼叫：
verses.textZhCnvs: 向过路的人呼叫， 就是向往前直行的人呼叫：
verses.textZhCuv: 呼叫过路的， 就是直行其道的人，
verses.textEnNiv: calling out to those who pass by, who go straight on their way,
verses.textEnEsv: calling to those who pass by, who are going straight on their way,
verses.textEnNkjv: To call to those who pass by, Who go straight on their way:
verses.textEnNlt: She calls out to men going by who are minding their own business.
verses.textEnNasb: Calling to those who pass by, Who are going straight on their paths:
verses.textEn: calling out to those who pass by, who go straight on their way,

verses.textZh: "谁是愚蒙人，可以到这里来！" 又对无知的人说：
verses.textZhCnvs: "谁是愚蒙人，可以到这里来！" 又对无知的人说：
verses.textZhCuv: 说：谁是愚蒙人，可以转到这里来！ 又对那无知的人说：
verses.textEnNiv: "Let all who are simple come to my house!" To those who have no sense she says,
verses.textEnEsv: "Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!" And to him who lacks sense she says,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Whoever is simple, let him turn in here"; And asfor him who lacks understanding, she says to him,
verses.textEnNlt: "Come in with me," she urges the simple. To those who lack good judgment, she says,
verses.textEnNasb: "Whoever is naive, let him turn in here," And to him who lacks understanding she says,
verses.textEn: "Let all who are simple come to my house!" To those who have no sense she says,

verses.textZh: "偷来的水是甜的， 在暗中吃的饼是美味的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "偷来的水是甜的， 在暗中吃的饼是美味的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 偷来的水是甜的， 暗吃的饼是好的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Stolen water is sweet; food eaten in secret is delicious!"
verses.textEnEsv: "Stolen water is sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Stolen water is sweet, And bread eaten in secret is pleasant."
verses.textEnNlt: "Stolen water is refreshing; food eaten in secret tastes the best!"
verses.textEnNasb: "Stolen water is sweet; And bread eaten in secret is pleasant."
verses.textEn: "Stolen water is sweet; food eaten in secret is delicious!"

verses.textZh: 人却不知道她那里有阴魂， 她的客人是在阴间的深处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人却不知道她那里有阴魂， 她的客人是在阴间的深处。
verses.textZhCuv: 人却不知有阴魂在她那里； 她的客在阴间的深处。
verses.textEnNiv: But little do they know that the dead are there, that her guests are deep in the realm of the dead.
verses.textEnEsv: But he does not know that the dead are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he does not know that the dead are there, That her guests are in the depths of hell.
verses.textEnNlt: But little do they know that the dead are there. Her guests are in the depths of the grave.
verses.textEnNasb: But he does not know that the dead are there, That her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
verses.textEn: But little do they know that the dead are there, that her guests are deep in the realm of the dead.

verses.textZh: 所罗门的箴言： 智慧的儿子使父亲欢乐， 愚昧的儿子使母亲忧愁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门的箴言： 智慧的儿子使父亲欢乐， 愚昧的儿子使母亲忧愁。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门的箴言： 智慧之子使父亲欢乐； 愚昧之子叫母亲担忧。
verses.textEnNiv: The proverbs of Solomon: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.
verses.textEnEsv: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father, but a foolish son is a sorrow to his mother.
verses.textEnNkjv: The proverbs of Solomon: A wise son makes a glad father, But a foolish son is the grief of his mother.
verses.textEnNlt: The proverbs of Solomon: A wise child brings joy to a father; a foolish child brings grief to a mother.
verses.textEnNasb: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a father glad, But a foolish son is a grief to his mother.
verses.textEn: The proverbs of Solomon: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.

verses.textZh: 不义之财毫无益处， 唯有公义能救人脱离死亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不义之财毫无益处， 唯有公义能救人脱离死亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 不义之财毫无益处； 惟有公义能救人脱离死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: Ill-gotten treasures have no lasting value, but righteousness delivers from death.
verses.textEnEsv: Treasures gained by wickedness do not profit, but righteousness delivers from death.
verses.textEnNkjv: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, But righteousness delivers from death.
verses.textEnNlt: Tainted wealth has no lasting value, but right living can save your life.
verses.textEnNasb: Ill-gotten gains do not benefit, But righteousness rescues from death.
verses.textEn: Ill-gotten treasures have no lasting value, but righteousness delivers from death.

verses.textZh: 耶和华不容许义人忍受饥饿， 恶人的欲念却无法得着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华不容许义人忍受饥饿， 恶人的欲念却无法得着。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华不使义人受饥饿； 恶人所欲的，他必推开。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord does not let the righteous go hungry, but he thwarts the craving of the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord does not let the righteous go hungry, but he thwarts the craving of the wicked.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord will not allow the righteous soul to famish, But He casts away the desire of the wicked.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will not let the godly go hungry, but he refuses to satisfy the craving of the wicked.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will not allow the righteous to hunger, But He will reject the craving of the wicked.
verses.textEn: The Lord does not let the righteous go hungry, but he thwarts the craving of the wicked.

verses.textZh: 游手好闲的，招致贫穷， 勤力工作的，得到富足。
verses.textZhCnvs: 游手好闲的，招致贫穷， 勤力工作的，得到富足。
verses.textZhCuv: 手懒的，要受贫穷； 手勤的，却要富足。
verses.textEnNiv: Lazy hands make for poverty, but diligent hands bring wealth.
verses.textEnEsv: A slack hand causes poverty, but the hand of the diligent makes rich.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who has a slack hand becomes poor, But the hand of the diligent makes rich.
verses.textEnNlt: Lazy people are soon poor; hard workers get rich.
verses.textEnNasb: Poor is one who works with a lazy hand, But the hand of the diligent makes rich.
verses.textEn: Lazy hands make for poverty, but diligent hands bring wealth.

verses.textZh: 夏天收聚的，是明慧的人， 收割时沉睡的，是贻羞的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 夏天收聚的，是明慧的人， 收割时沉睡的，是贻羞的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 夏天聚敛的，是智慧之子； 收割时沉睡的，是贻羞之子。
verses.textEnNiv: He who gathers crops in summer is a prudent son, but he who sleeps during harvest is a disgraceful son.
verses.textEnEsv: He who gathers in summer is a prudent son, but he who sleeps in harvest is a son who brings shame.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who gathers in summer is a wise son; He who sleeps in harvest is a son who causes shame.
verses.textEnNlt: A wise youth harvests in the summer, but one who sleeps during harvest is a disgrace.
verses.textEnNasb: He who gathers in summer is a son who acts wisely, But he who sleeps in harvest is a son who acts shamefully.
verses.textEn: He who gathers crops in summer is a prudent son, but he who sleeps during harvest is a disgraceful son.

verses.textZh: 福祉临到义人头上， 强暴遮盖恶人的口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 福祉临到义人头上， 强暴遮盖恶人的口。
verses.textZhCuv: 福祉临到义人的头； 强暴蒙蔽恶人的口。
verses.textEnNiv: Blessings crown the head of the righteous, but violence overwhelms the mouth of the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, But violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
verses.textEnNlt: The godly are showered with blessings; the words of the wicked conceal violent intentions.
verses.textEnNasb: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, But the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.
verses.textEn: Blessings crown the head of the righteous, but violence overwhelms the mouth of the wicked.

verses.textZh: 义人的名必蒙称赞， 恶人的名字却必腐朽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人的名必蒙称赞， 恶人的名字却必腐朽。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人的纪念被称赞； 恶人的名字必朽烂。
verses.textEnNiv: The name of the righteous is used in blessings, but the name of the wicked will rot.
verses.textEnEsv: The memory of the righteous is a blessing, but the name of the wicked will rot.
verses.textEnNkjv: The memory of the righteous is blessed, But the name of the wicked will rot.
verses.textEnNlt: We have happy memories of the godly, but the name of a wicked person rots away.
verses.textEnNasb: The mentioning of the righteous is a blessing, But the name of the wicked will rot.
verses.textEn: The name of the righteous is used in blessings, but the name of the wicked will rot.

verses.textZh: 心存智慧的，必接受诫命； 嘴唇愚妄的，必自招灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 心存智慧的，必接受诫命； 嘴唇愚妄的，必自招灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 心中智慧的，必受命令； 口里愚妄的，必致倾倒。
verses.textEnNiv: The wise in heart accept commands, but a chattering fool comes to ruin.
verses.textEnEsv: The wise of heart will receive commandments, but a babbling fool will come to ruin.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wise in heart will receive commands, But a prating fool will fall.
verses.textEnNlt: The wise are glad to be instructed, but babbling fools fall flat on their faces.
verses.textEnNasb: The wise of heart will receive commands, But a babbling fool will come to ruin.
verses.textEn: The wise in heart accept commands, but a chattering fool comes to ruin.

verses.textZh: 行为完全的，步步安稳； 行事弯曲的，终必败露。
verses.textZhCnvs: 行为完全的，步步安稳； 行事弯曲的，终必败露。
verses.textZhCuv: 行正直路的，步步安稳； 走弯曲道的，必致败露。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever walks in integrity walks securely, but whoever takes crooked paths will be found out.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever walks in integrity walks securely, but he who makes his ways crooked will be found out.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who walks with integrity walks securely, But he who perverts his ways will become known.
verses.textEnNlt: People with integrity walk safely, but those who follow crooked paths will be exposed.
verses.textEnNasb: One who walks in integrity walks securely, But one who perverts his ways will be found out.
verses.textEn: Whoever walks in integrity walks securely, but whoever takes crooked paths will be found out.

verses.textZh: 以眼传神的，使人受害； 嘴唇愚妄的，必自招灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以眼传神的，使人受害； 嘴唇愚妄的，必自招灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 以眼传神的，使人忧患； 口里愚妄的，必致倾倒。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever winks maliciously causes grief, and a chattering fool comes to ruin.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever winks the eye causes trouble, and a babbling fool will come to ruin.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who winks with the eye causes trouble, But a prating fool will fall.
verses.textEnNlt: People who wink at wrong cause trouble, but a bold reproof promotes peace.
verses.textEnNasb: He who winks the eye causes trouble, And a babbling fool will come to ruin.
verses.textEn: Whoever winks maliciously causes grief, and a chattering fool comes to ruin.

verses.textZh: 义人的口是生命的泉源， 强暴遮盖恶人的口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人的口是生命的泉源， 强暴遮盖恶人的口。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人的口是生命的泉源； 强暴蒙蔽恶人的口。
verses.textEnNiv: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.
verses.textEnEsv: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.
verses.textEnNkjv: The mouth of the righteous is a well of life, But violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
verses.textEnNlt: The words of the godly are a life-giving fountain; the words of the wicked conceal violent intentions.
verses.textEnNasb: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, But the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.
verses.textEn: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.

verses.textZh: 恨能挑起纷争， 爱能遮掩一切过失。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恨能挑起纷争， 爱能遮掩一切过失。
verses.textZhCuv: 恨能挑启争端； 爱能遮掩一切过错。
verses.textEnNiv: Hatred stirs up conflict, but love covers over all wrongs.
verses.textEnEsv: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all offenses.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hatred stirs up strife, But love covers all sins.
verses.textEnNlt: Hatred stirs up quarrels, but love makes up for all offenses.
verses.textEnNasb: Hatred stirs up strife, But love covers all offenses.
verses.textEn: Hatred stirs up conflict, but love covers over all wrongs.

verses.textZh: 聪明人嘴里有智慧， 无知人背上受刑杖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 聪明人嘴里有智慧， 无知人背上受刑杖。
verses.textZhCuv: 明哲人嘴里有智慧； 无知人背上受刑杖。
verses.textEnNiv: Wisdom is found on the lips of the discerning, but a rod is for the back of one who has no sense.
verses.textEnEsv: On the lips of him who has understanding, wisdom is found, but a rod is for the back of him who lacks sense.
verses.textEnNkjv: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has understanding, But a rod is for the back of him who is devoid of understanding.
verses.textEnNlt: Wise words come from the lips of people with understanding, but those lacking sense will be beaten with a rod.
verses.textEnNasb: On the lips of the discerning, wisdom is found, But a rod is for the back of him who has no sense.
verses.textEn: Wisdom is found on the lips of the discerning, but a rod is for the back of one who has no sense.

verses.textZh: 智慧人积存知识， 愚妄人的口招致毁灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧人积存知识， 愚妄人的口招致毁灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧人积存知识； 愚妄人的口速致败坏。
verses.textEnNiv: The wise store up knowledge, but the mouth of a fool invites ruin.
verses.textEnEsv: The wise lay up knowledge, but the mouth of a fool brings ruin near.
verses.textEnNkjv: Wise people store up knowledge, But the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.
verses.textEnNlt: Wise people treasure knowledge, but the babbling of a fool invites disaster.
verses.textEnNasb: Wise people store up knowledge, But with the mouth of the foolish, ruin is at hand.
verses.textEn: The wise store up knowledge, but the mouth of a fool invites ruin.

verses.textZh: 富翁的财物是他的坚城， 穷人的贫乏是他灭亡的因由。
verses.textZhCnvs: 富翁的财物是他的坚城， 穷人的贫乏是他灭亡的因由。
verses.textZhCuv: 富户的财物是他的坚城； 穷人的贫乏是他的败坏。
verses.textEnNiv: The wealth of the rich is their fortified city, but poverty is the ruin of the poor.
verses.textEnEsv: A rich man’s wealth is his strong city; the poverty of the poor is their ruin.
verses.textEnNkjv: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city; The destruction of the poor is their poverty.
verses.textEnNlt: The wealth of the rich is their fortress; the poverty of the poor is their destruction.
verses.textEnNasb: The rich person’s wealth is his fortress, The ruin of the poor is their poverty.
verses.textEn: The wealth of the rich is their fortified city, but poverty is the ruin of the poor.

verses.textZh: 义人的工价就是生命， 恶人所得的却是刑罚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人的工价就是生命， 恶人所得的却是刑罚。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人的勤劳致生； 恶人的进项致死 。
verses.textEnNiv: The wages of the righteous is life, but the earnings of the wicked are sin and death.
verses.textEnEsv: The wage of the righteous leads to life, the gain of the wicked to sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: The labor of the righteous leads to life, The wages of the wicked to sin.
verses.textEnNlt: The earnings of the godly enhance their lives, but evil people squander their money on sin.
verses.textEnNasb: The wages of the righteous is life, The income of the wicked, punishment.
verses.textEn: The wages of the righteous is life, but the earnings of the wicked are sin and death.

verses.textZh: 遵守教训的，走在生命的路上； 离弃责备的，却是走上错路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 遵守教训的，走在生命的路上； 离弃责备的，却是走上错路。
verses.textZhCuv: 谨守训诲的，乃在生命的道上； 违弃责备的，便失迷了路。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever heeds discipline shows the way to life, but whoever ignores correction leads others astray.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever heeds instruction is on the path to life, but he who rejects reproof leads others astray.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who keeps instruction isin the way of life, But he who refuses correction goes astray.
verses.textEnNlt: People who accept discipline are on the pathway to life, but those who ignore correction will go astray.
verses.textEnNasb: One who is on the path of life follows instruction, But one who ignores a rebuke goes astray.
verses.textEn: Whoever heeds discipline shows the way to life, but whoever ignores correction leads others astray.

verses.textZh: 隐藏怨恨的，嘴里必出谎言； 散播谣言的，是愚昧人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 隐藏怨恨的，嘴里必出谎言； 散播谣言的，是愚昧人。
verses.textZhCuv: 隐藏怨恨的，有说谎的嘴； 口出谗谤的，是愚妄的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever conceals hatred with lying lips and spreads slander is a fool.
verses.textEnEsv: The one who conceals hatred has lying lips, and whoever utters slander is a fool.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever hides hatred has lying lips, And whoever spreads slander is a fool.
verses.textEnNlt: Hiding hatred makes you a liar; slandering others makes you a fool.
verses.textEnNasb: One who conceals hatred has lying lips, And one who spreads slander is a fool.
verses.textEn: Whoever conceals hatred with lying lips and spreads slander is a fool.

verses.textZh: 多言多语难免有过失； 约束自己嘴唇的，是明慧人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 多言多语难免有过失； 约束自己嘴唇的，是明慧人。
verses.textZhCuv: 多言多语难免有过； 禁止嘴唇是有智慧。
verses.textEnNiv: Sin is not ended by multiplying words, but the prudent hold their tongues.
verses.textEnEsv: When words are many, transgression is not lacking, but whoever restrains his lips is prudent.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the multitude of words sin is not lacking, But he who restrains his lips is wise.
verses.textEnNlt: Too much talk leads to sin. Be sensible and keep your mouth shut.
verses.textEnNasb: When there are many words, wrongdoing is unavoidable, But one who restrains his lips is wise.
verses.textEn: Sin is not ended by multiplying words, but the prudent hold their tongues.

verses.textZh: 义人的舌头好象纯银， 恶人的心思毫无价值。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人的舌头好象纯银， 恶人的心思毫无价值。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人的舌乃似高银； 恶人的心所值无几。
verses.textEnNiv: The tongue of the righteous is choice silver, but the heart of the wicked is of little value.
verses.textEnEsv: The tongue of the righteous is choice silver; the heart of the wicked is of little worth.
verses.textEnNkjv: The tongue of the righteous is choice silver; The heart of the wicked isworth little.
verses.textEnNlt: The words of the godly are like sterling silver; the heart of a fool is worthless.
verses.textEnNasb: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver, The heart of the wicked is worth little.
verses.textEn: The tongue of the righteous is choice silver, but the heart of the wicked is of little value.

verses.textZh: 义人的嘴唇培育多人， 愚妄人因无知死亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人的嘴唇培育多人， 愚妄人因无知死亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人的口教养多人； 愚昧人因无知而死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: The lips of the righteous nourish many, but fools die for lack of sense.
verses.textEnEsv: The lips of the righteous feed many, but fools die for lack of sense.
verses.textEnNkjv: The lips of the righteous feed many, But fools die for lack of wisdom.
verses.textEnNlt: The words of the godly encourage many, but fools are destroyed by their lack of common sense.
verses.textEnNasb: The lips of the righteous feed many, But fools die for lack of understanding.
verses.textEn: The lips of the righteous nourish many, but fools die for lack of sense.

verses.textZh: 耶和华所赐的福使人富足， 并不加上愁烦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华所赐的福使人富足， 并不加上愁烦。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华所赐的福使人富足， 并不加上忧虑。
verses.textEnNiv: The blessing of the Lord brings wealth, without painful toil for it.
verses.textEnEsv: The blessing of the Lord makes rich, and he adds no sorrow with it.
verses.textEnNkjv: The blessing of the Lord makes one rich, And He adds no sorrow with it.
verses.textEnNlt: The blessing of the Lord makes a person rich, and he adds no sorrow with it.
verses.textEnNasb: It is the blessing of the Lord that makes rich, And He adds no sorrow to it.
verses.textEn: The blessing of the Lord brings wealth, without painful toil for it.

verses.textZh: 愚昧人以行恶为嬉戏， 聪明人却以智慧为乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚昧人以行恶为嬉戏， 聪明人却以智慧为乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 愚妄人以行恶为戏耍； 明哲人却以智慧为乐。
verses.textEnNiv: A fool finds pleasure in wicked schemes, but a person of understanding delights in wisdom.
verses.textEnEsv: Doing wrong is like a joke to a fool, but wisdom is pleasure to a man of understanding.
verses.textEnNkjv: To do evil is like sport to a fool, But a man of understanding has wisdom.
verses.textEnNlt: Doing wrong is fun for a fool, but living wisely brings pleasure to the sensible.
verses.textEnNasb: Doing wickedness is like sport to a fool, And so is wisdom to a person of understanding.
verses.textEn: A fool finds pleasure in wicked schemes, but a person of understanding delights in wisdom.

verses.textZh: 恶人所怕的，必临到他身上； 义人所愿的，必蒙应允。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人所怕的，必临到他身上； 义人所愿的，必蒙应允。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人所怕的，必临到他； 义人所愿的，必蒙应允。
verses.textEnNiv: What the wicked dread will overtake them; what the righteous desire will be granted.
verses.textEnEsv: What the wicked dreads will come upon him, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.
verses.textEnNkjv: The fear of the wicked will come upon him, And the desire of the righteous will be granted.
verses.textEnNlt: The fears of the wicked will be fulfilled; the hopes of the godly will be granted.
verses.textEnNasb: What the wicked fears will come upon him, But the desire of the righteous will be granted.
verses.textEn: What the wicked dread will overtake them; what the righteous desire will be granted.

verses.textZh: 暴风一过，恶人就归于无有， 义人却有永远的根基。
verses.textZhCnvs: 暴风一过，恶人就归于无有， 义人却有永远的根基。
verses.textZhCuv: 暴风一过，恶人归于无有； 义人的根基却是永久。
verses.textEnNiv: When the storm has swept by, the wicked are gone, but the righteous stand firm forever.
verses.textEnEsv: When the tempest passes, the wicked is no more, but the righteous is established forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the whirlwind passes by, the wicked is no more, But the righteous has an everlasting foundation.
verses.textEnNlt: When the storms of life come, the wicked are whirled away, but the godly have a lasting foundation.
verses.textEnNasb: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more, But the righteous has an everlasting foundation.
verses.textEn: When the storm has swept by, the wicked are gone, but the righteous stand firm forever.

verses.textZh: 醋怎样使牙酸倒，烟怎样熏目， 懒惰人也怎样使差他的人难受。
verses.textZhCnvs: 醋怎样使牙酸倒，烟怎样熏目， 懒惰人也怎样使差他的人难受。
verses.textZhCuv: 懒惰人叫差他的人 如醋倒牙，如烟薰目。
verses.textEnNiv: As vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, so are sluggards to those who send them.
verses.textEnEsv: Like vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.
verses.textEnNkjv: As vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, So is the lazy man to those who send him.
verses.textEnNlt: Lazy people irritate their employers, like vinegar to the teeth or smoke in the eyes.
verses.textEnNasb: Like vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, So is the lazy one to those who send him.
verses.textEn: As vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, so are sluggards to those who send them.

verses.textZh: 敬畏耶和华可以延年益寿， 恶人的年岁必被减少。
verses.textZhCnvs: 敬畏耶和华可以延年益寿， 恶人的年岁必被减少。
verses.textZhCuv: 敬畏耶和华使人日子加多； 但恶人的年岁必被减少。
verses.textEnNiv: The fear of the Lord adds length to life, but the years of the wicked are cut short.
verses.textEnEsv: The fear of the Lord prolongs life, but the years of the wicked will be short.
verses.textEnNkjv: The fear of the Lord prolongs days, But the years of the wicked will be shortened.
verses.textEnNlt: Fear of the Lord lengthens one’s life, but the years of the wicked are cut short.
verses.textEnNasb: The fear of the Lord prolongs life, But the years of the wicked will be shortened.
verses.textEn: The fear of the Lord adds length to life, but the years of the wicked are cut short.

verses.textZh: 义人的盼望使他们喜乐， 恶人的希望终必幻灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人的盼望使他们喜乐， 恶人的希望终必幻灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人的盼望必得喜乐； 恶人的指望必致灭没。
verses.textEnNiv: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hopes of the wicked come to nothing.
verses.textEnEsv: The hope of the righteous brings joy, but the expectation of the wicked will perish.
verses.textEnNkjv: The hope of the righteous willbe gladness, But the expectation of the wicked will perish.
verses.textEnNlt: The hopes of the godly result in happiness, but the expectations of the wicked come to nothing.
verses.textEnNasb: The hope of the righteous is gladness, But the expectation of the wicked perishes.
verses.textEn: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hopes of the wicked come to nothing.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的道是完全人的保障， 却是作孽的人灭亡的因由。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的道是完全人的保障， 却是作孽的人灭亡的因由。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的道是正直人的保障， 却成了作孽人的败坏。
verses.textEnNiv: The way of the Lord is a refuge for the blameless, but it is the ruin of those who do evil.
verses.textEnEsv: The way of the Lord is a stronghold to the blameless, but destruction to evildoers.
verses.textEnNkjv: The way of the Lordis strength for the upright, But destruction willcome to the workers of iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: The way of the Lord is a stronghold to those with integrity, but it destroys the wicked.
verses.textEnNasb: The way of the Lord is a stronghold for the upright, But ruin to the workers of injustice.
verses.textEn: The way of the Lord is a refuge for the blameless, but it is the ruin of those who do evil.

verses.textZh: 义人永不动摇， 恶人却不得安居在地上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人永不动摇， 恶人却不得安居在地上。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人永不挪移； 恶人不得住在地上。
verses.textEnNiv: The righteous will never be uprooted, but the wicked will not remain in the land.
verses.textEnEsv: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: The righteous will never be removed, But the wicked will not inhabit the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: The godly will never be disturbed, but the wicked will be removed from the land.
verses.textEnNasb: The righteous will never be shaken, But the wicked will not live in the land.
verses.textEn: The righteous will never be uprooted, but the wicked will not remain in the land.

verses.textZh: 义人的口结出智慧的果子， 乖谬的舌头必被割除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人的口结出智慧的果子， 乖谬的舌头必被割除。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人的口滋生智慧； 乖谬的舌必被割断。
verses.textEnNiv: From the mouth of the righteous comes the fruit of wisdom, but a perverse tongue will be silenced.
verses.textEnEsv: The mouth of the righteous brings forth wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.
verses.textEnNkjv: The mouth of the righteous brings forth wisdom, But the perverse tongue will be cut out.
verses.textEnNlt: The mouth of the godly person gives wise advice, but the tongue that deceives will be cut off.
verses.textEnNasb: The mouth of the righteous flows with wisdom, But the perverted tongue will be cut out.
verses.textEn: From the mouth of the righteous comes the fruit of wisdom, but a perverse tongue will be silenced.

verses.textZh: 义人的嘴使人喜悦， 恶人的口说乖谬的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人的嘴使人喜悦， 恶人的口说乖谬的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人的嘴能令人喜悦； 恶人的口说乖谬的话。
verses.textEnNiv: The lips of the righteous know what finds favor, but the mouth of the wicked only what is perverse.
verses.textEnEsv: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked, what is perverse.
verses.textEnNkjv: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, But the mouth of the wicked whatis perverse.
verses.textEnNlt: The lips of the godly speak helpful words, but the mouth of the wicked speaks perverse words.
verses.textEnNasb: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, But the mouth of the wicked, what is perverted.
verses.textEn: The lips of the righteous know what finds favor, but the mouth of the wicked only what is perverse.

verses.textZh: 诡诈的天平是耶和华所厌恶的， 准确的法码是他所喜悦的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 诡诈的天平是耶和华所厌恶的， 准确的法码是他所喜悦的。
verses.textZhCuv: 诡诈的天平为耶和华所憎恶； 公平的法码为他所喜悦。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verses.textEnEsv: A false balance is an abomination to the Lord , but a just weight is his delight.
verses.textEnNkjv: Dishonest scales are an abomination to the Lord, But a just weight is His delight.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord detests the use of dishonest scales, but he delights in accurate weights.
verses.textEnNasb: A false balance is an abomination to the Lord, But a just weight is His delight.
verses.textEn: The Lord detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.

verses.textZh: 傲慢来，羞辱也来； 谦卑的人却有智慧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 傲慢来，羞辱也来； 谦卑的人却有智慧。
verses.textZhCuv: 骄傲来，羞耻也来； 谦逊人却有智慧。
verses.textEnNiv: When pride comes, then comes disgrace, but with humility comes wisdom.
verses.textEnEsv: When pride comes, then comes disgrace, but with the humble is wisdom.
verses.textEnNkjv: When pride comes, then comes shame; But with the humble is wisdom.
verses.textEnNlt: Pride leads to disgrace, but with humility comes wisdom.
verses.textEnNasb: When pride comes, then comes dishonor; But with the humble there is wisdom.
verses.textEn: When pride comes, then comes disgrace, but with humility comes wisdom.

verses.textZh: 正直人的纯正必引导他们自己， 奸诈人的奸恶却毁灭自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 正直人的纯正必引导他们自己， 奸诈人的奸恶却毁灭自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 正直人的纯正必引导自己； 奸诈人的乖僻必毁灭自己。
verses.textEnNiv: The integrity of the upright guides them, but the unfaithful are destroyed by their duplicity.
verses.textEnEsv: The integrity of the upright guides them, but the crookedness of the treacherous destroys them.
verses.textEnNkjv: The integrity of the upright will guide them, But the perversity of the unfaithful will destroy them.
verses.textEnNlt: Honesty guides good people; dishonesty destroys treacherous people.
verses.textEnNasb: The integrity of the upright will guide them, But the perversity of the treacherous will destroy them.
verses.textEn: The integrity of the upright guides them, but the unfaithful are destroyed by their duplicity.

verses.textZh: 在神发怒的日子，财物毫无益处； 唯有公义能救人脱离死亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在神发怒的日子，财物毫无益处； 唯有公义能救人脱离死亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 发怒的日子资财无益； 惟有公义能救人脱离死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: Wealth is worthless in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
verses.textEnEsv: Riches do not profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
verses.textEnNkjv: Riches do not profit in the day of wrath, But righteousness delivers from death.
verses.textEnNlt: Riches won’t help on the day of judgment, but right living can save you from death.
verses.textEnNasb: Riches do not benefit on the day of wrath, But righteousness rescues from death.
verses.textEn: Wealth is worthless in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.

verses.textZh: 完全人的公义，必使自己的路平坦正直， 但恶人必因自己的邪恶跌倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 完全人的公义，必使自己的路平坦正直， 但恶人必因自己的邪恶跌倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 完全人的义必指引他的路； 但恶人必因自己的恶跌倒。
verses.textEnNiv: The righteousness of the blameless makes their paths straight, but the wicked are brought down by their own wickedness.
verses.textEnEsv: The righteousness of the blameless keeps his way straight, but the wicked falls by his own wickedness.
verses.textEnNkjv: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way aright, But the wicked will fall by his own wickedness.
verses.textEnNlt: The godly are directed by honesty; the wicked fall beneath their load of sin.
verses.textEnNasb: The righteousness of the blameless will smooth his way, But the wicked will fall by his own wickedness.
verses.textEn: The righteousness of the blameless makes their paths straight, but the wicked are brought down by their own wickedness.

verses.textZh: 正直人的公义必拯救自己， 但奸诈人必陷溺于自己的恶欲中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 正直人的公义必拯救自己， 但奸诈人必陷溺于自己的恶欲中。
verses.textZhCuv: 正直人的义必拯救自己； 奸诈人必陷在自己的罪孽中。
verses.textEnNiv: The righteousness of the upright delivers them, but the unfaithful are trapped by evil desires.
verses.textEnEsv: The righteousness of the upright delivers them, but the treacherous are taken captive by their lust.
verses.textEnNkjv: The righteousness of the upright will deliver them, But the unfaithful will be caught by their lust.
verses.textEnNlt: The godliness of good people rescues them; the ambition of treacherous people traps them.
verses.textEnNasb: The righteousness of the upright will rescue them, But the treacherous will be caught by their own greed.
verses.textEn: The righteousness of the upright delivers them, but the unfaithful are trapped by evil desires.

verses.textZh: 恶人一死，他的希望就幻灭； 有能力的人的盼望也消灭了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人一死，他的希望就幻灭； 有能力的人的盼望也消灭了。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人一死，他的指望必灭绝； 罪人的盼望也必灭没。
verses.textEnNiv: Hopes placed in mortals die with them; all the promise of their power comes to nothing.
verses.textEnEsv: When the wicked dies, his hope will perish, and the expectation of wealth perishes too.
verses.textEnNkjv: When a wicked man dies, his expectation will perish, And the hope of the unjust perishes.
verses.textEnNlt: When the wicked die, their hopes die with them, for they rely on their own feeble strength.
verses.textEnNasb: When a wicked person dies, his expectation will perish, And the hope of strong people perishes.
verses.textEn: Hopes placed in mortals die with them; all the promise of their power comes to nothing.

verses.textZh: 义人得蒙拯救脱离患难， 恶人却来代替他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人得蒙拯救脱离患难， 恶人却来代替他。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人得脱离患难， 有恶人来代替他。
verses.textEnNiv: The righteous person is rescued from trouble, and it falls on the wicked instead.
verses.textEnEsv: The righteous is delivered from trouble, and the wicked walks into it instead.
verses.textEnNkjv: The righteous is delivered from trouble, And it comes to the wicked instead.
verses.textEnNlt: The godly are rescued from trouble, and it falls on the wicked instead.
verses.textEnNasb: The righteous is rescued from trouble, But the wicked takes his place.
verses.textEn: The righteous person is rescued from trouble, and it falls on the wicked instead.

verses.textZh: 不敬虔的人用口败坏邻舍， 义人却因知识免受其害。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不敬虔的人用口败坏邻舍， 义人却因知识免受其害。
verses.textZhCuv: 不虔敬的人用口败坏邻舍； 义人却因知识得救。
verses.textEnNiv: With their mouths the godless destroy their neighbors, but through knowledge the righteous escape.
verses.textEnEsv: With his mouth the godless man would destroy his neighbor, but by knowledge the righteous are delivered.
verses.textEnNkjv: The hypocrite with his mouth destroys his neighbor, But through knowledge the righteous will be delivered.
verses.textEnNlt: With their words, the godless destroy their friends, but knowledge will rescue the righteous.
verses.textEnNasb: With his mouth the godless person destroys his neighbor, But through knowledge the righteous will be rescued.
verses.textEn: With their mouths the godless destroy their neighbors, but through knowledge the righteous escape.

verses.textZh: 义人亨通，全城欢乐； 恶人灭亡，大家欢呼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人亨通，全城欢乐； 恶人灭亡，大家欢呼。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人享福，合城喜乐； 恶人灭亡，人都欢呼。
verses.textEnNiv: When the righteous prosper, the city rejoices; when the wicked perish, there are shouts of joy.
verses.textEnEsv: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices, and when the wicked perish there are shouts of gladness.
verses.textEnNkjv: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices; And when the wicked perish, thereis jubilation.
verses.textEnNlt: The whole city celebrates when the godly succeed; they shout for joy when the wicked die.
verses.textEnNasb: When things go well for the righteous, the city rejoices, And when the wicked perish, there is joyful shouting.
verses.textEn: When the righteous prosper, the city rejoices; when the wicked perish, there are shouts of joy.

verses.textZh: 因正直人的祝福，城的地位就提高； 因恶人的口，城就倾覆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因正直人的祝福，城的地位就提高； 因恶人的口，城就倾覆。
verses.textZhCuv: 城因正直人祝福便高举， 却因邪恶人的口就倾覆。
verses.textEnNiv: Through the blessing of the upright a city is exalted, but by the mouth of the wicked it is destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: By the blessing of the upright a city is exalted, but by the mouth of the wicked it is overthrown.
verses.textEnNkjv: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted, But it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
verses.textEnNlt: Upright citizens are good for a city and make it prosper, but the talk of the wicked tears it apart.
verses.textEnNasb: By the blessing of the upright a city is exalted, But by the mouth of the wicked, it is torn down.
verses.textEn: Through the blessing of the upright a city is exalted, but by the mouth of the wicked it is destroyed.

verses.textZh: 藐视邻舍的，真是无知； 聪明人却缄默不言。
verses.textZhCnvs: 藐视邻舍的，真是无知； 聪明人却缄默不言。
verses.textZhCuv: 藐视邻舍的，毫无智慧； 明哲人却静默不言。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever derides their neighbor has no sense, but the one who has understanding holds their tongue.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever belittles his neighbor lacks sense, but a man of understanding remains silent.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who is devoid of wisdom despises his neighbor, But a man of understanding holds his peace.
verses.textEnNlt: It is foolish to belittle one’s neighbor; a sensible person keeps quiet.
verses.textEnNasb: One who despises his neighbor lacks sense, But a person of understanding keeps silent.
verses.textEn: Whoever derides their neighbor has no sense, but the one who has understanding holds their tongue.

verses.textZh: 到处搬弄是非的，泄露秘密， 心里诚实的，遮隐事情。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到处搬弄是非的，泄露秘密， 心里诚实的，遮隐事情。
verses.textZhCuv: 往来传舌的，泄漏密事； 心中诚实的，遮隐事情。
verses.textEnNiv: A gossip betrays a confidence, but a trustworthy person keeps a secret.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever goes about slandering reveals secrets, but he who is trustworthy in spirit keeps a thing covered.
verses.textEnNkjv: A talebearer reveals secrets, But he who is of a faithful spirit conceals a matter.
verses.textEnNlt: A gossip goes around telling secrets, but those who are trustworthy can keep a confidence.
verses.textEnNasb: One who goes about as a slanderer reveals secrets, But one who is trustworthy conceals a matter.
verses.textEn: A gossip betrays a confidence, but a trustworthy person keeps a secret.

verses.textZh: 没有智谋，国家败落； 谋士众多，就能得胜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有智谋，国家败落； 谋士众多，就能得胜。
verses.textZhCuv: 无智谋，民就败落； 谋士多，人便安居。
verses.textEnNiv: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verses.textEnEsv: Where there is no guidance, a people falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is safety.
verses.textEnNkjv: Where thereis no counsel, the people fall; But in the multitude of counselors thereis safety.
verses.textEnNlt: Without wise leadership, a nation falls; there is safety in having many advisers.
verses.textEnNasb: Where there is no guidance the people fall, But in an abundance of counselors there is victory.
verses.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.

verses.textZh: 为外人作保证人的，必受亏损； 厌恶替人击掌担保的，却得着安稳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为外人作保证人的，必受亏损； 厌恶替人击掌担保的，却得着安稳。
verses.textZhCuv: 为外人作保的，必受亏损； 恨恶击掌的，却得安稳。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever puts up security for a stranger will surely suffer, but whoever refuses to shake hands in pledge is safe.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever puts up security for a stranger will surely suffer harm, but he who hates striking hands in pledge is secure.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who is surety for a stranger will suffer, But one who hates being surety is secure.
verses.textEnNlt: There’s danger in putting up security for a stranger’s debt; it’s safer not to guarantee another person’s debt.
verses.textEnNasb: One who is a guarantor for a stranger will certainly suffer for it, But one who hates being a guarantor is secure.
verses.textEn: Whoever puts up security for a stranger will surely suffer, but whoever refuses to shake hands in pledge is safe.

verses.textZh: 贤德的妇女得着尊荣， 强暴的男子只得着财富。
verses.textZhCnvs: 贤德的妇女得着尊荣， 强暴的男子只得着财富。
verses.textZhCuv: 恩德的妇女得尊荣； 强暴的男子得资财。
verses.textEnNiv: A kindhearted woman gains honor, but ruthless men gain only wealth.
verses.textEnEsv: A gracious woman gets honor, and violent men get riches.
verses.textEnNkjv: A gracious woman retains honor, But ruthless men retain riches.
verses.textEnNlt: A gracious woman gains respect, but ruthless men gain only wealth.
verses.textEnNasb: A gracious woman attains honor, And ruthless men attain riches.
verses.textEn: A kindhearted woman gains honor, but ruthless men gain only wealth.

verses.textZh: 仁慈的人自己获益， 残忍的人自己受害。
verses.textZhCnvs: 仁慈的人自己获益， 残忍的人自己受害。
verses.textZhCuv: 仁慈的人善待自己； 残忍的人扰害己身。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who are kind benefit themselves, but the cruel bring ruin on themselves.
verses.textEnEsv: A man who is kind benefits himself, but a cruel man hurts himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: The merciful man does good for his own soul, But hewhois cruel troubles his own flesh.
verses.textEnNlt: Your kindness will reward you, but your cruelty will destroy you.
verses.textEnNasb: A merciful person does himself good, But the cruel person does himself harm.
verses.textEn: Those who are kind benefit themselves, but the cruel bring ruin on themselves.

verses.textZh: 恶人赚得的工价是虚假的， 播种公义的得着实在的赏赐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人赚得的工价是虚假的， 播种公义的得着实在的赏赐。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人经营，得虚浮的工价； 撒义种的，得实在的果效。
verses.textEnNiv: A wicked person earns deceptive wages, but the one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.
verses.textEnEsv: The wicked earns deceptive wages, but one who sows righteousness gets a sure reward.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wicked man does deceptive work, But he who sows righteousness willhave a sure reward.
verses.textEnNlt: Evil people get rich for the moment, but the reward of the godly will last.
verses.textEnNasb: A wicked person earns deceptive wages, But one who sows righteousness gets a true reward.
verses.textEn: A wicked person earns deceptive wages, but the one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.

verses.textZh: 恒心行义的必得生命； 追随邪恶的必致死亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恒心行义的必得生命； 追随邪恶的必致死亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 恒心为义的，必得生命； 追求邪恶的，必致死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: Truly the righteous attain life, but whoever pursues evil finds death.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever is steadfast in righteousness will live, but he who pursues evil will die.
verses.textEnNkjv: As righteousness leads to life, So he who pursues evil pursuesit to his own death.
verses.textEnNlt: Godly people find life; evil people find death.
verses.textEnNasb: One who is steadfast in righteousness attains life, But one who pursues evil attains his own death.
verses.textEn: Truly the righteous attain life, but whoever pursues evil finds death.

verses.textZh: 欺诈的心是耶和华厌恶的； 行为完全是他所喜悦的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 欺诈的心是耶和华厌恶的； 行为完全是他所喜悦的。
verses.textZhCuv: 心中乖僻的，为耶和华所憎恶； 行事完全的，为他所喜悦。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord detests those whose hearts are perverse, but he delights in those whose ways are blameless.
verses.textEnEsv: Those of crooked heart are an abomination to the Lord , but those of blameless ways are his delight.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who are of a perverse heart are an abomination to the Lord, But the blameless in their ways are His delight.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord detests people with crooked hearts, but he delights in those with integrity.
verses.textEnNasb: The perverse in heart are an abomination to the Lord, But the blameless in their walk are His delight.
verses.textEn: The Lord detests those whose hearts are perverse, but he delights in those whose ways are blameless.

verses.textZh: 恶人必不免受罚， 但义人的后裔必蒙解救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人必不免受罚， 但义人的后裔必蒙解救。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人虽然连手，必不免受罚； 义人的后裔必得拯救。
verses.textEnNiv: Be sure of this: The wicked will not go unpunished, but those who are righteous will go free.
verses.textEnEsv: Be assured, an evil person will not go unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.
verses.textEnNkjv: Though they join forces, the wicked will not go unpunished; But the posterity of the righteous will be delivered.
verses.textEnNlt: Evil people will surely be punished, but the children of the godly will go free.
verses.textEnNasb: Be assured, the evil person will not go unpunished, But the descendants of the righteous will be rescued.
verses.textEn: Be sure of this: The wicked will not go unpunished, but those who are righteous will go free.

verses.textZh: 妇女美丽而无见识， 就像金环带在猪鼻上一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 妇女美丽而无见识， 就像金环带在猪鼻上一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 妇女美貌而无见识， 如同金环带在猪鼻上。
verses.textEnNiv: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout is a beautiful woman who shows no discretion.
verses.textEnEsv: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout is a beautiful woman without discretion.
verses.textEnNkjv: As a ring of gold in a swine’s snout, Sois a lovely woman who lacks discretion.
verses.textEnNlt: A beautiful woman who lacks discretion is like a gold ring in a pig’s snout.
verses.textEnNasb: As a ring of gold in a pig’s snout So is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.
verses.textEn: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout is a beautiful woman who shows no discretion.

verses.textZh: 义人的愿望，尽是美好， 恶人的希望，必招致忿怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人的愿望，尽是美好， 恶人的希望，必招致忿怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人的心愿尽得好处； 恶人的指望致干忿怒。
verses.textEnNiv: The desire of the righteous ends only in good, but the hope of the wicked only in wrath.
verses.textEnEsv: The desire of the righteous ends only in good, the expectation of the wicked in wrath.
verses.textEnNkjv: The desire of the righteous is only good, But the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
verses.textEnNlt: The godly can look forward to a reward, while the wicked can expect only judgment.
verses.textEnNasb: The desire of the righteous is only good, But the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
verses.textEn: The desire of the righteous ends only in good, but the hope of the wicked only in wrath.

verses.textZh: 有人慷慨好施，财富却更增添； 有人吝啬过度，反招致贫穷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人慷慨好施，财富却更增添； 有人吝啬过度，反招致贫穷。
verses.textZhCuv: 有施散的，却更增添； 有吝惜过度的，反致穷乏。
verses.textEnNiv: One person gives freely, yet gains even more; another withholds unduly, but comes to poverty.
verses.textEnEsv: One gives freely, yet grows all the richer; another withholds what he should give, and only suffers want.
verses.textEnNkjv: There is one who scatters, yet increases more; And there is one who withholds more than is right, But it leads to poverty.
verses.textEnNlt: Give freely and become more wealthy; be stingy and lose everything.
verses.textEnNasb: There is one who scatters, and yet increases all the more, And there is one who withholds what is justly due, and yet it results only in poverty.
verses.textEn: One person gives freely, yet gains even more; another withholds unduly, but comes to poverty.

verses.textZh: 乐善好施的人，必得丰裕； 施惠于人的，自己也必蒙施惠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乐善好施的人，必得丰裕； 施惠于人的，自己也必蒙施惠。
verses.textZhCuv: 好施舍的，必得丰裕； 滋润人的，必得滋润。
verses.textEnNiv: A generous person will prosper; whoever refreshes others will be refreshed.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever brings blessing will be enriched, and one who waters will himself be watered.
verses.textEnNkjv: The generous soul will be made rich, And he who waters will also be watered himself.
verses.textEnNlt: The generous will prosper; those who refresh others will themselves be refreshed.
verses.textEnNasb: A generous person will be prosperous, And one who gives others plenty of water will himself be given plenty.
verses.textEn: A generous person will prosper; whoever refreshes others will be refreshed.

verses.textZh: 屯积五谷的，必被人民咒诅； 出售粮食的，福祉必临到他的头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 屯积五谷的，必被人民咒诅； 出售粮食的，福祉必临到他的头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 屯粮不卖的，民必咒诅他； 情愿出卖的，人必为他祝福。
verses.textEnNiv: People curse the one who hoards grain, but they pray God’s blessing on the one who is willing to sell.
verses.textEnEsv: The people curse him who holds back grain, but a blessing is on the head of him who sells it.
verses.textEnNkjv: The people will curse him who withholds grain, But blessing willbe on the head of him who sells it.
verses.textEnNlt: People curse those who hoard their grain, but they bless the one who sells in time of need.
verses.textEnNasb: One who withholds grain, the people will curse him, But blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.
verses.textEn: People curse the one who hoards grain, but they pray God’s blessing on the one who is willing to sell.

verses.textZh: 殷切求善的，必得到爱顾； 追求邪恶的，邪恶必临到他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 殷切求善的，必得到爱顾； 追求邪恶的，邪恶必临到他。
verses.textZhCuv: 恳切求善的，就求得恩惠； 惟独求恶的，恶必临到他身。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever seeks good finds favor, but evil comes to one who searches for it.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever diligently seeks good seeks favor, but evil comes to him who searches for it.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who earnestly seeks good finds favor, But trouble will come to him who seeks evil.
verses.textEnNlt: If you search for good, you will find favor; but if you search for evil, it will find you!
verses.textEnNasb: One who diligently seeks good seeks favor, But one who seeks evil, evil will come to him.
verses.textEn: Whoever seeks good finds favor, but evil comes to one who searches for it.

verses.textZh: 倚赖自己财富的，必然衰落； 义人却必繁茂，好象绿叶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 倚赖自己财富的，必然衰落； 义人却必繁茂，好象绿叶。
verses.textZhCuv: 倚仗自己财物的，必跌倒； 义人必发旺，如青叶。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who trust in their riches will fall, but the righteous will thrive like a green leaf.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous will flourish like a green leaf.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who trusts in his riches will fall, But the righteous will flourish like foliage.
verses.textEnNlt: Trust in your money and down you go! But the godly flourish like leaves in spring.
verses.textEnNasb: One who trusts in his riches will fall, But the righteous will flourish like the green leaf.
verses.textEn: Those who trust in their riches will fall, but the righteous will thrive like a green leaf.

verses.textZh: 祸害自己家庭的，必承受清风； 愚妄人必作心思智慧的人的仆人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祸害自己家庭的，必承受清风； 愚妄人必作心思智慧的人的仆人。
verses.textZhCuv: 扰害己家的，必承受清风； 愚昧人必作慧心人的仆人。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever brings ruin on their family will inherit only wind, and the fool will be servant to the wise.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever troubles his own household will inherit the wind, and the fool will be servant to the wise of heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who troubles his own house will inherit the wind, And the fool willbe servant to the wise of heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who bring trouble on their families inherit the wind. The fool will be a servant to the wise.
verses.textEnNasb: One who troubles his own house will inherit wind, And the foolish will be servant to the wise-hearted.
verses.textEn: Whoever brings ruin on their family will inherit only wind, and the fool will be servant to the wise.

verses.textZh: 义人所结的果子就是生命树； 智慧人必能得人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人所结的果子就是生命树； 智慧人必能得人。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人所结的果子就是生命树； 有智慧的，必能得人。
verses.textEnNiv: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, and the one who is wise saves lives.
verses.textEnEsv: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, and whoever captures souls is wise.
verses.textEnNkjv: The fruit of the righteous isa tree of life, And he who wins souls is wise.
verses.textEnNlt: The seeds of good deeds become a tree of life; a wise person wins friends.
verses.textEnNasb: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, And one who is wise gains souls.
verses.textEn: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, and the one who is wise saves lives.

verses.textZh: 义人在世上尚且受报应， 何况恶人和罪人呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人在世上尚且受报应， 何况恶人和罪人呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，义人在世尚且受报， 何况恶人和罪人呢？
verses.textEnNiv: If the righteous receive their due on earth, how much more the ungodly and the sinner!
verses.textEnEsv: If the righteous is repaid on earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!
verses.textEnNkjv: If the righteous will be recompensed on the earth, How much more the ungodly and the sinner.
verses.textEnNlt: If the righteous are rewarded here on earth, what will happen to wicked sinners?
verses.textEnNasb: If the righteous will be repaid on the earth, How much more the wicked and the sinner!
verses.textEn: If the righteous receive their due on earth, how much more the ungodly and the sinner!

verses.textZh: 喜爱教训的，就是喜爱知识； 厌恶责备的，却是愚顽人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 喜爱教训的，就是喜爱知识； 厌恶责备的，却是愚顽人。
verses.textZhCuv: 喜爱管教的，就是喜爱知识； 恨恶责备的，却是畜类。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, but whoever hates correction is stupid.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever loves instruction loves knowledge, But he who hates correction is stupid.
verses.textEnNlt: To learn, you must love discipline; it is stupid to hate correction.
verses.textEnNasb: One who loves discipline loves knowledge, But one who hates rebuke is stupid.
verses.textEn: Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, but whoever hates correction is stupid.

verses.textZh: 良善的人必得到耶和华的恩宠； 图谋奸计的人，耶和华必把他定罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 良善的人必得到耶和华的恩宠； 图谋奸计的人，耶和华必把他定罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 善人必蒙耶和华的恩惠； 设诡计的人，耶和华必定他的罪。
verses.textEnNiv: Good people obtain favor from the Lord , but he condemns those who devise wicked schemes.
verses.textEnEsv: A good man obtains favor from the Lord , but a man of evil devices he condemns.
verses.textEnNkjv: A good man obtains favor from the Lord, But a man of wicked intentions He will condemn.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord approves of those who are good, but he condemns those who plan wickedness.
verses.textEnNasb: A good person will obtain favor from the Lord, But He will condemn a person who devises evil.
verses.textEn: Good people obtain favor from the Lord , but he condemns those who devise wicked schemes.

verses.textZh: 人不能恃凭恶行坚立； 但义人的根必不动摇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人不能恃凭恶行坚立； 但义人的根必不动摇。
verses.textZhCuv: 人靠恶行不能坚立； 义人的根必不动摇。
verses.textEnNiv: No one can be established through wickedness, but the righteous cannot be uprooted.
verses.textEnEsv: No one is established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous will never be moved.
verses.textEnNkjv: A man is not established by wickedness, But the root of the righteous cannot be moved.
verses.textEnNlt: Wickedness never brings stability, but the godly have deep roots.
verses.textEnNasb: A person will not be established by wickedness, But the root of the righteous will not be moved.
verses.textEn: No one can be established through wickedness, but the righteous cannot be uprooted.

verses.textZh: 有才德的妻子是丈夫的冠冕， 贻羞的妇人，如同丈夫骨中的朽烂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有才德的妻子是丈夫的冠冕， 贻羞的妇人，如同丈夫骨中的朽烂。
verses.textZhCuv: 才德的妇人是丈夫的冠冕； 贻羞的妇人如同朽烂在她丈夫的骨中。
verses.textEnNiv: A wife of noble character is her husband’s crown, but a disgraceful wife is like decay in his bones.
verses.textEnEsv: An excellent wife is the crown of her husband, but she who brings shame is like rottenness in his bones.
verses.textEnNkjv: An excellent wife is the crown of her husband, But she who causes shame is like rottenness in his bones.
verses.textEnNlt: A worthy wife is a crown for her husband, but a disgraceful woman is like cancer in his bones.
verses.textEnNasb: An excellent wife is the crown of her husband, But she who shames him is like rottenness in his bones.
verses.textEn: A wife of noble character is her husband’s crown, but a disgraceful wife is like decay in his bones.

verses.textZh: 义人的筹算是公平， 恶人的计谋却是诡诈。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人的筹算是公平， 恶人的计谋却是诡诈。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人的思念是公平； 恶人的计谋是诡诈。
verses.textEnNiv: The plans of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.
verses.textEnEsv: The thoughts of the righteous are just; the counsels of the wicked are deceitful.
verses.textEnNkjv: The thoughts of the righteous are right, But the counsels of the wicked are deceitful.
verses.textEnNlt: The plans of the godly are just; the advice of the wicked is treacherous.
verses.textEnNasb: The thoughts of the righteous are just, But the counsels of the wicked are deceitful.
verses.textEn: The plans of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.

verses.textZh: 恶人的言语埋伏着，等待要流人的血， 正直人的口能拯救人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人的言语埋伏着，等待要流人的血， 正直人的口能拯救人。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人的言论是埋伏流人的血； 正直人的口必拯救人。
verses.textEnNiv: The words of the wicked lie in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.
verses.textEnEsv: The words of the wicked lie in wait for blood, but the mouth of the upright delivers them.
verses.textEnNkjv: The words of the wicked are, "Lie in wait for blood," But the mouth of the upright will deliver them.
verses.textEnNlt: The words of the wicked are like a murderous ambush, but the words of the godly save lives.
verses.textEnNasb: The words of the wicked wait in ambush for blood, But the mouth of the upright will rescue them.
verses.textEn: The words of the wicked lie in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.

verses.textZh: 恶人倾覆，就不再存在； 义人的家却必站立得住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人倾覆，就不再存在； 义人的家却必站立得住。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人倾覆，归于无有； 义人的家必站得住。
verses.textEnNiv: The wicked are overthrown and are no more, but the house of the righteous stands firm.
verses.textEnEsv: The wicked are overthrown and are no more, but the house of the righteous will stand.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wicked are overthrown and are no more, But the house of the righteous will stand.
verses.textEnNlt: The wicked die and disappear, but the family of the godly stands firm.
verses.textEnNasb: The wicked are overthrown and are no more, But the house of the righteous will stand.
verses.textEn: The wicked are overthrown and are no more, but the house of the righteous stands firm.

verses.textZh: 人因着自己的明慧必得称赞， 但心中乖谬的必被藐视。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人因着自己的明慧必得称赞， 但心中乖谬的必被藐视。
verses.textZhCuv: 人必按自己的智慧被称赞； 心中乖谬的，必被藐视。
verses.textEnNiv: A person is praised according to their prudence, and one with a warped mind is despised.
verses.textEnEsv: A man is commended according to his good sense, but one of twisted mind is despised.
verses.textEnNkjv: A man will be commended according to his wisdom, But he who is of a perverse heart will be despised.
verses.textEnNlt: A sensible person wins admiration, but a warped mind is despised.
verses.textEnNasb: A person will be praised according to his insight, But one of perverse mind will be despised.
verses.textEn: A person is praised according to their prudence, and one with a warped mind is despised.

verses.textZh: 被人轻看却有仆人的人， 胜过自尊自大却缺少食物的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 被人轻看却有仆人的人， 胜过自尊自大却缺少食物的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 被人轻贱，却有仆人， 强如自尊，缺少食物。
verses.textEnNiv: Better to be a nobody and yet have a servant than pretend to be somebody and have no food.
verses.textEnEsv: Better to be lowly and have a servant than to play the great man and lack bread.
verses.textEnNkjv: Better istheone who is slighted but has a servant, Than he who honors himself but lacks bread.
verses.textEnNlt: Better to be an ordinary person with a servant than to be self-important but have no food.
verses.textEnNasb: Better is one who is lightly esteemed and has a servant, Than one who honors himself and lacks bread.
verses.textEn: Better to be a nobody and yet have a servant than pretend to be somebody and have no food.

verses.textZh: 义人连自己牲畜的性命也顾惜； 但恶人的怜悯也是残忍。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人连自己牲畜的性命也顾惜； 但恶人的怜悯也是残忍。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人顾惜他牲畜的命； 恶人的怜悯也是残忍。
verses.textEnNiv: The righteous care for the needs of their animals, but the kindest acts of the wicked are cruel.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever is righteous has regard for the life of his beast, but the mercy of the wicked is cruel.
verses.textEnNkjv: A righteous man regards the life of his animal, But the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
verses.textEnNlt: The godly care for their animals, but the wicked are always cruel.
verses.textEnNasb: A righteous person has regard for the life of his animal, But even the compassion of the wicked is cruel.
verses.textEn: The righteous care for the needs of their animals, but the kindest acts of the wicked are cruel.

verses.textZh: 耕种自己田地的，也有充足的粮食； 追求虚幻的，实在无知。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耕种自己田地的，也有充足的粮食； 追求虚幻的，实在无知。
verses.textZhCuv: 耕种自己田地的，必得饱食； 追随虚浮的，却是无知。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who work their land will have abundant food, but those who chase fantasies have no sense.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever works his land will have plenty of bread, but he who follows worthless pursuits lacks sense.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who tills his land will be satisfied with bread, But he who follows frivolity is devoid of understanding.
verses.textEnNlt: A hard worker has plenty of food, but a person who chases fantasies has no sense.
verses.textEnNasb: One who works his land will have plenty of bread, But one who pursues worthless things lacks sense.
verses.textEn: Those who work their land will have abundant food, but those who chase fantasies have no sense.

verses.textZh: 恶人贪慕坏人的网罗； 义人的根得以结果。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人贪慕坏人的网罗； 义人的根得以结果。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人想得坏人的网罗； 义人的根得以结实。
verses.textEnNiv: The wicked desire the stronghold of evildoers, but the root of the righteous endures.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever is wicked covets the spoil of evildoers, but the root of the righteous bears fruit.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wicked covet the catch of evil men, But the root of the righteous yields fruit.
verses.textEnNlt: Thieves are jealous of each other’s loot, but the godly are well rooted and bear their own fruit.
verses.textEnNasb: The wicked person desires the plunder of evil people, But the root of the righteous yields fruit.
verses.textEn: The wicked desire the stronghold of evildoers, but the root of the righteous endures.

verses.textZh: 坏人嘴里的过失，是自己的网罗； 但义人必脱离患难。
verses.textZhCnvs: 坏人嘴里的过失，是自己的网罗； 但义人必脱离患难。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人嘴中的过错是自己的网罗； 但义人必脱离患难。
verses.textEnNiv: Evildoers are trapped by their sinful talk, and so the innocent escape trouble.
verses.textEnEsv: An evil man is ensnared by the transgression of his lips, but the righteous escapes from trouble.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wicked is ensnared by the transgression of his lips, But the righteous will come through trouble.
verses.textEnNlt: The wicked are trapped by their own words, but the godly escape such trouble.
verses.textEnNasb: An evil person is ensnared by the offense of his lips, But the righteous will escape from trouble.
verses.textEn: Evildoers are trapped by their sinful talk, and so the innocent escape trouble.

verses.textZh: 人因口所结的果子必饱尝美物； 人手所作的必归到他身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人因口所结的果子必饱尝美物； 人手所作的必归到他身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 人因口所结的果子，必饱得美福； 人手所做的，必为自己的报应。
verses.textEnNiv: From the fruit of their lips people are filled with good things, and the work of their hands brings them reward.
verses.textEnEsv: From the fruit of his mouth a man is satisfied with good, and the work of a man’s hand comes back to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: A man will be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth, And the recompense of a man’s hands will be rendered to him.
verses.textEnNlt: Wise words bring many benefits, and hard work brings rewards.
