verses.textEnNasb: A person will be satisfied with good by the fruit of his words, And the deeds of a person’s hands will return to him.
verses.textEn: From the fruit of their lips people are filled with good things, and the work of their hands brings them reward.

verses.textZh: 愚妄人所行的，在自己眼中看为正直， 只有智慧人肯听劝告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚妄人所行的，在自己眼中看为正直， 只有智慧人肯听劝告。
verses.textZhCuv: 愚妄人所行的，在自己眼中看为正直； 惟智慧人肯听人的劝教。
verses.textEnNiv: The way of fools seems right to them, but the wise listen to advice.
verses.textEnEsv: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but a wise man listens to advice.
verses.textEnNkjv: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, But he who heeds counsel is wise.
verses.textEnNlt: Fools think their own way is right, but the wise listen to others.
verses.textEnNasb: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, But a person who listens to advice is wise.
verses.textEn: The way of fools seems right to them, but the wise listen to advice.

verses.textZh: 愚妄人的恼怒立时显露， 精明的人却能忍受羞辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚妄人的恼怒立时显露， 精明的人却能忍受羞辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 愚妄人的恼怒立时显露； 通达人能忍辱藏羞。
verses.textEnNiv: Fools show their annoyance at once, but the prudent overlook an insult.
verses.textEnEsv: The vexation of a fool is known at once, but the prudent ignores an insult.
verses.textEnNkjv: A fool’s wrath is known at once, But a prudent man covers shame.
verses.textEnNlt: A fool is quick-tempered, but a wise person stays calm when insulted.
verses.textEnNasb: A fool’s anger is known at once, But a prudent person conceals dishonor.
verses.textEn: Fools show their annoyance at once, but the prudent overlook an insult.

verses.textZh: 吐露真情的，彰显正义， 作假见证的却是诡诈。
verses.textZhCnvs: 吐露真情的，彰显正义， 作假见证的却是诡诈。
verses.textZhCuv: 说出真话的，显明公义； 作假见证的，显出诡诈。
verses.textEnNiv: An honest witness tells the truth, but a false witness tells lies.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever speaks the truth gives honest evidence, but a false witness utters deceit.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who speaks truth declares righteousness, But a false witness, deceit.
verses.textEnNlt: An honest witness tells the truth; a false witness tells lies.
verses.textEnNasb: One who declares truth tells what is right, But a false witness, deceit.
verses.textEn: An honest witness tells the truth, but a false witness tells lies.

verses.textZh: 有人说话不慎，好象利刀刺人， 智慧人的舌头却能医治人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人说话不慎，好象利刀刺人， 智慧人的舌头却能医治人。
verses.textZhCuv: 说话浮躁的，如刀刺人； 智慧人的舌头却为医人的良药。
verses.textEnNiv: The words of the reckless pierce like swords, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.
verses.textEnEsv: There is one whose rash words are like sword thrusts, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.
verses.textEnNkjv: There is one who speaks like the piercings of a sword, But the tongue of the wise promotes health.
verses.textEnNlt: Some people make cutting remarks, but the words of the wise bring healing.
verses.textEnNasb: There is one who speaks rashly like the thrusts of a sword, But the tongue of the wise brings healing.
verses.textEn: The words of the reckless pierce like swords, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.

verses.textZh: 说实话的嘴唇，永远坚立； 撒谎的舌头，眨眼间消失。
verses.textZhCnvs: 说实话的嘴唇，永远坚立； 撒谎的舌头，眨眼间消失。
verses.textZhCuv: 口吐真言，永远坚立； 舌说谎话，只存片时。
verses.textEnNiv: Truthful lips endure forever, but a lying tongue lasts only a moment.
verses.textEnEsv: Truthful lips endure forever, but a lying tongue is but for a moment.
verses.textEnNkjv: The truthful lip shall be established forever, But a lying tongue is but for a moment.
verses.textEnNlt: Truthful words stand the test of time, but lies are soon exposed.
verses.textEnNasb: Truthful lips will endure forever, But a lying tongue is only for a moment.
verses.textEn: Truthful lips endure forever, but a lying tongue lasts only a moment.

verses.textZh: 图谋恶事的，心存诡诈； 使人和睦的，心中喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 图谋恶事的，心存诡诈； 使人和睦的，心中喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 图谋恶事的，心存诡诈； 劝人和睦的，便得喜乐。
verses.textEnNiv: Deceit is in the hearts of those who plot evil, but those who promote peace have joy.
verses.textEnEsv: Deceit is in the heart of those who devise evil, but those who plan peace have joy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Deceit is in the heart of those who devise evil, But counselors of peace have joy.
verses.textEnNlt: Deceit fills hearts that are plotting evil; joy fills hearts that are planning peace!
verses.textEnNasb: Deceit is in the heart of those who devise evil, But counselors of peace have joy.
verses.textEn: Deceit is in the hearts of those who plot evil, but those who promote peace have joy.

verses.textZh: 义人不会遭遇灾祸， 恶人却饱经祸患。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人不会遭遇灾祸， 恶人却饱经祸患。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人不遭灾害；恶人满受祸患。
verses.textEnNiv: No harm overtakes the righteous, but the wicked have their fill of trouble.
verses.textEnEsv: No ill befalls the righteous, but the wicked are filled with trouble.
verses.textEnNkjv: No grave trouble will overtake the righteous, But the wicked shall be filled with evil.
verses.textEnNlt: No harm comes to the godly, but the wicked have their fill of trouble.
verses.textEnNasb: No harm happens to the righteous, But the wicked are filled with trouble.
verses.textEn: No harm overtakes the righteous, but the wicked have their fill of trouble.

verses.textZh: 撒谎的嘴唇是耶和华憎恶的； 行事诚实是他所喜悦的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒谎的嘴唇是耶和华憎恶的； 行事诚实是他所喜悦的。
verses.textZhCuv: 说谎言的嘴为耶和华所憎恶； 行事诚实的，为他所喜悦。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord detests lying lips, but he delights in people who are trustworthy.
verses.textEnEsv: Lying lips are an abomination to the Lord , but those who act faithfully are his delight.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lying lips are an abomination to the Lord, But those who deal truthfully are His delight.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord detests lying lips, but he delights in those who tell the truth.
verses.textEnNasb: Lying lips are an abomination to the Lord, But those who deal faithfully are His delight.
verses.textEn: The Lord detests lying lips, but he delights in people who are trustworthy.

verses.textZh: 精明的人隐藏自己的知识， 愚昧人的心却显出愚妄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 精明的人隐藏自己的知识， 愚昧人的心却显出愚妄。
verses.textZhCuv: 通达人隐藏知识； 愚昧人的心彰显愚昧。
verses.textEnNiv: The prudent keep their knowledge to themselves, but a fool’s heart blurts out folly.
verses.textEnEsv: A prudent man conceals knowledge, but the heart of fools proclaims folly.
verses.textEnNkjv: A prudent man conceals knowledge, But the heart of fools proclaims foolishness.
verses.textEnNlt: The wise don’t make a show of their knowledge, but fools broadcast their foolishness.
verses.textEnNasb: A prudent person conceals knowledge, But the heart of fools proclaims foolishness.
verses.textEn: The prudent keep their knowledge to themselves, but a fool’s heart blurts out folly.

verses.textZh: 殷勤人的手必掌权， 懒惰人的手必作苦工。
verses.textZhCnvs: 殷勤人的手必掌权， 懒惰人的手必作苦工。
verses.textZhCuv: 殷勤人的手必掌权； 懒惰的人必服苦。
verses.textEnNiv: Diligent hands will rule, but laziness ends in forced labor.
verses.textEnEsv: The hand of the diligent will rule, while the slothful will be put to forced labor.
verses.textEnNkjv: The hand of the diligent will rule, But the lazy man will be put to forced labor.
verses.textEnNlt: Work hard and become a leader; be lazy and become a slave.
verses.textEnNasb: The hand of the diligent will rule, But the lazy hand will be put to forced labor.
verses.textEn: Diligent hands will rule, but laziness ends in forced labor.

verses.textZh: 心中忧虑，使人消沉； 一句良言使他欢喜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 心中忧虑，使人消沉； 一句良言使他欢喜。
verses.textZhCuv: 人心忧虑，屈而不伸； 一句良言，使心欢乐。
verses.textEnNiv: Anxiety weighs down the heart, but a kind word cheers it up.
verses.textEnEsv: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs him down, but a good word makes him glad.
verses.textEnNkjv: Anxiety in the heart of man causes depression, But a good word makes it glad.
verses.textEnNlt: Worry weighs a person down; an encouraging word cheers a person up.
verses.textEnNasb: Anxiety in a person’s heart weighs it down, But a good word makes it glad.
verses.textEn: Anxiety weighs down the heart, but a kind word cheers it up.

verses.textZh: 义人作自己邻舍的引导； 恶人的道路，却使别人走迷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人作自己邻舍的引导； 恶人的道路，却使别人走迷。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人引导他的邻舍； 恶人的道叫人失迷。
verses.textEnNiv: The righteous choose their friends carefully, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.
verses.textEnEsv: One who is righteous is a guide to his neighbor, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.
verses.textEnNkjv: The righteous should choose his friends carefully, For the way of the wicked leads them astray.
verses.textEnNlt: The godly give good advice to their friends; the wicked lead them astray.
verses.textEnNasb: The righteous person is a guide to his neighbor, But the way of the wicked leads them astray.
verses.textEn: The righteous choose their friends carefully, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.

verses.textZh: 懒惰的人不去烧烤他的猎物， 殷勤的人却得宝贵的财物 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 懒惰的人不去烧烤他的猎物， 殷勤的人却得宝贵的财物 。
verses.textZhCuv: 懒惰的人不烤打猎所得的； 殷勤的人却得宝贵的财物。
verses.textEnNiv: The lazy do not roast any game, but the diligent feed on the riches of the hunt.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever is slothful will not roast his game, but the diligent man will get precious wealth.
verses.textEnNkjv: The lazy man does not roast what he took in hunting, But diligence is man’s precious possession.
verses.textEnNlt: Lazy people don’t even cook the game they catch, but the diligent make use of everything they find.
verses.textEnNasb: A lazy person does not roast his prey, But the precious possession of a person is diligence.
verses.textEn: The lazy do not roast any game, but the diligent feed on the riches of the hunt.

verses.textZh: 在公义的路上有生命， 这路径之上没有死亡 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在公义的路上有生命， 这路径之上没有死亡 。
verses.textZhCuv: 在公义的道上有生命； 其路之中并无死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: In the way of righteousness there is life; along that path is immortality.
verses.textEnEsv: In the path of righteousness is life, and in its pathway there is no death.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the way of righteousness is life, And in its pathway thereis no death.
verses.textEnNlt: The way of the godly leads to life; that path does not lead to death.
verses.textEnNasb: In the way of righteousness there is life, And in its pathway there is no death.
verses.textEn: In the way of righteousness there is life; along that path is immortality.

verses.textZh: 智慧的儿子听从父亲的教训， 好讥笑人的不听责备。
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧的儿子听从父亲的教训， 好讥笑人的不听责备。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧子听父亲的教训； 亵慢人不听责备。
verses.textEnNiv: A wise son heeds his father’s instruction, but a mocker does not respond to rebukes.
verses.textEnEsv: A wise son hears his father’s instruction, but a scoffer does not listen to rebuke.
verses.textEnNkjv: A wise son heeds his father’s instruction, But a scoffer does not listen to rebuke.
verses.textEnNlt: A wise child accepts a parent’s discipline; a mocker refuses to listen to correction.
verses.textEnNasb: A wise son accepts his father’s discipline, But a scoffer does not listen to rebuke.
verses.textEn: A wise son heeds his father’s instruction, but a mocker does not respond to rebukes.

verses.textZh: 人因口所结的果子，必得尝美物， 奸诈人的欲望却是强暴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人因口所结的果子，必得尝美物， 奸诈人的欲望却是强暴。
verses.textZhCuv: 人因口所结的果子，必享美福； 奸诈人必遭强暴。
verses.textEnNiv: From the fruit of their lips people enjoy good things, but the unfaithful have an appetite for violence.
verses.textEnEsv: From the fruit of his mouth a man eats what is good, but the desire of the treacherous is for violence.
verses.textEnNkjv: A man shall eat well by the fruit of his mouth, But the soul of the unfaithful feeds on violence.
verses.textEnNlt: Wise words will win you a good meal, but treacherous people have an appetite for violence.
verses.textEnNasb: From the fruit of a person’s mouth he enjoys good, But the desire of the treacherous is violence.
verses.textEn: From the fruit of their lips people enjoy good things, but the unfaithful have an appetite for violence.

verses.textZh: 谨慎口舌的，可保性命； 口没遮拦的，自取灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谨慎口舌的，可保性命； 口没遮拦的，自取灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 谨守口的，得保生命； 大张嘴的，必致败亡。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who guard their lips preserve their lives, but those who speak rashly will come to ruin.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever guards his mouth preserves his life; he who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who guards his mouth preserves his life, But he who opens wide his lips shall have destruction.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who control their tongue will have a long life; opening your mouth can ruin everything.
verses.textEnNasb: One who guards his mouth protects his life; One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.
verses.textEn: Those who guard their lips preserve their lives, but those who speak rashly will come to ruin.

verses.textZh: 懒惰人渴求，却一无所得； 殷勤人必得丰裕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 懒惰人渴求，却一无所得； 殷勤人必得丰裕。
verses.textZhCuv: 懒惰人羡慕，却无所得； 殷勤人必得丰裕。
verses.textEnNiv: A sluggard’s appetite is never filled, but the desires of the diligent are fully satisfied.
verses.textEnEsv: The soul of the sluggard craves and gets nothing, while the soul of the diligent is richly supplied.
verses.textEnNkjv: The soul of a lazy man desires, and has nothing; But the soul of the diligent shall be made rich.
verses.textEnNlt: Lazy people want much but get little, but those who work hard will prosper.
verses.textEnNasb: The soul of the lazy one craves and gets nothing, But the soul of the diligent is made prosperous.
verses.textEn: A sluggard’s appetite is never filled, but the desires of the diligent are fully satisfied.

verses.textZh: 义人恨恶虚假， 恶人行事，遗臭贻羞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人恨恶虚假， 恶人行事，遗臭贻羞。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人恨恶谎言； 恶人有臭名，且致惭愧。
verses.textEnNiv: The righteous hate what is false, but the wicked make themselves a stench and bring shame on themselves.
verses.textEnEsv: The righteous hates falsehood, but the wicked brings shame and disgrace.
verses.textEnNkjv: A righteous man hates lying, But a wicked man is loathsome and comes to shame.
verses.textEnNlt: The godly hate lies; the wicked cause shame and disgrace.
verses.textEnNasb: A righteous person hates a false statement, But a wicked person acts disgustingly and shamefully.
verses.textEn: The righteous hate what is false, but the wicked make themselves a stench and bring shame on themselves.

verses.textZh: 正义护卫行为完全的人； 邪恶却使犯罪的人倾覆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 正义护卫行为完全的人； 邪恶却使犯罪的人倾覆。
verses.textZhCuv: 行为正直的，有公义保守； 犯罪的，被邪恶倾覆。
verses.textEnNiv: Righteousness guards the person of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.
verses.textEnEsv: Righteousness guards him whose way is blameless, but sin overthrows the wicked.
verses.textEnNkjv: Righteousness guards himwhose way is blameless, But wickedness overthrows the sinner.
verses.textEnNlt: Godliness guards the path of the blameless, but the evil are misled by sin.
verses.textEnNasb: Righteousness guards the one whose way is blameless, But wickedness brings the sinner to ruin.
verses.textEn: Righteousness guards the person of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

verses.textZh: 有人自充富足，却一无所有； 有人假装贫穷，财物却极多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人自充富足，却一无所有； 有人假装贫穷，财物却极多。
verses.textZhCuv: 假作富足的，却一无所有； 装作穷乏的，却广有财物。
verses.textEnNiv: One person pretends to be rich, yet has nothing; another pretends to be poor, yet has great wealth.
verses.textEnEsv: One pretends to be rich, yet has nothing; another pretends to be poor, yet has great wealth.
verses.textEnNkjv: There is one who makes himself rich, yet has nothing; And one who makes himself poor, yet has great riches.
verses.textEnNlt: Some who are poor pretend to be rich; others who are rich pretend to be poor.
verses.textEnNasb: There is one who pretends to be rich but has nothing; Another pretends to be poor, but has great wealth.
verses.textEn: One person pretends to be rich, yet has nothing; another pretends to be poor, yet has great wealth.

verses.textZh: 人的财富是他性命的赎价， 穷人却听不见威吓的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人的财富是他性命的赎价， 穷人却听不见威吓的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 人的资财是他生命的赎价； 穷乏人却听不见威吓的话。
verses.textEnNiv: A person’s riches may ransom their life, but the poor cannot respond to threatening rebukes.
verses.textEnEsv: The ransom of a man’s life is his wealth, but a poor man hears no threat.
verses.textEnNkjv: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, But the poor does not hear rebuke.
verses.textEnNlt: The rich can pay a ransom for their lives, but the poor won’t even get threatened.
verses.textEnNasb: The ransom of a person’s life is his wealth, But the poor hears no rebuke.
verses.textEn: A person’s riches may ransom their life, but the poor cannot respond to threatening rebukes.

verses.textZh: 义人的光必明亮， 恶人的灯必熄灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人的光必明亮， 恶人的灯必熄灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人的光明亮 ； 恶人的灯要熄灭。
verses.textEnNiv: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.
verses.textEnEsv: The light of the righteous rejoices, but the lamp of the wicked will be put out.
verses.textEnNkjv: The light of the righteous rejoices, But the lamp of the wicked will be put out.
verses.textEnNlt: The life of the godly is full of light and joy, but the light of the wicked will be snuffed out.
verses.textEnNasb: The light of the righteous rejoices, But the lamp of the wicked goes out.
verses.textEn: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.

verses.textZh: 傲慢只能引起争端； 接受劝告的却有智慧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 傲慢只能引起争端； 接受劝告的却有智慧。
verses.textZhCuv: 骄傲只启争竞； 听劝言的，却有智慧。
verses.textEnNiv: Where there is strife, there is pride, but wisdom is found in those who take advice.
verses.textEnEsv: By insolence comes nothing but strife, but with those who take advice is wisdom.
verses.textEnNkjv: By pride comes nothing but strife, But with the well-advised is wisdom.
verses.textEnNlt: Pride leads to conflict; those who take advice are wise.
verses.textEnNasb: Through overconfidence comes nothing but strife, But wisdom is with those who receive counsel.
verses.textEn: Where there is strife, there is pride, but wisdom is found in those who take advice.

verses.textZh: 不劳而获的财物，必快减少； 慢慢积蓄的，必然增多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不劳而获的财物，必快减少； 慢慢积蓄的，必然增多。
verses.textZhCuv: 不劳而得之财必然消耗； 勤劳积蓄的，必见加增。
verses.textEnNiv: Dishonest money dwindles away, but whoever gathers money little by little makes it grow.
verses.textEnEsv: Wealth gained hastily will dwindle, but whoever gathers little by little will increase it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Wealth gainedby dishonesty will be diminished, But he who gathers by labor will increase.
verses.textEnNlt: Wealth from get-rich-quick schemes quickly disappears; wealth from hard work grows over time.
verses.textEnNasb: Wealth obtained from nothing dwindles, But one who gathers by labor increases it.
verses.textEn: Dishonest money dwindles away, but whoever gathers money little by little makes it grow.

verses.textZh: 所盼望的迟延未得，令人心忧； 所愿的来到，好比生命树。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所盼望的迟延未得，令人心忧； 所愿的来到，好比生命树。
verses.textZhCuv: 所盼望的迟延未得，令人心忧； 所愿意的临到，却是生命树。
verses.textEnNiv: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but a longing fulfilled is a tree of life.
verses.textEnEsv: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but a desire fulfilled is a tree of life.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, But when the desire comes, itis a tree of life.
verses.textEnNlt: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but a dream fulfilled is a tree of life.
verses.textEnNasb: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, But desire fulfilled is a tree of life.
verses.textEn: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but a longing fulfilled is a tree of life.

verses.textZh: 藐视训言的，必自取灭亡； 敬畏诫命的，必得善报。
verses.textZhCnvs: 藐视训言的，必自取灭亡； 敬畏诫命的，必得善报。
verses.textZhCuv: 藐视训言的，自取灭亡； 敬畏诫命的，必得善报。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever scorns instruction will pay for it, but whoever respects a command is rewarded.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever despises the word brings destruction on himself, but he who reveres the commandment will be rewarded.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who despises the word will be destroyed, But he who fears the commandment will be rewarded.
verses.textEnNlt: People who despise advice are asking for trouble; those who respect a command will succeed.
verses.textEnNasb: One who despises the word will do badly, But one who fears the commandment will be rewarded.
verses.textEn: Whoever scorns instruction will pay for it, but whoever respects a command is rewarded.

verses.textZh: 智慧人的训诲是生命的泉源， 能使人避开死亡的网罗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧人的训诲是生命的泉源， 能使人避开死亡的网罗。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧人的法则 是生命的泉源， 可以使人离开死亡的网罗。
verses.textEnNiv: The teaching of the wise is a fountain of life, turning a person from the snares of death.
verses.textEnEsv: The teaching of the wise is a fountain of life, that one may turn away from the snares of death.
verses.textEnNkjv: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, To turn one away from the snares of death.
verses.textEnNlt: The instruction of the wise is like a life-giving fountain; those who accept it avoid the snares of death.
verses.textEnNasb: The teaching of the wise is a fountain of life, To turn aside from the snares of death.
verses.textEn: The teaching of the wise is a fountain of life, turning a person from the snares of death.

verses.textZh: 聪颖的明慧使人蒙恩， 奸诈人的道路崎岖难行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 聪颖的明慧使人蒙恩， 奸诈人的道路崎岖难行。
verses.textZhCuv: 美好的聪明使人蒙恩； 奸诈人的道路崎岖难行。
verses.textEnNiv: Good judgment wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful leads to their destruction.
verses.textEnEsv: Good sense wins favor, but the way of the treacherous is their ruin.
verses.textEnNkjv: Good understanding gains favor, But the way of the unfaithful is hard.
verses.textEnNlt: A person with good sense is respected; a treacherous person is headed for destruction.
verses.textEnNasb: Good understanding produces favor, But the way of the treacherous is their own disaster.
verses.textEn: Good judgment wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful leads to their destruction.

verses.textZh: 精明的人都按知识行事， 愚昧人却显露自己的愚妄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 精明的人都按知识行事， 愚昧人却显露自己的愚妄。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡通达人都凭知识行事； 愚昧人张扬自己的愚昧。
verses.textEnNiv: All who are prudent act with knowledge, but fools expose their folly.
verses.textEnEsv: Every prudent man acts with knowledge, but a fool flaunts his folly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Every prudent man acts with knowledge, But a fool lays open his folly.
verses.textEnNlt: Wise people think before they act; fools don’t—and even brag about their foolishness.
verses.textEnNasb: Every prudent person acts with knowledge, But a fool displays foolishness.
verses.textEn: All who are prudent act with knowledge, but fools expose their folly.

verses.textZh: 奸恶的使者，必陷在祸患里 ； 忠心的使臣，使人复原。
verses.textZhCnvs: 奸恶的使者，必陷在祸患里 ； 忠心的使臣，使人复原。
verses.textZhCuv: 奸恶的使者必陷在祸患里； 忠信的使臣乃医人的良药。
verses.textEnNiv: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy brings healing.
verses.textEnEsv: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a faithful envoy brings healing.
verses.textEnNkjv: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, But a faithful ambassador brings health.
verses.textEnNlt: An unreliable messenger stumbles into trouble, but a reliable messenger brings healing.
verses.textEnNasb: A wicked messenger falls into adversity, But a faithful messenger brings healing.
verses.textEn: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy brings healing.

verses.textZh: 轻忽管教的，必致穷乏受辱； 看重责备的，必得尊荣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 轻忽管教的，必致穷乏受辱； 看重责备的，必得尊荣。
verses.textZhCuv: 弃绝管教的，必致贫受辱； 领受责备的，必得尊荣。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever disregards discipline comes to poverty and shame, but whoever heeds correction is honored.
verses.textEnEsv: Poverty and disgrace come to him who ignores instruction, but whoever heeds reproof is honored.
verses.textEnNkjv: Poverty and shame willcome to him who disdains correction, But he who regards a rebuke will be honored.
verses.textEnNlt: If you ignore criticism, you will end in poverty and disgrace; if you accept correction, you will be honored.
verses.textEnNasb: Poverty and shame will come to one who neglects discipline, But one who complies with rebuke will be honored.
verses.textEn: Whoever disregards discipline comes to poverty and shame, but whoever heeds correction is honored.

verses.textZh: 所愿的成功，使人心里甘甜； 远离恶事，却为愚昧人憎恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所愿的成功，使人心里甘甜； 远离恶事，却为愚昧人憎恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 所欲的成就，心觉甘甜； 远离恶事，为愚昧人所憎恶。
verses.textEnNiv: A longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.
verses.textEnEsv: A desire fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but to turn away from evil is an abomination to fools.
verses.textEnNkjv: A desire accomplished is sweet to the soul, But itis an abomination to fools to depart from evil.
verses.textEnNlt: It is pleasant to see dreams come true, but fools refuse to turn from evil to attain them.
verses.textEnNasb: Desire realized is sweet to the soul, But it is an abomination to fools to turn away from evil.
verses.textEn: A longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.

verses.textZh: 与智慧人同行的，必得智慧； 与愚昧人为友的，必受亏损。
verses.textZhCnvs: 与智慧人同行的，必得智慧； 与愚昧人为友的，必受亏损。
verses.textZhCuv: 与智慧人同行的，必得智慧； 和愚昧人作伴的，必受亏损。
verses.textEnNiv: Walk with the wise and become wise, for a companion of fools suffers harm.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever walks with the wise becomes wise, but the companion of fools will suffer harm.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who walks with wise men will be wise, But the companion of fools will be destroyed.
verses.textEnNlt: Walk with the wise and become wise; associate with fools and get in trouble.
verses.textEnNasb: One who walks with wise people will be wise, But a companion of fools will suffer harm.
verses.textEn: Walk with the wise and become wise, for a companion of fools suffers harm.

verses.textZh: 祸患追赶罪人， 义人必得善报。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祸患追赶罪人， 义人必得善报。
verses.textZhCuv: 祸患追赶罪人； 义人必得善报。
verses.textEnNiv: Trouble pursues the sinner, but the righteous are rewarded with good things.
verses.textEnEsv: Disaster pursues sinners, but the righteous are rewarded with good.
verses.textEnNkjv: Evil pursues sinners, But to the righteous, good shall be repaid.
verses.textEnNlt: Trouble chases sinners, while blessings reward the righteous.
verses.textEnNasb: Adversity pursues sinners, But the righteous will be rewarded with prosperity.
verses.textEn: Trouble pursues the sinner, but the righteous are rewarded with good things.

verses.textZh: 善人给子孙留下产业， 罪人的财富，却是为义人积藏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 善人给子孙留下产业， 罪人的财富，却是为义人积藏。
verses.textZhCuv: 善人给子孙遗留产业； 罪人为义人积存资财。
verses.textEnNiv: A good person leaves an inheritance for their children’s children, but a sinner’s wealth is stored up for the righteous.
verses.textEnEsv: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the sinner’s wealth is laid up for the righteous.
verses.textEnNkjv: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, But the wealth of the sinner is stored up for the righteous.
verses.textEnNlt: Good people leave an inheritance to their grandchildren, but the sinner’s wealth passes to the godly.
verses.textEnNasb: A good person leaves an inheritance to his grandchildren, And the wealth of a sinner is stored up for the righteous.
verses.textEn: A good person leaves an inheritance for their children’s children, but a sinner’s wealth is stored up for the righteous.

verses.textZh: 穷人的耕地可产大量粮食， 却因不义都被摧毁了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 穷人的耕地可产大量粮食， 却因不义都被摧毁了。
verses.textZhCuv: 穷人耕种多得粮食， 但因不义，有消灭的。
verses.textEnNiv: An unplowed field produces food for the poor, but injustice sweeps it away.
verses.textEnEsv: The fallow ground of the poor would yield much food, but it is swept away through injustice.
verses.textEnNkjv: Much food isin the fallow ground of the poor, And for lack of justice there is waste.
verses.textEnNlt: A poor person’s farm may produce much food, but injustice sweeps it all away.
verses.textEnNasb: Abundant food is in the uncultivated ground of the poor, But it is swept away by injustice.
verses.textEn: An unplowed field produces food for the poor, but injustice sweeps it away.

verses.textZh: 不用杖责打儿子的，是恨恶他； 爱儿子的，必对他勤加管教。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不用杖责打儿子的，是恨恶他； 爱儿子的，必对他勤加管教。
verses.textZhCuv: 不忍用杖打儿子的，是恨恶他； 疼爱儿子的，随时管教。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever spares the rod hates their children, but the one who loves their children is careful to discipline them.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever spares the rod hates his son, but he who loves him is diligent to discipline him.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who spares his rod hates his son, But he who loves him disciplines him promptly.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who spare the rod of discipline hate their children. Those who love their children care enough to discipline them.
verses.textEnNasb: He who withholds his rod hates his son, But he who loves him disciplines him diligently.
verses.textEn: Whoever spares the rod hates their children, but the one who loves their children is careful to discipline them.

verses.textZh: 义人必吃得饱足， 恶人却空着肚子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人必吃得饱足， 恶人却空着肚子。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人吃得饱足； 恶人肚腹缺粮。
verses.textEnNiv: The righteous eat to their hearts’ content, but the stomach of the wicked goes hungry.
verses.textEnEsv: The righteous has enough to satisfy his appetite, but the belly of the wicked suffers want.
verses.textEnNkjv: The righteous eats to the satisfying of his soul, But the stomach of the wicked shall be in want.
verses.textEnNlt: The godly eat to their hearts’ content, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.
verses.textEnNasb: The righteous has enough to satisfy his appetite, But the stomach of the wicked is in need.
verses.textEn: The righteous eat to their hearts’ content, but the stomach of the wicked goes hungry.

verses.textZh: 智慧妇人建立家室， 愚妄妇人亲手拆毁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧妇人建立家室， 愚妄妇人亲手拆毁。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧妇人建立家室； 愚妄妇人亲手拆毁。
verses.textEnNiv: The wise woman builds her house, but with her own hands the foolish one tears hers down.
verses.textEnEsv: The wisest of women builds her house, but folly with her own hands tears it down.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wise woman builds her house, But the foolish pulls it down with her hands.
verses.textEnNlt: A wise woman builds her home, but a foolish woman tears it down with her own hands.
verses.textEnNasb: The wise woman builds her house, But the foolish tears it down with her own hands.
verses.textEn: The wise woman builds her house, but with her own hands the foolish one tears hers down.

verses.textZh: 行事正直的，敬畏耶和华； 行为乖僻的，却藐视他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 行事正直的，敬畏耶和华； 行为乖僻的，却藐视他。
verses.textZhCuv: 行动正直的，敬畏耶和华； 行事乖僻的，却藐视他。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever fears the Lord walks uprightly, but those who despise him are devious in their ways.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever walks in uprightness fears the Lord , but he who is devious in his ways despises him.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who walks in his uprightness fears the Lord, But hewhois perverse in his ways despises Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who follow the right path fear the Lord ; those who take the wrong path despise him.
verses.textEnNasb: One who walks in his uprightness fears the Lord, But one who is devious in his ways despises Him.
verses.textEn: Whoever fears the Lord walks uprightly, but those who despise him are devious in their ways.

verses.textZh: 愚妄人的口中长出骄傲的枝子； 智慧人的嘴唇，能保障自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚妄人的口中长出骄傲的枝子； 智慧人的嘴唇，能保障自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 愚妄人口中骄傲，如杖责打己身； 智慧人的嘴必保守自己。
verses.textEnNiv: A fool’s mouth lashes out with pride, but the lips of the wise protect them.
verses.textEnEsv: By the mouth of a fool comes a rod for his back, but the lips of the wise will preserve them.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the mouth of a fool is a rod of pride, But the lips of the wise will preserve them.
verses.textEnNlt: A fool’s proud talk becomes a rod that beats him, but the words of the wise keep them safe.
verses.textEnNasb: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod for his back, But the lips of the wise will protect them.
verses.textEn: A fool’s mouth lashes out with pride, but the lips of the wise protect them.

verses.textZh: 没有耕牛，槽头干净； 出产丰盛，却是凭着牛的力量。
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有耕牛，槽头干净； 出产丰盛，却是凭着牛的力量。
verses.textZhCuv: 家里无牛，槽头干净； 土产加多乃凭牛力。
verses.textEnNiv: Where there are no oxen, the manger is empty, but from the strength of an ox come abundant harvests.
verses.textEnEsv: Where there are no oxen, the manger is clean, but abundant crops come by the strength of the ox.
verses.textEnNkjv: Where no oxen are, the trough is clean; But much increase comes by the strength of an ox.
verses.textEnNlt: Without oxen a stable stays clean, but you need a strong ox for a large harvest.
verses.textEnNasb: Where there are no oxen, the manger is clean; But much revenue comes by the strength of the ox.
verses.textEn: Where there are no oxen, the manger is empty, but from the strength of an ox come abundant harvests.

verses.textZh: 诚实的证人不说谎话； 虚伪的证人吐出谎言。
verses.textZhCnvs: 诚实的证人不说谎话； 虚伪的证人吐出谎言。
verses.textZhCuv: 诚实见证人不说谎话； 假见证人吐出谎言。
verses.textEnNiv: An honest witness does not deceive, but a false witness pours out lies.
verses.textEnEsv: A faithful witness does not lie, but a false witness breathes out lies.
verses.textEnNkjv: A faithful witness does not lie, But a false witness will utter lies.
verses.textEnNlt: An honest witness does not lie; a false witness breathes lies.
verses.textEnNasb: A trustworthy witness will not lie, But a false witness declares lies.
verses.textEn: An honest witness does not deceive, but a false witness pours out lies.

verses.textZh: 好讥笑人的寻找智慧，却寻不着； 聪明人寻找知识，却轻易得着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好讥笑人的寻找智慧，却寻不着； 聪明人寻找知识，却轻易得着。
verses.textZhCuv: 亵慢人寻智慧，却寻不着； 聪明人易得知识。
verses.textEnNiv: The mocker seeks wisdom and finds none, but knowledge comes easily to the discerning.
verses.textEnEsv: A scoffer seeks wisdom in vain, but knowledge is easy for a man of understanding.
verses.textEnNkjv: A scoffer seeks wisdom and does not findit, But knowledge is easy to him who understands.
verses.textEnNlt: A mocker seeks wisdom and never finds it, but knowledge comes easily to those with understanding.
verses.textEnNasb: A scoffer seeks wisdom and finds none, But knowledge is easy for one who has understanding.
verses.textEn: The mocker seeks wisdom and finds none, but knowledge comes easily to the discerning.

verses.textZh: 你当离开愚昧人， 因为你不会从他的嘴里晓得知识。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你当离开愚昧人， 因为你不会从他的嘴里晓得知识。
verses.textZhCuv: 到愚昧人面前， 不见他嘴中有知识。
verses.textEnNiv: Stay away from a fool, for you will not find knowledge on their lips.
verses.textEnEsv: Leave the presence of a fool, for there you do not meet words of knowledge.
verses.textEnNkjv: Go from the presence of a foolish man, When you do not perceive inhim the lips of knowledge.
verses.textEnNlt: Stay away from fools, for you won’t find knowledge on their lips.
verses.textEnNasb: Leave the presence of a fool, Or you will not discern words of knowledge.
verses.textEn: Stay away from a fool, for you will not find knowledge on their lips.

verses.textZh: 精明人的智慧能分辨自己的道路； 愚昧人的愚妄却欺骗自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 精明人的智慧能分辨自己的道路； 愚昧人的愚妄却欺骗自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 通达人的智慧在乎明白己道； 愚昧人的愚妄乃是诡诈 。
verses.textEnNiv: The wisdom of the prudent is to give thought to their ways, but the folly of fools is deception.
verses.textEnEsv: The wisdom of the prudent is to discern his way, but the folly of fools is deceiving.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way, But the folly of fools is deceit.
verses.textEnNlt: The prudent understand where they are going, but fools deceive themselves.
verses.textEnNasb: The wisdom of the sensible is to understand his way, But the foolishness of fools is deceit.
verses.textEn: The wisdom of the prudent is to give thought to their ways, but the folly of fools is deception.

verses.textZh: 愚妄人讥笑赎愆祭， 正直人中间却有恩宠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚妄人讥笑赎愆祭， 正直人中间却有恩宠。
verses.textZhCuv: 愚妄人犯罪，以为戏耍 ； 正直人互相喜悦。
verses.textEnNiv: Fools mock at making amends for sin, but goodwill is found among the upright.
verses.textEnEsv: Fools mock at the guilt offering, but the upright enjoy acceptance.
verses.textEnNkjv: Fools mock at sin, But among the upright thereis favor.
verses.textEnNlt: Fools make fun of guilt, but the godly acknowledge it and seek reconciliation.
verses.textEnNasb: Fools mock at sin, But among the upright there is goodwill.
verses.textEn: Fools mock at making amends for sin, but goodwill is found among the upright.

verses.textZh: 人的苦楚，只有自己心里知道； 心中的喜乐，外人也不能分享。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人的苦楚，只有自己心里知道； 心中的喜乐，外人也不能分享。
verses.textZhCuv: 心中的苦楚，自己知道； 心里的喜乐，外人无干。
verses.textEnNiv: Each heart knows its own bitterness, and no one else can share its joy.
verses.textEnEsv: The heart knows its own bitterness, and no stranger shares its joy.
verses.textEnNkjv: The heart knows its own bitterness, And a stranger does not share its joy.
verses.textEnNlt: Each heart knows its own bitterness, and no one else can fully share its joy.
verses.textEnNasb: The heart knows its own bitterness, And a stranger does not share its joy.
verses.textEn: Each heart knows its own bitterness, and no one else can share its joy.

verses.textZh: 恶人的家必毁坏， 正直人的帐棚却必兴盛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人的家必毁坏， 正直人的帐棚却必兴盛。
verses.textZhCuv: 奸恶人的房屋必倾倒； 正直人的帐棚必兴盛。
verses.textEnNiv: The house of the wicked will be destroyed, but the tent of the upright will flourish.
verses.textEnEsv: The house of the wicked will be destroyed, but the tent of the upright will flourish.
verses.textEnNkjv: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, But the tent of the upright will flourish.
verses.textEnNlt: The house of the wicked will be destroyed, but the tent of the godly will flourish.
verses.textEnNasb: The house of the wicked will be destroyed, But the tent of the upright will flourish.
verses.textEn: The house of the wicked will be destroyed, but the tent of the upright will flourish.

verses.textZh: 有一条路，人以为是正路， 走到尽头却是死亡之路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一条路，人以为是正路， 走到尽头却是死亡之路。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一条路，人以为正， 至终成为死亡之路。
verses.textEnNiv: There is a way that appears to be right, but in the end it leads to death.
verses.textEnEsv: There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the way to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: There is a way thatseems right to a man, But its end is the way of death.
verses.textEnNlt: There is a path before each person that seems right, but it ends in death.
verses.textEnNasb: There is a way which seems right to a person, But its end is the way of death.
verses.textEn: There is a way that appears to be right, but in the end it leads to death.

verses.textZh: 人在喜笑中，心里也会有痛苦； 欢乐的结局，会是愁苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人在喜笑中，心里也会有痛苦； 欢乐的结局，会是愁苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 人在喜笑中，心也忧愁； 快乐至极就生愁苦。
verses.textEnNiv: Even in laughter the heart may ache, and rejoicing may end in grief.
verses.textEnEsv: Even in laughter the heart may ache, and the end of joy may be grief.
verses.textEnNkjv: Even in laughter the heart may sorrow, And the end of mirth maybe grief.
verses.textEnNlt: Laughter can conceal a heavy heart, but when the laughter ends, the grief remains.
verses.textEnNasb: Even in laughter the heart may be in pain, And the end of joy may be grief.
verses.textEn: Even in laughter the heart may ache, and rejoicing may end in grief.

verses.textZh: 心中背道的，必饱尝自己行为的恶果； 善人也因自己所行的，得到善报。
verses.textZhCnvs: 心中背道的，必饱尝自己行为的恶果； 善人也因自己所行的，得到善报。
verses.textZhCuv: 心中背道的，必满得自己的结果； 善人必从自己的行为得以知足。
verses.textEnNiv: The faithless will be fully repaid for their ways, and the good rewarded for theirs.
verses.textEnEsv: The backslider in heart will be filled with the fruit of his ways, and a good man will be filled with the fruit of his ways.
verses.textEnNkjv: The backslider in heart will be filled with his own ways, But a good man willbesatisfied from above.
verses.textEnNlt: Backsliders get what they deserve; good people receive their reward.
verses.textEnNasb: One with a wayward heart will have his fill of his own ways, But a good person will be satisfied with his.
verses.textEn: The faithless will be fully repaid for their ways, and the good rewarded for theirs.

verses.textZh: 愚蒙人凡话都信； 精明的人却步步谨慎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚蒙人凡话都信； 精明的人却步步谨慎。
verses.textZhCuv: 愚蒙人是话都信； 通达人步步谨慎。
verses.textEnNiv: The simple believe anything, but the prudent give thought to their steps.
verses.textEnEsv: The simple believes everything, but the prudent gives thought to his steps.
verses.textEnNkjv: The simple believes every word, But the prudent considers well his steps.
verses.textEnNlt: Only simpletons believe everything they’re told! The prudent carefully consider their steps.
verses.textEnNasb: The naive believes everything, But the sensible person considers his steps.
verses.textEn: The simple believe anything, but the prudent give thought to their steps.

verses.textZh: 智慧人敬畏耶和华 ，远离恶事； 愚昧人却骄傲自恃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧人敬畏耶和华 ，远离恶事； 愚昧人却骄傲自恃。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧人惧怕，就远离恶事； 愚妄人却狂傲自恃。
verses.textEnNiv: The wise fear the Lord and shun evil, but a fool is hotheaded and yet feels secure.
verses.textEnEsv: One who is wise is cautious and turns away from evil, but a fool is reckless and careless.
verses.textEnNkjv: A wise man fears and departs from evil, But a fool rages and is self-confident.
verses.textEnNlt: The wise are cautious and avoid danger; fools plunge ahead with reckless confidence.
verses.textEnNasb: A wise person is cautious and turns away from evil, But a fool is arrogant and careless.
verses.textEn: The wise fear the Lord and shun evil, but a fool is hotheaded and yet feels secure.

verses.textZh: 轻易动怒的，行事愚妄； 心怀诡计的人，被人恨恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 轻易动怒的，行事愚妄； 心怀诡计的人，被人恨恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 轻易发怒的，行事愚妄； 设立诡计的，被人恨恶。
verses.textEnNiv: A quick-tempered person does foolish things, and the one who devises evil schemes is hated.
verses.textEnEsv: A man of quick temper acts foolishly, and a man of evil devices is hated.
verses.textEnNkjv: A quick-tempered man acts foolishly, And a man of wicked intentions is hated.
verses.textEnNlt: Short-tempered people do foolish things, and schemers are hated.
verses.textEnNasb: A quick-tempered person acts foolishly, And a person of evil devices is hated.
verses.textEn: A quick-tempered person does foolish things, and the one who devises evil schemes is hated.

verses.textZh: 愚蒙人得愚妄为产业； 精明的人以知识为冠冕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚蒙人得愚妄为产业； 精明的人以知识为冠冕。
verses.textZhCuv: 愚蒙人得愚昧为产业； 通达人得知识为冠冕。
verses.textEnNiv: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
verses.textEnEsv: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
verses.textEnNkjv: The simple inherit folly, But the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
verses.textEnNlt: Simpletons are clothed with foolishness, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
verses.textEnNasb: The naive inherit foolishness, But the sensible are crowned with knowledge.
verses.textEn: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

verses.textZh: 坏人必俯伏在好人面前， 恶人必俯伏在义人门口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 坏人必俯伏在好人面前， 恶人必俯伏在义人门口。
verses.textZhCuv: 坏人俯伏在善人面前； 恶人俯伏在义人门口。
verses.textEnNiv: Evildoers will bow down in the presence of the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
verses.textEnEsv: The evil bow down before the good, the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
verses.textEnNkjv: The evil will bow before the good, And the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
verses.textEnNlt: Evil people will bow before good people; the wicked will bow at the gates of the godly.
verses.textEnNasb: The evil will bow down before the good, And the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
verses.textEn: Evildoers will bow down in the presence of the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

verses.textZh: 穷人连邻舍也厌恶他； 财主却有很多人爱他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 穷人连邻舍也厌恶他； 财主却有很多人爱他。
verses.textZhCuv: 贫穷人连邻舍也恨他； 富足人朋友最多。
verses.textEnNiv: The poor are shunned even by their neighbors, but the rich have many friends.
verses.textEnEsv: The poor is disliked even by his neighbor, but the rich has many friends.
verses.textEnNkjv: The poor man is hated even by his own neighbor, But the rich has many friends.
verses.textEnNlt: The poor are despised even by their neighbors, while the rich have many "friends."
verses.textEnNasb: The poor is hated even by his neighbor, But those who love the rich are many.
verses.textEn: The poor are shunned even by their neighbors, but the rich have many friends.

verses.textZh: 藐视邻舍的，是为有罪； 恩待贫穷人的，是为有福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 藐视邻舍的，是为有罪； 恩待贫穷人的，是为有福。
verses.textZhCuv: 藐视邻舍的，这人有罪； 怜悯贫穷的，这人有福。
verses.textEnNiv: It is a sin to despise one’s neighbor, but blessed is the one who is kind to the needy.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever despises his neighbor is a sinner, but blessed is he who is generous to the poor.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who despises his neighbor sins; But he who has mercy on the poor, happy is he.
verses.textEnNlt: It is a sin to belittle one’s neighbor; blessed are those who help the poor.
verses.textEnNasb: One who despises his neighbor sins, But one who is gracious to the poor is blessed.
verses.textEn: It is a sin to despise one’s neighbor, but blessed is the one who is kind to the needy.

verses.textZh: 图谋恶事的，不是走错了吗？ 谋求善事的，必得慈爱和诚实。
verses.textZhCnvs: 图谋恶事的，不是走错了吗？ 谋求善事的，必得慈爱和诚实。
verses.textZhCuv: 谋恶的，岂非走入迷途吗？ 谋善的，必得慈爱和诚实。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not those who plot evil go astray? But those who plan what is good find love and faithfulness.
verses.textEnEsv: Do they not go astray who devise evil? Those who devise good meet steadfast love and faithfulness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do they not go astray who devise evil? But mercy and truth belong to those who devise good.
verses.textEnNlt: If you plan to do evil, you will be lost; if you plan to do good, you will receive unfailing love and faithfulness.
verses.textEnNasb: Will they who devise evil not go astray? But kindness and truth will be to those who devise good.
verses.textEn: Do not those who plot evil go astray? But those who plan what is good find love and faithfulness.

verses.textZh: 一切劳苦都有益处， 嘴上空谈引致贫穷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一切劳苦都有益处， 嘴上空谈引致贫穷。
verses.textZhCuv: 诸般勤劳都有益处； 嘴上多言乃致穷乏。
verses.textEnNiv: All hard work brings a profit, but mere talk leads only to poverty.
verses.textEnEsv: In all toil there is profit, but mere talk tends only to poverty.
verses.textEnNkjv: In all labor there is profit, But idle chatter leads only to poverty.
verses.textEnNlt: Work brings profit, but mere talk leads to poverty!
verses.textEnNasb: In all labor there is profit, But mere talk leads only to poverty.
verses.textEn: All hard work brings a profit, but mere talk leads only to poverty.

verses.textZh: 智慧人的冠冕是他们的财富； 愚昧人的愚妄，始终是愚妄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧人的冠冕是他们的财富； 愚昧人的愚妄，始终是愚妄。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧人的财为自己的冠冕； 愚妄人的愚昧终是愚昧。
verses.textEnNiv: The wealth of the wise is their crown, but the folly of fools yields folly.
verses.textEnEsv: The crown of the wise is their wealth, but the folly of fools brings folly.
verses.textEnNkjv: The crown of the wise is their riches, But the foolishness of fools is folly.
verses.textEnNlt: Wealth is a crown for the wise; the effort of fools yields only foolishness.
verses.textEnNasb: The crown of the wise is their riches, But the foolishness of fools is simply foolishness.
verses.textEn: The wealth of the wise is their crown, but the folly of fools yields folly.

verses.textZh: 作真见证的，救人性命； 吐出谎言的，以诡诈害人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 作真见证的，救人性命； 吐出谎言的，以诡诈害人。
verses.textZhCuv: 作真见证的，救人性命； 吐出谎言的，施行诡诈。
verses.textEnNiv: A truthful witness saves lives, but a false witness is deceitful.
verses.textEnEsv: A truthful witness saves lives, but one who breathes out lies is deceitful.
verses.textEnNkjv: A true witness delivers souls, But a deceitful witness speaks lies.
verses.textEnNlt: A truthful witness saves lives, but a false witness is a traitor.
verses.textEnNasb: A truthful witness saves lives, But one who declares lies is deceitful.
verses.textEn: A truthful witness saves lives, but a false witness is deceitful.

verses.textZh: 敬畏耶和华的，大有倚靠； 他的子孙也有避难所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 敬畏耶和华的，大有倚靠； 他的子孙也有避难所。
verses.textZhCuv: 敬畏耶和华的，大有倚靠； 他的儿女也有避难所。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever fears the Lord has a secure fortress, and for their children it will be a refuge.
verses.textEnEsv: In the fear of the Lord one has strong confidence, and his children will have a refuge.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the fear of the Lordthereis strong confidence, And His children will have a place of refuge.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who fear the Lord are secure; he will be a refuge for their children.
verses.textEnNasb: In the fear of the Lord there is strong confidence, And his children will have refuge.
verses.textEn: Whoever fears the Lord has a secure fortress, and for their children it will be a refuge.

verses.textZh: 敬畏耶和华是生命的泉源， 能使人避开死亡的网罗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 敬畏耶和华是生命的泉源， 能使人避开死亡的网罗。
verses.textZhCuv: 敬畏耶和华就是生命的泉源， 可以使人离开死亡的网罗。
verses.textEnNiv: The fear of the Lord is a fountain of life, turning a person from the snares of death.
verses.textEnEsv: The fear of the Lord is a fountain of life, that one may turn away from the snares of death.
verses.textEnNkjv: The fear of the Lordis a fountain of life, To turn one away from the snares of death.
verses.textEnNlt: Fear of the Lord is a life-giving fountain; it offers escape from the snares of death.
verses.textEnNasb: The fear of the Lord is a fountain of life, By which one may avoid the snares of death.
verses.textEn: The fear of the Lord is a fountain of life, turning a person from the snares of death.

verses.textZh: 君王的荣耀在于人民众多， 帝王的没落由于国民寡少。
verses.textZhCnvs: 君王的荣耀在于人民众多， 帝王的没落由于国民寡少。
verses.textZhCuv: 帝王荣耀在乎民多； 君王衰败在乎民少。
verses.textEnNiv: A large population is a king’s glory, but without subjects a prince is ruined.
verses.textEnEsv: In a multitude of people is the glory of a king, but without people a prince is ruined.
verses.textEnNkjv: In a multitude of people is a king’s honor, But in the lack of people is the downfall of a prince.
verses.textEnNlt: A growing population is a king’s glory; a prince without subjects has nothing.
verses.textEnNasb: In a multitude of people is a king’s glory, But in the scarcity of people is a prince’s ruin.
verses.textEn: A large population is a king’s glory, but without subjects a prince is ruined.

verses.textZh: 不轻易动怒的，十分聪明； 轻易动怒的，大显愚妄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不轻易动怒的，十分聪明； 轻易动怒的，大显愚妄。
verses.textZhCuv: 不轻易发怒的，大有聪明； 性情暴躁的，大显愚妄。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever is patient has great understanding, but one who is quick-tempered displays folly.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a hasty temper exalts folly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hewhois slow to wrath has great understanding, But hewhois impulsive exalts folly.
verses.textEnNlt: People with understanding control their anger; a hot temper shows great foolishness.
verses.textEnNasb: One who is slow to anger has great understanding; But one who is quick-tempered exalts foolishness.
verses.textEn: Whoever is patient has great understanding, but one who is quick-tempered displays folly.

verses.textZh: 心里平静，可使身体健康； 但嫉妒能使骨头朽烂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 心里平静，可使身体健康； 但嫉妒能使骨头朽烂。
verses.textZhCuv: 心中安静是肉体的生命； 嫉妒是骨中的朽烂。
verses.textEnNiv: A heart at peace gives life to the body, but envy rots the bones.
verses.textEnEsv: A tranquil heart gives life to the flesh, but envy makes the bones rot.
verses.textEnNkjv: A sound heart is life to the body, But envy is rottenness to the bones.
verses.textEnNlt: A peaceful heart leads to a healthy body; jealousy is like cancer in the bones.
verses.textEnNasb: A tranquil heart is life to the body, But jealousy is rottenness to the bones.
verses.textEn: A heart at peace gives life to the body, but envy rots the bones.

verses.textZh: 欺压贫寒的，就是辱骂造他的主； 恩待穷苦人的，就是尊敬造他的主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 欺压贫寒的，就是辱骂造他的主； 恩待穷苦人的，就是尊敬造他的主。
verses.textZhCuv: 欺压贫寒的，是辱没造他的主； 怜悯穷乏的，乃是尊敬主。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever oppresses the poor shows contempt for their Maker, but whoever is kind to the needy honors God.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever oppresses a poor man insults his Maker, but he who is generous to the needy honors him.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who oppresses the poor reproaches his Maker, But he who honors Him has mercy on the needy.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who oppress the poor insult their Maker, but helping the poor honors him.
verses.textEnNasb: One who oppresses the poor taunts his Maker, But one who is gracious to the needy honors Him.
verses.textEn: Whoever oppresses the poor shows contempt for their Maker, but whoever is kind to the needy honors God.

verses.textZh: 恶人必因自己所行的恶事被推倒， 义人死的时候仍有所倚靠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人必因自己所行的恶事被推倒， 义人死的时候仍有所倚靠。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人在所行的恶上必被推倒； 义人临死，有所投靠。
verses.textEnNiv: When calamity comes, the wicked are brought down, but even in death the righteous seek refuge in God.
verses.textEnEsv: The wicked is overthrown through his evildoing, but the righteous finds refuge in his death.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wicked is banished in his wickedness, But the righteous has a refuge in his death.
verses.textEnNlt: The wicked are crushed by disaster, but the godly have a refuge when they die.
verses.textEnNasb: The wicked is thrust down by his own wrongdoing, But the righteous has a refuge when he dies.
verses.textEn: When calamity comes, the wicked are brought down, but even in death the righteous seek refuge in God.

verses.textZh: 智慧居于聪明人的心中； 愚昧人心里所存的，人所周知 在愚昧人心里也显明自己"）。
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧居于聪明人的心中； 愚昧人心里所存的，人所周知 在愚昧人心里也显明自己"）。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧存在聪明人心中； 愚昧人心里所存的，显而易见。
verses.textEnNiv: Wisdom reposes in the heart of the discerning and even among fools she lets herself be known.
verses.textEnEsv: Wisdom rests in the heart of a man of understanding, but it makes itself known even in the midst of fools.
verses.textEnNkjv: Wisdom rests in the heart of him who has understanding, But whatis in the heart of fools is made known.
verses.textEnNlt: Wisdom is enshrined in an understanding heart; wisdom is not found among fools.
verses.textEnNasb: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, But among fools it is made known.
verses.textEn: Wisdom reposes in the heart of the discerning and even among fools she lets herself be known.

verses.textZh: 正义使国家兴盛， 罪恶是人民的羞辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 正义使国家兴盛， 罪恶是人民的羞辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 公义使邦国高举； 罪恶是人民的羞辱。
verses.textEnNiv: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin condemns any people.
verses.textEnEsv: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a reproach to any people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Righteousness exalts a nation, But sin is a reproach to any people.
verses.textEnNlt: Godliness makes a nation great, but sin is a disgrace to any people.
verses.textEnNasb: Righteousness exalts a nation, But sin is a disgrace to any people.
verses.textEn: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin condemns any people.

verses.textZh: 明慧的臣仆，为王喜悦； 贻羞的仆人，遭王震怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 明慧的臣仆，为王喜悦； 贻羞的仆人，遭王震怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧的臣子蒙王恩惠； 贻羞的仆人遭其震怒。
verses.textEnNiv: A king delights in a wise servant, but a shameful servant arouses his fury.
verses.textEnEsv: A servant who deals wisely has the king’s favor, but his wrath falls on one who acts shamefully.
verses.textEnNkjv: The king’s favor is toward a wise servant, But his wrath isagainst him who causes shame.
verses.textEnNlt: A king rejoices in wise servants but is angry with those who disgrace him.
verses.textEnNasb: The king’s favor is toward a servant who acts wisely, But his anger is toward him who acts shamefully.
verses.textEn: A king delights in a wise servant, but a shameful servant arouses his fury.

verses.textZh: 柔和的回答使烈怒消退， 暴戾的话激动怒气。
verses.textZhCnvs: 柔和的回答使烈怒消退， 暴戾的话激动怒气。
verses.textZhCuv: 回答柔和，使怒消退； 言语暴戾，触动怒气。
verses.textEnNiv: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
verses.textEnEsv: A soft answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
verses.textEnNkjv: A soft answer turns away wrath, But a harsh word stirs up anger.
verses.textEnNlt: A gentle answer deflects anger, but harsh words make tempers flare.
verses.textEnNasb: A gentle answer turns away wrath, But a harsh word stirs up anger.
verses.textEn: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

verses.textZh: 智慧人的舌头阐扬知识； 愚昧人的口发出愚妄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧人的舌头阐扬知识； 愚昧人的口发出愚妄。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧人的舌善发知识； 愚昧人的口吐出愚昧。
verses.textEnNiv: The tongue of the wise adorns knowledge, but the mouth of the fool gushes folly.
verses.textEnEsv: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouths of fools pour out folly.
verses.textEnNkjv: The tongue of the wise uses knowledge rightly, But the mouth of fools pours forth foolishness.
verses.textEnNlt: The tongue of the wise makes knowledge appealing, but the mouth of a fool belches out foolishness.
verses.textEnNasb: The tongue of the wise makes knowledge pleasant, But the mouth of fools spouts foolishness.
verses.textEn: The tongue of the wise adorns knowledge, but the mouth of the fool gushes folly.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的眼目无所不在； 坏人好人他都鉴察。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的眼目无所不在； 坏人好人他都鉴察。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的眼目无处不在； 恶人善人，他都鉴察。
verses.textEnNiv: The eyes of the Lord are everywhere, keeping watch on the wicked and the good.
verses.textEnEsv: The eyes of the Lord are in every place, keeping watch on the evil and the good.
verses.textEnNkjv: The eyes of the Lordare in every place, Keeping watch on the evil and the good.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is watching everywhere, keeping his eye on both the evil and the good.
verses.textEnNasb: The eyes of the Lord are in every place, Watching the evil and the good.
verses.textEn: The eyes of the Lord are everywhere, keeping watch on the wicked and the good.

verses.textZh: 说安慰话的舌头是生命树； 奸恶的舌头使人心碎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 说安慰话的舌头是生命树； 奸恶的舌头使人心碎。
verses.textZhCuv: 温良的舌是生命树； 乖谬的嘴使人心碎。
verses.textEnNiv: The soothing tongue is a tree of life, but a perverse tongue crushes the spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but perverseness in it breaks the spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life, But perverseness in it breaks the spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: Gentle words are a tree of life; a deceitful tongue crushes the spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: A soothing tongue is a tree of life, But perversion in it crushes the spirit.
verses.textEn: The soothing tongue is a tree of life, but a perverse tongue crushes the spirit.

verses.textZh: 愚妄人藐视父亲的管教； 看重责备的是精明的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚妄人藐视父亲的管教； 看重责备的是精明的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 愚妄人藐视父亲的管教； 领受责备的，得着见识。
verses.textEnNiv: A fool spurns a parent’s discipline, but whoever heeds correction shows prudence.
verses.textEnEsv: A fool despises his father’s instruction, but whoever heeds reproof is prudent.
verses.textEnNkjv: A fool despises his father’s instruction, But he who receives correction is prudent.
verses.textEnNlt: Only a fool despises a parent’s discipline; whoever learns from correction is wise.
verses.textEnNasb: A fool rejects his father’s discipline, But he who complies with rebuke is sensible.
verses.textEn: A fool spurns a parent’s discipline, but whoever heeds correction shows prudence.

verses.textZh: 义人家中财宝丰富； 恶人的收入却带来扰害。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人家中财宝丰富； 恶人的收入却带来扰害。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人家中多有财宝； 恶人得利反受扰害。
verses.textEnNiv: The house of the righteous contains great treasure, but the income of the wicked brings ruin.
verses.textEnEsv: In the house of the righteous there is much treasure, but trouble befalls the income of the wicked.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the house of the righteous thereis much treasure, But in the revenue of the wicked is trouble.
verses.textEnNlt: There is treasure in the house of the godly, but the earnings of the wicked bring trouble.
verses.textEnNasb: Great wealth is in the house of the righteous, But trouble is in the income of the wicked.
verses.textEn: The house of the righteous contains great treasure, but the income of the wicked brings ruin.

verses.textZh: 智慧人的嘴唇散播知识； 愚昧人的心并不是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧人的嘴唇散播知识； 愚昧人的心并不是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧人的嘴播扬知识； 愚昧人的心并不如此。
verses.textEnNiv: The lips of the wise spread knowledge, but the hearts of fools are not upright.
verses.textEnEsv: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so the hearts of fools.
verses.textEnNkjv: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge, But the heart of the fool does not do so.
verses.textEnNlt: The lips of the wise give good advice; the heart of a fool has none to give.
verses.textEnNasb: The lips of the wise spread knowledge, But the hearts of fools are not so.
verses.textEn: The lips of the wise spread knowledge, but the hearts of fools are not upright.

verses.textZh: 恶人的祭物是耶和华厌恶的； 正直人的祷告却是他所喜悦的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人的祭物是耶和华厌恶的； 正直人的祷告却是他所喜悦的。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人献祭，为耶和华所憎恶； 正直人祈祷，为他所喜悦。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord detests the sacrifice of the wicked, but the prayer of the upright pleases him.
verses.textEnEsv: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the Lord , but the prayer of the upright is acceptable to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the Lord, But the prayer of the upright is His delight.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord detests the sacrifice of the wicked, but he delights in the prayers of the upright.
verses.textEnNasb: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the Lord, But the prayer of the upright is His delight.
verses.textEn: The Lord detests the sacrifice of the wicked, but the prayer of the upright pleases him.

verses.textZh: 恶人的道路是耶和华厌恶的； 追求公义的人却是他所爱的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人的道路是耶和华厌恶的； 追求公义的人却是他所爱的。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人的道路，为耶和华所憎恶； 追求公义的，为他所喜爱。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord detests the way of the wicked, but he loves those who pursue righteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: The way of the wicked is an abomination to the Lord , but he loves him who pursues righteousness.
verses.textEnNkjv: The way of the wicked is an abomination to the Lord, But He loves him who follows righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord detests the way of the wicked, but he loves those who pursue godliness.
verses.textEnNasb: The way of the wicked is an abomination to the Lord, But He loves the one who pursues righteousness.
verses.textEn: The Lord detests the way of the wicked, but he loves those who pursue righteousness.

verses.textZh: 离弃正路的必受严厉的管教； 恨恶责备的必致死亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 离弃正路的必受严厉的管教； 恨恶责备的必致死亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 舍弃正路的，必受严刑； 恨恶责备的，必致死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: Stern discipline awaits anyone who leaves the path; the one who hates correction will die.
verses.textEnEsv: There is severe discipline for him who forsakes the way; whoever hates reproof will die.
verses.textEnNkjv: Harsh discipline is for him who forsakes the way, And he who hates correction will die.
verses.textEnNlt: Whoever abandons the right path will be severely disciplined; whoever hates correction will die.
verses.textEnNasb: There is severe punishment for one who abandons the way; One who hates a rebuke will die.
verses.textEn: Stern discipline awaits anyone who leaves the path; the one who hates correction will die.

verses.textZh: 阴间和灭亡展露在耶和华面前， 何况世人的心呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 阴间和灭亡展露在耶和华面前， 何况世人的心呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 阴间和灭亡尚在耶和华眼前， 何况世人的心呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Death and Destruction lie open before the Lord — how much more do human hearts!
verses.textEnEsv: Sheol and Abaddon lie open before the Lord ; how much more the hearts of the children of man!
verses.textEnNkjv: Hell and Destruction are before the Lord; So how much more the hearts of the sons of men.
verses.textEnNlt: Even Death and Destruction hold no secrets from the Lord . How much more does he know the human heart!
verses.textEnNasb: Sheol and Abaddon lie open before the Lord, How much more the hearts of mankind!
verses.textEn: Death and Destruction lie open before the Lord — how much more do human hearts!

verses.textZh: 好讥笑人的不喜爱责备他的人， 也不到智慧人那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好讥笑人的不喜爱责备他的人， 也不到智慧人那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 亵慢人不爱受责备； 他也不就近智慧人。
verses.textEnNiv: Mockers resent correction, so they avoid the wise.
verses.textEnEsv: A scoffer does not like to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.
verses.textEnNkjv: A scoffer does not love one who corrects him, Nor will he go to the wise.
verses.textEnNlt: Mockers hate to be corrected, so they stay away from the wise.
verses.textEnNasb: A scoffer does not love one who rebukes him; He will not go to the wise.
verses.textEn: Mockers resent correction, so they avoid the wise.

verses.textZh: 喜乐的心使人脸上容光焕发； 心中愁苦使人精神颓丧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 喜乐的心使人脸上容光焕发； 心中愁苦使人精神颓丧。
verses.textZhCuv: 心中喜乐，面带笑容； 心里忧愁，灵被损伤。
verses.textEnNiv: A happy heart makes the face cheerful, but heartache crushes the spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but by sorrow of heart the spirit is crushed.
verses.textEnNkjv: A merry heart makes a cheerful countenance, But by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
verses.textEnNlt: A glad heart makes a happy face; a broken heart crushes the spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: A joyful heart makes a cheerful face, But when the heart is sad, the spirit is broken.
verses.textEn: A happy heart makes the face cheerful, but heartache crushes the spirit.

verses.textZh: 聪明人的心寻求知识， 愚昧人的口只吃愚妄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 聪明人的心寻求知识， 愚昧人的口只吃愚妄。
verses.textZhCuv: 聪明人心求知识； 愚昧人口吃愚昧。
verses.textEnNiv: The discerning heart seeks knowledge, but the mouth of a fool feeds on folly.
verses.textEnEsv: The heart of him who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.
verses.textEnNkjv: The heart of him who has understanding seeks knowledge, But the mouth of fools feeds on foolishness.
verses.textEnNlt: A wise person is hungry for knowledge, while the fool feeds on trash.
verses.textEnNasb: The mind of the intelligent seeks knowledge, But the mouth of fools feeds on foolishness.
verses.textEn: The discerning heart seeks knowledge, but the mouth of a fool feeds on folly.

verses.textZh: 困苦人的日子尽是艰难； 心中畅快的好象常享丰筵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 困苦人的日子尽是艰难； 心中畅快的好象常享丰筵。
verses.textZhCuv: 困苦人的日子都是愁苦； 心中欢畅的，常享丰筵。
verses.textEnNiv: All the days of the oppressed are wretched, but the cheerful heart has a continual feast.
verses.textEnEsv: All the days of the afflicted are evil, but the cheerful of heart has a continual feast.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the days of the afflicted are evil, But he who is of a merry heart has a continual feast.
verses.textEnNlt: For the despondent, every day brings trouble; for the happy heart, life is a continual feast.
verses.textEnNasb: All the days of the needy are bad, But a cheerful heart has a continual feast.
verses.textEn: All the days of the oppressed are wretched, but the cheerful heart has a continual feast.

verses.textZh: 财物虽少而敬畏耶和华， 胜过财物丰富却烦恼不安。
verses.textZhCnvs: 财物虽少而敬畏耶和华， 胜过财物丰富却烦恼不安。
verses.textZhCuv: 少有财宝，敬畏耶和华， 强如多有财宝，烦乱不安。
verses.textEnNiv: Better a little with the fear of the Lord than great wealth with turmoil.
verses.textEnEsv: Better is a little with the fear of the Lord than great treasure and trouble with it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Better is a little with the fear of the Lord, Than great treasure with trouble.
verses.textEnNlt: Better to have little, with fear for the Lord , than to have great treasure and inner turmoil.
verses.textEnNasb: Better is a little with the fear of the Lord Than great treasure, and turmoil with the treasure.
verses.textEn: Better a little with the fear of the Lord than great wealth with turmoil.

verses.textZh: 吃素菜而彼此相爱， 胜过吃肥牛却彼此憎恨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 吃素菜而彼此相爱， 胜过吃肥牛却彼此憎恨。
verses.textZhCuv: 吃素菜，彼此相爱， 强如吃肥牛，彼此相恨。
verses.textEnNiv: Better a small serving of vegetables with love than a fattened calf with hatred.
verses.textEnEsv: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is than a fattened ox and hatred with it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, Than a fatted calf with hatred.
verses.textEnNlt: A bowl of vegetables with someone you love is better than steak with someone you hate.
verses.textEnNasb: Better is a portion of vegetables where there is love, Than a fattened ox served with hatred.
verses.textEn: Better a small serving of vegetables with love than a fattened calf with hatred.

verses.textZh: 脾气暴烈的人常引起纷争； 不轻易动怒的可平息争执。
verses.textZhCnvs: 脾气暴烈的人常引起纷争； 不轻易动怒的可平息争执。
verses.textZhCuv: 暴怒的人挑启争端； 忍怒的人止息纷争。
verses.textEnNiv: A hot-tempered person stirs up conflict, but the one who is patient calms a quarrel.
verses.textEnEsv: A hot-tempered man stirs up strife, but he who is slow to anger quiets contention.
verses.textEnNkjv: A wrathful man stirs up strife, But hewhois slow to anger allays contention.
verses.textEnNlt: A hot-tempered person starts fights; a cool-tempered person stops them.
verses.textEnNasb: A hot-tempered person stirs up strife, But the slow to anger calms a dispute.
verses.textEn: A hot-tempered person stirs up conflict, but the one who is patient calms a quarrel.

verses.textZh: 懒惰人的道路好象荆棘篱笆； 正直人的路径是平坦的大道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 懒惰人的道路好象荆棘篱笆； 正直人的路径是平坦的大道。
verses.textZhCuv: 懒惰人的道像荆棘的篱笆； 正直人的路是平坦的大道。
verses.textEnNiv: The way of the sluggard is blocked with thorns, but the path of the upright is a highway.
verses.textEnEsv: The way of a sluggard is like a hedge of thorns, but the path of the upright is a level highway.
verses.textEnNkjv: The way of the lazy manis like a hedge of thorns, But the way of the upright is a highway.
verses.textEnNlt: A lazy person’s way is blocked with briers, but the path of the upright is an open highway.
verses.textEnNasb: The way of the lazy one is like a hedge of thorns, But the path of the upright is a highway.
verses.textEn: The way of the sluggard is blocked with thorns, but the path of the upright is a highway.

verses.textZh: 智慧的儿子使父亲快乐； 愚昧人却藐视自己的母亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧的儿子使父亲快乐； 愚昧人却藐视自己的母亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧子使父亲喜乐； 愚昧人藐视母亲。
verses.textEnNiv: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish man despises his mother.
verses.textEnEsv: A wise son makes a glad father, but a foolish man despises his mother.
verses.textEnNkjv: A wise son makes a father glad, But a foolish man despises his mother.
verses.textEnNlt: Sensible children bring joy to their father; foolish children despise their mother.
verses.textEnNasb: A wise son makes a father glad, But a foolish man despises his mother.
verses.textEn: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish man despises his mother.

verses.textZh: 无知的人以愚妄为乐； 聪明人却行事正直。
verses.textZhCnvs: 无知的人以愚妄为乐； 聪明人却行事正直。
verses.textZhCuv: 无知的人以愚妄为乐； 聪明的人按正直而行。
verses.textEnNiv: Folly brings joy to one who has no sense, but whoever has understanding keeps a straight course.
verses.textEnEsv: Folly is a joy to him who lacks sense, but a man of understanding walks straight ahead.
verses.textEnNkjv: Folly is joy tohimwhois destitute of discernment, But a man of understanding walks uprightly.
verses.textEnNlt: Foolishness brings joy to those with no sense; a sensible person stays on the right path.
verses.textEnNasb: Foolishness is joy to one who lacks sense, But a person of understanding walks straight.
verses.textEn: Folly brings joy to one who has no sense, but whoever has understanding keeps a straight course.

verses.textZh: 不经商议，计划必定失败； 谋士众多，计划就可成功。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不经商议，计划必定失败； 谋士众多，计划就可成功。
verses.textZhCuv: 不先商议，所谋无效； 谋士众多，所谋乃成。
verses.textEnNiv: Plans fail for lack of counsel, but with many advisers they succeed.
verses.textEnEsv: Without counsel plans fail, but with many advisers they succeed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Without counsel, plans go awry, But in the multitude of counselors they are established.
verses.textEnNlt: Plans go wrong for lack of advice; many advisers bring success.
verses.textEnNasb: Without consultation, plans are frustrated, But with many counselors they succeed.
verses.textEn: Plans fail for lack of counsel, but with many advisers they succeed.

verses.textZh: 应对得当，自己也觉喜乐； 合时的话，多么美好！
verses.textZhCnvs: 应对得当，自己也觉喜乐； 合时的话，多么美好！
verses.textZhCuv: 口善应对，自觉喜乐； 话合其时，何等美好。
verses.textEnNiv: A person finds joy in giving an apt reply— and how good is a timely word!
verses.textEnEsv: To make an apt answer is a joy to a man, and a word in season, how good it is!
verses.textEnNkjv: A man has joy by the answer of his mouth, And a word spoken in due season, how good itis!
verses.textEnNlt: Everyone enjoys a fitting reply; it is wonderful to say the right thing at the right time!
verses.textEnNasb: A person has joy in an apt answer, And how delightful is a timely word!
verses.textEn: A person finds joy in giving an apt reply— and how good is a timely word!

verses.textZh: 生命之路领明慧人向上， 因此他可以离开在下面的阴间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 生命之路领明慧人向上， 因此他可以离开在下面的阴间。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧人从生命的道上升， 使他远离在下的阴间。
verses.textEnNiv: The path of life leads upward for the prudent to keep them from going down to the realm of the dead.
verses.textEnEsv: The path of life leads upward for the prudent, that he may turn away from Sheol beneath.
verses.textEnNkjv: The way of life winds upward for the wise, That he may turn away from hell below.
verses.textEnNlt: The path of life leads upward for the wise; they leave the grave behind.
verses.textEnNasb: The path of life leads upward for the wise, So that he may keep away from Sheol below.
verses.textEn: The path of life leads upward for the prudent to keep them from going down to the realm of the dead.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必拆毁骄傲人的家， 却要立定寡妇的地界。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必拆毁骄傲人的家， 却要立定寡妇的地界。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必拆毁骄傲人的家， 却要立定寡妇的地界。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord tears down the house of the proud, but he sets the widow’s boundary stones in place.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord tears down the house of the proud but maintains the widow’s boundaries.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord will destroy the house of the proud, But He will establish the boundary of the widow.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord tears down the house of the proud, but he protects the property of widows.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will tear down the house of the proud, But He will set the boundary of the widow.
verses.textEn: The Lord tears down the house of the proud, but he sets the widow’s boundary stones in place.

verses.textZh: 邪恶的思想是耶和华厌恶的； 恩慈的话却是纯净的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 邪恶的思想是耶和华厌恶的； 恩慈的话却是纯净的。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶谋为耶和华所憎恶； 良言乃为纯净。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord detests the thoughts of the wicked, but gracious words are pure in his sight.
verses.textEnEsv: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the Lord , but gracious words are pure.
verses.textEnNkjv: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the Lord, But the words of the pure are pleasant.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord detests evil plans, but he delights in pure words.
verses.textEnNasb: Evil plans are an abomination to the Lord, But pleasant words are pure.
verses.textEn: The Lord detests the thoughts of the wicked, but gracious words are pure in his sight.

verses.textZh: 贪爱不义之财的祸害自己的家； 恨恶贿赂的必可以存活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 贪爱不义之财的祸害自己的家； 恨恶贿赂的必可以存活。
verses.textZhCuv: 贪恋财利的，扰害己家； 恨恶贿赂的，必得存活。
verses.textEnNiv: The greedy bring ruin to their households, but the one who hates bribes will live.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever is greedy for unjust gain troubles his own household, but he who hates bribes will live.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, But he who hates bribes will live.
verses.textEnNlt: Greed brings grief to the whole family, but those who hate bribes will live.
verses.textEnNasb: He who profits illicitly troubles his own house, But he who hates bribes will live.
verses.textEn: The greedy bring ruin to their households, but the one who hates bribes will live.

verses.textZh: 义人的心思想怎样回答； 恶人的口发出恶言。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人的心思想怎样回答； 恶人的口发出恶言。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人的心，思量如何回答； 恶人的口吐出恶言。
verses.textEnNiv: The heart of the righteous weighs its answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes evil.
verses.textEnEsv: The heart of the righteous ponders how to answer, but the mouth of the wicked pours out evil things.
verses.textEnNkjv: The heart of the righteous studies how to answer, But the mouth of the wicked pours forth evil.
verses.textEnNlt: The heart of the godly thinks carefully before speaking; the mouth of the wicked overflows with evil words.
verses.textEnNasb: The heart of the righteous ponders how to answer, But the mouth of the wicked pours out evil things.
verses.textEn: The heart of the righteous weighs its answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes evil.

verses.textZh: 耶和华远离恶人， 却垂听义人的祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华远离恶人， 却垂听义人的祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华远离恶人， 却听义人的祷告。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lordis far from the wicked, But He hears the prayer of the righteous.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayers of the righteous.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is far from the wicked, But He hears the prayer of the righteous.
verses.textEn: The Lord is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.

verses.textZh: 眼中的光采使人心快乐； 好消息使骨头滋润。
verses.textZhCnvs: 眼中的光采使人心快乐； 好消息使骨头滋润。
verses.textZhCuv: 眼有光，使心喜乐； 好信息，使骨滋润。
verses.textEnNiv: Light in a messenger’s eyes brings joy to the heart, and good news gives health to the bones.
verses.textEnEsv: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart, and good news refreshes the bones.
verses.textEnNkjv: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart, And a good report makes the bones healthy.
verses.textEnNlt: A cheerful look brings joy to the heart; good news makes for good health.
verses.textEnNasb: Bright eyes gladden the heart; Good news refreshes the bones.
verses.textEn: Light in a messenger’s eyes brings joy to the heart, and good news gives health to the bones.

verses.textZh: 听从有关生命之责备的， 必住在智慧人中间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 听从有关生命之责备的， 必住在智慧人中间。
verses.textZhCuv: 听从生命责备的， 必常在智慧人中。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever heeds life-giving correction will be at home among the wise.
verses.textEnEsv: The ear that listens to life-giving reproof will dwell among the wise.
verses.textEnNkjv: The ear that hears the rebukes of life Will abide among the wise.
verses.textEnNlt: If you listen to constructive criticism, you will be at home among the wise.
verses.textEnNasb: One whose ear listens to a life-giving rebuke Will stay among the wise.
verses.textEn: Whoever heeds life-giving correction will be at home among the wise.

verses.textZh: 轻忽管教的是藐视自己； 听从责备的却得着智慧 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 轻忽管教的是藐视自己； 听从责备的却得着智慧 。
verses.textZhCuv: 弃绝管教的，轻看自己的生命； 听从责备的，却得智慧。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who disregard discipline despise themselves, but the one who heeds correction gains understanding.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever ignores instruction despises himself, but he who listens to reproof gains intelligence.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who disdains instruction despises his own soul, But he who heeds rebuke gets understanding.
verses.textEnNlt: If you reject discipline, you only harm yourself; but if you listen to correction, you grow in understanding.
verses.textEnNasb: One who neglects discipline rejects himself, But one who listens to a rebuke acquires understanding.
verses.textEn: Those who disregard discipline despise themselves, but the one who heeds correction gains understanding.

verses.textZh: 敬畏耶和华是智慧的教训； 尊荣以先，必有谦卑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 敬畏耶和华是智慧的教训； 尊荣以先，必有谦卑。
verses.textZhCuv: 敬畏耶和华是智慧的训诲； 尊荣以前，必有谦卑。
verses.textEnNiv: Wisdom’s instruction is to fear the Lord , and humility comes before honor.
verses.textEnEsv: The fear of the Lord is instruction in wisdom, and humility comes before honor.
verses.textEnNkjv: The fear of the Lordis the instruction of wisdom, And before honor is humility.
verses.textEnNlt: Fear of the Lord teaches wisdom; humility precedes honor.
verses.textEnNasb: The fear of the Lord is the instruction for wisdom, And before honor comes humility.
verses.textEn: Wisdom’s instruction is to fear the Lord , and humility comes before honor.

verses.textZh: 心里的筹划在于人， 舌头的应对却出于耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 心里的筹划在于人， 舌头的应对却出于耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 心中的谋算在乎人； 舌头的应对由于耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: To humans belong the plans of the heart, but from the Lord comes the proper answer of the tongue.
verses.textEnEsv: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: The preparations of the heart belong to man, But the answer of the tongue is from the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: We can make our own plans, but the Lord gives the right answer.
verses.textEnNasb: The plans of the heart belong to a person, But the answer of the tongue is from the Lord.
verses.textEn: To humans belong the plans of the heart, but from the Lord comes the proper answer of the tongue.

verses.textZh: 人看自己一切所行的，都是清洁的； 耶和华却衡量人心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人看自己一切所行的，都是清洁的； 耶和华却衡量人心。
verses.textZhCuv: 人一切所行的，在自己眼中看为清洁； 惟有耶和华衡量人心。
verses.textEnNiv: All a person’s ways seem pure to them, but motives are weighed by the Lord .
