verses.textEnEsv: All the ways of a man are pure in his own eyes, but the Lord weighs the spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the ways of a man are pure in his own eyes, But the Lord weighs the spirits.
verses.textEnNlt: People may be pure in their own eyes, but the Lord examines their motives.
verses.textEnNasb: All the ways of a person are clean in his own sight, But the Lord examines the motives.
verses.textEn: All a person’s ways seem pure to them, but motives are weighed by the Lord .

verses.textZh: 当把你所作的交托耶和华， 你的计划就必成功。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当把你所作的交托耶和华， 你的计划就必成功。
verses.textZhCuv: 你所做的，要交托耶和华， 你所谋的，就必成立。
verses.textEnNiv: Commit to the Lord whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verses.textEnEsv: Commit your work to the Lord , and your plans will be established.
verses.textEnNkjv: Commit your works to the Lord, And your thoughts will be established.
verses.textEnNlt: Commit your actions to the Lord , and your plans will succeed.
verses.textEnNasb: Commit your works to the Lord, And your plans will be established.
verses.textEn: Commit to the Lord whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.

verses.textZh: 耶和华所造的各有目的， 连恶人也是为祸患的日子而造的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华所造的各有目的， 连恶人也是为祸患的日子而造的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华所造的，各适其用； 就是恶人也为祸患的日子所造。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord works out everything to its proper end— even the wicked for a day of disaster.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has made everything for its purpose, even the wicked for the day of trouble.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord has made all for Himself, Yes, even the wicked for the day of doom.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord has made everything for his own purposes, even the wicked for a day of disaster.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has made everything for its own purpose, Even the wicked for the day of evil.
verses.textEn: The Lord works out everything to its proper end— even the wicked for a day of disaster.

verses.textZh: 心里骄傲的人都是耶和华厌恶的； 他们必不免受罚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 心里骄傲的人都是耶和华厌恶的； 他们必不免受罚。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡心里骄傲的，为耶和华所憎恶； 虽然连手，他必不免受罚。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord detests all the proud of heart. Be sure of this: They will not go unpunished.
verses.textEnEsv: Everyone who is arrogant in heart is an abomination to the Lord ; be assured, he will not go unpunished.
verses.textEnNkjv: Everyone proud in heart is an abomination to the Lord; Thoughtheyjoin forces, none will go unpunished.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord detests the proud; they will surely be punished.
verses.textEnNasb: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to the Lord; Be assured, he will not go unpunished.
verses.textEn: The Lord detests all the proud of heart. Be sure of this: They will not go unpunished.

verses.textZh: 因着怜悯和信实，罪孽得赎； 因为敬畏耶和华，人可以避开罪恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着怜悯和信实，罪孽得赎； 因为敬畏耶和华，人可以避开罪恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 因怜悯诚实，罪孽得赎； 敬畏耶和华的，远离恶事。
verses.textEnNiv: Through love and faithfulness sin is atoned for; through the fear of the Lord evil is avoided.
verses.textEnEsv: By steadfast love and faithfulness iniquity is atoned for, and by the fear of the Lord one turns away from evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: In mercy and truth Atonement is provided for iniquity; And by the fear of the Lordone departs from evil.
verses.textEnNlt: Unfailing love and faithfulness make atonement for sin. By fearing the Lord , people avoid evil.
verses.textEnNasb: By mercy and truth atonement is made for wrongdoing, And by the fear of the Lord one keeps away from evil.
verses.textEn: Through love and faithfulness sin is atoned for; through the fear of the Lord evil is avoided.

verses.textZh: 人所行的，若是蒙耶和华喜悦， 耶和华也使他的仇敌与他和好。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人所行的，若是蒙耶和华喜悦， 耶和华也使他的仇敌与他和好。
verses.textZhCuv: 人所行的，若蒙耶和华喜悦， 耶和华也使他的仇敌与他和好。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Lord takes pleasure in anyone’s way, he causes their enemies to make peace with them.
verses.textEnEsv: When a man’s ways please the Lord , he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: When a man’s ways please the Lord, He makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
verses.textEnNlt: When people’s lives please the Lord , even their enemies are at peace with them.
verses.textEnNasb: When a person’s ways are pleasing to the Lord, He causes even his enemies to make peace with him.
verses.textEn: When the Lord takes pleasure in anyone’s way, he causes their enemies to make peace with them.

verses.textZh: 收入少而有公义， 胜过收入多却毫无正义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 收入少而有公义， 胜过收入多却毫无正义。
verses.textZhCuv: 多有财利，行事不义， 不如少有财利，行事公义。
verses.textEnNiv: Better a little with righteousness than much gain with injustice.
verses.textEnEsv: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues with injustice.
verses.textEnNkjv: Better is a little with righteousness, Than vast revenues without justice.
verses.textEnNlt: Better to have little, with godliness, than to be rich and dishonest.
verses.textEnNasb: Better is a little with righteousness Than great income with injustice.
verses.textEn: Better a little with righteousness than much gain with injustice.

verses.textZh: 人心计划自己的道路， 他的脚步却由耶和华指引。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人心计划自己的道路， 他的脚步却由耶和华指引。
verses.textZhCuv: 人心筹算自己的道路； 惟耶和华指引他的脚步。
verses.textEnNiv: In their hearts humans plan their course, but the Lord establishes their steps.
verses.textEnEsv: The heart of man plans his way, but the Lord establishes his steps.
verses.textEnNkjv: A man’s heart plans his way, But the Lord directs his steps.
verses.textEnNlt: We can make our plans, but the Lord determines our steps.
verses.textEnNasb: The mind of a person plans his way, But the Lord directs his steps.
verses.textEn: In their hearts humans plan their course, but the Lord establishes their steps.

verses.textZh: 王的嘴里有神的判语， 审判的时候，他的口必不差错。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王的嘴里有神的判语， 审判的时候，他的口必不差错。
verses.textZhCuv: 王的嘴中有神语， 审判之时，他的口必不差错。
verses.textEnNiv: The lips of a king speak as an oracle, and his mouth does not betray justice.
verses.textEnEsv: An oracle is on the lips of a king; his mouth does not sin in judgment.
verses.textEnNkjv: Divination is on the lips of the king; His mouth must not transgress in judgment.
verses.textEnNlt: The king speaks with divine wisdom; he must never judge unfairly.
verses.textEnNasb: A divine verdict is on the lips of the king; His mouth should not err in judgment.
verses.textEn: The lips of a king speak as an oracle, and his mouth does not betray justice.

verses.textZh: 公正的秤和天平都属耶和华， 囊中的一切法码都是他所造的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 公正的秤和天平都属耶和华， 囊中的一切法码都是他所造的。
verses.textZhCuv: 公道的天平和秤都属耶和华； 囊中一切法码都为他所定。
verses.textEnNiv: Honest scales and balances belong to the Lord ; all the weights in the bag are of his making.
verses.textEnEsv: A just balance and scales are the Lord ’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.
verses.textEnNkjv: Honest weights and scales are the Lord’s; All the weights in the bag are His work.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord demands accurate scales and balances; he sets the standards for fairness.
verses.textEnNasb: A just balance and scales belong to the Lord; All the weights of the bag are His concern.
verses.textEn: Honest scales and balances belong to the Lord ; all the weights in the bag are of his making.

verses.textZh: 作恶是君王所厌恶的， 因为王位是靠赖公义建立的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 作恶是君王所厌恶的， 因为王位是靠赖公义建立的。
verses.textZhCuv: 作恶，为王所憎恶， 因国位是靠公义坚立。
verses.textEnNiv: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: It is an abomination to kings to do evil, for the throne is established by righteousness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis an abomination for kings to commit wickedness, For a throne is established by righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: A king detests wrongdoing, for his rule is built on justice.
verses.textEnNasb: It is an abomination for kings to commit wicked acts, Because a throne is established on righteousness.
verses.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.

verses.textZh: 公义的嘴唇是君王所喜悦的； 他喜爱说话正直的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 公义的嘴唇是君王所喜悦的； 他喜爱说话正直的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 公义的嘴为王所喜悦； 说正直话的，为王所喜爱。
verses.textEnNiv: Kings take pleasure in honest lips; they value the one who speaks what is right.
verses.textEnEsv: Righteous lips are the delight of a king, and he loves him who speaks what is right.
verses.textEnNkjv: Righteous lips are the delight of kings, And they love him who speaks whatis right.
verses.textEnNlt: The king is pleased with words from righteous lips; he loves those who speak honestly.
verses.textEnNasb: Righteous lips are the delight of kings, And one who speaks right is loved.
verses.textEn: Kings take pleasure in honest lips; they value the one who speaks what is right.

verses.textZh: 君王的烈怒好象死亡的使者， 唯有智慧人能平息君王的怒气。
verses.textZhCnvs: 君王的烈怒好象死亡的使者， 唯有智慧人能平息君王的怒气。
verses.textZhCuv: 王的震怒如杀人的使者； 但智慧人能止息王怒。
verses.textEnNiv: A king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but the wise will appease it.
verses.textEnEsv: A king’s wrath is a messenger of death, and a wise man will appease it.
verses.textEnNkjv: As messengers of death is the king’s wrath, But a wise man will appease it.
verses.textEnNlt: The anger of the king is a deadly threat; the wise will try to appease it.
verses.textEnNasb: The fury of a king is like messengers of death; But a wise person will appease it.
verses.textEn: A king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but the wise will appease it.

verses.textZh: 君王脸上欣悦的光采，使人得生命； 君王的恩宠好象春日雨云。
verses.textZhCnvs: 君王脸上欣悦的光采，使人得生命； 君王的恩宠好象春日雨云。
verses.textZhCuv: 王的脸光使人有生命； 王的恩典好像春云时雨。
verses.textEnNiv: When a king’s face brightens, it means life; his favor is like a rain cloud in spring.
verses.textEnEsv: In the light of a king’s face there is life, and his favor is like the clouds that bring the spring rain.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the light of the king’s face is life, And his favor is like a cloud of the latter rain.
verses.textEnNlt: When the king smiles, there is life; his favor refreshes like a spring rain.
verses.textEnNasb: In the light of a king’s face is life, And his favor is like a cloud with the spring rain.
verses.textEn: When a king’s face brightens, it means life; his favor is like a rain cloud in spring.

verses.textZh: 得智慧胜过得金子， 选择哲理，胜过选择银子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 得智慧胜过得金子， 选择哲理，胜过选择银子。
verses.textZhCuv: 得智慧胜似得金子； 选聪明强如选银子。
verses.textEnNiv: How much better to get wisdom than gold, to get insight rather than silver!
verses.textEnEsv: How much better to get wisdom than gold! To get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: How much better to get wisdom than gold! And to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.
verses.textEnNlt: How much better to get wisdom than gold, and good judgment than silver!
verses.textEnNasb: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! And to get understanding is to be chosen above silver.
verses.textEn: How much better to get wisdom than gold, to get insight rather than silver!

verses.textZh: 正直人的大道远离罪恶； 谨守自己道路的，保全自己的性命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 正直人的大道远离罪恶； 谨守自己道路的，保全自己的性命。
verses.textZhCuv: 正直人的道是远离恶事； 谨守己路的，是保全性命。
verses.textEnNiv: The highway of the upright avoids evil; those who guard their ways preserve their lives.
verses.textEnEsv: The highway of the upright turns aside from evil; whoever guards his way preserves his life.
verses.textEnNkjv: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil; He who keeps his way preserves his soul.
verses.textEnNlt: The path of the virtuous leads away from evil; whoever follows that path is safe.
verses.textEnNasb: The highway of the upright is to turn away from evil; One who watches his way protects his life.
verses.textEn: The highway of the upright avoids evil; those who guard their ways preserve their lives.

verses.textZh: 在灭亡以先，必有骄傲； 在跌倒以前，心中高傲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在灭亡以先，必有骄傲； 在跌倒以前，心中高傲。
verses.textZhCuv: 骄傲在败坏以先； 狂心在跌倒之前。
verses.textEnNiv: Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall.
verses.textEnEsv: Pride goes before destruction, and a haughty spirit before a fall.
verses.textEnNkjv: Pride goes before destruction, And a haughty spirit before a fall.
verses.textEnNlt: Pride goes before destruction, and haughtiness before a fall.
verses.textEnNasb: Pride goes before destruction, And a haughty spirit before stumbling.
verses.textEn: Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall.

verses.textZh: 存谦卑的心与穷乏人在一起， 胜过与骄傲人同分战利品。
verses.textZhCnvs: 存谦卑的心与穷乏人在一起， 胜过与骄傲人同分战利品。
verses.textZhCuv: 心里谦卑与穷乏人来往， 强如将掳物与骄傲人同分。
verses.textEnNiv: Better to be lowly in spirit along with the oppressed than to share plunder with the proud.
verses.textEnEsv: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor than to divide the spoil with the proud.
verses.textEnNkjv: Better tobe of a humble spirit with the lowly, Than to divide the spoil with the proud.
verses.textEnNlt: Better to live humbly with the poor than to share plunder with the proud.
verses.textEnNasb: It is better to be humble in spirit with the needy Than to divide the spoils with the proud.
verses.textEn: Better to be lowly in spirit along with the oppressed than to share plunder with the proud.

verses.textZh: 留心听训言的必定得益； 倚靠耶和华的是有福的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 留心听训言的必定得益； 倚靠耶和华的是有福的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 谨守训言的，必得好处； 倚靠耶和华的，便为有福。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever gives heed to instruction prospers, and blessed is the one who trusts in the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever gives thought to the word will discover good, and blessed is he who trusts in the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: He who heeds the word wisely will find good, And whoever trusts in the Lord, happy is he.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who listen to instruction will prosper; those who trust the Lord will be joyful.
verses.textEnNasb: One who pays attention to the word will find good, And blessed is one who trusts in the Lord.
verses.textEn: Whoever gives heed to instruction prospers, and blessed is the one who trusts in the Lord .

verses.textZh: 心中有智慧的必称为聪明人； 动听的话能增加说服力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 心中有智慧的必称为聪明人； 动听的话能增加说服力。
verses.textZhCuv: 心中有智慧，必称为通达人； 嘴中的甜言，加增人的学问。
verses.textEnNiv: The wise in heart are called discerning, and gracious words promote instruction.
verses.textEnEsv: The wise of heart is called discerning, and sweetness of speech increases persuasiveness.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wise in heart will be called prudent, And sweetness of the lips increases learning.
verses.textEnNlt: The wise are known for their understanding, and pleasant words are persuasive.
verses.textEnNasb: The wise in heart will be called understanding, And sweetness of speech increases persuasiveness.
verses.textEn: The wise in heart are called discerning, and gracious words promote instruction.

verses.textZh: 明慧人的明慧是他生命的泉源； 愚妄人的惩罚就是愚妄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 明慧人的明慧是他生命的泉源； 愚妄人的惩罚就是愚妄。
verses.textZhCuv: 人有智慧就有生命的泉源； 愚昧人必被愚昧惩治。
verses.textEnNiv: Prudence is a fountain of life to the prudent, but folly brings punishment to fools.
verses.textEnEsv: Good sense is a fountain of life to him who has it, but the instruction of fools is folly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Understanding is a wellspring of life to him who has it. But the correction of fools is folly.
verses.textEnNlt: Discretion is a life-giving fountain to those who possess it, but discipline is wasted on fools.
verses.textEnNasb: Understanding is a fountain of life to those who have it, But the discipline of fools is foolishness.
verses.textEn: Prudence is a fountain of life to the prudent, but folly brings punishment to fools.

verses.textZh: 智慧人的心教导自己的口， 使自己口中的话增加说服力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧人的心教导自己的口， 使自己口中的话增加说服力。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧人的心教训他的口， 又使他的嘴增长学问。
verses.textEnNiv: The hearts of the wise make their mouths prudent, and their lips promote instruction.
verses.textEnEsv: The heart of the wise makes his speech judicious and adds persuasiveness to his lips.
verses.textEnNkjv: The heart of the wise teaches his mouth, And adds learning to his lips.
verses.textEnNlt: From a wise mind comes wise speech; the words of the wise are persuasive.
verses.textEnNasb: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth And adds persuasiveness to his lips.
verses.textEn: The hearts of the wise make their mouths prudent, and their lips promote instruction.

verses.textZh: 恩慈的话好象蜂巢中的蜂蜜， 使人心里甘甜，骨头健壮。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恩慈的话好象蜂巢中的蜂蜜， 使人心里甘甜，骨头健壮。
verses.textZhCuv: 良言如同蜂房， 使心觉甘甜，使骨得医治。
verses.textEnNiv: Gracious words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul and healing to the bones.
verses.textEnEsv: Gracious words are like a honeycomb, sweetness to the soul and health to the body.
verses.textEnNkjv: Pleasant words arelike a honeycomb, Sweetness to the soul and health to the bones.
verses.textEnNlt: Kind words are like honey— sweet to the soul and healthy for the body.
verses.textEnNasb: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, Sweet to the soul and healing to the bones.
verses.textEn: Gracious words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul and healing to the bones.

verses.textZh: 有一条路，人以为是正路， 走到尽头却是死亡之路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一条路，人以为是正路， 走到尽头却是死亡之路。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一条路，人以为正， 至终成为死亡之路。
verses.textEnNiv: There is a way that appears to be right, but in the end it leads to death.
verses.textEnEsv: There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the way to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: There is a way thatseems right to a man, But its end is the way of death.
verses.textEnNlt: There is a path before each person that seems right, but it ends in death.
verses.textEnNasb: There is a way which seems right to a person, But its end is the way of death.
verses.textEn: There is a way that appears to be right, but in the end it leads to death.

verses.textZh: 劳力的人身体的需要促使他劳力； 因为他的饥饿催逼着他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 劳力的人身体的需要促使他劳力； 因为他的饥饿催逼着他。
verses.textZhCuv: 劳力人的胃口使他劳力， 因为他的口腹催逼他。
verses.textEnNiv: The appetite of laborers works for them; their hunger drives them on.
verses.textEnEsv: A worker’s appetite works for him; his mouth urges him on.
verses.textEnNkjv: The person who labors, labors for himself, For his hungry mouth drives him on.
verses.textEnNlt: It is good for workers to have an appetite; an empty stomach drives them on.
verses.textEnNasb: A worker’s appetite works for him, For his hunger urges him on.
verses.textEn: The appetite of laborers works for them; their hunger drives them on.

verses.textZh: 无赖之徒挖出邪恶， 他口里的话好象灼热的火。
verses.textZhCnvs: 无赖之徒挖出邪恶， 他口里的话好象灼热的火。
verses.textZhCuv: 匪徒图谋奸恶， 嘴上仿佛有烧焦的火。
verses.textEnNiv: A scoundrel plots evil, and on their lips it is like a scorching fire.
verses.textEnEsv: A worthless man plots evil, and his speech is like a scorching fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: An ungodly man digs up evil, And itis on his lips like a burning fire.
verses.textEnNlt: Scoundrels create trouble; their words are a destructive blaze.
verses.textEnNasb: A worthless person digs up evil, While his words are like scorching fire.
verses.textEn: A scoundrel plots evil, and on their lips it is like a scorching fire.

verses.textZh: 乖谬的人散播纷争， 搬弄是非的离间亲密的朋友。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乖谬的人散播纷争， 搬弄是非的离间亲密的朋友。
verses.textZhCuv: 乖僻人播散纷争； 传舌的，离间密友。
verses.textEnNiv: A perverse person stirs up conflict, and a gossip separates close friends.
verses.textEnEsv: A dishonest man spreads strife, and a whisperer separates close friends.
verses.textEnNkjv: A perverse man sows strife, And a whisperer separates the best of friends.
verses.textEnNlt: A troublemaker plants seeds of strife; gossip separates the best of friends.
verses.textEnNasb: A perverse person spreads strife, And a slanderer separates close friends.
verses.textEn: A perverse person stirs up conflict, and a gossip separates close friends.

verses.textZh: 强暴的人引诱邻舍， 领他走邪恶的道路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 强暴的人引诱邻舍， 领他走邪恶的道路。
verses.textZhCuv: 强暴人诱惑邻舍， 领他走不善之道。
verses.textEnNiv: A violent person entices their neighbor and leads them down a path that is not good.
verses.textEnEsv: A man of violence entices his neighbor and leads him in a way that is not good.
verses.textEnNkjv: A violent man entices his neighbor, And leads him in a way thatis not good.
verses.textEnNlt: Violent people mislead their companions, leading them down a harmful path.
verses.textEnNasb: A person of violence entices his neighbor And leads him in a way that is not good.
verses.textEn: A violent person entices their neighbor and leads them down a path that is not good.

verses.textZh: 瞇着眼睛的，图谋乖谬的事； 紧抿着嘴唇的，作成恶事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 瞇着眼睛的，图谋乖谬的事； 紧抿着嘴唇的，作成恶事。
verses.textZhCuv: 眼目紧合的，图谋乖僻； 嘴唇紧闭的，成就邪恶。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever winks with their eye is plotting perversity; whoever purses their lips is bent on evil.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever winks his eyes plans dishonest things; he who purses his lips brings evil to pass.
verses.textEnNkjv: He winks his eye to devise perverse things; He purses his lips and brings about evil.
verses.textEnNlt: With narrowed eyes, people plot evil; with a smirk, they plan their mischief.
verses.textEnNasb: He who winks his eyes does so to devise perverse things; He who compresses his lips brings evil to pass.
verses.textEn: Whoever winks with their eye is plotting perversity; whoever purses their lips is bent on evil.

verses.textZh: 白发是荣耀的冠冕， 在公义的路上，必能得着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 白发是荣耀的冠冕， 在公义的路上，必能得着。
verses.textZhCuv: 白发是荣耀的冠冕， 在公义的道上必能得着。
verses.textEnNiv: Gray hair is a crown of splendor; it is attained in the way of righteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: Gray hair is a crown of glory; it is gained in a righteous life.
verses.textEnNkjv: The silver-haired head is a crown of glory, If it is found in the way of righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: Gray hair is a crown of glory; it is gained by living a godly life.
verses.textEnNasb: A gray head is a crown of glory; It is found in the way of righteousness.
verses.textEn: Gray hair is a crown of splendor; it is attained in the way of righteousness.

verses.textZh: 不轻易动怒的，胜过勇士； 克服己心的，胜过把城攻取的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不轻易动怒的，胜过勇士； 克服己心的，胜过把城攻取的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 不轻易发怒的，胜过勇士； 治服己心的，强如取城。
verses.textEnNiv: Better a patient person than a warrior, one with self-control than one who takes a city.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever is slow to anger is better than the mighty, and he who rules his spirit than he who takes a city.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hewhois slow to anger is better than the mighty, And he who rules his spirit than he who takes a city.
verses.textEnNlt: Better to be patient than powerful; better to have self-control than to conquer a city.
verses.textEnNasb: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty, And one who rules his spirit, than one who captures a city.
verses.textEn: Better a patient person than a warrior, one with self-control than one who takes a city.

verses.textZh: 签拋在人的怀中， 一切决断却在于耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 签拋在人的怀中， 一切决断却在于耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 签放在怀里， 定事由耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: The lot is cast into the lap, But its every decision is from the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: We may throw the dice, but the Lord determines how they fall.
verses.textEnNasb: The lot is cast into the lap, But its every decision is from the Lord.
verses.textEn: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the Lord .

verses.textZh: 平静相安地吃一块干饼， 胜过筵席满屋，吵闹相争。
verses.textZhCnvs: 平静相安地吃一块干饼， 胜过筵席满屋，吵闹相争。
verses.textZhCuv: 设筵满屋，大家相争， 不如有块干饼，大家相安。
verses.textEnNiv: Better a dry crust with peace and quiet than a house full of feasting, with strife.
verses.textEnEsv: Better is a dry morsel with quiet than a house full of feasting with strife.
verses.textEnNkjv: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, Than a house full of feasting with strife.
verses.textEnNlt: Better a dry crust eaten in peace than a house filled with feasting—and conflict.
verses.textEnNasb: Better is a dry morsel and quietness with it Than a house full of feasting with strife.
verses.textEn: Better a dry crust with peace and quiet than a house full of feasting, with strife.

verses.textZh: 明慧的仆人，必管辖主人贻羞的儿子； 又可以在众儿子中同分产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 明慧的仆人，必管辖主人贻羞的儿子； 又可以在众儿子中同分产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 仆人办事聪明，必管辖贻羞之子， 又在众子中同分产业。
verses.textEnNiv: A prudent servant will rule over a disgraceful son and will share the inheritance as one of the family.
verses.textEnEsv: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who acts shamefully and will share the inheritance as one of the brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: A wise servant will rule over a son who causes shame, And will share an inheritance among the brothers.
verses.textEnNlt: A wise servant will rule over the master’s disgraceful son and will share the inheritance of the master’s children.
verses.textEnNasb: A servant who acts wisely will rule over a son who acts shamefully, And will share in the inheritance among brothers.
verses.textEn: A prudent servant will rule over a disgraceful son and will share the inheritance as one of the family.

verses.textZh: 用锅炼银，用炉炼金； 唯有耶和华锻炼人心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 用锅炼银，用炉炼金； 唯有耶和华锻炼人心。
verses.textZhCuv: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金； 惟有耶和华熬炼人心。
verses.textEnNiv: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but the Lord tests the heart.
verses.textEnEsv: The crucible is for silver, and the furnace is for gold, and the Lord tests hearts.
verses.textEnNkjv: The refining pot is for silver and the furnace for gold, But the Lord tests the hearts.
verses.textEnNlt: Fire tests the purity of silver and gold, but the Lord tests the heart.
verses.textEnNasb: The refining pot is for silver and the furnace for gold, But the Lord tests hearts.
verses.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but the Lord tests the heart.

verses.textZh: 作恶的人留心听邪恶的话； 说谎的人侧耳听攻击人的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 作恶的人留心听邪恶的话； 说谎的人侧耳听攻击人的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 行恶的，留心听奸诈之言； 说谎的，侧耳听邪恶之语。
verses.textEnNiv: A wicked person listens to deceitful lips; a liar pays attention to a destructive tongue.
verses.textEnEsv: An evildoer listens to wicked lips, and a liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.
verses.textEnNkjv: An evildoer gives heed to false lips; A liar listens eagerly to a spiteful tongue.
verses.textEnNlt: Wrongdoers eagerly listen to gossip; liars pay close attention to slander.
verses.textEnNasb: An evildoer listens to wicked lips; A liar pays attention to a destructive tongue.
verses.textEn: A wicked person listens to deceitful lips; a liar pays attention to a destructive tongue.

verses.textZh: 嘲笑穷人的就是辱骂造他的主； 幸灾乐祸的必难免受惩罚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 嘲笑穷人的就是辱骂造他的主； 幸灾乐祸的必难免受惩罚。
verses.textZhCuv: 戏笑穷人的，是辱没造他的主； 幸灾乐祸的，必不免受罚。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever mocks the poor shows contempt for their Maker; whoever gloats over disaster will not go unpunished.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever mocks the poor insults his Maker; he who is glad at calamity will not go unpunished.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who mocks the poor reproaches his Maker; He who is glad at calamity will not go unpunished.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who mock the poor insult their Maker; those who rejoice at the misfortune of others will be punished.
verses.textEnNasb: One who mocks the poor taunts his Maker; One who rejoices at disaster will not go unpunished.
verses.textEn: Whoever mocks the poor shows contempt for their Maker; whoever gloats over disaster will not go unpunished.

verses.textZh: 儿孙是老人的冠冕， 父亲是儿女的荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 儿孙是老人的冠冕， 父亲是儿女的荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 子孙为老人的冠冕； 父亲是儿女的荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: Children’s children are a crown to the aged, and parents are the pride of their children.
verses.textEnEsv: Grandchildren are the crown of the aged, and the glory of children is their fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Children’s children are the crown of old men, And the glory of children is their father.
verses.textEnNlt: Grandchildren are the crowning glory of the aged; parents are the pride of their children.
verses.textEnNasb: Grandchildren are the crown of the old, And the glory of sons is their fathers.
verses.textEn: Children’s children are a crown to the aged, and parents are the pride of their children.

verses.textZh: 愚顽人说佳美的话是不相称的， 何况尊贵的人说虚谎的话呢！
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚顽人说佳美的话是不相称的， 何况尊贵的人说虚谎的话呢！
verses.textZhCuv: 愚顽人说美言本不相宜， 何况君王说谎话呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Eloquent lips are unsuited to a godless fool— how much worse lying lips to a ruler!
verses.textEnEsv: Fine speech is not becoming to a fool; still less is false speech to a prince.
verses.textEnNkjv: Excellent speech is not becoming to a fool, Much less lying lips to a prince.
verses.textEnNlt: Eloquent words are not fitting for a fool; even less are lies fitting for a ruler.
verses.textEnNasb: Excellent speech is not fitting for a fool, Much less are lying lips to a prince.
verses.textEn: Eloquent lips are unsuited to a godless fool— how much worse lying lips to a ruler!

verses.textZh: 在馈送的人看来，贿赂有如灵符 ； 无论他到哪里，都必顺利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在馈送的人看来，贿赂有如灵符 ； 无论他到哪里，都必顺利。
verses.textZhCuv: 贿赂在馈送的人眼中看为宝玉， 随处运动都得顺利。
verses.textEnNiv: A bribe is seen as a charm by the one who gives it; they think success will come at every turn.
verses.textEnEsv: A bribe is like a magic stone in the eyes of the one who gives it; wherever he turns he prospers.
verses.textEnNkjv: A present is a precious stone in the eyes of its possessor; Wherever he turns, he prospers.
verses.textEnNlt: A bribe is like a lucky charm; whoever gives one will prosper!
verses.textEnNasb: A bribe is a charm in the sight of its owner; Wherever he turns, he prospers.
verses.textEn: A bribe is seen as a charm by the one who gives it; they think success will come at every turn.

verses.textZh: 遮掩别人过犯的，得到人的喜爱； 屡次提起别人过错的，离间亲密的朋友。
verses.textZhCnvs: 遮掩别人过犯的，得到人的喜爱； 屡次提起别人过错的，离间亲密的朋友。
verses.textZhCuv: 遮掩人过的，寻求人爱； 屡次挑错的，离间密友。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever would foster love covers over an offense, but whoever repeats the matter separates close friends.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever covers an offense seeks love, but he who repeats a matter separates close friends.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who covers a transgression seeks love, But he who repeats a matter separates friends.
verses.textEnNlt: Love prospers when a fault is forgiven, but dwelling on it separates close friends.
verses.textEnNasb: One who conceals an offense seeks love, But one who repeats a matter separates close friends.
verses.textEn: Whoever would foster love covers over an offense, but whoever repeats the matter separates close friends.

verses.textZh: 对聪明人说一句责备的话， 胜过责打愚昧人一百下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对聪明人说一句责备的话， 胜过责打愚昧人一百下。
verses.textZhCuv: 一句责备话深入聪明人的心， 强如责打愚昧人一百下。
verses.textEnNiv: A rebuke impresses a discerning person more than a hundred lashes a fool.
verses.textEnEsv: A rebuke goes deeper into a man of understanding than a hundred blows into a fool.
verses.textEnNkjv: Rebuke is more effective for a wise man Than a hundred blows on a fool.
verses.textEnNlt: A single rebuke does more for a person of understanding than a hundred lashes on the back of a fool.
verses.textEnNasb: A rebuke goes deeper into one who has understanding Than a hundred blows into a fool.
verses.textEn: A rebuke impresses a discerning person more than a hundred lashes a fool.

verses.textZh: 悖逆的人只求恶事， 必有残忍的使者奉派去对付他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 悖逆的人只求恶事， 必有残忍的使者奉派去对付他。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人只寻背叛， 所以必有严厉的使者奉差攻击他。
verses.textEnNiv: Evildoers foster rebellion against God; the messenger of death will be sent against them.
verses.textEnEsv: An evil man seeks only rebellion, and a cruel messenger will be sent against him.
verses.textEnNkjv: An evil man seeks only rebellion; Therefore a cruel messenger will be sent against him.
verses.textEnNlt: Evil people are eager for rebellion, but they will be severely punished.
verses.textEnNasb: A rebellious person seeks only evil, So a cruel messenger will be sent against him.
verses.textEn: Evildoers foster rebellion against God; the messenger of death will be sent against them.

verses.textZh: 宁愿遇见失掉幼子的母熊， 也不愿遇见正在行愚妄事的愚昧人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 宁愿遇见失掉幼子的母熊， 也不愿遇见正在行愚妄事的愚昧人。
verses.textZhCuv: 宁可遇见丢崽子的母熊， 不可遇见正行愚妄的愚昧人。
verses.textEnNiv: Better to meet a bear robbed of her cubs than a fool bent on folly.
verses.textEnEsv: Let a man meet a she-bear robbed of her cubs rather than a fool in his folly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let a man meet a bear robbed of her cubs, Rather than a fool in his folly.
verses.textEnNlt: It is safer to meet a bear robbed of her cubs than to confront a fool caught in foolishness.
verses.textEnNasb: Let a person meet a bear robbed of her cubs, Rather than a fool in his foolishness.
verses.textEn: Better to meet a bear robbed of her cubs than a fool bent on folly.

verses.textZh: 以恶报善的， 灾祸必不离开他的家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以恶报善的， 灾祸必不离开他的家。
verses.textZhCuv: 以恶报善的， 祸患必不离他的家。
verses.textEnNiv: Evil will never leave the house of one who pays back evil for good.
verses.textEnEsv: If anyone returns evil for good, evil will not depart from his house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever rewards evil for good, Evil will not depart from his house.
verses.textEnNlt: If you repay good with evil, evil will never leave your house.
verses.textEnNasb: One who returns evil for good, Evil will not depart from his house.
verses.textEn: Evil will never leave the house of one who pays back evil for good.

verses.textZh: 纷争的开始，如同决堤的水； 所以在争执发生以前，就要制止。
verses.textZhCnvs: 纷争的开始，如同决堤的水； 所以在争执发生以前，就要制止。
verses.textZhCuv: 纷争的起头如水放开， 所以，在争闹之先必当止息争竞。
verses.textEnNiv: Starting a quarrel is like breaching a dam; so drop the matter before a dispute breaks out.
verses.textEnEsv: The beginning of strife is like letting out water, so quit before the quarrel breaks out.
verses.textEnNkjv: The beginning of strife islike releasing water; Therefore stop contention before a quarrel starts.
verses.textEnNlt: Starting a quarrel is like opening a floodgate, so stop before a dispute breaks out.
verses.textEnNasb: The beginning of strife is like letting out water, So abandon the quarrel before it breaks out.
verses.textEn: Starting a quarrel is like breaching a dam; so drop the matter before a dispute breaks out.

verses.textZh: 宣判恶人为义，裁定义人有罪， 二者都是耶和华所厌恶的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 宣判恶人为义，裁定义人有罪， 二者都是耶和华所厌恶的。
verses.textZhCuv: 定恶人为义的，定义人为恶的， 这都为耶和华所憎恶。
verses.textEnNiv: Acquitting the guilty and condemning the innocent— the Lord detests them both.
verses.textEnEsv: He who justifies the wicked and he who condemns the righteous are both alike an abomination to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the just, Both of them alike are an abomination to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Acquitting the guilty and condemning the innocent— both are detestable to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: One who justifies the wicked and one who condemns the righteous, Both of them alike are an abomination to the Lord.
verses.textEn: Acquitting the guilty and condemning the innocent— the Lord detests them both.

verses.textZh: 愚昧人既是无知， 为甚么手里拿着价银要买智慧呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚昧人既是无知， 为甚么手里拿着价银要买智慧呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 愚昧人既无聪明， 为何手拿价银买智慧呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Why should fools have money in hand to buy wisdom, when they are not able to understand it?
verses.textEnEsv: Why should a fool have money in his hand to buy wisdom when he has no sense?
verses.textEnNkjv: Why isthere in the hand of a fool the purchase price of wisdom, Since hehas no heart forit?
verses.textEnNlt: It is senseless to pay to educate a fool, since he has no heart for learning.
verses.textEnNasb: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, When he has no sense?
verses.textEn: Why should fools have money in hand to buy wisdom, when they are not able to understand it?

verses.textZh: 朋友常显爱心， 兄弟为患难而生。
verses.textZhCnvs: 朋友常显爱心， 兄弟为患难而生。
verses.textZhCuv: 朋友乃时常亲爱， 弟兄为患难而生。
verses.textEnNiv: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for a time of adversity.
verses.textEnEsv: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
verses.textEnNkjv: A friend loves at all times, And a brother is born for adversity.
verses.textEnNlt: A friend is always loyal, and a brother is born to help in time of need.
verses.textEnNasb: A friend loves at all times, And a brother is born for adversity.
verses.textEn: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for a time of adversity.

verses.textZh: 为邻舍击掌作保证人的， 是无知的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为邻舍击掌作保证人的， 是无知的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 在邻舍面前击掌作保 乃是无知的人。
verses.textEnNiv: One who has no sense shakes hands in pledge and puts up security for a neighbor.
verses.textEnEsv: One who lacks sense gives a pledge and puts up security in the presence of his neighbor.
verses.textEnNkjv: A man devoid of understanding shakes hands in a pledge, And becomes surety for his friend.
verses.textEnNlt: It’s poor judgment to guarantee another person’s debt or put up security for a friend.
verses.textEnNasb: A person lacking in sense shakes hands And becomes guarantor in the presence of his neighbor.
verses.textEn: One who has no sense shakes hands in pledge and puts up security for a neighbor.

verses.textZh: 喜爱争竞的就是喜爱过犯； 把家门建高的自取灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 喜爱争竞的就是喜爱过犯； 把家门建高的自取灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 喜爱争竞的，是喜爱过犯； 高立家门的，乃自取败坏。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever loves a quarrel loves sin; whoever builds a high gate invites destruction.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever loves transgression loves strife; he who makes his door high seeks destruction.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who loves transgression loves strife, And he who exalts his gate seeks destruction.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who loves to quarrel loves sin; anyone who trusts in high walls invites disaster.
verses.textEnNasb: One who loves wrongdoing loves strife; One who makes his doorway high seeks destruction.
verses.textEn: Whoever loves a quarrel loves sin; whoever builds a high gate invites destruction.

verses.textZh: 心存欺诈的得不着益处； 舌头搬弄是非的必陷在祸患中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 心存欺诈的得不着益处； 舌头搬弄是非的必陷在祸患中。
verses.textZhCuv: 心存邪僻的，寻不着好处； 舌弄是非的，陷在祸患中。
verses.textEnNiv: One whose heart is corrupt does not prosper; one whose tongue is perverse falls into trouble.
verses.textEnEsv: A man of crooked heart does not discover good, and one with a dishonest tongue falls into calamity.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who has a deceitful heart finds no good, And he who has a perverse tongue falls into evil.
verses.textEnNlt: The crooked heart will not prosper; the lying tongue tumbles into trouble.
verses.textEnNasb: One who has a crooked mind finds nothing good, And one who is corrupted in his language falls into evil.
verses.textEn: One whose heart is corrupt does not prosper; one whose tongue is perverse falls into trouble.

verses.textZh: 生下愚昧的儿子，使父亲忧愁； 愚顽人的父亲毫无喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 生下愚昧的儿子，使父亲忧愁； 愚顽人的父亲毫无喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 生愚昧子的，必自愁苦； 愚顽人的父毫无喜乐。
verses.textEnNiv: To have a fool for a child brings grief; there is no joy for the parent of a godless fool.
verses.textEnEsv: He who sires a fool gets himself sorrow, and the father of a fool has no joy.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who begets a scoffer doesso to his sorrow, And the father of a fool has no joy.
verses.textEnNlt: It is painful to be the parent of a fool; there is no joy for the father of a rebel.
verses.textEnNasb: He who fathers a fool does so to his sorrow, And the father of a fool has no joy.
verses.textEn: To have a fool for a child brings grief; there is no joy for the parent of a godless fool.

verses.textZh: 心里喜乐就是良药； 心灵忧郁使骨头枯干。
verses.textZhCnvs: 心里喜乐就是良药； 心灵忧郁使骨头枯干。
verses.textZhCuv: 喜乐的心乃是良药； 忧伤的灵使骨枯干。
verses.textEnNiv: A cheerful heart is good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
verses.textEnEsv: A joyful heart is good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
verses.textEnNkjv: A merry heart does good, like medicine, But a broken spirit dries the bones.
verses.textEnNlt: A cheerful heart is good medicine, but a broken spirit saps a person’s strength.
verses.textEnNasb: A joyful heart is good medicine, But a broken spirit dries up the bones.
verses.textEn: A cheerful heart is good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

verses.textZh: 恶人暗中 接受贿赂， 为要歪曲公正。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人暗中 接受贿赂， 为要歪曲公正。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人暗中受贿赂， 为要颠倒判断。
verses.textEnNiv: The wicked accept bribes in secret to pervert the course of justice.
verses.textEnEsv: The wicked accepts a bribe in secret to pervert the ways of justice.
verses.textEnNkjv: A wicked man accepts a bribe behind the back To pervert the ways of justice.
verses.textEnNlt: The wicked take secret bribes to pervert the course of justice.
verses.textEnNasb: A wicked person accepts a bribe from an inside pocket To pervert the ways of justice.
verses.textEn: The wicked accept bribes in secret to pervert the course of justice.

verses.textZh: 聪明人面前有智慧， 愚昧人却眼望地极。
verses.textZhCnvs: 聪明人面前有智慧， 愚昧人却眼望地极。
verses.textZhCuv: 明哲人眼前有智慧； 愚昧人眼望地极。
verses.textEnNiv: A discerning person keeps wisdom in view, but a fool’s eyes wander to the ends of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: The discerning sets his face toward wisdom, but the eyes of a fool are on the ends of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Wisdom is in the sight of him who has understanding, But the eyes of a fool are on the ends of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Sensible people keep their eyes glued on wisdom, but a fool’s eyes wander to the ends of the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: Wisdom is in the presence of one who has understanding, But the eyes of a fool are on the ends of the earth.
verses.textEn: A discerning person keeps wisdom in view, but a fool’s eyes wander to the ends of the earth.

verses.textZh: 愚昧的儿子使父亲愁烦， 使母亲痛苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚昧的儿子使父亲愁烦， 使母亲痛苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 愚昧子使父亲愁烦， 使母亲忧苦。
verses.textEnNiv: A foolish son brings grief to his father and bitterness to the mother who bore him.
verses.textEnEsv: A foolish son is a grief to his father and bitterness to her who bore him.
verses.textEnNkjv: A foolish son is a grief to his father, And bitterness to her who bore him.
verses.textEnNlt: Foolish children bring grief to their father and bitterness to the one who gave them birth.
verses.textEnNasb: A foolish son is a grief to his father, And bitterness to her who gave birth to him.
verses.textEn: A foolish son brings grief to his father and bitterness to the mother who bore him.

verses.textZh: 惩罚义人，已是不当； 击打正直的官长，更是不妥。
verses.textZhCnvs: 惩罚义人，已是不当； 击打正直的官长，更是不妥。
verses.textZhCuv: 刑罚义人为不善； 责打君子为不义。
verses.textEnNiv: If imposing a fine on the innocent is not good, surely to flog honest officials is not right.
verses.textEnEsv: To impose a fine on a righteous man is not good, nor to strike the noble for their uprightness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also, to punish the righteous is not good, Nor to strike princes for their uprightness.
verses.textEnNlt: It is wrong to punish the godly for being good or to flog leaders for being honest.
verses.textEnNasb: It is also not good to fine the righteous, Nor to strike the noble for their uprightness.
verses.textEn: If imposing a fine on the innocent is not good, surely to flog honest officials is not right.

verses.textZh: 有知识的约束自己的言语； 聪明人心平气和。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有知识的约束自己的言语； 聪明人心平气和。
verses.textZhCuv: 寡少言语的，有知识； 性情温良的，有聪明。
verses.textEnNiv: The one who has knowledge uses words with restraint, and whoever has understanding is even-tempered.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever restrains his words has knowledge, and he who has a cool spirit is a man of understanding.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who has knowledge spares his words, And a man of understanding is of a calm spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: A truly wise person uses few words; a person with understanding is even-tempered.
verses.textEnNasb: One who withholds his words has knowledge, And one who has a cool spirit is a person of understanding.
verses.textEn: The one who has knowledge uses words with restraint, and whoever has understanding is even-tempered.

verses.textZh: 愚妄人默不作声，也算是智慧； 闭口不言，也算是聪明。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚妄人默不作声，也算是智慧； 闭口不言，也算是聪明。
verses.textZhCuv: 愚昧人若静默不言也可算为智慧； 闭口不说也可算为聪明。
verses.textEnNiv: Even fools are thought wise if they keep silent, and discerning if they hold their tongues.
verses.textEnEsv: Even a fool who keeps silent is considered wise; when he closes his lips, he is deemed intelligent.
verses.textEnNkjv: Even a fool is counted wise when he holds his peace; When he shuts his lips, heisconsidered perceptive.
verses.textEnNlt: Even fools are thought wise when they keep silent; with their mouths shut, they seem intelligent.
verses.textEnNasb: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is considered wise; When he closes his lips, he is considered prudent.
verses.textEn: Even fools are thought wise if they keep silent, and discerning if they hold their tongues.

verses.textZh: 离群独处的，只顾自己的心愿； 他抗拒一切大智慧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 离群独处的，只顾自己的心愿； 他抗拒一切大智慧。
verses.textZhCuv: 与众寡合的，独自寻求心愿， 并恼恨一切真智慧。
verses.textEnNiv: An unfriendly person pursues selfish ends and against all sound judgment starts quarrels.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever isolates himself seeks his own desire; he breaks out against all sound judgment.
verses.textEnNkjv: A man who isolates himself seeks his own desire; He rages against all wise judgment.
verses.textEnNlt: Unfriendly people care only about themselves; they lash out at common sense.
verses.textEnNasb: One who separates himself seeks his own desire; He quarrels against all sound wisdom.
verses.textEn: An unfriendly person pursues selfish ends and against all sound judgment starts quarrels.

verses.textZh: 愚昧人不喜欢明白事理， 只喜欢显露自己的心意。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚昧人不喜欢明白事理， 只喜欢显露自己的心意。
verses.textZhCuv: 愚昧人不喜爱明哲， 只喜爱显露心意。
verses.textEnNiv: Fools find no pleasure in understanding but delight in airing their own opinions.
verses.textEnEsv: A fool takes no pleasure in understanding, but only in expressing his opinion.
verses.textEnNkjv: A fool has no delight in understanding, But in expressing his own heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Fools have no interest in understanding; they only want to air their own opinions.
verses.textEnNasb: A fool does not delight in understanding, But in revealing his own mind.
verses.textEn: Fools find no pleasure in understanding but delight in airing their own opinions.

verses.textZh: 恶人来，也带来藐视； 羞耻的事也引致羞辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人来，也带来藐视； 羞耻的事也引致羞辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人来，藐视随来； 羞耻到，辱骂同到。
verses.textEnNiv: When wickedness comes, so does contempt, and with shame comes reproach.
verses.textEnEsv: When wickedness comes, contempt comes also, and with dishonor comes disgrace.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the wicked comes, contempt comes also; And with dishonor comes reproach.
verses.textEnNlt: Doing wrong leads to disgrace, and scandalous behavior brings contempt.
verses.textEnNasb: When a wicked person comes, contempt also comes, And with dishonor comes taunting.
verses.textEn: When wickedness comes, so does contempt, and with shame comes reproach.

verses.textZh: 人口中的言语如同深水， 智慧的泉源好象涌流的河水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人口中的言语如同深水， 智慧的泉源好象涌流的河水。
verses.textZhCuv: 人口中的言语如同深水； 智慧的泉源好像涌流的河水。
verses.textEnNiv: The words of the mouth are deep waters, but the fountain of wisdom is a rushing stream.
verses.textEnEsv: The words of a man’s mouth are deep waters; the fountain of wisdom is a bubbling brook.
verses.textEnNkjv: The words of a man’s mouth are deep waters; The wellspring of wisdom is a flowing brook.
verses.textEnNlt: Wise words are like deep waters; wisdom flows from the wise like a bubbling brook.
verses.textEnNasb: The words of a person’s mouth are deep waters; The fountain of wisdom is a bubbling brook.
verses.textEn: The words of the mouth are deep waters, but the fountain of wisdom is a rushing stream.

verses.textZh: 在审判时，偏袒恶人、 屈枉义人，是不对的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在审判时，偏袒恶人、 屈枉义人，是不对的。
verses.textZhCuv: 瞻徇恶人的情面， 偏断义人的案件，都为不善。
verses.textEnNiv: It is not good to be partial to the wicked and so deprive the innocent of justice.
verses.textEnEsv: It is not good to be partial to the wicked or to deprive the righteous of justice.
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis not good to show partiality to the wicked, Or to overthrow the righteous in judgment.
verses.textEnNlt: It is not right to acquit the guilty or deny justice to the innocent.
verses.textEnNasb: To show partiality to the wicked is not good, Nor to suppress the righteous in judgment.
verses.textEn: It is not good to be partial to the wicked and so deprive the innocent of justice.

verses.textZh: 愚昧人的嘴引起纷争， 他的口招来责打。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚昧人的嘴引起纷争， 他的口招来责打。
verses.textZhCuv: 愚昧人张嘴启争端， 开口招鞭打。
verses.textEnNiv: The lips of fools bring them strife, and their mouths invite a beating.
verses.textEnEsv: A fool’s lips walk into a fight, and his mouth invites a beating.
verses.textEnNkjv: A fool’s lips enter into contention, And his mouth calls for blows.
verses.textEnNlt: Fools’ words get them into constant quarrels; they are asking for a beating.
verses.textEnNasb: A fool’s lips bring strife, And his mouth invites beatings.
verses.textEn: The lips of fools bring them strife, and their mouths invite a beating.

verses.textZh: 愚昧人的口自取灭亡， 他的嘴唇是自己性命的网罗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚昧人的口自取灭亡， 他的嘴唇是自己性命的网罗。
verses.textZhCuv: 愚昧人的口自取败坏； 他的嘴是他生命的网罗。
verses.textEnNiv: The mouths of fools are their undoing, and their lips are a snare to their very lives.
verses.textEnEsv: A fool’s mouth is his ruin, and his lips are a snare to his soul.
verses.textEnNkjv: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, And his lips are the snare of his soul.
verses.textEnNlt: The mouths of fools are their ruin; they trap themselves with their lips.
verses.textEnNasb: A fool’s mouth is his ruin, And his lips are the snare of his soul.
verses.textEn: The mouths of fools are their undoing, and their lips are a snare to their very lives.

verses.textZh: 搬弄是非的人的言语，如同美食， 深入人的脏腑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 搬弄是非的人的言语，如同美食， 深入人的脏腑。
verses.textZhCuv: 传舌人的言语如同美食， 深入人的心腹。
verses.textEnNiv: The words of a gossip are like choice morsels; they go down to the inmost parts.
verses.textEnEsv: The words of a whisperer are like delicious morsels; they go down into the inner parts of the body.
verses.textEnNkjv: The words of a talebearer are like tasty trifles, And they go down into the inmost body.
verses.textEnNlt: Rumors are dainty morsels that sink deep into one’s heart.
verses.textEnNasb: The words of a gossiper are like dainty morsels, And they go down into the innermost parts of the body.
verses.textEn: The words of a gossip are like choice morsels; they go down to the inmost parts.

verses.textZh: 工作懒惰的， 是灭亡者的兄弟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 工作懒惰的， 是灭亡者的兄弟。
verses.textZhCuv: 做工懈怠的， 与浪费人为弟兄。
verses.textEnNiv: One who is slack in his work is brother to one who destroys.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever is slack in his work is a brother to him who destroys.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who is slothful in his work Is a brother to him who is a great destroyer.
verses.textEnNlt: A lazy person is as bad as someone who destroys things.
verses.textEnNasb: He also who is lax in his work Is a brother to him who destroys.
verses.textEn: One who is slack in his work is brother to one who destroys.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的名是坚固的高台， 义人投奔，就得安全。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的名是坚固的高台， 义人投奔，就得安全。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的名是坚固台； 义人奔入便得安稳。
verses.textEnNiv: The name of the Lord is a fortified tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.
verses.textEnEsv: The name of the Lord is a strong tower; the righteous man runs into it and is safe.
verses.textEnNkjv: The name of the Lordis a strong tower; The righteous run to it and are safe.
verses.textEnNlt: The name of the Lord is a strong fortress; the godly run to him and are safe.
verses.textEnNasb: The name of the Lord is a strong tower; The righteous runs into it and is safe.
verses.textEn: The name of the Lord is a fortified tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.

verses.textZh: 富翁的财物是他们的坚城； 在他们的想象中，有如高墙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 富翁的财物是他们的坚城； 在他们的想象中，有如高墙。
verses.textZhCuv: 富足人的财物是他的坚城， 在他心想，犹如高墙。
verses.textEnNiv: The wealth of the rich is their fortified city; they imagine it a wall too high to scale.
verses.textEnEsv: A rich man’s wealth is his strong city, and like a high wall in his imagination.
verses.textEnNkjv: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, And like a high wall in his own esteem.
verses.textEnNlt: The rich think of their wealth as a strong defense; they imagine it to be a high wall of safety.
verses.textEnNasb: A rich person’s wealth is his strong city, And like a high wall in his own imagination.
verses.textEn: The wealth of the rich is their fortified city; they imagine it a wall too high to scale.

verses.textZh: 灭亡以先，人心高傲； 尊荣以先，必有谦卑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 灭亡以先，人心高傲； 尊荣以先，必有谦卑。
verses.textZhCuv: 败坏之先，人心骄傲； 尊荣以前，必有谦卑。
verses.textEnNiv: Before a downfall the heart is haughty, but humility comes before honor.
verses.textEnEsv: Before destruction a man’s heart is haughty, but humility comes before honor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Before destruction the heart of a man is haughty, And before honor is humility.
verses.textEnNlt: Haughtiness goes before destruction; humility precedes honor.
verses.textEnNasb: Before destruction the heart of a person is haughty, But humility goes before honor.
verses.textEn: Before a downfall the heart is haughty, but humility comes before honor.

verses.textZh: 不先聆听就回答的， 这就是他的愚妄和羞辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不先聆听就回答的， 这就是他的愚妄和羞辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 未曾听完先回答的， 便是他的愚昧和羞辱。
verses.textEnNiv: To answer before listening— that is folly and shame.
verses.textEnEsv: If one gives an answer before he hears, it is his folly and shame.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who answers a matter before he hears it, It is folly and shame to him.
verses.textEnNlt: Spouting off before listening to the facts is both shameful and foolish.
verses.textEnNasb: One who gives an answer before he hears, It is foolishness and shame to him.
verses.textEn: To answer before listening— that is folly and shame.

verses.textZh: 人的心灵能忍受疾病， 心灵忧郁，谁能承受呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 人的心灵能忍受疾病， 心灵忧郁，谁能承受呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 人有疾病，心能忍耐； 心灵忧伤，谁能承当呢？
verses.textEnNiv: The human spirit can endure in sickness, but a crushed spirit who can bear?
verses.textEnEsv: A man’s spirit will endure sickness, but a crushed spirit who can bear?
verses.textEnNkjv: The spirit of a man will sustain him in sickness, But who can bear a broken spirit?
verses.textEnNlt: The human spirit can endure a sick body, but who can bear a crushed spirit?
verses.textEnNasb: The spirit of a person can endure his sickness, But as for a broken spirit, who can endure it?
verses.textEn: The human spirit can endure in sickness, but a crushed spirit who can bear?

verses.textZh: 聪明人的心获得知识； 智慧人的耳朵寻求知识。
verses.textZhCnvs: 聪明人的心获得知识； 智慧人的耳朵寻求知识。
verses.textZhCuv: 聪明人的心得知识； 智慧人的耳求知识。
verses.textEnNiv: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verses.textEnEsv: An intelligent heart acquires knowledge, and the ear of the wise seeks knowledge.
verses.textEnNkjv: The heart of the prudent acquires knowledge, And the ear of the wise seeks knowledge.
verses.textEnNlt: Intelligent people are always ready to learn. Their ears are open for knowledge.
verses.textEnNasb: The mind of the discerning acquires knowledge, And the ear of the wise seeks knowledge.
verses.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.

verses.textZh: 人的礼物能为他开路， 引他到大人物面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人的礼物能为他开路， 引他到大人物面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 人的礼物为他开路， 引他到高位的人面前。
verses.textEnNiv: A gift opens the way and ushers the giver into the presence of the great.
verses.textEnEsv: A man’s gift makes room for him and brings him before the great.
verses.textEnNkjv: A man’s gift makes room for him, And brings him before great men.
verses.textEnNlt: Giving a gift can open doors; it gives access to important people!
verses.textEnNasb: A person’s gift makes room for him And brings him before great people.
verses.textEn: A gift opens the way and ushers the giver into the presence of the great.

verses.textZh: 首先陈述情由的，似乎有理， 等他的邻舍来到，才可以查明实情。
verses.textZhCnvs: 首先陈述情由的，似乎有理， 等他的邻舍来到，才可以查明实情。
verses.textZhCuv: 先诉情由的，似乎有理； 但邻舍来到，就察出实情。
verses.textEnNiv: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verses.textEnEsv: The one who states his case first seems right, until the other comes and examines him.
verses.textEnNkjv: The first one to plead his cause seems right, Until his neighbor comes and examines him.
verses.textEnNlt: The first to speak in court sounds right— until the cross-examination begins.
verses.textEnNasb: The first to plead his case seems right, Until another comes and examines him.
verses.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.

verses.textZh: 抽签能止息纷争， 排解二强之间的纠纷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 抽签能止息纷争， 排解二强之间的纠纷。
verses.textZhCuv: 掣签能止息争竞， 也能解散强胜的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Casting the lot settles disputes and keeps strong opponents apart.
verses.textEnEsv: The lot puts an end to quarrels and decides between powerful contenders.
verses.textEnNkjv: Casting lots causes contentions to cease, And keeps the mighty apart.
verses.textEnNlt: Flipping a coin can end arguments; it settles disputes between powerful opponents.
verses.textEnNasb: The cast lot puts an end to quarrels, And decides between the mighty ones.
verses.textEn: Casting the lot settles disputes and keeps strong opponents apart.

verses.textZh: 触怒兄弟，要劝他和解，比取坚城还难； 这样的纷争，如同堡垒的门闩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 触怒兄弟，要劝他和解，比取坚城还难； 这样的纷争，如同堡垒的门闩。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄结怨，劝他和好，比取坚固城还难； 这样的争竞如同坚寨的门闩。
verses.textEnNiv: A brother wronged is more unyielding than a fortified city; disputes are like the barred gates of a citadel.
verses.textEnEsv: A brother offended is more unyielding than a strong city, and quarreling is like the bars of a castle.
verses.textEnNkjv: A brother offended ishardertowin than a strong city, And contentions are like the bars of a castle.
verses.textEnNlt: An offended friend is harder to win back than a fortified city. Arguments separate friends like a gate locked with bars.
verses.textEnNasb: A brother who is offended is harder to be won than a strong city, And quarrels are like the bars of a citadel.
verses.textEn: A brother wronged is more unyielding than a fortified city; disputes are like the barred gates of a citadel.

verses.textZh: 人口中所结的果子，必使自己的肚腹饱足； 他嘴里所出的，必使他饱足。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人口中所结的果子，必使自己的肚腹饱足； 他嘴里所出的，必使他饱足。
verses.textZhCuv: 人口中所结的果子，必充满肚腹； 他嘴所出的，必使他饱足。
verses.textEnNiv: From the fruit of their mouth a person’s stomach is filled; with the harvest of their lips they are satisfied.
verses.textEnEsv: From the fruit of a man’s mouth his stomach is satisfied; he is satisfied by the yield of his lips.
verses.textEnNkjv: A man’s stomach shall be satisfied from the fruit of his mouth; From the produce of his lips he shall be filled.
verses.textEnNlt: Wise words satisfy like a good meal; the right words bring satisfaction.
verses.textEnNasb: With the fruit of a person’s mouth his stomach will be satisfied; He will be satisfied with the product of his lips.
verses.textEn: From the fruit of their mouth a person’s stomach is filled; with the harvest of their lips they are satisfied.

verses.textZh: 生与死都在舌头的权下； 爱把弄这权柄的，必自食其果。
verses.textZhCnvs: 生与死都在舌头的权下； 爱把弄这权柄的，必自食其果。
verses.textZhCuv: 生死在舌头的权下， 喜爱它的，必吃它所结的果子。
verses.textEnNiv: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.
verses.textEnEsv: Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and those who love it will eat its fruits.
verses.textEnNkjv: Death and life are in the power of the tongue, And those who love it will eat its fruit.
verses.textEnNlt: The tongue can bring death or life; those who love to talk will reap the consequences.
verses.textEnNasb: Death and life are in the power of the tongue, And those who love it will eat its fruit.
verses.textEn: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.

verses.textZh: 觅得贤妻的，就是觅得幸福， 也是蒙了耶和华的恩宠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 觅得贤妻的，就是觅得幸福， 也是蒙了耶和华的恩宠。
verses.textZhCuv: 得着贤妻的，是得着好处， 也是蒙了耶和华的恩惠。
verses.textEnNiv: He who finds a wife finds what is good and receives favor from the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: He who finds a wife finds a good thing and obtains favor from the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Hewho finds a wife finds a good thing, And obtains favor from the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The man who finds a wife finds a treasure, and he receives favor from the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: He who finds a wife finds a good thing And obtains favor from the Lord.
verses.textEn: He who finds a wife finds what is good and receives favor from the Lord .

verses.textZh: 穷人乞恩哀求， 财主却声色俱厉地回答。
verses.textZhCnvs: 穷人乞恩哀求， 财主却声色俱厉地回答。
verses.textZhCuv: 贫穷人说哀求的话； 富足人用威吓的话回答。
verses.textEnNiv: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.
verses.textEnEsv: The poor use entreaties, but the rich answer roughly.
verses.textEnNkjv: The poor man uses entreaties, But the rich answers roughly.
verses.textEnNlt: The poor plead for mercy; the rich answer with insults.
verses.textEnNasb: A poor person utters pleadings, But a rich person answers defiantly.
verses.textEn: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.

verses.textZh: 朋友众多的人，终必彼此破裂， 但有一位朋友，比兄弟更亲密。
verses.textZhCnvs: 朋友众多的人，终必彼此破裂， 但有一位朋友，比兄弟更亲密。
verses.textZhCuv: 滥交朋友的，自取败坏； 但有一朋友比弟兄更亲密。
verses.textEnNiv: One who has unreliable friends soon comes to ruin, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
verses.textEnEsv: A man of many companions may come to ruin, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
verses.textEnNkjv: A man whohas friends must himself be friendly, But there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
verses.textEnNlt: There are "friends" who destroy each other, but a real friend sticks closer than a brother.
verses.textEnNasb: A person of too many friends comes to ruin, But there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
verses.textEn: One who has unreliable friends soon comes to ruin, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.

verses.textZh: 行为完全的穷人， 胜过说话欺诈的愚昧人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 行为完全的穷人， 胜过说话欺诈的愚昧人。
verses.textZhCuv: 行为纯正的贫穷人 胜过乖谬愚妄的富足人。
verses.textEnNiv: Better the poor whose walk is blameless than a fool whose lips are perverse.
verses.textEnEsv: Better is a poor person who walks in his integrity than one who is crooked in speech and is a fool.
verses.textEnNkjv: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity Than onewhois perverse in his lips, and is a fool.
verses.textEnNlt: Better to be poor and honest than to be dishonest and a fool.
verses.textEnNasb: Better is a poor person who walks in his integrity Than a person who is perverse in speech and is a fool.
verses.textEn: Better the poor whose walk is blameless than a fool whose lips are perverse.

verses.textZh: 一个人没有知识是不好的， 脚步匆忙的，难免失足。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一个人没有知识是不好的， 脚步匆忙的，难免失足。
verses.textZhCuv: 心无知识的，乃为不善； 脚步急快的，难免犯罪。
verses.textEnNiv: Desire without knowledge is not good— how much more will hasty feet miss the way!
verses.textEnEsv: Desire without knowledge is not good, and whoever makes haste with his feet misses his way.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also it is not good for a soul tobe without knowledge, And he sins who hastens with his feet.
verses.textEnNlt: Enthusiasm without knowledge is no good; haste makes mistakes.
verses.textEnNasb: Also it is not good for a person to be without knowledge, And one who hurries his footsteps errs.
verses.textEn: Desire without knowledge is not good— how much more will hasty feet miss the way!

verses.textZh: 人的愚妄毁灭自己的道路； 他的心却恼怒耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人的愚妄毁灭自己的道路； 他的心却恼怒耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 人的愚昧倾败他的道； 他的心也抱怨耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: A person’s own folly leads to their ruin, yet their heart rages against the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: When a man’s folly brings his way to ruin, his heart rages against the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: The foolishness of a man twists his way, And his heart frets against the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: People ruin their lives by their own foolishness and then are angry at the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: The foolishness of a person ruins his way, And his heart rages against the Lord.
verses.textEn: A person’s own folly leads to their ruin, yet their heart rages against the Lord .

verses.textZh: 财富使朋友增多， 但穷人连他的一个朋友也与他分离。
verses.textZhCnvs: 财富使朋友增多， 但穷人连他的一个朋友也与他分离。
verses.textZhCuv: 财物使朋友增多； 但穷人朋友远离。
verses.textEnNiv: Wealth attracts many friends, but even the closest friend of the poor person deserts them.
verses.textEnEsv: Wealth brings many new friends, but a poor man is deserted by his friend.
verses.textEnNkjv: Wealth makes many friends, But the poor is separated from his friend.
verses.textEnNlt: Wealth makes many "friends"; poverty drives them all away.
verses.textEnNasb: Wealth adds many friends, But a poor person is separated from his friend.
verses.textEn: Wealth attracts many friends, but even the closest friend of the poor person deserts them.

verses.textZh: 作假见证的必难免受惩罚； 吐出谎言的必不能逃脱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 作假见证的必难免受惩罚； 吐出谎言的必不能逃脱。
verses.textZhCuv: 作假见证的，必不免受罚； 吐出谎言的，终不能逃脱。
verses.textEnNiv: A false witness will not go unpunished, and whoever pours out lies will not go free.
verses.textEnEsv: A false witness will not go unpunished, and he who breathes out lies will not escape.
verses.textEnNkjv: A false witness will not go unpunished, And hewho speaks lies will not escape.
verses.textEnNlt: A false witness will not go unpunished, nor will a liar escape.
verses.textEnNasb: A false witness will not go unpunished, And one who declares lies will not escape.
verses.textEn: A false witness will not go unpunished, and whoever pours out lies will not go free.

verses.textZh: 尊贵的人，很多人求他的情面； 慷慨施赠的，人人都作他的朋友。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尊贵的人，很多人求他的情面； 慷慨施赠的，人人都作他的朋友。
verses.textZhCuv: 好施散的，有多人求他的恩情； 爱送礼的，人都为他的朋友。
verses.textEnNiv: Many curry favor with a ruler, and everyone is the friend of one who gives gifts.
verses.textEnEsv: Many seek the favor of a generous man, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.
verses.textEnNkjv: Many entreat the favor of the nobility, And every man is a friend to one who gives gifts.
verses.textEnNlt: Many seek favors from a ruler; everyone is the friend of a person who gives gifts!
verses.textEnNasb: Many will seek the favor of a generous person, And every person is a friend to him who gives gifts.
verses.textEn: Many curry favor with a ruler, and everyone is the friend of one who gives gifts.

verses.textZh: 贫穷人的兄弟都恨他； 他的朋友更疏远他。 虽然他多多恳求他们，他们却不理会。
verses.textZhCnvs: 贫穷人的兄弟都恨他； 他的朋友更疏远他。 虽然他多多恳求他们，他们却不理会。
verses.textZhCuv: 贫穷人，弟兄都恨他； 何况他的朋友，更远离他！ 他用言语追随，他们却走了。
verses.textEnNiv: The poor are shunned by all their relatives— how much more do their friends avoid them! Though the poor pursue them with pleading, they are nowhere to be found.
verses.textEnEsv: All a poor man’s brothers hate him; how much more do his friends go far from him! He pursues them with words, but does not have them.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the brothers of the poor hate him; How much more do his friends go far from him! He may pursue themwith words, yet they abandon him.
verses.textEnNlt: The relatives of the poor despise them; how much more will their friends avoid them! Though the poor plead with them, their friends are gone.
verses.textEnNasb: All the brothers of a poor person hate him; How much more do his friends abandon him! He pursues them with words, but they are gone.
verses.textEn: The poor are shunned by all their relatives— how much more do their friends avoid them! Though the poor pursue them with pleading, they are nowhere to be found.

verses.textZh: 得着智慧的，爱惜自己的性命； 保持明达的，必得益处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 得着智慧的，爱惜自己的性命； 保持明达的，必得益处。
verses.textZhCuv: 得着智慧的，爱惜生命； 保守聪明的，必得好处。
verses.textEnNiv: The one who gets wisdom loves life; the one who cherishes understanding will soon prosper.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever gets sense loves his own soul; he who keeps understanding will discover good.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul; He who keeps understanding will find good.
verses.textEnNlt: To acquire wisdom is to love yourself; people who cherish understanding will prosper.
verses.textEnNasb: One who gets wisdom loves his own soul; One who keeps understanding will find good.
verses.textEn: The one who gets wisdom loves life; the one who cherishes understanding will soon prosper.

verses.textZh: 作假见证的必难免受惩罚； 吐出谎言的终必灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 作假见证的必难免受惩罚； 吐出谎言的终必灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 作假见证的，不免受罚； 吐出谎言的，也必灭亡。
verses.textEnNiv: A false witness will not go unpunished, and whoever pours out lies will perish.
verses.textEnEsv: A false witness will not go unpunished, and he who breathes out lies will perish.
verses.textEnNkjv: A false witness will not go unpunished, And hewho speaks lies shall perish.
verses.textEnNlt: A false witness will not go unpunished, and a liar will be destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: A false witness will not go unpunished, And one who declares lies will perish.
verses.textEn: A false witness will not go unpunished, and whoever pours out lies will perish.

verses.textZh: 愚昧人生活奢侈是不相称的， 何况奴仆管辖领袖呢！
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚昧人生活奢侈是不相称的， 何况奴仆管辖领袖呢！
verses.textZhCuv: 愚昧人宴乐度日是不合宜的； 何况仆人管辖王子呢？
verses.textEnNiv: It is not fitting for a fool to live in luxury— how much worse for a slave to rule over princes!
verses.textEnEsv: It is not fitting for a fool to live in luxury, much less for a slave to rule over princes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Luxury is not fitting for a fool, Much less for a servant to rule over princes.
verses.textEnNlt: It isn’t right for a fool to live in luxury or for a slave to rule over princes!
verses.textEnNasb: Luxury is not fitting for a fool; Much less for a slave to rule over princes.
verses.textEn: It is not fitting for a fool to live in luxury— how much worse for a slave to rule over princes!

verses.textZh: 人的明慧使他不轻易动怒； 宽恕别人过失的，是自己的荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人的明慧使他不轻易动怒； 宽恕别人过失的，是自己的荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 人有见识就不轻易发怒； 宽恕人的过失便是自己的荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: A person’s wisdom yields patience; it is to one’s glory to overlook an offense.
verses.textEnEsv: Good sense makes one slow to anger, and it is his glory to overlook an offense.
verses.textEnNkjv: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger, And his glory is to overlook a transgression.
verses.textEnNlt: Sensible people control their temper; they earn respect by overlooking wrongs.
verses.textEnNasb: A person’s discretion makes him slow to anger, And it is his glory to overlook an offense.
verses.textEn: A person’s wisdom yields patience; it is to one’s glory to overlook an offense.

verses.textZh: 王的忿怒，好象狮子的吼叫， 他的恩宠，如同草上的朝露。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王的忿怒，好象狮子的吼叫， 他的恩宠，如同草上的朝露。
verses.textZhCuv: 王的忿怒好像狮子吼叫； 他的恩典却如草上的甘露。
verses.textEnNiv: A king’s rage is like the roar of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.
verses.textEnEsv: A king’s wrath is like the growling of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.
verses.textEnNkjv: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, But his favor is like dew on the grass.
verses.textEnNlt: The king’s anger is like a lion’s roar, but his favor is like dew on the grass.
verses.textEnNasb: A king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, But his favor is like dew on the grass.
verses.textEn: A king’s rage is like the roar of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.

verses.textZh: 愚昧的儿子是父亲的祸患， 吵闹的妻子好象雨水不停地滴漏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚昧的儿子是父亲的祸患， 吵闹的妻子好象雨水不停地滴漏。
verses.textZhCuv: 愚昧的儿子是父亲的祸患； 妻子的争吵如雨连连滴漏。
verses.textEnNiv: A foolish child is a father’s ruin, and a quarrelsome wife is like the constant dripping of a leaky roof.
verses.textEnEsv: A foolish son is ruin to his father, and a wife’s quarreling is a continual dripping of rain.
verses.textEnNkjv: A foolish son is the ruin of his father, And the contentions of a wife are a continual dripping.
verses.textEnNlt: A foolish child is a calamity to a father; a quarrelsome wife is as annoying as constant dripping.
verses.textEnNasb: A foolish son is destruction to his father, And the quarrels of a wife are a constant dripping.
verses.textEn: A foolish child is a father’s ruin, and a quarrelsome wife is like the constant dripping of a leaky roof.

verses.textZh: 房屋与财富是祖宗遗留的产业； 唯有明慧的妻子是耶和华所赐的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 房屋与财富是祖宗遗留的产业； 唯有明慧的妻子是耶和华所赐的。
verses.textZhCuv: 房屋钱财是祖宗所遗留的； 惟有贤慧的妻是耶和华所赐的。
verses.textEnNiv: Houses and wealth are inherited from parents, but a prudent wife is from the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: House and wealth are inherited from fathers, but a prudent wife is from the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Houses and riches are an inheritance from fathers, But a prudent wife is from the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Fathers can give their sons an inheritance of houses and wealth, but only the Lord can give an understanding wife.
verses.textEnNasb: House and wealth are an inheritance from fathers, But a prudent wife is from the Lord.
verses.textEn: Houses and wealth are inherited from parents, but a prudent wife is from the Lord .

verses.textZh: 懒惰使人沉睡， 闲懒的人必受饥饿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 懒惰使人沉睡， 闲懒的人必受饥饿。
verses.textZhCuv: 懒惰使人沉睡； 懈怠的人必受饥饿。
verses.textEnNiv: Laziness brings on deep sleep, and the shiftless go hungry.
verses.textEnEsv: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep, and an idle person will suffer hunger.
verses.textEnNkjv: Laziness casts one into a deep sleep, And an idle person will suffer hunger.
verses.textEnNlt: Lazy people sleep soundly, but idleness leaves them hungry.
verses.textEnNasb: Laziness casts one into a deep sleep, And a lazy person will suffer hunger.
verses.textEn: Laziness brings on deep sleep, and the shiftless go hungry.

verses.textZh: 谨守诫命的，保全自己的性命； 轻忽自己道路的，必致死亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谨守诫命的，保全自己的性命； 轻忽自己道路的，必致死亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 谨守诫命的，保全生命； 轻忽己路的，必致死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever keeps commandments keeps their life, but whoever shows contempt for their ways will die.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever keeps the commandment keeps his life; he who despises his ways will die.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, But he who is careless of his ways will die.
verses.textEnNlt: Keep the commandments and keep your life; despising them leads to death.
verses.textEnNasb: One who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, But one who is careless of conduct will die.
verses.textEn: Whoever keeps commandments keeps their life, but whoever shows contempt for their ways will die.

verses.textZh: 恩待穷人的，等于借钱给耶和华； 他所行的，耶和华必偿还。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恩待穷人的，等于借钱给耶和华； 他所行的，耶和华必偿还。
verses.textZhCuv: 怜悯贫穷的，就是借给耶和华； 他的善行，耶和华必偿还。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever is kind to the poor lends to the Lord , and he will reward them for what they have done.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever is generous to the poor lends to the Lord , and he will repay him for his deed.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who has pity on the poor lends to the Lord, And He will pay back what he has given.
verses.textEnNlt: If you help the poor, you are lending to the Lord — and he will repay you!
verses.textEnNasb: One who is gracious to a poor person lends to the Lord, And He will repay him for his good deed.
verses.textEn: Whoever is kind to the poor lends to the Lord , and he will reward them for what they have done.

verses.textZh: 趁着还有指望的时候，要管教你的儿子； 不可存心使他死亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 趁着还有指望的时候，要管教你的儿子； 不可存心使他死亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 趁有指望，管教你的儿子； 你的心不可任他死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: Discipline your children, for in that there is hope; do not be a willing party to their death.
verses.textEnEsv: Discipline your son, for there is hope; do not set your heart on putting him to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: Chasten your son while there is hope, And do not set your heart on his destruction.
verses.textEnNlt: Discipline your children while there is hope. Otherwise you will ruin their lives.
verses.textEnNasb: Discipline your son while there is hope, And do not desire his death.
verses.textEn: Discipline your children, for in that there is hope; do not be a willing party to their death.

verses.textZh: 常发烈怒的人，必须受罚， 如果你帮助他，就必须一而再帮助他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 常发烈怒的人，必须受罚， 如果你帮助他，就必须一而再帮助他。
verses.textZhCuv: 暴怒的人必受刑罚； 你若救他，必须再救。
verses.textEnNiv: A hot-tempered person must pay the penalty; rescue them, and you will have to do it again.
verses.textEnEsv: A man of great wrath will pay the penalty, for if you deliver him, you will only have to do it again.
verses.textEnNkjv: Amanof great wrath will suffer punishment; For if you rescue him, you will have to do it again.
verses.textEnNlt: Hot-tempered people must pay the penalty. If you rescue them once, you will have to do it again.
verses.textEnNasb: A person of great anger will suffer the penalty, For if you rescue him, you will only have to do it again.
verses.textEn: A hot-tempered person must pay the penalty; rescue them, and you will have to do it again.

verses.textZh: 你要听劝告，受管教， 好使你将来作个有智慧的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要听劝告，受管教， 好使你将来作个有智慧的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要听劝教，受训诲， 使你终久有智慧。
verses.textEnNiv: Listen to advice and accept discipline, and at the end you will be counted among the wise.
verses.textEnEsv: Listen to advice and accept instruction, that you may gain wisdom in the future.
verses.textEnNkjv: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, That you may be wise in your latter days.
verses.textEnNlt: Get all the advice and instruction you can, so you will be wise the rest of your life.
verses.textEnNasb: Listen to advice and accept discipline, So that you may be wise the rest of your days.
verses.textEn: Listen to advice and accept discipline, and at the end you will be counted among the wise.

verses.textZh: 人心里的谋算很多， 唯有耶和华的计划能实现。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人心里的谋算很多， 唯有耶和华的计划能实现。
verses.textZhCuv: 人心多有计谋； 惟有耶和华的筹算才能立定。
verses.textEnNiv: Many are the plans in a person’s heart, but it is the Lord ’s purpose that prevails.
verses.textEnEsv: Many are the plans in the mind of a man, but it is the purpose of the Lord that will stand.
verses.textEnNkjv: There are many plans in a man’s heart, Nevertheless the Lord’s counsel—that will stand.
verses.textEnNlt: You can make many plans, but the Lord ’s purpose will prevail.
verses.textEnNasb: Many plans are in a person’s heart, But the advice of the Lord will stand.
verses.textEn: Many are the plans in a person’s heart, but it is the Lord ’s purpose that prevails.

verses.textZh: 人所渴望的，就是忠诚； 作穷人比作撒谎的人还好。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人所渴望的，就是忠诚； 作穷人比作撒谎的人还好。
verses.textZhCuv: 施行仁慈的，令人爱慕； 穷人强如说谎言的。
verses.textEnNiv: What a person desires is unfailing love ; better to be poor than a liar.
verses.textEnEsv: What is desired in a man is steadfast love, and a poor man is better than a liar.
verses.textEnNkjv: What is desired in a man is kindness, And a poor man is better than a liar.
verses.textEnNlt: Loyalty makes a person attractive. It is better to be poor than dishonest.
verses.textEnNasb: What is desirable in a person is his kindness, And it is better to be a poor person than a liar.
verses.textEn: What a person desires is unfailing love ; better to be poor than a liar.

verses.textZh: 敬畏耶和华的，得着生命； 他必安居知足，不会遭受祸患。
verses.textZhCnvs: 敬畏耶和华的，得着生命； 他必安居知足，不会遭受祸患。
verses.textZhCuv: 敬畏耶和华的，得着生命； 他必恒久知足，不遭祸患。
verses.textEnNiv: The fear of the Lord leads to life; then one rests content, untouched by trouble.
verses.textEnEsv: The fear of the Lord leads to life, and whoever has it rests satisfied; he will not be visited by harm.
verses.textEnNkjv: The fear of the Lordleads to life, And hewhohasit will abide in satisfaction; He will not be visited with evil.
verses.textEnNlt: Fear of the Lord leads to life, bringing security and protection from harm.
verses.textEnNasb: The fear of the Lordleads to life, So that one may sleep satisfied, untouched by evil.
verses.textEn: The fear of the Lord leads to life; then one rests content, untouched by trouble.

verses.textZh: 懒惰人把手放在盘子里， 连拿食物送回口边，也不愿意。
verses.textZhCnvs: 懒惰人把手放在盘子里， 连拿食物送回口边，也不愿意。
verses.textZhCuv: 懒惰人放手在盘子里， 就是向口撤回，他也不肯。
verses.textEnNiv: A sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not even bring it back to his mouth!
verses.textEnEsv: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish and will not even bring it back to his mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: A lazy man buries his hand in the bowl, And will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
verses.textEnNlt: Lazy people take food in their hand but don’t even lift it to their mouth.
verses.textEnNasb: The lazy one buries his hand in the dish, But will not even bring it back to his mouth.
verses.textEn: A sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not even bring it back to his mouth!

verses.textZh: 责打好讥笑人的，愚蒙人就会变得精明； 责备聪明人，他就会明白知识。
verses.textZhCnvs: 责打好讥笑人的，愚蒙人就会变得精明； 责备聪明人，他就会明白知识。
verses.textZhCuv: 鞭打亵慢人，愚蒙人必长见识； 责备明哲人，他就明白知识。
verses.textEnNiv: Flog a mocker, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke the discerning, and they will gain knowledge.
