verses.textEnEsv: Strike a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; reprove a man of understanding, and he will gain knowledge.
verses.textEnNkjv: Strike a scoffer, and the simple will become wary; Rebuke one who has understanding, and he will discern knowledge.
verses.textEnNlt: If you punish a mocker, the simpleminded will learn a lesson; if you correct the wise, they will be all the wiser.
verses.textEnNasb: Strike a scoffer and the naive may become clever, But rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.
verses.textEn: Flog a mocker, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke the discerning, and they will gain knowledge.

verses.textZh: 虐待父亲，赶走母亲的， 是贻羞可耻的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虐待父亲，赶走母亲的， 是贻羞可耻的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 虐待父亲、撵出母亲的， 是贻羞致辱之子。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever robs their father and drives out their mother is a child who brings shame and disgrace.
verses.textEnEsv: He who does violence to his father and chases away his mother is a son who brings shame and reproach.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who mistreats his father and chases away his mother Is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.
verses.textEnNlt: Children who mistreat their father or chase away their mother are an embarrassment and a public disgrace.
verses.textEnNasb: He who assaults his father and drives his mother away Is a shameful and disgraceful son.
verses.textEn: Whoever robs their father and drives out their mother is a child who brings shame and disgrace.

verses.textZh: 我儿，你若是停止听受管教， 就会偏离知识的言语。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我儿，你若是停止听受管教， 就会偏离知识的言语。
verses.textZhCuv: 我儿，不可听了教训 而又偏离知识的言语。
verses.textEnNiv: Stop listening to instruction, my son, and you will stray from the words of knowledge.
verses.textEnEsv: Cease to hear instruction, my son, and you will stray from the words of knowledge.
verses.textEnNkjv: Cease listening to instruction, my son, And you will stray from the words of knowledge.
verses.textEnNlt: If you stop listening to instruction, my child, you will turn your back on knowledge.
verses.textEnNasb: Stop listening, my son, to discipline, And you will stray from the words of knowledge.
verses.textEn: Stop listening to instruction, my son, and you will stray from the words of knowledge.

verses.textZh: 无赖作见证，嘲笑公平， 恶人的口，吞吃罪孽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 无赖作见证，嘲笑公平， 恶人的口，吞吃罪孽。
verses.textZhCuv: 匪徒作见证戏笑公平； 恶人的口吞下罪孽。
verses.textEnNiv: A corrupt witness mocks at justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down evil.
verses.textEnEsv: A worthless witness mocks at justice, and the mouth of the wicked devours iniquity.
verses.textEnNkjv: A disreputable witness scorns justice, And the mouth of the wicked devours iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: A corrupt witness makes a mockery of justice; the mouth of the wicked gulps down evil.
verses.textEnNasb: A worthless witness makes a mockery of justice, And the mouth of the wicked swallows wrongdoing.
verses.textEn: A corrupt witness mocks at justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down evil.

verses.textZh: 刑罚是为好讥笑人的预备的， 鞭打是为愚昧人的背预备的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 刑罚是为好讥笑人的预备的， 鞭打是为愚昧人的背预备的。
verses.textZhCuv: 刑罚是为亵慢人预备的； 鞭打是为愚昧人的背预备的。
verses.textEnNiv: Penalties are prepared for mockers, and beatings for the backs of fools.
verses.textEnEsv: Condemnation is ready for scoffers, and beating for the backs of fools.
verses.textEnNkjv: Judgments are prepared for scoffers, And beatings for the backs of fools.
verses.textEnNlt: Punishment is made for mockers, and the backs of fools are made to be beaten.
verses.textEnNasb: Judgments are prepared for scoffers, And beatings for the backs of fools.
verses.textEn: Penalties are prepared for mockers, and beatings for the backs of fools.

verses.textZh: 酒能使人狂放，烈酒能使人喧哗； 所有因醉酒而犯错的，都没有智慧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 酒能使人狂放，烈酒能使人喧哗； 所有因醉酒而犯错的，都没有智慧。
verses.textZhCuv: 酒能使人亵慢，浓酒使人喧嚷； 凡因酒错误的，就无智慧。
verses.textEnNiv: Wine is a mocker and beer a brawler; whoever is led astray by them is not wise.
verses.textEnEsv: Wine is a mocker, strong drink a brawler, and whoever is led astray by it is not wise.
verses.textEnNkjv: Wine is a mocker, Strong drink is a brawler, And whoever is led astray by it is not wise.
verses.textEnNlt: Wine produces mockers; alcohol leads to brawls. Those led astray by drink cannot be wise.
verses.textEnNasb: Wine is a mocker, intoxicating drink a brawler, And whoever is intoxicated by it is not wise.
verses.textEn: Wine is a mocker and beer a brawler; whoever is led astray by them is not wise.

verses.textZh: 王的震怒好象狮子的吼叫； 触怒他的是自害己命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王的震怒好象狮子的吼叫； 触怒他的是自害己命。
verses.textZhCuv: 王的威吓如同狮子吼叫； 惹动他怒的，是自害己命。
verses.textEnNiv: A king’s wrath strikes terror like the roar of a lion; those who anger him forfeit their lives.
verses.textEnEsv: The terror of a king is like the growling of a lion; whoever provokes him to anger forfeits his life.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wrath of a king is like the roaring of a lion; Whoever provokes him to anger sins against his own life.
verses.textEnNlt: The king’s fury is like a lion’s roar; to rouse his anger is to risk your life.
verses.textEnNasb: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion; One who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.
verses.textEn: A king’s wrath strikes terror like the roar of a lion; those who anger him forfeit their lives.

verses.textZh: 平息纷争就是人的荣耀； 只有愚妄人个个都爱争执。
verses.textZhCnvs: 平息纷争就是人的荣耀； 只有愚妄人个个都爱争执。
verses.textZhCuv: 远离纷争是人的尊荣； 愚妄人都爱争闹。
verses.textEnNiv: It is to one’s honor to avoid strife, but every fool is quick to quarrel.
verses.textEnEsv: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife, but every fool will be quarreling.
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis honorable for a man to stop striving, Since any fool can start a quarrel.
verses.textEnNlt: Avoiding a fight is a mark of honor; only fools insist on quarreling.
verses.textEnNasb: Avoiding strife is an honor for a person, But any fool will quarrel.
verses.textEn: It is to one’s honor to avoid strife, but every fool is quick to quarrel.

verses.textZh: 懒惰人冬天不耕种； 到收割的时候，出去求食，必一无所得。
verses.textZhCnvs: 懒惰人冬天不耕种； 到收割的时候，出去求食，必一无所得。
verses.textZhCuv: 懒惰人因冬寒不肯耕种， 到收割的时候，他必讨饭而无所得。
verses.textEnNiv: Sluggards do not plow in season; so at harvest time they look but find nothing.
verses.textEnEsv: The sluggard does not plow in the autumn; he will seek at harvest and have nothing.
verses.textEnNkjv: The lazy man will not plow because of winter; He will beg during harvest and have nothing.
verses.textEnNlt: Those too lazy to plow in the right season will have no food at the harvest.
verses.textEnNasb: The lazy one does not plow after the autumn, So he begs during the harvest and has nothing.
verses.textEn: Sluggards do not plow in season; so at harvest time they look but find nothing.

verses.textZh: 人心里的谋略如同深水， 唯有聪明人能汲引出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人心里的谋略如同深水， 唯有聪明人能汲引出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 人心怀藏谋略，好像深水， 惟明哲人才能汲引出来。
verses.textEnNiv: The purposes of a person’s heart are deep waters, but one who has insight draws them out.
verses.textEnEsv: The purpose in a man’s heart is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.
verses.textEnNkjv: Counsel in the heart of man islike deep water, But a man of understanding will draw it out.
verses.textEnNlt: Though good advice lies deep within the heart, a person with understanding will draw it out.
verses.textEnNasb: A plan in the heart of a person is like deep water, But a person of understanding draws it out.
verses.textEn: The purposes of a person’s heart are deep waters, but one who has insight draws them out.

verses.textZh: 很多人自称忠诚， 但信实的人，谁能遇着呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 很多人自称忠诚， 但信实的人，谁能遇着呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 人多述说自己的仁慈， 但忠信人谁能遇着呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Many claim to have unfailing love, but a faithful person who can find?
verses.textEnEsv: Many a man proclaims his own steadfast love, but a faithful man who can find?
verses.textEnNkjv: Most men will proclaim each his own goodness, But who can find a faithful man?
verses.textEnNlt: Many will say they are loyal friends, but who can find one who is truly reliable?
verses.textEnNasb: Many a person proclaims his own loyalty, But who can find a trustworthy person?
verses.textEn: Many claim to have unfailing love, but a faithful person who can find?

verses.textZh: 行为完全的义人， 他的后代是有福的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 行为完全的义人， 他的后代是有福的。
verses.textZhCuv: 行为纯正的义人， 他的子孙是有福的！
verses.textEnNiv: The righteous lead blameless lives; blessed are their children after them.
verses.textEnEsv: The righteous who walks in his integrity— blessed are his children after him!
verses.textEnNkjv: The righteous man walks in his integrity; His children are blessed after him.
verses.textEnNlt: The godly walk with integrity; blessed are their children who follow them.
verses.textEnNasb: A righteous person who walks in his integrity— How blessed are his sons after him.
verses.textEn: The righteous lead blameless lives; blessed are their children after them.

verses.textZh: 君王坐在审判的位上， 他的眼目查察一切恶事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 君王坐在审判的位上， 他的眼目查察一切恶事。
verses.textZhCuv: 王坐在审判的位上， 以眼目驱散诸恶。
verses.textEnNiv: When a king sits on his throne to judge, he winnows out all evil with his eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: A king who sits on the throne of judgment winnows all evil with his eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: A king who sits on the throne of judgment Scatters all evil with his eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: When a king sits in judgment, he weighs all the evidence, distinguishing the bad from the good.
verses.textEnNasb: A king who sits on the throne of justice Disperses all evil with his eyes.
verses.textEn: When a king sits on his throne to judge, he winnows out all evil with his eyes.

verses.textZh: 谁能说："我洁净了我的心， 我是清洁无罪的"？
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁能说："我洁净了我的心， 我是清洁无罪的"？
verses.textZhCuv: 谁能说，我洁净了我的心， 我脱净了我的罪？
verses.textEnNiv: Who can say, "I have kept my heart pure; I am clean and without sin"?
verses.textEnEsv: Who can say, "I have made my heart pure; I am clean from my sin"?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who can say, "I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin"?
verses.textEnNlt: Who can say, "I have cleansed my heart; I am pure and free from sin"?
verses.textEnNasb: Who can say, "I have cleansed my heart, I am pure from my sin"?
verses.textEn: Who can say, "I have kept my heart pure; I am clean and without sin"?

verses.textZh: 不同的法码，不同的量器， 两样都是耶和华所厌恶的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不同的法码，不同的量器， 两样都是耶和华所厌恶的。
verses.textZhCuv: 两样的法码，两样的升斗， 都为耶和华所憎恶。
verses.textEnNiv: Differing weights and differing measures— the Lord detests them both.
verses.textEnEsv: Unequal weights and unequal measures are both alike an abomination to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Diverse weights and diverse measures, They are both alike, an abomination to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: False weights and unequal measures — the Lord detests double standards of every kind.
verses.textEnNasb: Differing weights and differing measures, Both of them are abominable to the Lord.
verses.textEn: Differing weights and differing measures— the Lord detests them both.

verses.textZh: 孩童的行动是否清洁正直， 凭他的行为就可以把他自己显明出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 孩童的行动是否清洁正直， 凭他的行为就可以把他自己显明出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 孩童的动作是清洁，是正直， 都显明他的本性。
verses.textEnNiv: Even small children are known by their actions, so is their conduct really pure and upright?
verses.textEnEsv: Even a child makes himself known by his acts, by whether his conduct is pure and upright.
verses.textEnNkjv: Even a child is known by his deeds, Whether what he does is pure and right.
verses.textEnNlt: Even children are known by the way they act, whether their conduct is pure, and whether it is right.
verses.textEnNasb: It is by his deeds that a boy distinguishes himself, If his conduct is pure and right.
verses.textEn: Even small children are known by their actions, so is their conduct really pure and upright?

verses.textZh: 能听的耳朵和能看的眼睛， 两样都是耶和华所造的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 能听的耳朵和能看的眼睛， 两样都是耶和华所造的。
verses.textZhCuv: 能听的耳，能看的眼， 都是耶和华所造的。
verses.textEnNiv: Ears that hear and eyes that see— the Lord has made them both.
verses.textEnEsv: The hearing ear and the seeing eye, the Lord has made them both.
verses.textEnNkjv: The hearing ear and the seeing eye, The Lord has made them both.
verses.textEnNlt: Ears to hear and eyes to see— both are gifts from the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: The hearing ear and the seeing eye, The Lord has made both of them.
verses.textEn: Ears that hear and eyes that see— the Lord has made them both.

verses.textZh: 不要贪睡，免得你贫穷； 睁开眼睛，你才有饱餐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要贪睡，免得你贫穷； 睁开眼睛，你才有饱餐。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要贪睡，免致贫穷； 眼要睁开，你就吃饱。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not love sleep or you will grow poor; stay awake and you will have food to spare.
verses.textEnEsv: Love not sleep, lest you come to poverty; open your eyes, and you will have plenty of bread.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not love sleep, lest you come to poverty; Open your eyes, and you will be satisfied with bread.
verses.textEnNlt: If you love sleep, you will end in poverty. Keep your eyes open, and there will be plenty to eat!
verses.textEnNasb: Do not love sleep, or you will become poor; Open your eyes, and you will be satisfied with food.
verses.textEn: Do not love sleep or you will grow poor; stay awake and you will have food to spare.

verses.textZh: 买东西的说："不好，不好！" 离去以后，他就自夸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 买东西的说："不好，不好！" 离去以后，他就自夸。
verses.textZhCuv: 买物的说：不好，不好； 及至买去，他便自夸。
verses.textEnNiv: "It’s no good, it’s no good!" says the buyer— then goes off and boasts about the purchase.
verses.textEnEsv: "Bad, bad," says the buyer, but when he goes away, then he boasts.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Itis good for nothing," cries the buyer; But when he has gone his way, then he boasts.
verses.textEnNlt: The buyer haggles over the price, saying, "It’s worthless," then brags about getting a bargain!
verses.textEnNasb: "Bad, bad," says the buyer, But when he goes his way, then he boasts.
verses.textEn: "It’s no good, it’s no good!" says the buyer— then goes off and boasts about the purchase.

verses.textZh: 虽有金子、许多红宝石和宝器， 但充满知识的嘴唇比这一切更宝贵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽有金子、许多红宝石和宝器， 但充满知识的嘴唇比这一切更宝贵。
verses.textZhCuv: 有金子和许多珍珠 ， 惟有知识的嘴乃为贵重的珍宝。
verses.textEnNiv: Gold there is, and rubies in abundance, but lips that speak knowledge are a rare jewel.
verses.textEnEsv: There is gold and abundance of costly stones, but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.
verses.textEnNkjv: There is gold and a multitude of rubies, But the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.
verses.textEnNlt: Wise words are more valuable than much gold and many rubies.
verses.textEnNasb: There is gold, and an abundance of jewels; But lips of knowledge are a more precious thing.
verses.textEn: Gold there is, and rubies in abundance, but lips that speak knowledge are a rare jewel.

verses.textZh: 谁为陌生人作保证人，就拿去谁的衣服； 谁替妓女作保证人，谁就要作担保。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁为陌生人作保证人，就拿去谁的衣服； 谁替妓女作保证人，谁就要作担保。
verses.textZhCuv: 谁为生人作保，就拿谁的衣服； 谁为外人作保，谁就要承当。
verses.textEnNiv: Take the garment of one who puts up security for a stranger; hold it in pledge if it is done for an outsider.
verses.textEnEsv: Take a man’s garment when he has put up security for a stranger, and hold it in pledge when he puts up security for foreigners.
verses.textEnNkjv: Take the garment of one who is surety for a stranger, And hold it as a pledge whenit is for a seductress.
verses.textEnNlt: Get security from someone who guarantees a stranger’s debt. Get a deposit if he does it for foreigners.
verses.textEnNasb: Take his garment when he becomes guarantor for a stranger; And for foreigners, seize a pledge from him.
verses.textEn: Take the garment of one who puts up security for a stranger; hold it in pledge if it is done for an outsider.

verses.textZh: 欺骗得来的食物，人总觉得甘甜； 事后他的口必充满沙石。
verses.textZhCnvs: 欺骗得来的食物，人总觉得甘甜； 事后他的口必充满沙石。
verses.textZhCuv: 以虚谎而得的食物，人觉甘甜； 但后来，他的口必充满尘沙。
verses.textEnNiv: Food gained by fraud tastes sweet, but one ends up with a mouth full of gravel.
verses.textEnEsv: Bread gained by deceit is sweet to a man, but afterward his mouth will be full of gravel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Bread gained by deceit is sweet to a man, But afterward his mouth will be filled with gravel.
verses.textEnNlt: Stolen bread tastes sweet, but it turns to gravel in the mouth.
verses.textEnNasb: Bread obtained by a lie is sweet to a person, But afterward his mouth will be filled with gravel.
verses.textEn: Food gained by fraud tastes sweet, but one ends up with a mouth full of gravel.

verses.textZh: 计划要有筹算才能确立； 作战也要倚靠智谋。
verses.textZhCnvs: 计划要有筹算才能确立； 作战也要倚靠智谋。
verses.textZhCuv: 计谋都凭筹算立定； 打仗要凭智谋。
verses.textEnNiv: Plans are established by seeking advice; so if you wage war, obtain guidance.
verses.textEnEsv: Plans are established by counsel; by wise guidance wage war.
verses.textEnNkjv: Plans are established by counsel; By wise counsel wage war.
verses.textEnNlt: Plans succeed through good counsel; don’t go to war without wise advice.
verses.textEnNasb: Prepare plans by consultation, And make war by wise guidance.
verses.textEn: Plans are established by seeking advice; so if you wage war, obtain guidance.

verses.textZh: 到处搬弄是非的，泄露秘密； 口无遮拦的，不可与他结交。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到处搬弄是非的，泄露秘密； 口无遮拦的，不可与他结交。
verses.textZhCuv: 往来传舌的，泄漏密事； 大张嘴的，不可与他结交。
verses.textEnNiv: A gossip betrays a confidence; so avoid anyone who talks too much.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever goes about slandering reveals secrets; therefore do not associate with a simple babbler.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who goes about as a talebearer reveals secrets; Therefore do not associate with one who flatters with his lips.
verses.textEnNlt: A gossip goes around telling secrets, so don’t hang around with chatterers.
verses.textEnNasb: One who goes about as a slanderer reveals secrets; Therefore do not associate with a gossip.
verses.textEn: A gossip betrays a confidence; so avoid anyone who talks too much.

verses.textZh: 咒骂父母的， 他的灯必在漆黑的幽暗中熄灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 咒骂父母的， 他的灯必在漆黑的幽暗中熄灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 咒骂父母的，他的灯必灭， 变为漆黑的黑暗。
verses.textEnNiv: If someone curses their father or mother, their lamp will be snuffed out in pitch darkness.
verses.textEnEsv: If one curses his father or his mother, his lamp will be put out in utter darkness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever curses his father or his mother, His lamp will be put out in deep darkness.
verses.textEnNlt: If you insult your father or mother, your light will be snuffed out in total darkness.
verses.textEnNasb: He who curses his father or his mother, His lamp will go out in time of darkness.
verses.textEn: If someone curses their father or mother, their lamp will be snuffed out in pitch darkness.

verses.textZh: 起初迅速得来的产业， 最后却不是福气。
verses.textZhCnvs: 起初迅速得来的产业， 最后却不是福气。
verses.textZhCuv: 起初速得的产业， 终久却不为福。
verses.textEnNiv: An inheritance claimed too soon will not be blessed at the end.
verses.textEnEsv: An inheritance gained hastily in the beginning will not be blessed in the end.
verses.textEnNkjv: An inheritance gained hastily at the beginning Will not be blessed at the end.
verses.textEnNlt: An inheritance obtained too early in life is not a blessing in the end.
verses.textEnNasb: An inheritance gained in a hurry at the beginning Will not be blessed in the end.
verses.textEn: An inheritance claimed too soon will not be blessed at the end.

verses.textZh: 你不要说："我要以恶报恶"； 要等候耶和华，他必拯救你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不要说："我要以恶报恶"； 要等候耶和华，他必拯救你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你不要说，我要以恶报恶； 要等候耶和华，他必拯救你。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not say, "I’ll pay you back for this wrong!" Wait for the Lord , and he will avenge you.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not say, "I will repay evil"; wait for the Lord , and he will deliver you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not say, "I will recompense evil"; Wait for the Lord, and He will save you.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t say, "I will get even for this wrong." Wait for the Lord to handle the matter.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not say, "I will repay evil"; Wait for the Lord, and He will save you.
verses.textEn: Do not say, "I’ll pay you back for this wrong!" Wait for the Lord , and he will avenge you.

verses.textZh: 不同的法码是耶和华所厌恶的； 诡诈的天平，也是邪恶的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不同的法码是耶和华所厌恶的； 诡诈的天平，也是邪恶的。
verses.textZhCuv: 两样的法码为耶和华所憎恶； 诡诈的天平也为不善。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord detests differing weights, and dishonest scales do not please him.
verses.textEnEsv: Unequal weights are an abomination to the Lord , and false scales are not good.
verses.textEnNkjv: Diverse weights are an abomination to the Lord, And dishonest scales are not good.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord detests double standards; he is not pleased by dishonest scales.
verses.textEnNasb: Differing weights are an abomination to the Lord, And a false scale is not good.
verses.textEn: The Lord detests differing weights, and dishonest scales do not please him.

verses.textZh: 人的脚步是由耶和华所定， 人怎能明白自己的道路呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 人的脚步是由耶和华所定， 人怎能明白自己的道路呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 人的脚步为耶和华所定； 人岂能明白自己的路呢？
verses.textEnNiv: A person’s steps are directed by the Lord . How then can anyone understand their own way?
verses.textEnEsv: A man’s steps are from the Lord ; how then can man understand his way?
verses.textEnNkjv: A man’s steps are of the Lord; How then can a man understand his own way?
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord directs our steps, so why try to understand everything along the way?
verses.textEnNasb: A man’s steps are ordained by the Lord; How then can a person understand his way?
verses.textEn: A person’s steps are directed by the Lord . How then can anyone understand their own way?

verses.textZh: 如果有人轻率地说："这是归神为圣之物"， 许愿以后才重新考虑，就是自陷网罗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人轻率地说："这是归神为圣之物"， 许愿以后才重新考虑，就是自陷网罗。
verses.textZhCuv: 人冒失说，这是圣物， 许愿之后才查问，就是自陷网罗。
verses.textEnNiv: It is a trap to dedicate something rashly and only later to consider one’s vows.
verses.textEnEsv: It is a snare to say rashly, "It is holy," and to reflect only after making vows.
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis a snare for a man to devote rashly somethingas holy, And afterward to reconsider his vows.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t trap yourself by making a rash promise to God and only later counting the cost.
verses.textEnNasb: It is a trap for a person to say carelessly, "It is holy!" And after the vows to make inquiry.
verses.textEn: It is a trap to dedicate something rashly and only later to consider one’s vows.

verses.textZh: 智慧的王簸散恶人， 并用车轮碾他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧的王簸散恶人， 并用车轮碾他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧的王簸散恶人， 用碌碡滚轧他们。
verses.textEnNiv: A wise king winnows out the wicked; he drives the threshing wheel over them.
verses.textEnEsv: A wise king winnows the wicked and drives the wheel over them.
verses.textEnNkjv: A wise king sifts out the wicked, And brings the threshing wheel over them.
verses.textEnNlt: A wise king scatters the wicked like wheat, then runs his threshing wheel over them.
verses.textEnNasb: A wise king scatters the wicked, And drives a threshing wheel over them.
verses.textEn: A wise king winnows out the wicked; he drives the threshing wheel over them.

verses.textZh: 人的灵是耶和华的灯， 探照人的脏腑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人的灵是耶和华的灯， 探照人的脏腑。
verses.textZhCuv: 人的灵是耶和华的灯， 鉴察人的心腹。
verses.textEnNiv: The human spirit is the lamp of the Lord that sheds light on one’s inmost being.
verses.textEnEsv: The spirit of man is the lamp of the Lord , searching all his innermost parts.
verses.textEnNkjv: The spirit of a man is the lamp of the Lord, Searching all the inner depths of his heart.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord ’s light penetrates the human spirit, exposing every hidden motive.
verses.textEnNasb: The spirit of a person is the lamp of the Lord, Searching all the innermost parts of his being.
verses.textEn: The human spirit is the lamp of the Lord that sheds light on one’s inmost being.

verses.textZh: 慈爱和信实保护君王， 他的王位也藉慈爱维持。
verses.textZhCnvs: 慈爱和信实保护君王， 他的王位也藉慈爱维持。
verses.textZhCuv: 王因仁慈和诚实得以保全他的国位， 也因仁慈立稳。
verses.textEnNiv: Love and faithfulness keep a king safe; through love his throne is made secure.
verses.textEnEsv: Steadfast love and faithfulness preserve the king, and by steadfast love his throne is upheld.
verses.textEnNkjv: Mercy and truth preserve the king, And by lovingkindness he upholds his throne.
verses.textEnNlt: Unfailing love and faithfulness protect the king; his throne is made secure through love.
verses.textEnNasb: Loyalty and truth watch over the king, And he upholds his throne by loyalty.
verses.textEn: Love and faithfulness keep a king safe; through love his throne is made secure.

verses.textZh: 气力是年轻人的荣耀， 白发是老年人的尊荣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 气力是年轻人的荣耀， 白发是老年人的尊荣。
verses.textZhCuv: 强壮乃少年人的荣耀； 白发为老年人的尊荣。
verses.textEnNiv: The glory of young men is their strength, gray hair the splendor of the old.
verses.textEnEsv: The glory of young men is their strength, but the splendor of old men is their gray hair.
verses.textEnNkjv: The glory of young men is their strength, And the splendor of old men is their gray head.
verses.textEnNlt: The glory of the young is their strength; the gray hair of experience is the splendor of the old.
verses.textEnNasb: The glory of young men is their strength, And the honor of old men is their gray hair.
verses.textEn: The glory of young men is their strength, gray hair the splendor of the old.

verses.textZh: 鞭伤能除净人的邪恶， 责打能洗净人的脏腑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 鞭伤能除净人的邪恶， 责打能洗净人的脏腑。
verses.textZhCuv: 鞭伤除净人的罪恶； 责打能入人的心腹。
verses.textEnNiv: Blows and wounds scrub away evil, and beatings purge the inmost being.
verses.textEnEsv: Blows that wound cleanse away evil; strokes make clean the innermost parts.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blows that hurt cleanse away evil, As do stripes the inner depths of the heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Physical punishment cleanses away evil; such discipline purifies the heart.
verses.textEnNasb: Bruising wounds clean away evil, And blows cleanse the innermost parts.
verses.textEn: Blows and wounds scrub away evil, and beatings purge the inmost being.

verses.textZh: 君王的心在耶和华手中，好象水沟的水， 他可以随意转移。
verses.textZhCnvs: 君王的心在耶和华手中，好象水沟的水， 他可以随意转移。
verses.textZhCuv: 王的心在耶和华手中， 好像陇沟的水随意流转。
verses.textEnNiv: In the Lord ’s hand the king’s heart is a stream of water that he channels toward all who please him.
verses.textEnEsv: The king’s heart is a stream of water in the hand of the Lord ; he turns it wherever he will.
verses.textEnNkjv: The king’s heart is in the hand of the Lord, Like the rivers of water; He turns it wherever He wishes.
verses.textEnNlt: The king’s heart is like a stream of water directed by the Lord ; he guides it wherever he pleases.
verses.textEnNasb: The king’s heart is like channels of water in the hand of the Lord; He turns it wherever He pleases.
verses.textEn: In the Lord ’s hand the king’s heart is a stream of water that he channels toward all who please him.

verses.textZh: 人看自己一切所行的，都是正直的； 耶和华却衡量人心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人看自己一切所行的，都是正直的； 耶和华却衡量人心。
verses.textZhCuv: 人所行的，在自己眼中都看为正； 惟有耶和华衡量人心。
verses.textEnNiv: A person may think their own ways are right, but the Lord weighs the heart.
verses.textEnEsv: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but the Lord weighs the heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, But the Lord weighs the hearts.
verses.textEnNlt: People may be right in their own eyes, but the Lord examines their heart.
verses.textEnNasb: Every person’s way is right in his own eyes, But the Lord examines the hearts.
verses.textEn: A person may think their own ways are right, but the Lord weighs the heart.

verses.textZh: 秉公行义， 比献祭更蒙耶和华悦纳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 秉公行义， 比献祭更蒙耶和华悦纳。
verses.textZhCuv: 行仁义公平 比献祭更蒙耶和华悦纳。
verses.textEnNiv: To do what is right and just is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice.
verses.textEnEsv: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice.
verses.textEnNkjv: To do righteousness and justice Is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is more pleased when we do what is right and just than when we offer him sacrifices.
verses.textEnNasb: To do righteousness and justice Is preferred by the Lord more than sacrifice.
verses.textEn: To do what is right and just is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice.

verses.textZh: 高傲的眼、傲慢的心， 恶人的灯，都是罪恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 高傲的眼、傲慢的心， 恶人的灯，都是罪恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人发达 ，眼高心傲， 这乃是罪。
verses.textEnNiv: Haughty eyes and a proud heart— the unplowed field of the wicked—produce sin.
verses.textEnEsv: Haughty eyes and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, are sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: A haughty look, a proud heart, And the plowing of the wicked are sin.
verses.textEnNlt: Haughty eyes, a proud heart, and evil actions are all sin.
verses.textEnNasb: Haughty eyes and a proud heart, The lamp of the wicked, is sin.
verses.textEn: Haughty eyes and a proud heart— the unplowed field of the wicked—produce sin.

verses.textZh: 殷勤人的筹划必使他获利； 行事急躁的必致贫穷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 殷勤人的筹划必使他获利； 行事急躁的必致贫穷。
verses.textZhCuv: 殷勤筹划的，足致丰裕； 行事急躁的，都必缺乏。
verses.textEnNiv: The plans of the diligent lead to profit as surely as haste leads to poverty.
verses.textEnEsv: The plans of the diligent lead surely to abundance, but everyone who is hasty comes only to poverty.
verses.textEnNkjv: The plans of the diligent lead surely to plenty, But thoseof everyone whois hasty, surely to poverty.
verses.textEnNlt: Good planning and hard work lead to prosperity, but hasty shortcuts lead to poverty.
verses.textEnNasb: The plans of the diligent certainly lead to advantage, But everyone who is in a hurry certainly comes to poverty.
verses.textEn: The plans of the diligent lead to profit as surely as haste leads to poverty.

verses.textZh: 凭撒谎的舌头得来的财宝， 是飘荡的浮云、死亡的追寻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凭撒谎的舌头得来的财宝， 是飘荡的浮云、死亡的追寻。
verses.textZhCuv: 用诡诈之舌求财的，就是自己取死； 所得之财乃是吹来吹去的浮云。
verses.textEnNiv: A fortune made by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor and a deadly snare.
verses.textEnEsv: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor and a snare of death.
verses.textEnNkjv: Getting treasures by a lying tongue Is the fleeting fantasy of those who seek death.
verses.textEnNlt: Wealth created by a lying tongue is a vanishing mist and a deadly trap.
verses.textEnNasb: The acquisition of treasures by a lying tongue Is a fleeting vapor, the pursuit of death.
verses.textEn: A fortune made by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor and a deadly snare.

verses.textZh: 恶人的暴行必拖累自己； 因为他们不肯秉行公正。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人的暴行必拖累自己； 因为他们不肯秉行公正。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人的强暴必将自己扫除， 因他们不肯按公平行事。
verses.textEnNiv: The violence of the wicked will drag them away, for they refuse to do what is right.
verses.textEnEsv: The violence of the wicked will sweep them away, because they refuse to do what is just.
verses.textEnNkjv: The violence of the wicked will destroy them, Because they refuse to do justice.
verses.textEnNlt: The violence of the wicked sweeps them away, because they refuse to do what is just.
verses.textEnNasb: The violence of the wicked will sweep them away, Because they refuse to act with justice.
verses.textEn: The violence of the wicked will drag them away, for they refuse to do what is right.

verses.textZh: 罪人的道路充满狡诈， 清洁的人，行为正直。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罪人的道路充满狡诈， 清洁的人，行为正直。
verses.textZhCuv: 负罪之人的路甚是弯曲； 至于清洁的人，他所行的乃是正直。
verses.textEnNiv: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.
verses.textEnEsv: The way of the guilty is crooked, but the conduct of the pure is upright.
verses.textEnNkjv: The way of a guilty man is perverse; But asfor the pure, his work is right.
verses.textEnNlt: The guilty walk a crooked path; the innocent travel a straight road.
verses.textEnNasb: The way of a guilty person is crooked, But as for the pure, his conduct is upright.
verses.textEn: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.

verses.textZh: 宁可住在房顶的一角， 也不跟吵闹的妇人同住一间房屋。
verses.textZhCnvs: 宁可住在房顶的一角， 也不跟吵闹的妇人同住一间房屋。
verses.textZhCuv: 宁可住在房顶的角上， 不在宽阔的房屋与争吵的妇人同住。
verses.textEnNiv: Better to live on a corner of the roof than share a house with a quarrelsome wife.
verses.textEnEsv: It is better to live in a corner of the housetop than in a house shared with a quarrelsome wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: Better to dwell in a corner of a housetop, Than in a house shared with a contentious woman.
verses.textEnNlt: It’s better to live alone in the corner of an attic than with a quarrelsome wife in a lovely home.
verses.textEnNasb: It is better to live on a corner of a roof Than in a house shared with a contentious woman.
verses.textEn: Better to live on a corner of the roof than share a house with a quarrelsome wife.

verses.textZh: 恶人的心只求邪恶， 他的眼并不顾惜邻舍。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人的心只求邪恶， 他的眼并不顾惜邻舍。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人的心乐人受祸； 他眼并不怜恤邻舍。
verses.textEnNiv: The wicked crave evil; their neighbors get no mercy from them.
verses.textEnEsv: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: The soul of the wicked desires evil; His neighbor finds no favor in his eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: Evil people desire evil; their neighbors get no mercy from them.
verses.textEnNasb: The soul of the wicked desires evil; His neighbor is shown no compassion in his eyes.
verses.textEn: The wicked crave evil; their neighbors get no mercy from them.

verses.textZh: 好讥笑人的受刑罚的时候，愚蒙人就得着智慧； 智慧人受训诲的时候，他就得着知识。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好讥笑人的受刑罚的时候，愚蒙人就得着智慧； 智慧人受训诲的时候，他就得着知识。
verses.textZhCuv: 亵慢的人受刑罚，愚蒙的人就得智慧； 智慧人受训诲，便得知识。
verses.textEnNiv: When a mocker is punished, the simple gain wisdom; by paying attention to the wise they get knowledge.
verses.textEnEsv: When a scoffer is punished, the simple becomes wise; when a wise man is instructed, he gains knowledge.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the scoffer is punished, the simple is made wise; But when the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.
verses.textEnNlt: If you punish a mocker, the simpleminded become wise; if you instruct the wise, they will be all the wiser.
verses.textEnNasb: When the scoffer is punished, the naive becomes wise; But when the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.
verses.textEn: When a mocker is punished, the simple gain wisdom; by paying attention to the wise they get knowledge.

verses.textZh: 公义的神留意恶人的家， 使恶人在祸患中毁灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 公义的神留意恶人的家， 使恶人在祸患中毁灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人思想恶人的家， 知道恶人倾倒，必致灭亡。
verses.textEnNiv: The Righteous One takes note of the house of the wicked and brings the wicked to ruin.
verses.textEnEsv: The Righteous One observes the house of the wicked; he throws the wicked down to ruin.
verses.textEnNkjv: The righteous God wisely considers the house of the wicked, Overthrowing the wicked for their wickedness.
verses.textEnNlt: The Righteous One knows what is going on in the homes of the wicked; he will bring disaster on them.
verses.textEnNasb: The righteous one considers the house of the wicked, Bringing the wicked to ruin.
verses.textEn: The Righteous One takes note of the house of the wicked and brings the wicked to ruin.

verses.textZh: 塞耳不听贫穷人呼求的， 他将来呼求，也得不到应允。
verses.textZhCnvs: 塞耳不听贫穷人呼求的， 他将来呼求，也得不到应允。
verses.textZhCuv: 塞耳不听穷人哀求的， 他将来呼吁也不蒙应允。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever shuts their ears to the cry of the poor will also cry out and not be answered.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever closes his ear to the cry of the poor will himself call out and not be answered.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever shuts his ears to the cry of the poor Will also cry himself and not be heard.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who shut their ears to the cries of the poor will be ignored in their own time of need.
verses.textEnNasb: One who shuts his ear to the outcry of the poor Will also call out himself, and not be answered.
verses.textEn: Whoever shuts their ears to the cry of the poor will also cry out and not be answered.

verses.textZh: 暗中送的礼物，可以平息怒气， 怀里藏的贿赂，能平息暴怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 暗中送的礼物，可以平息怒气， 怀里藏的贿赂，能平息暴怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 暗中送的礼物挽回怒气； 怀中搋的贿赂止息暴怒。
verses.textEnNiv: A gift given in secret soothes anger, and a bribe concealed in the cloak pacifies great wrath.
verses.textEnEsv: A gift in secret averts anger, and a concealed bribe, strong wrath.
verses.textEnNkjv: A gift in secret pacifies anger, And a bribe behind the back, strong wrath.
verses.textEnNlt: A secret gift calms anger; a bribe under the table pacifies fury.
verses.textEnNasb: A gift in secret subdues anger, And a bribe in an inside pocket, strong wrath.
verses.textEn: A gift given in secret soothes anger, and a bribe concealed in the cloak pacifies great wrath.

verses.textZh: 秉行公正，使义人喜乐， 却使作孽的人恐惧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 秉行公正，使义人喜乐， 却使作孽的人恐惧。
verses.textZhCuv: 秉公行义使义人喜乐， 使作孽的人败坏。
verses.textEnNiv: When justice is done, it brings joy to the righteous but terror to evildoers.
verses.textEnEsv: When justice is done, it is a joy to the righteous but terror to evildoers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis a joy for the just to do justice, But destruction willcome to the workers of iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: Justice is a joy to the godly, but it terrifies evildoers.
verses.textEnNasb: The exercise of justice is joy for the righteous, But terror to those who practice injustice.
verses.textEn: When justice is done, it brings joy to the righteous but terror to evildoers.

verses.textZh: 偏离明慧之道的人， 必住在阴魂的会中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 偏离明慧之道的人， 必住在阴魂的会中。
verses.textZhCuv: 迷离通达道路的， 必住在阴魂的会中。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever strays from the path of prudence comes to rest in the company of the dead.
verses.textEnEsv: One who wanders from the way of good sense will rest in the assembly of the dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: A man who wanders from the way of understanding Will rest in the assembly of the dead.
verses.textEnNlt: The person who strays from common sense will end up in the company of the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: A person who wanders from the way of understanding Will rest in the assembly of the dead.
verses.textEn: Whoever strays from the path of prudence comes to rest in the company of the dead.

verses.textZh: 贪爱享乐的，必成为穷乏人； 好酒爱脂油的，必不会富足。
verses.textZhCnvs: 贪爱享乐的，必成为穷乏人； 好酒爱脂油的，必不会富足。
verses.textZhCuv: 爱宴乐的，必致穷乏； 好酒，爱膏油的，必不富足。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever loves pleasure will become poor; whoever loves wine and olive oil will never be rich.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever loves pleasure will be a poor man; he who loves wine and oil will not be rich.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who loves pleasure willbe a poor man; He who loves wine and oil will not be rich.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who love pleasure become poor; those who love wine and luxury will never be rich.
verses.textEnNasb: One who loves pleasure will become a poor person; One who loves wine and oil will not become rich.
verses.textEn: Whoever loves pleasure will become poor; whoever loves wine and olive oil will never be rich.

verses.textZh: 恶人作了义人的赎价， 奸诈人作了正直人的替身。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人作了义人的赎价， 奸诈人作了正直人的替身。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人作了义人的赎价； 奸诈人代替正直人。
verses.textEnNiv: The wicked become a ransom for the righteous, and the unfaithful for the upright.
verses.textEnEsv: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, and the traitor for the upright.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wicked shallbe a ransom for the righteous, And the unfaithful for the upright.
verses.textEnNlt: The wicked are punished in place of the godly, and traitors in place of the honest.
verses.textEnNasb: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, And the treacherous is in the place of the upright.
verses.textEn: The wicked become a ransom for the righteous, and the unfaithful for the upright.

verses.textZh: 宁可住在野地， 也不跟吵闹易怒的妇人同住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 宁可住在野地， 也不跟吵闹易怒的妇人同住。
verses.textZhCuv: 宁可住在旷野， 不与争吵使气的妇人同住。
verses.textEnNiv: Better to live in a desert than with a quarrelsome and nagging wife.
verses.textEnEsv: It is better to live in a desert land than with a quarrelsome and fretful woman.
verses.textEnNkjv: Better to dwell in the wilderness, Than with a contentious and angry woman.
verses.textEnNlt: It’s better to live alone in the desert than with a quarrelsome, complaining wife.
verses.textEnNasb: It is better to live in a desert land Than with a contentious and irritating woman.
verses.textEn: Better to live in a desert than with a quarrelsome and nagging wife.

verses.textZh: 智慧人的居所中，积存珍贵的财物和油； 愚昧人却把他所有的挥霍耗尽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧人的居所中，积存珍贵的财物和油； 愚昧人却把他所有的挥霍耗尽。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧人家中积蓄宝物膏油； 愚昧人随得来随吞下。
verses.textEnNiv: The wise store up choice food and olive oil, but fools gulp theirs down.
verses.textEnEsv: Precious treasure and oil are in a wise man’s dwelling, but a foolish man devours it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thereis desirable treasure, And oil in the dwelling of the wise, But a foolish man squanders it.
verses.textEnNlt: The wise have wealth and luxury, but fools spend whatever they get.
verses.textEnNasb: There is precious treasure and oil in the home of the wise, But a foolish person swallows it up.
verses.textEn: The wise store up choice food and olive oil, but fools gulp theirs down.

verses.textZh: 追求公义与慈爱的， 必得着生命、公义和荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 追求公义与慈爱的， 必得着生命、公义和荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 追求公义仁慈的， 就寻得生命、公义，和尊荣。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever pursues righteousness and love finds life, prosperity and honor.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever pursues righteousness and kindness will find life, righteousness, and honor.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who follows righteousness and mercy Finds life, righteousness, and honor.
verses.textEnNlt: Whoever pursues righteousness and unfailing love will find life, righteousness, and honor.
verses.textEnNasb: One who pursues righteousness and loyalty Finds life, righteousness, and honor.
verses.textEn: Whoever pursues righteousness and love finds life, prosperity and honor.

verses.textZh: 智慧人登上勇士的城， 倾覆他倚靠的坚垒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧人登上勇士的城， 倾覆他倚靠的坚垒。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧人爬上勇士的城墙， 倾覆他所倚靠的坚垒。
verses.textEnNiv: One who is wise can go up against the city of the mighty and pull down the stronghold in which they trust.
verses.textEnEsv: A wise man scales the city of the mighty and brings down the stronghold in which they trust.
verses.textEnNkjv: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, And brings down the trusted stronghold.
verses.textEnNlt: The wise conquer the city of the strong and level the fortress in which they trust.
verses.textEnNasb: A wise person scales the city of the mighty And brings down the stronghold in which they trust.
verses.textEn: One who is wise can go up against the city of the mighty and pull down the stronghold in which they trust.

verses.textZh: 谨守口舌的， 保护自己免受患难。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谨守口舌的， 保护自己免受患难。
verses.textZhCuv: 谨守口与舌的， 就保守自己免受灾难。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who guard their mouths and their tongues keep themselves from calamity.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever keeps his mouth and his tongue keeps himself out of trouble.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever guards his mouth and tongue Keeps his soul from troubles.
verses.textEnNlt: Watch your tongue and keep your mouth shut, and you will stay out of trouble.
verses.textEnNasb: One who guards his mouth and his tongue, Guards his soul from troubles.
verses.textEn: Those who guard their mouths and their tongues keep themselves from calamity.

verses.textZh: 骄傲自大的人，他的名字是好讥笑人的； 他行事狂妄骄傲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 骄傲自大的人，他的名字是好讥笑人的； 他行事狂妄骄傲。
verses.textZhCuv: 心骄气傲的人名叫亵慢； 他行事狂妄，都出于骄傲。
verses.textEnNiv: The proud and arrogant person—"Mocker" is his name— behaves with insolent fury.
verses.textEnEsv: "Scoffer" is the name of the arrogant, haughty man who acts with arrogant pride.
verses.textEnNkjv: A proud and haughty man— "Scoffer" is his name; He acts with arrogant pride.
verses.textEnNlt: Mockers are proud and haughty; they act with boundless arrogance.
verses.textEnNasb: "Proud," "Arrogant," "Scoffer," are his names, One who acts with insolent pride.
verses.textEn: The proud and arrogant person—"Mocker" is his name— behaves with insolent fury.

verses.textZh: 懒惰人的愿望害死自己， 因为他的手不肯工作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 懒惰人的愿望害死自己， 因为他的手不肯工作。
verses.textZhCuv: 懒惰人的心愿将他杀害， 因为他手不肯做工。
verses.textEnNiv: The craving of a sluggard will be the death of him, because his hands refuse to work.
verses.textEnEsv: The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.
verses.textEnNkjv: The desire of the lazy man kills him, For his hands refuse to labor.
verses.textEnNlt: Despite their desires, the lazy will come to ruin, for their hands refuse to work.
verses.textEnNasb: The desire of the lazy one puts him to death, For his hands refuse to work;
verses.textEn: The craving of a sluggard will be the death of him, because his hands refuse to work.

verses.textZh: 他终日贪得无厌， 但义人施予毫不吝啬。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他终日贪得无厌， 但义人施予毫不吝啬。
verses.textZhCuv: 有终日贪得无厌的； 义人施舍而不吝惜。
verses.textEnNiv: All day long he craves for more, but the righteous give without sparing.
verses.textEnEsv: All day long he craves and craves, but the righteous gives and does not hold back.
verses.textEnNkjv: He covets greedily all day long, But the righteous gives and does not spare.
verses.textEnNlt: Some people are always greedy for more, but the godly love to give!
verses.textEnNasb: All day long he is craving, While the righteous gives and does not hold back.
verses.textEn: All day long he craves for more, but the righteous give without sparing.

verses.textZh: 恶人的祭物是耶和华所厌恶的， 更何况是怀着恶念来献的呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人的祭物是耶和华所厌恶的， 更何况是怀着恶念来献的呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人的祭物是可憎的； 何况他存恶意来献呢？
verses.textEnNiv: The sacrifice of the wicked is detestable— how much more so when brought with evil intent!
verses.textEnEsv: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination; how much more when he brings it with evil intent.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination; How much more when he brings it with wicked intent!
verses.textEnNlt: The sacrifice of an evil person is detestable, especially when it is offered with wrong motives.
verses.textEnNasb: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination, How much more when he brings it with evil intent!
verses.textEn: The sacrifice of the wicked is detestable— how much more so when brought with evil intent!

verses.textZh: 作假见证的必要灭亡， 聆听真情的人，他的话长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 作假见证的必要灭亡， 聆听真情的人，他的话长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 作假见证的必灭亡； 惟有听真情而言的，其言长存。
verses.textEnNiv: A false witness will perish, but a careful listener will testify successfully.
verses.textEnEsv: A false witness will perish, but the word of a man who hears will endure.
verses.textEnNkjv: A false witness shall perish, But the man who hears him will speak endlessly.
verses.textEnNlt: A false witness will be cut off, but a credible witness will be allowed to speak.
verses.textEnNasb: A false witness will perish, But a person who listens will speak forever.
verses.textEn: A false witness will perish, but a careful listener will testify successfully.

verses.textZh: 恶人厚颜无耻， 正直人却坚定他的道路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人厚颜无耻， 正直人却坚定他的道路。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人脸无羞耻； 正直人行事坚定。
verses.textEnNiv: The wicked put up a bold front, but the upright give thought to their ways.
verses.textEnEsv: A wicked man puts on a bold face, but the upright gives thought to his ways.
verses.textEnNkjv: A wicked man hardens his face, But asfor the upright, he establishes his way.
verses.textEnNlt: The wicked bluff their way through, but the virtuous think before they act.
verses.textEnNasb: A wicked person displays a bold face, But as for the upright, he makes his way sure.
verses.textEn: The wicked put up a bold front, but the upright give thought to their ways.

verses.textZh: 任何智慧、聪明、 谋略都不能敌挡耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 任何智慧、聪明、 谋略都不能敌挡耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 没有人能以智慧、聪明、 谋略敌挡耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: There is no wisdom, no insight, no plan that can succeed against the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: No wisdom, no understanding, no counsel can avail against the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Thereis no wisdom or understanding Or counsel against the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: No human wisdom or understanding or plan can stand against the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: There is no wisdom, no understanding, And no plan against the Lord.
verses.textEn: There is no wisdom, no insight, no plan that can succeed against the Lord .

verses.textZh: 马是为打仗之日预备的， 胜利却在于耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 马是为打仗之日预备的， 胜利却在于耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 马是为打仗之日预备的； 得胜乃在乎耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: The horse is made ready for the day of battle, but victory rests with the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: The horse is made ready for the day of battle, but the victory belongs to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: The horse is prepared for the day of battle, But deliverance is of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The horse is prepared for the day of battle, but the victory belongs to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: The horse is prepared for the day of battle, But the victory belongs to the Lord.
verses.textEn: The horse is made ready for the day of battle, but victory rests with the Lord .

verses.textZh: 名誉胜过多财， 恩宠胜过金银。
verses.textZhCnvs: 名誉胜过多财， 恩宠胜过金银。
verses.textZhCuv: 美名胜过大财； 恩宠强如金银。
verses.textEnNiv: A good name is more desirable than great riches; to be esteemed is better than silver or gold.
verses.textEnEsv: A good name is to be chosen rather than great riches, and favor is better than silver or gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: A good name is to be chosen rather than great riches, Loving favor rather than silver and gold.
verses.textEnNlt: Choose a good reputation over great riches; being held in high esteem is better than silver or gold.
verses.textEnNasb: A good name is to be more desired than great wealth; Favor is better than silver and gold.
verses.textEn: A good name is more desirable than great riches; to be esteemed is better than silver or gold.

verses.textZh: 世上有财主，也有穷人， 两者都是耶和华所造的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 世上有财主，也有穷人， 两者都是耶和华所造的。
verses.textZhCuv: 富户穷人在世相遇， 都为耶和华所造。
verses.textEnNiv: Rich and poor have this in common: The Lord is the Maker of them all.
verses.textEnEsv: The rich and the poor meet together; the Lord is the Maker of them all.
verses.textEnNkjv: The rich and the poor have this in common, The Lordis the maker of them all.
verses.textEnNlt: The rich and poor have this in common: The Lord made them both.
verses.textEnNasb: The rich and the poor have a common bond, The Lord is the Maker of them all.
verses.textEn: Rich and poor have this in common: The Lord is the Maker of them all.

verses.textZh: 精明人看见灾祸，就躲藏起来； 愚蒙人却往前走，自取祸害。
verses.textZhCnvs: 精明人看见灾祸，就躲藏起来； 愚蒙人却往前走，自取祸害。
verses.textZhCuv: 通达人见祸藏躲； 愚蒙人前往受害。
verses.textEnNiv: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verses.textEnEsv: The prudent sees danger and hides himself, but the simple go on and suffer for it.
verses.textEnNkjv: A prudent man foresees evil and hides himself, But the simple pass on and are punished.
verses.textEnNlt: A prudent person foresees danger and takes precautions. The simpleton goes blindly on and suffers the consequences.
verses.textEnNasb: A prudent person sees evil and hides himself, But the naive proceed, and pay the penalty.
verses.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.

verses.textZh: 谦卑和敬畏耶和华的赏赐， 就是财富、荣耀和生命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谦卑和敬畏耶和华的赏赐， 就是财富、荣耀和生命。
verses.textZhCuv: 敬畏耶和华心存谦卑， 就得富有、尊荣、生命为赏赐。
verses.textEnNiv: Humility is the fear of the Lord ; its wages are riches and honor and life.
verses.textEnEsv: The reward for humility and fear of the Lord is riches and honor and life.
verses.textEnNkjv: By humility and the fear of the Lord Are riches and honor and life.
verses.textEnNlt: True humility and fear of the Lord lead to riches, honor, and long life.
verses.textEnNasb: The reward of humility and the fear of the Lord Are riches, honor, and life.
verses.textEn: Humility is the fear of the Lord ; its wages are riches and honor and life.

verses.textZh: 奸诈人的道路，满布荆棘和网罗； 谨慎自己的，必远离这些。
verses.textZhCnvs: 奸诈人的道路，满布荆棘和网罗； 谨慎自己的，必远离这些。
verses.textZhCuv: 乖僻人的路上有荆棘和网罗； 保守自己生命的，必要远离。
verses.textEnNiv: In the paths of the wicked are snares and pitfalls, but those who would preserve their life stay far from them.
verses.textEnEsv: Thorns and snares are in the way of the crooked; whoever guards his soul will keep far from them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thorns and snares are in the way of the perverse; He who guards his soul will be far from them.
verses.textEnNlt: Corrupt people walk a thorny, treacherous road; whoever values life will avoid it.
verses.textEnNasb: Thorns and snares are in the way of the perverse; One who guards himself will be far from them.
verses.textEn: In the paths of the wicked are snares and pitfalls, but those who would preserve their life stay far from them.

verses.textZh: 教养孩童走他当行的路， 就是到老，他也不会偏离。
verses.textZhCnvs: 教养孩童走他当行的路， 就是到老，他也不会偏离。
verses.textZhCuv: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道， 就是到老他也不偏离。
verses.textEnNiv: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.
verses.textEnEsv: Train up a child in the way he should go; even when he is old he will not depart from it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Train up a child in the way he should go, And when he is old he will not depart from it.
verses.textEnNlt: Direct your children onto the right path, and when they are older, they will not leave it.
verses.textEnNasb: Train up a child in the way he should go, Even when he grows older he will not abandon it.
verses.textEn: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.

verses.textZh: 财主管辖穷人， 欠债的作债主的奴仆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 财主管辖穷人， 欠债的作债主的奴仆。
verses.textZhCuv: 富户管辖穷人； 欠债的是债主的仆人。
verses.textEnNiv: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is slave to the lender.
verses.textEnEsv: The rich rules over the poor, and the borrower is the slave of the lender.
verses.textEnNkjv: The rich rules over the poor, And the borrower is servant to the lender.
verses.textEnNlt: Just as the rich rule the poor, so the borrower is servant to the lender.
verses.textEnNasb: The rich rules over the poor, And the borrower becomes the lender’s slave.
verses.textEn: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is slave to the lender.

verses.textZh: 散播邪恶的，必收祸害； 他忿怒的杖终必毁掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 散播邪恶的，必收祸害； 他忿怒的杖终必毁掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒罪孽的，必收灾祸； 他逞怒的杖也必废掉。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever sows injustice reaps calamity, and the rod they wield in fury will be broken.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever sows injustice will reap calamity, and the rod of his fury will fail.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who sows iniquity will reap sorrow, And the rod of his anger will fail.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who plant injustice will harvest disaster, and their reign of terror will come to an end.
verses.textEnNasb: One who sows injustice will reap disaster, And the rod of his fury will perish.
verses.textEn: Whoever sows injustice reaps calamity, and the rod they wield in fury will be broken.

verses.textZh: 心存良善看人的，必蒙赐福； 因为他把自己的食物分给穷人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 心存良善看人的，必蒙赐福； 因为他把自己的食物分给穷人。
verses.textZhCuv: 眼目慈善的，就必蒙福， 因他将食物分给穷人。
verses.textEnNiv: The generous will themselves be blessed, for they share their food with the poor.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever has a bountiful eye will be blessed, for he shares his bread with the poor.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who has a generous eye will be blessed, For he gives of his bread to the poor.
verses.textEnNlt: Blessed are those who are generous, because they feed the poor.
verses.textEnNasb: One who is generous will be blessed, Because he gives some of his food to the poor.
verses.textEn: The generous will themselves be blessed, for they share their food with the poor.

verses.textZh: 赶走好讥笑人的，纷争就除去； 争执和耻辱也必止息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 赶走好讥笑人的，纷争就除去； 争执和耻辱也必止息。
verses.textZhCuv: 赶出亵慢人，争端就消除； 纷争和羞辱也必止息。
verses.textEnNiv: Drive out the mocker, and out goes strife; quarrels and insults are ended.
verses.textEnEsv: Drive out a scoffer, and strife will go out, and quarreling and abuse will cease.
verses.textEnNkjv: Cast out the scoffer, and contention will leave; Yes, strife and reproach will cease.
verses.textEnNlt: Throw out the mocker, and fighting goes, too. Quarrels and insults will disappear.
verses.textEnNasb: Drive out the scoffer, and strife will leave, Even quarreling and dishonor will cease.
verses.textEn: Drive out the mocker, and out goes strife; quarrels and insults are ended.

verses.textZh: 喜爱内心洁净，嘴上有恩言的， 君王要作他的朋友。
verses.textZhCnvs: 喜爱内心洁净，嘴上有恩言的， 君王要作他的朋友。
verses.textZhCuv: 喜爱清心的人因他嘴上的恩言， 王必与他为友。
verses.textEnNiv: One who loves a pure heart and who speaks with grace will have the king for a friend.
verses.textEnEsv: He who loves purity of heart, and whose speech is gracious, will have the king as his friend.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who loves purity of heart Andhas grace on his lips, The king willbe his friend.
verses.textEnNlt: Whoever loves a pure heart and gracious speech will have the king as a friend.
verses.textEnNasb: One who loves purity of heart And whose speech is gracious, the king is his friend.
verses.textEn: One who loves a pure heart and who speaks with grace will have the king for a friend.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的眼目护卫知识， 却倾覆奸诈人的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的眼目护卫知识， 却倾覆奸诈人的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的眼目眷顾聪明人， 却倾败奸诈人的言语。
verses.textEnNiv: The eyes of the Lord keep watch over knowledge, but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.
verses.textEnEsv: The eyes of the Lord keep watch over knowledge, but he overthrows the words of the traitor.
verses.textEnNkjv: The eyes of the Lord preserve knowledge, But He overthrows the words of the faithless.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord preserves those with knowledge, but he ruins the plans of the treacherous.
verses.textEnNasb: The eyes of the Lord protect knowledge, But He overthrows the words of the treacherous person.
verses.textEn: The eyes of the Lord keep watch over knowledge, but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.

verses.textZh: 懒惰人说："外面有狮子， 我在街上必被杀害。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 懒惰人说："外面有狮子， 我在街上必被杀害。"
verses.textZhCuv: 懒惰人说：外头有狮子； 我在街上就必被杀。
verses.textEnNiv: The sluggard says, "There’s a lion outside! I’ll be killed in the public square!"
verses.textEnEsv: The sluggard says, "There is a lion outside! I shall be killed in the streets!"
verses.textEnNkjv: The lazy man says, "Thereis a lion outside! I shall be slain in the streets!"
verses.textEnNlt: The lazy person claims, "There’s a lion out there! If I go outside, I might be killed!"
verses.textEnNasb: The lazy one says, "There is a lion outside; I will be killed in the streets!"
verses.textEn: The sluggard says, "There’s a lion outside! I’ll be killed in the public square!"

verses.textZh: 淫妇的口是深坑， 耶和华所恼恨的必陷在其中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 淫妇的口是深坑， 耶和华所恼恨的必陷在其中。
verses.textZhCuv: 淫妇的口为深坑； 耶和华所憎恶的，必陷在其中。
verses.textEnNiv: The mouth of an adulterous woman is a deep pit; a man who is under the Lord ’s wrath falls into it.
verses.textEnEsv: The mouth of forbidden women is a deep pit; he with whom the Lord is angry will fall into it.
verses.textEnNkjv: The mouth of an immoral woman is a deep pit; He who is abhorred by the Lord will fall there.
verses.textEnNlt: The mouth of an immoral woman is a dangerous trap; those who make the Lord angry will fall into it.
verses.textEnNasb: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit; He who is cursed of the Lord will fall into it.
verses.textEn: The mouth of an adulterous woman is a deep pit; a man who is under the Lord ’s wrath falls into it.

verses.textZh: 愚妄束缚孩童的心， 管教的杖可以把愚妄远远驱除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚妄束缚孩童的心， 管教的杖可以把愚妄远远驱除。
verses.textZhCuv: 愚蒙迷住孩童的心， 用管教的杖可以远远赶除。
verses.textEnNiv: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child, but the rod of discipline will drive it far away.
verses.textEnEsv: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child, but the rod of discipline drives it far from him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Foolishness is bound up in the heart of a child; The rod of correction will drive it far from him.
verses.textEnNlt: A youngster’s heart is filled with foolishness, but physical discipline will drive it far away.
verses.textEnNasb: Foolishness is bound up in the heart of a child; The rod of discipline will remove it far from him.
verses.textEn: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child, but the rod of discipline will drive it far away.

verses.textZh: 欺压穷人为要增加自己财富的， 送礼给财主的，必致穷乏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 欺压穷人为要增加自己财富的， 送礼给财主的，必致穷乏。
verses.textZhCuv: 欺压贫穷为要利己的， 并送礼与富户的，都必缺乏。
verses.textEnNiv: One who oppresses the poor to increase his wealth and one who gives gifts to the rich—both come to poverty.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever oppresses the poor to increase his own wealth, or gives to the rich, will only come to poverty.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who oppresses the poor to increase his riches, And he who gives to the rich, will surely come to poverty.
verses.textEnNlt: A person who gets ahead by oppressing the poor or by showering gifts on the rich will end in poverty.
verses.textEnNasb: One who oppresses the poor to make more for himself, Or gives to the rich, will only come to poverty.
verses.textEn: One who oppresses the poor to increase his wealth and one who gives gifts to the rich—both come to poverty.

verses.textZh: 你要留心听智慧人的言语， 专心领受我的知识。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要留心听智慧人的言语， 专心领受我的知识。
verses.textZhCuv: 你须侧耳听受智慧人的言语， 留心领会我的知识。
verses.textEnNiv: Pay attention and turn your ear to the sayings of the wise; apply your heart to what I teach,
verses.textEnEsv: Incline your ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply your heart to my knowledge,
verses.textEnNkjv: Incline your ear and hear the words of the wise, And apply your heart to my knowledge;
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to the words of the wise; apply your heart to my instruction.
verses.textEnNasb: Extend your ear and hear the words of the wise, And apply your mind to my knowledge;
verses.textEn: Pay attention and turn your ear to the sayings of the wise; apply your heart to what I teach,

verses.textZh: 如果你心里谨守， 嘴唇上常常诵念这一切，自会觉得甘美。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你心里谨守， 嘴唇上常常诵念这一切，自会觉得甘美。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若心中存记， 嘴上咬定，这便为美。
verses.textEnNiv: for it is pleasing when you keep them in your heart and have all of them ready on your lips.
verses.textEnEsv: for it will be pleasant if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.
verses.textEnNkjv: For itis a pleasant thing if you keep them within you; Let them all be fixed upon your lips,
verses.textEnNlt: For it is good to keep these sayings in your heart and always ready on your lips.
verses.textEnNasb: For it will be pleasant if you keep them within you, So that they may be ready on your lips.
verses.textEn: for it is pleasing when you keep them in your heart and have all of them ready on your lips.

verses.textZh: 我今日特别指教你， 为要使你倚靠耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我今日特别指教你， 为要使你倚靠耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 我今日以此特特指教你， 为要使你倚靠耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: So that your trust may be in the Lord , I teach you today, even you.
verses.textEnEsv: That your trust may be in the Lord , I have made them known to you today, even to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: So that your trust may be in the Lord; I have instructed you today, even you.
verses.textEnNlt: I am teaching you today—yes, you— so you will trust in the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So that your trust may be in the Lord, I have taught you today, you indeed.
verses.textEn: So that your trust may be in the Lord , I teach you today, even you.

verses.textZh: 我不是曾经给你们写下 有关谋略和知识的事吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我不是曾经给你们写下 有关谋略和知识的事吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 谋略和知识的美事， 我岂没有写给你吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Have I not written thirty sayings for you, sayings of counsel and knowledge,
verses.textEnEsv: Have I not written for you thirty sayings of counsel and knowledge,
verses.textEnNkjv: Have I not written to you excellent things Of counsels and knowledge,
verses.textEnNlt: I have written thirty sayings for you, filled with advice and knowledge.
verses.textEnNasb: Have I not written to you excellent things Of counsels and knowledge,
verses.textEn: Have I not written thirty sayings for you, sayings of counsel and knowledge,

verses.textZh: 要教你认识确实的真理， 使你把真理回复那差派你来的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要教你认识确实的真理， 使你把真理回复那差派你来的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 要使你知道真言的实理， 你好将真言回复那打发你来的人。
verses.textEnNiv: teaching you to be honest and to speak the truth, so that you bring back truthful reports to those you serve?
verses.textEnEsv: to make you know what is right and true, that you may give a true answer to those who sent you?
verses.textEnNkjv: That I may make you know the certainty of the words of truth, That you may answer words of truth To those who send to you?
verses.textEnNlt: In this way, you may know the truth and take an accurate report to those who sent you.
verses.textEnNasb: To make you know the certainty of the words of truth, So that you may correctly answer him who sent you?
verses.textEn: teaching you to be honest and to speak the truth, so that you bring back truthful reports to those you serve?

verses.textZh: 你不可因为贫穷人穷乏，就抢夺他的东西， 也不可在城门口欺压穷苦人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可因为贫穷人穷乏，就抢夺他的东西， 也不可在城门口欺压穷苦人。
verses.textZhCuv: 贫穷人，你不可因他贫穷就抢夺他的物， 也不可在城门口欺压困苦人；
verses.textEnNiv: Do not exploit the poor because they are poor and do not crush the needy in court,
verses.textEnEsv: Do not rob the poor, because he is poor, or crush the afflicted at the gate,
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not rob the poor because he is poor, Nor oppress the afflicted at the gate;
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t rob the poor just because you can, or exploit the needy in court.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not rob the poor because he is poor, Nor crush the needy at the gate;
verses.textEn: Do not exploit the poor because they are poor and do not crush the needy in court,

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华必为他们伸冤， 抢夺他们的，耶和华也必夺取那人的性命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华必为他们伸冤， 抢夺他们的，耶和华也必夺取那人的性命。
verses.textZhCuv: 因耶和华必为他辨屈； 抢夺他的，耶和华必夺取那人的命。
verses.textEnNiv: for the Lord will take up their case and will exact life for life.
verses.textEnEsv: for the Lord will plead their cause and rob of life those who rob them.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord will plead their cause, And plunder the soul of those who plunder them.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord is their defender. He will ruin anyone who ruins them.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord will plead their case And take the life of those who rob them.
verses.textEn: for the Lord will take up their case and will exact life for life.

verses.textZh: 容易发怒的人，不要与他为友； 脾气暴躁的人，不要与他来往，
verses.textZhCnvs: 容易发怒的人，不要与他为友； 脾气暴躁的人，不要与他来往，
verses.textZhCuv: 好生气的人，不可与他结交； 暴怒的人，不可与他来往；
verses.textEnNiv: Do not make friends with a hot-tempered person, do not associate with one easily angered,
verses.textEnEsv: Make no friendship with a man given to anger, nor go with a wrathful man,
verses.textEnNkjv: Make no friendship with an angry man, And with a furious man do not go,
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t befriend angry people or associate with hot-tempered people,
verses.textEnNasb: Do not make friends with a person given to anger, Or go with a hot-tempered person,
verses.textEn: Do not make friends with a hot-tempered person, do not associate with one easily angered,

verses.textZh: 免得你效法他的行径， 自己就陷在网罗里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 免得你效法他的行径， 自己就陷在网罗里。
verses.textZhCuv: 恐怕你效法他的行为， 自己就陷在网罗里。
verses.textEnNiv: or you may learn their ways and get yourself ensnared.
verses.textEnEsv: lest you learn his ways and entangle yourself in a snare.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lest you learn his ways And set a snare for your soul.
verses.textEnNlt: or you will learn to be like them and endanger your soul.
verses.textEnNasb: Or you will learn his ways And find a snare for yourself.
verses.textEn: or you may learn their ways and get yourself ensnared.

verses.textZh: 不要替别人击掌担保， 也不可为欠债的作保证人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要替别人击掌担保， 也不可为欠债的作保证人。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要与人击掌， 不要为欠债的作保。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be one who shakes hands in pledge or puts up security for debts;
verses.textEnEsv: Be not one of those who give pledges, who put up security for debts.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not be one of those who shakes hands in a pledge, One of those who is surety for debts;
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t agree to guarantee another person’s debt or put up security for someone else.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not be among those who shake hands, Among those who become guarantors for debts.
verses.textEn: Do not be one who shakes hands in pledge or puts up security for debts;

verses.textZh: 如果你没有甚么可以偿还， 何必使人连你睡觉的床也夺去呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你没有甚么可以偿还， 何必使人连你睡觉的床也夺去呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你若没有什么偿还， 何必使人夺去你睡卧的床呢？
verses.textEnNiv: if you lack the means to pay, your very bed will be snatched from under you.
verses.textEnEsv: If you have nothing with which to pay, why should your bed be taken from under you?
verses.textEnNkjv: If you have nothing withwhich to pay, Why should he take away your bed from under you?
verses.textEnNlt: If you can’t pay it, even your bed will be snatched from under you.
verses.textEnNasb: If you have nothing with which to repay, Why should he take your bed from under you?
verses.textEn: if you lack the means to pay, your very bed will be snatched from under you.

verses.textZh: 你的祖先立定古时的地界， 你不可迁移。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的祖先立定古时的地界， 你不可迁移。
verses.textZhCuv: 你先祖所立的地界， 你不可挪移。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not move an ancient boundary stone set up by your ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not move the ancient landmark that your fathers have set.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not remove the ancient landmark Which your fathers have set.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t cheat your neighbor by moving the ancient boundary markers set up by previous generations.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not move the ancient boundary Which your fathers have set.
verses.textEn: Do not move an ancient boundary stone set up by your ancestors.

verses.textZh: 你见过办事能干的人吗？ 他必侍立在君王面前， 必不会侍立在低微的人面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你见过办事能干的人吗？ 他必侍立在君王面前， 必不会侍立在低微的人面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 你看见办事殷勤的人吗？ 他必站在君王面前， 必不站在下贱人面前。
verses.textEnNiv: Do you see someone skilled in their work? They will serve before kings; they will not serve before officials of low rank.
verses.textEnEsv: Do you see a man skillful in his work? He will stand before kings; he will not stand before obscure men.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you see a man who excels in his work? He will stand before kings; He will not stand before unknown men.
verses.textEnNlt: Do you see any truly competent workers? They will serve kings rather than working for ordinary people.
verses.textEnNasb: Do you see a person skilled in his work? He will stand before kings; He will not stand before obscure people.
verses.textEn: Do you see someone skilled in their work? They will serve before kings; they will not serve before officials of low rank.

verses.textZh: 你与官长一起坐席吃饭的时候， 要特别留意在你面前的是谁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你与官长一起坐席吃饭的时候， 要特别留意在你面前的是谁。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若与官长坐席， 要留意在你面前的是谁。
verses.textEnNiv: When you sit to dine with a ruler, note well what is before you,
verses.textEnEsv: When you sit down to eat with a ruler, observe carefully what is before you,
verses.textEnNkjv: When you sit down to eat with a ruler, Consider carefully what is before you;
verses.textEnNlt: While dining with a ruler, pay attention to what is put before you.
verses.textEnNasb: When you sit down to dine with a ruler, Consider carefully what is before you,
verses.textEn: When you sit to dine with a ruler, note well what is before you,

verses.textZh: 你若是个贪吃的人， 就当把刀子放在喉咙上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你若是个贪吃的人， 就当把刀子放在喉咙上。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若是贪食的， 就当拿刀放在喉咙上。
verses.textEnNiv: and put a knife to your throat if you are given to gluttony.
verses.textEnEsv: and put a knife to your throat if you are given to appetite.
verses.textEnNkjv: And put a knife to your throat If you are a man given to appetite.
verses.textEnNlt: If you are a big eater, put a knife to your throat;
verses.textEnNasb: And put a knife to your throat If you are a person of great appetite.
verses.textEn: and put a knife to your throat if you are given to gluttony.

verses.textZh: 不可贪恋他的美食， 因为那是骗人的食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可贪恋他的美食， 因为那是骗人的食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可贪恋他的美食， 因为是哄人的食物。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not crave his delicacies, for that food is deceptive.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not desire his delicacies, for they are deceptive food.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not desire his delicacies, For they are deceptive food.
verses.textEnNlt: don’t desire all the delicacies, for he might be trying to trick you.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not desire his delicacies, For it is deceptive food.
verses.textEn: Do not crave his delicacies, for that food is deceptive.

verses.textZh: 不要劳碌求富， 你要明智地放下这企图。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要劳碌求富， 你要明智地放下这企图。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要劳碌求富， 休仗自己的聪明。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not wear yourself out to get rich; do not trust your own cleverness.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not toil to acquire wealth; be discerning enough to desist.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not overwork to be rich; Because of your own understanding, cease!
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t wear yourself out trying to get rich. Be wise enough to know when to quit.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not weary yourself to gain wealth; Stop dwelling on it.
verses.textEn: Do not wear yourself out to get rich; do not trust your own cleverness.

verses.textZh: 你的眼睛注视在钱财上，钱财却不见了， 因为钱财必长起翅膀， 如鹰飞往天上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的眼睛注视在钱财上，钱财却不见了， 因为钱财必长起翅膀， 如鹰飞往天上。
verses.textZhCuv: 你岂要定睛在虚无的钱财上吗？ 因钱财必长翅膀，如鹰向天飞去。
verses.textEnNiv: Cast but a glance at riches, and they are gone, for they will surely sprout wings and fly off to the sky like an eagle.
verses.textEnEsv: When your eyes light on it, it is gone, for suddenly it sprouts wings, flying like an eagle toward heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: Will you set your eyes on that which is not? For riches certainly make themselves wings; They fly away like an eagle toward heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: In the blink of an eye wealth disappears, for it will sprout wings and fly away like an eagle.
verses.textEnNasb: When you set your eyes on it, it is gone. For wealth certainly makes itself wings Like an eagle that flies toward the heavens.
verses.textEn: Cast but a glance at riches, and they are gone, for they will surely sprout wings and fly off to the sky like an eagle.

verses.textZh: 不可吃吝啬人的饭， 也不可贪恋他的美食。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可吃吝啬人的饭， 也不可贪恋他的美食。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要吃恶眼人的饭， 也不要贪他的美味；
verses.textEnNiv: Do not eat the food of a begrudging host, do not crave his delicacies;
verses.textEnEsv: Do not eat the bread of a man who is stingy; do not desire his delicacies,
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not eat the bread of a miser, Nor desire his delicacies;
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t eat with people who are stingy; don’t desire their delicacies.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not eat the bread of a selfish person; Or desire his delicacies;
verses.textEn: Do not eat the food of a begrudging host, do not crave his delicacies;

verses.textZh: 因为他心里怎样计算，他的为人就是怎样； 他虽然对你说："请吃，请喝！" 他的心里却没有你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他心里怎样计算，他的为人就是怎样； 他虽然对你说："请吃，请喝！" 他的心里却没有你。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他心怎样思量， 他为人就是怎样。 他虽对你说，请吃，请喝， 他的心却与你相背。
verses.textEnNiv: for he is the kind of person who is always thinking about the cost. "Eat and drink," he says to you, but his heart is not with you.
verses.textEnEsv: for he is like one who is inwardly calculating. "Eat and drink!" he says to you, but his heart is not with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For as he thinks in his heart, so is he. "Eat and drink!" he says to you, But his heart is not with you.
verses.textEnNlt: They are always thinking about how much it costs. "Eat and drink," they say, but they don’t mean it.
verses.textEnNasb: For as he thinks within himself, so he is. He says to you, "Eat and drink!" But his heart is not with you.
verses.textEn: for he is the kind of person who is always thinking about the cost. "Eat and drink," he says to you, but his heart is not with you.

verses.textZh: 你所吃的那一点食物，必要吐出来， 你道谢的美言，也都白费了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你所吃的那一点食物，必要吐出来， 你道谢的美言，也都白费了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你所吃的那点食物必吐出来； 你所说的甘美言语也必落空。
verses.textEnNiv: You will vomit up the little you have eaten and will have wasted your compliments.
verses.textEnEsv: You will vomit up the morsels that you have eaten, and waste your pleasant words.
verses.textEnNkjv: The morsel you have eaten, you will vomit up, And waste your pleasant words.
verses.textEnNlt: You will throw up what little you’ve eaten, and your compliments will be wasted.
verses.textEnNasb: You will vomit up the morsel you have eaten And waste your compliments.
verses.textEn: You will vomit up the little you have eaten and will have wasted your compliments.

verses.textZh: 不要说话给愚昧人听， 因为他必藐视你明慧的言语。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要说话给愚昧人听， 因为他必藐视你明慧的言语。
verses.textZhCuv: 你不要说话给愚昧人听， 因他必藐视你智慧的言语。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not speak to fools, for they will scorn your prudent words.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not speak in the hearing of a fool, for he will despise the good sense of your words.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not speak in the hearing of a fool, For he will despise the wisdom of your words.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t waste your breath on fools, for they will despise the wisest advice.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not speak to be heard by a fool, For he will despise the wisdom of your words.
verses.textEn: Do not speak to fools, for they will scorn your prudent words.

verses.textZh: 你不可迁移古时的地界； 也不可侵占孤儿的田地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可迁移古时的地界； 也不可侵占孤儿的田地。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可挪移古时的地界， 也不可侵入孤儿的田地；
verses.textEnNiv: Do not move an ancient boundary stone or encroach on the fields of the fatherless,
verses.textEnEsv: Do not move an ancient landmark or enter the fields of the fatherless,
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not remove the ancient landmark, Nor enter the fields of the fatherless;
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t cheat your neighbor by moving the ancient boundary markers; don’t take the land of defenseless orphans.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not move the ancient boundary Or go into the fields of the fatherless,
verses.textEn: Do not move an ancient boundary stone or encroach on the fields of the fatherless,

verses.textZh: 因为他们的救赎主大有能力， 他必向你为他们的案件伸冤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们的救赎主大有能力， 他必向你为他们的案件伸冤。
verses.textZhCuv: 因他们的救赎主大有能力， 他必向你为他们辨屈。
verses.textEnNiv: for their Defender is strong; he will take up their case against you.
verses.textEnEsv: for their Redeemer is strong; he will plead their cause against you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For their Redeemer is mighty; He will plead their cause against you.
verses.textEnNlt: For their Redeemer is strong; he himself will bring their charges against you.
verses.textEnNasb: For their Redeemer is strong; He will plead their case against you.
verses.textEn: for their Defender is strong; he will take up their case against you.

verses.textZh: 你要专心领受教训， 留心听知识的言语。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要专心领受教训， 留心听知识的言语。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要留心领受训诲， 侧耳听从知识的言语。
verses.textEnNiv: Apply your heart to instruction and your ears to words of knowledge.
verses.textEnEsv: Apply your heart to instruction and your ear to words of knowledge.
verses.textEnNkjv: Apply your heart to instruction, And your ears to words of knowledge.
verses.textEnNlt: Commit yourself to instruction; listen carefully to words of knowledge.
verses.textEnNasb: Apply your heart to discipline, And your ears to words of knowledge.
verses.textEn: Apply your heart to instruction and your ears to words of knowledge.

verses.textZh: 要管教孩童，不可姑息， 你虽然用杖打他，他也不会死；
verses.textZhCnvs: 要管教孩童，不可姑息， 你虽然用杖打他，他也不会死；
verses.textZhCuv: 不可不管教孩童； 你用杖打他，他必不至于死。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not withhold discipline from a child; if you punish them with the rod, they will not die.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not withhold discipline from a child; if you strike him with a rod, he will not die.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not withhold correction from a child, For if you beat him with a rod, he will not die.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t fail to discipline your children. The rod of punishment won’t kill them.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not withhold discipline from a child; Though you strike him with the rod, he will not die.
verses.textEn: Do not withhold discipline from a child; if you punish them with the rod, they will not die.

verses.textZh: 你要用杖打他， 就可以救他的灵魂免下阴间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要用杖打他， 就可以救他的灵魂免下阴间。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要用杖打他， 就可以救他的灵魂免下阴间。
verses.textEnNiv: Punish them with the rod and save them from death.
verses.textEnEsv: If you strike him with the rod, you will save his soul from Sheol.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall beat him with a rod, And deliver his soul from hell.
verses.textEnNlt: Physical discipline may well save them from death.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall strike him with the rod And rescue his soul from Sheol.
verses.textEn: Punish them with the rod and save them from death.

verses.textZh: 我儿，如果你的心有智慧， 我的心也就欢喜；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我儿，如果你的心有智慧， 我的心也就欢喜；
verses.textZhCuv: 我儿，你心若存智慧， 我的心也甚欢喜。
verses.textEnNiv: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad indeed;
verses.textEnEsv: My son, if your heart is wise, my heart too will be glad.
verses.textEnNkjv: My son, if your heart is wise, My heart will rejoice—indeed, I myself;
verses.textEnNlt: My child, if your heart is wise, my own heart will rejoice!
