verses.textEnNasb: My son, if your heart is wise, My own heart also will be glad,
verses.textEn: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad indeed;

verses.textZh: 你的嘴唇说正直话的时候， 我的内心就欢乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的嘴唇说正直话的时候， 我的内心就欢乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的嘴若说正直话， 我的心肠也必快乐。
verses.textEnNiv: my inmost being will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.
verses.textEnEsv: My inmost being will exult when your lips speak what is right.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, my inmost being will rejoice When your lips speak right things.
verses.textEnNlt: Everything in me will celebrate when you speak what is right.
verses.textEnNasb: And my innermost being will rejoice When your lips speak what is right.
verses.textEn: my inmost being will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.

verses.textZh: 你的心不要嫉妒罪人， 只要时常敬畏耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的心不要嫉妒罪人， 只要时常敬畏耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 你心中不要嫉妒罪人， 只要终日敬畏耶和华；
verses.textEnNiv: Do not let your heart envy sinners, but always be zealous for the fear of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Let not your heart envy sinners, but continue in the fear of the Lord all the day.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not let your heart envy sinners, But bezealous for the fear of the Lord all the day;
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t envy sinners, but always continue to fear the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Do not let your heart envy sinners, But live in the fear of the Lord always.
verses.textEn: Do not let your heart envy sinners, but always be zealous for the fear of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 因为万事必有结局， 你的盼望也不会断绝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为万事必有结局， 你的盼望也不会断绝。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为至终必有善报， 你的指望也不致断绝。
verses.textEnNiv: There is surely a future hope for you, and your hope will not be cut off.
verses.textEnEsv: Surely there is a future, and your hope will not be cut off.
verses.textEnNkjv: For surely there is a hereafter, And your hope will not be cut off.
verses.textEnNlt: You will be rewarded for this; your hope will not be disappointed.
verses.textEnNasb: Certainly there is a future, And your hope will not be cut off.
verses.textEn: There is surely a future hope for you, and your hope will not be cut off.

verses.textZh: 我儿，你要听，要有智慧， 要引导你的心走在正路上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我儿，你要听，要有智慧， 要引导你的心走在正路上。
verses.textZhCuv: 我儿，你当听，当存智慧， 好在正道上引导你的心。
verses.textEnNiv: Listen, my son, and be wise, and set your heart on the right path:
verses.textEnEsv: Hear, my son, and be wise, and direct your heart in the way.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear, my son, and be wise; And guide your heart in the way.
verses.textEnNlt: My child, listen and be wise: Keep your heart on the right course.
verses.textEnNasb: Listen, my son, and be wise, And direct your heart in the way.
verses.textEn: Listen, my son, and be wise, and set your heart on the right path:

verses.textZh: 酗酒的人，不可与他们来往； 暴食的人，不要与他们为友。
verses.textZhCnvs: 酗酒的人，不可与他们来往； 暴食的人，不要与他们为友。
verses.textZhCuv: 好饮酒的，好吃肉的， 不要与他们来往；
verses.textEnNiv: Do not join those who drink too much wine or gorge themselves on meat,
verses.textEnEsv: Be not among drunkards or among gluttonous eaters of meat,
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not mix with winebibbers, Or with gluttonous eaters of meat;
verses.textEnNlt: Do not carouse with drunkards or feast with gluttons,
verses.textEnNasb: Do not be with heavy drinkers of wine, Or with gluttonous eaters of meat;
verses.textEn: Do not join those who drink too much wine or gorge themselves on meat,

verses.textZh: 因为酗酒暴食的人必致穷乏； 贪睡的人必穿破衣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为酗酒暴食的人必致穷乏； 贪睡的人必穿破衣。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为好酒贪食的，必致贫穷； 好睡觉的，必穿破烂衣服。
verses.textEnNiv: for drunkards and gluttons become poor, and drowsiness clothes them in rags.
verses.textEnEsv: for the drunkard and the glutton will come to poverty, and slumber will clothe them with rags.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the drunkard and the glutton will come to poverty, And drowsiness will clothe aman with rags.
verses.textEnNlt: for they are on their way to poverty, and too much sleep clothes them in rags.
verses.textEnNasb: For the heavy drinker and the glutton will come to poverty, And drowsiness will clothe one with rags.
verses.textEn: for drunkards and gluttons become poor, and drowsiness clothes them in rags.

verses.textZh: 你要听从生你的父亲； 也不可因为母亲老了，就藐视她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要听从生你的父亲； 也不可因为母亲老了，就藐视她。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要听从生你的父亲； 你母亲老了，也不可藐视她。
verses.textEnNiv: Listen to your father, who gave you life, and do not despise your mother when she is old.
verses.textEnEsv: Listen to your father who gave you life, and do not despise your mother when she is old.
verses.textEnNkjv: Listen to your father who begot you, And do not despise your mother when she is old.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to your father, who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.
verses.textEnNasb: Listen to your father, who fathered you, And do not despise your mother when she is old.
verses.textEn: Listen to your father, who gave you life, and do not despise your mother when she is old.

verses.textZh: 你要买真理，不可出卖； 要得智慧、教训和哲理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要买真理，不可出卖； 要得智慧、教训和哲理。
verses.textZhCuv: 你当买真理； 就是智慧、训诲，和聪明也都不可卖。
verses.textEnNiv: Buy the truth and do not sell it— wisdom, instruction and insight as well.
verses.textEnEsv: Buy truth, and do not sell it; buy wisdom, instruction, and understanding.
verses.textEnNkjv: Buy the truth, and do not sell it, Also wisdom and instruction and understanding.
verses.textEnNlt: Get the truth and never sell it; also get wisdom, discipline, and good judgment.
verses.textEnNasb: Buy truth, and do not sell it, Get wisdom, instruction, and understanding.
verses.textEn: Buy the truth and do not sell it— wisdom, instruction and insight as well.

verses.textZh: 义人的父亲必大有快乐； 生下智慧的儿子的，必因儿子欢喜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人的父亲必大有快乐； 生下智慧的儿子的，必因儿子欢喜。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人的父亲必大得快乐； 人生智慧的儿子，必因他欢喜。
verses.textEnNiv: The father of a righteous child has great joy; a man who fathers a wise son rejoices in him.
verses.textEnEsv: The father of the righteous will greatly rejoice; he who fathers a wise son will be glad in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: The father of the righteous will greatly rejoice, And he who begets a wise child will delight in him.
verses.textEnNlt: The father of godly children has cause for joy. What a pleasure to have children who are wise.
verses.textEnNasb: The father of the righteous will greatly rejoice, And he who fathers a wise son will be glad in him.
verses.textEn: The father of a righteous child has great joy; a man who fathers a wise son rejoices in him.

verses.textZh: 要使你的父母欢喜， 使生下你的快乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要使你的父母欢喜， 使生下你的快乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要使父母欢喜， 使生你的快乐。
verses.textEnNiv: May your father and mother rejoice; may she who gave you birth be joyful!
verses.textEnEsv: Let your father and mother be glad; let her who bore you rejoice.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let your father and your mother be glad, And let her who bore you rejoice.
verses.textEnNlt: So give your father and mother joy! May she who gave you birth be happy.
verses.textEnNasb: Let your father and your mother be glad, And let her rejoice who gave birth to you.
verses.textEn: May your father and mother rejoice; may she who gave you birth be joyful!

verses.textZh: 我儿，把你的心给我； 你的眼目要关注我的道路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我儿，把你的心给我； 你的眼目要关注我的道路。
verses.textZhCuv: 我儿，要将你的心归我； 你的眼目也要喜悦我的道路。
verses.textEnNiv: My son, give me your heart and let your eyes delight in my ways,
verses.textEnEsv: My son, give me your heart, and let your eyes observe my ways.
verses.textEnNkjv: My son, give me your heart, And let your eyes observe my ways.
verses.textEnNlt: O my son, give me your heart. May your eyes take delight in following my ways.
verses.textEnNasb: Give me your heart, my son, And let your eyes delight in my ways.
verses.textEn: My son, give me your heart and let your eyes delight in my ways,

verses.textZh: 因为妓女是深坑， 淫妇是狭窄的井。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为妓女是深坑， 淫妇是狭窄的井。
verses.textZhCuv: 妓女是深坑； 外女是窄阱。
verses.textEnNiv: for an adulterous woman is a deep pit, and a wayward wife is a narrow well.
verses.textEnEsv: For a prostitute is a deep pit; an adulteress is a narrow well.
verses.textEnNkjv: For a harlot is a deep pit, And a seductress is a narrow well.
verses.textEnNlt: A prostitute is a dangerous trap; a promiscuous woman is as dangerous as falling into a narrow well.
verses.textEnNasb: For a prostitute is a deep pit, And a strange woman is a narrow well.
verses.textEn: for an adulterous woman is a deep pit, and a wayward wife is a narrow well.

verses.textZh: 她像强盗一样埋伏， 使人间增添很多奸诈的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她像强盗一样埋伏， 使人间增添很多奸诈的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 她埋伏好像强盗； 她使人中多有奸诈的。
verses.textEnNiv: Like a bandit she lies in wait and multiplies the unfaithful among men.
verses.textEnEsv: She lies in wait like a robber and increases the traitors among mankind.
verses.textEnNkjv: She also lies in wait as for a victim, And increases the unfaithful among men.
verses.textEnNlt: She hides and waits like a robber, eager to make more men unfaithful.
verses.textEnNasb: Certainly she lurks as a robber, And increases the treacherous among mankind.
verses.textEn: Like a bandit she lies in wait and multiplies the unfaithful among men.

verses.textZh: 谁有祸患？谁有愁苦？ 谁有纷争？谁有怨言？ 谁无故受伤？ 谁的眼睛赤红？
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁有祸患？谁有愁苦？ 谁有纷争？谁有怨言？ 谁无故受伤？ 谁的眼睛赤红？
verses.textZhCuv: 谁有祸患？谁有忧愁？ 谁有争斗？谁有哀叹 ？ 谁无故受伤？谁眼目红赤？
verses.textEnNiv: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?
verses.textEnEsv: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaining? Who has wounds without cause? Who has redness of eyes?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has contentions? Who has complaints? Who has wounds without cause? Who has redness of eyes?
verses.textEnNlt: Who has anguish? Who has sorrow? Who is always fighting? Who is always complaining? Who has unnecessary bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?
verses.textEnNasb: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has contentions? Who has complaining? Who has wounds without cause? Who has red eyes?
verses.textEn: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?

verses.textZh: 就是那些沉湎于酒， 常去品尝调和了的酒的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是那些沉湎于酒， 常去品尝调和了的酒的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是那流连饮酒、 常去寻找调和酒的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who linger over wine, who go to sample bowls of mixed wine.
verses.textEnEsv: Those who tarry long over wine; those who go to try mixed wine.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who linger long at the wine, Those who go in search of mixed wine.
verses.textEnNlt: It is the one who spends long hours in the taverns, trying out new drinks.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who linger long over wine, Those who go to taste mixed wine.
verses.textEn: Those who linger over wine, who go to sample bowls of mixed wine.

verses.textZh: 你不要看酒怎样发红， 在杯中怎样闪烁诱人， 喝下去怎样舒畅，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不要看酒怎样发红， 在杯中怎样闪烁诱人， 喝下去怎样舒畅，
verses.textZhCuv: 你不可观看， 虽然下咽舒畅， 终久是咬你如蛇，刺你如毒蛇。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not gaze at wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly!
verses.textEnEsv: Do not look at wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup and goes down smoothly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not look on the wine when it is red, When it sparkles in the cup, When it swirls around smoothly;
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t gaze at the wine, seeing how red it is, how it sparkles in the cup, how smoothly it goes down.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not look at wine when it is red, When it sparkles in the cup, When it goes down smoothly;
verses.textEn: Do not gaze at wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly!

verses.textZh: 最后它却像咬你的蛇、 像刺你的毒蛇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 最后它却像咬你的蛇、 像刺你的毒蛇。
verses.textZhCuv: 你眼必看见异怪的事 ； 你心必发出乖谬的话。
verses.textEnNiv: In the end it bites like a snake and poisons like a viper.
verses.textEnEsv: In the end it bites like a serpent and stings like an adder.
verses.textEnNkjv: At the last it bites like a serpent, And stings like a viper.
verses.textEnNlt: For in the end it bites like a poisonous snake; it stings like a viper.
verses.textEnNasb: In the end it bites like a snake And stings like a viper.
verses.textEn: In the end it bites like a snake and poisons like a viper.

verses.textZh: 你的眼睛必看见怪异的事， 你的心必说乖谬的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的眼睛必看见怪异的事， 你的心必说乖谬的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必像躺在海中， 或像卧在桅杆上。
verses.textEnNiv: Your eyes will see strange sights, and your mind will imagine confusing things.
verses.textEnEsv: Your eyes will see strange things, and your heart utter perverse things.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your eyes will see strange things, And your heart will utter perverse things.
verses.textEnNlt: You will see hallucinations, and you will say crazy things.
verses.textEnNasb: Your eyes will see strange things And your mind will say perverse things.
verses.textEn: Your eyes will see strange sights, and your mind will imagine confusing things.

verses.textZh: 你必好象躺在海中， 又好象躺在桅杆顶上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必好象躺在海中， 又好象躺在桅杆顶上。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必说：人打我，我却未受伤； 人鞭打我，我竟不觉得。 我几时清醒，我仍去寻酒。
verses.textEnNiv: You will be like one sleeping on the high seas, lying on top of the rigging.
verses.textEnEsv: You will be like one who lies down in the midst of the sea, like one who lies on the top of a mast.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, you will be like one who lies down in the midst of the sea, Or like one who lies at the top of the mast, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: You will stagger like a sailor tossed at sea, clinging to a swaying mast.
verses.textEnNasb: And you will be like one who lies down in the middle of the sea, Or like one who lies down on the top of a mast.
verses.textEn: You will be like one sleeping on the high seas, lying on top of the rigging.

verses.textZh: 你必说："人打我，我不痛； 人鞭打我，我不晓得； 我甚么时候清醒？ 我还要再去寻酒。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必说："人打我，我不痛； 人鞭打我，我不晓得； 我甚么时候清醒？ 我还要再去寻酒。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你必说："人打我，我不痛； 人鞭打我，我不晓得； 我甚么时候清醒？ 我还要再去寻酒。"
verses.textEnNiv: "They hit me," you will say, "but I’m not hurt! They beat me, but I don’t feel it! When will I wake up so I can find another drink?"
verses.textEnEsv: "They struck me," you will say, "but I was not hurt; they beat me, but I did not feel it. When shall I awake? I must have another drink."
verses.textEnNkjv: "They have struck me, but I was not hurt; They have beaten me, but I did not feel it. When shall I awake, that I may seek another drink?"
verses.textEnNlt: And you will say, "They hit me, but I didn’t feel it. I didn’t even know it when they beat me up. When will I wake up so I can look for another drink?"
verses.textEnNasb: "They struck me, but I did not become ill; They beat me, but I did not know it. When will I awake? I will seek another drink."
verses.textEn: "They hit me," you will say, "but I’m not hurt! They beat me, but I don’t feel it! When will I wake up so I can find another drink?"

verses.textZh: 你不要嫉妒恶人， 也不要祈望与他们共处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不要嫉妒恶人， 也不要祈望与他们共处。
verses.textZhCuv: 你不要嫉妒恶人， 也不要起意与他们相处；
verses.textEnNiv: Do not envy the wicked, do not desire their company;
verses.textEnEsv: Be not envious of evil men, nor desire to be with them,
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not be envious of evil men, Nor desire to be with them;
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t envy evil people or desire their company.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not be envious of evil people, Nor desire to be with them;
verses.textEn: Do not envy the wicked, do not desire their company;

verses.textZh: 因为他们的心图谋强暴， 他们的嘴唇讲论奸恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们的心图谋强暴， 他们的嘴唇讲论奸恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，他们的心图谋强暴， 他们的口谈论奸恶。
verses.textEnNiv: for their hearts plot violence, and their lips talk about making trouble.
verses.textEnEsv: for their hearts devise violence, and their lips talk of trouble.
verses.textEnNkjv: For their heart devises violence, And their lips talk of troublemaking.
verses.textEnNlt: For their hearts plot violence, and their words always stir up trouble.
verses.textEnNasb: For their minds plot violence, And their lips talk of trouble.
verses.textEn: for their hearts plot violence, and their lips talk about making trouble.

verses.textZh: 房屋的建造是凭着智慧， 又借着聪明得到坚立；
verses.textZhCnvs: 房屋的建造是凭着智慧， 又借着聪明得到坚立；
verses.textZhCuv: 房屋因智慧建造， 又因聪明立稳；
verses.textEnNiv: By wisdom a house is built, and through understanding it is established;
verses.textEnEsv: By wisdom a house is built, and by understanding it is established;
verses.textEnNkjv: Through wisdom a house is built, And by understanding it is established;
verses.textEnNlt: A house is built by wisdom and becomes strong through good sense.
verses.textEnNasb: By wisdom a house is built, And by understanding it is established;
verses.textEn: By wisdom a house is built, and through understanding it is established;

verses.textZh: 并且借着知识，各房间充满 各样宝贵和美好的财物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且借着知识，各房间充满 各样宝贵和美好的财物。
verses.textZhCuv: 其中因知识充满各样美好宝贵的财物。
verses.textEnNiv: through knowledge its rooms are filled with rare and beautiful treasures.
verses.textEnEsv: by knowledge the rooms are filled with all precious and pleasant riches.
verses.textEnNkjv: By knowledge the rooms are filled With all precious and pleasant riches.
verses.textEnNlt: Through knowledge its rooms are filled with all sorts of precious riches and valuables.
verses.textEnNasb: And by knowledge the rooms are filled With all precious and pleasant riches.
verses.textEn: through knowledge its rooms are filled with rare and beautiful treasures.

verses.textZh: 智慧人大有能力， 有知识的人力上加力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧人大有能力， 有知识的人力上加力。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧人大有能力； 有知识的人力上加力。
verses.textEnNiv: The wise prevail through great power, and those who have knowledge muster their strength.
verses.textEnEsv: A wise man is full of strength, and a man of knowledge enhances his might,
verses.textEnNkjv: A wise man is strong, Yes, a man of knowledge increases strength;
verses.textEnNlt: The wise are mightier than the strong, and those with knowledge grow stronger and stronger.
verses.textEnNasb: A wise man is strong, And a person of knowledge increases power.
verses.textEn: The wise prevail through great power, and those who have knowledge muster their strength.

verses.textZh: 你要凭着智谋去作战； 谋士众多，就可得胜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要凭着智谋去作战； 谋士众多，就可得胜。
verses.textZhCuv: 你去打仗，要凭智谋； 谋士众多，人便得胜。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely you need guidance to wage war, and victory is won through many advisers.
verses.textEnEsv: for by wise guidance you can wage your war, and in abundance of counselors there is victory.
verses.textEnNkjv: For by wise counsel you will wage your own war, And in a multitude of counselors thereis safety.
verses.textEnNlt: So don’t go to war without wise guidance; victory depends on having many advisers.
verses.textEnNasb: For by wise guidance you will wage war, And in an abundance of counselors there is victory.
verses.textEn: Surely you need guidance to wage war, and victory is won through many advisers.

verses.textZh: 智慧对愚妄人来说是太高超， 因此他在城门口哑口无言。
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧对愚妄人来说是太高超， 因此他在城门口哑口无言。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧极高，非愚昧人所能及， 所以在城门内不敢开口。
verses.textEnNiv: Wisdom is too high for fools; in the assembly at the gate they must not open their mouths.
verses.textEnEsv: Wisdom is too high for a fool; in the gate he does not open his mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Wisdom is too lofty for a fool; He does not open his mouth in the gate.
verses.textEnNlt: Wisdom is too lofty for fools. Among leaders at the city gate, they have nothing to say.
verses.textEnNasb: Wisdom is too exalted for a fool, He does not open his mouth at the gate.
verses.textEn: Wisdom is too high for fools; in the assembly at the gate they must not open their mouths.

verses.textZh: 计划作恶的， 必称为阴谋家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 计划作恶的， 必称为阴谋家。
verses.textZhCuv: 设计作恶的， 必称为奸人。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever plots evil will be known as a schemer.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever plans to do evil will be called a schemer.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who plots to do evil Will be called a schemer.
verses.textEnNlt: A person who plans evil will get a reputation as a troublemaker.
verses.textEnNasb: One who plans to do evil, People will call a schemer.
verses.textEn: Whoever plots evil will be known as a schemer.

verses.textZh: 愚妄人的计谋，尽是罪恶； 好讥笑人的是人所厌恶的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚妄人的计谋，尽是罪恶； 好讥笑人的是人所厌恶的。
verses.textZhCuv: 愚妄人的思念乃是罪恶； 亵慢者为人所憎恶。
verses.textEnNiv: The schemes of folly are sin, and people detest a mocker.
verses.textEnEsv: The devising of folly is sin, and the scoffer is an abomination to mankind.
verses.textEnNkjv: The devising of foolishness is sin, And the scoffer is an abomination to men.
verses.textEnNlt: The schemes of a fool are sinful; everyone detests a mocker.
verses.textEnNasb: The devising of foolishness is sin, And the scoffer is an abomination to humanity.
verses.textEn: The schemes of folly are sin, and people detest a mocker.

verses.textZh: 你在患难的日子若是懈怠， 你的力量就微小。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你在患难的日子若是懈怠， 你的力量就微小。
verses.textZhCuv: 你在患难之日若胆怯， 你的力量就微小。
verses.textEnNiv: If you falter in a time of trouble, how small is your strength!
verses.textEnEsv: If you faint in the day of adversity, your strength is small.
verses.textEnNkjv: If you faint in the day of adversity, Your strength is small.
verses.textEnNlt: If you fail under pressure, your strength is too small.
verses.textEnNasb: If you show yourself lacking courage on the day of distress, Your strength is meager.
verses.textEn: If you falter in a time of trouble, how small is your strength!

verses.textZh: 被拉到死地的人，你要拯救； 将要被杀戮的人，你要挽救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 被拉到死地的人，你要拯救； 将要被杀戮的人，你要挽救。
verses.textZhCuv: 人被拉到死地，你要解救； 人将被杀，你须拦阻。
verses.textEnNiv: Rescue those being led away to death; hold back those staggering toward slaughter.
verses.textEnEsv: Rescue those who are being taken away to death; hold back those who are stumbling to the slaughter.
verses.textEnNkjv: Deliver thosewho are drawn toward death, And hold back those stumbling to the slaughter.
verses.textEnNlt: Rescue those who are unjustly sentenced to die; save them as they stagger to their death.
verses.textEnNasb: Rescue those who are being taken away to death, And those who are staggering to the slaughter, Oh hold them back!
verses.textEn: Rescue those being led away to death; hold back those staggering toward slaughter.

verses.textZh: 如果你说："这事我不知道。" 那衡量人心的不明白吗？ 那看顾你性命的不晓得吗？ 他不按照各人的行为报应各人吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你说："这事我不知道。" 那衡量人心的不明白吗？ 那看顾你性命的不晓得吗？ 他不按照各人的行为报应各人吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你若说：这事我未曾知道， 那衡量人心的岂不明白吗？ 保守你命的岂不知道吗？ 他岂不按各人所行的报应各人吗？
verses.textEnNiv: If you say, "But we knew nothing about this," does not he who weighs the heart perceive it? Does not he who guards your life know it? Will he not repay everyone according to what they have done?
verses.textEnEsv: If you say, "Behold, we did not know this," does not he who weighs the heart perceive it? Does not he who keeps watch over your soul know it, and will he not repay man according to his work?
verses.textEnNkjv: If you say, "Surely we did not know this," Does not He who weighs the hearts consider it? He who keeps your soul, does He not know it? And will He not render to each man according to his deeds?
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t excuse yourself by saying, "Look, we didn’t know." For God understands all hearts, and he sees you. He who guards your soul knows you knew. He will repay all people as their actions deserve.
verses.textEnNasb: If you say, "See, we did not know this," Does He who weighs the hearts not consider it? And does He who watches over your soul not know it? And will He not repay a person according to his work?
verses.textEn: If you say, "But we knew nothing about this," does not he who weighs the heart perceive it? Does not he who guards your life know it? Will he not repay everyone according to what they have done?

verses.textZh: 我儿，你要吃蜜，因为这是好的； 吃蜂房下滴的蜜，就觉甘甜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我儿，你要吃蜜，因为这是好的； 吃蜂房下滴的蜜，就觉甘甜。
verses.textZhCuv: 我儿，你要吃蜜，因为是好的； 吃蜂房下滴的蜜便觉甘甜。
verses.textEnNiv: Eat honey, my son, for it is good; honey from the comb is sweet to your taste.
verses.textEnEsv: My son, eat honey, for it is good, and the drippings of the honeycomb are sweet to your taste.
verses.textEnNkjv: My son, eat honey because itis good, And the honeycomb whichis sweet to your taste;
verses.textEnNlt: My child, eat honey, for it is good, and the honeycomb is sweet to the taste.
verses.textEnNasb: My son, eat honey, for it is good; Yes, the honey from the comb is sweet to your taste;
verses.textEn: Eat honey, my son, for it is good; honey from the comb is sweet to your taste.

verses.textZh: 要知道智慧对你的心也是这样， 如果你得着智慧，就必有好结局， 你的盼望也不会断绝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要知道智慧对你的心也是这样， 如果你得着智慧，就必有好结局， 你的盼望也不会断绝。
verses.textZhCuv: 你心得了智慧，也必觉得如此。 你若找着，至终必有善报； 你的指望也不致断绝。
verses.textEnNiv: Know also that wisdom is like honey for you: If you find it, there is a future hope for you, and your hope will not be cut off.
verses.textEnEsv: Know that wisdom is such to your soul; if you find it, there will be a future, and your hope will not be cut off.
verses.textEnNkjv: So shall the knowledge of wisdom be to your soul; If you have found it, there is a prospect, And your hope will not be cut off.
verses.textEnNlt: In the same way, wisdom is sweet to your soul. If you find it, you will have a bright future, and your hopes will not be cut short.
verses.textEnNasb: Know that wisdom is the same for your soul; If you find it, then there will be a future, And your hope will not be cut off.
verses.textEn: Know also that wisdom is like honey for you: If you find it, there is a future hope for you, and your hope will not be cut off.

verses.textZh: 恶人哪！不要埋伏攻击义人的住处， 不要毁坏他的居所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人哪！不要埋伏攻击义人的住处， 不要毁坏他的居所。
verses.textZhCuv: 你这恶人，不要埋伏攻击义人的家； 不要毁坏他安居之所。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not lurk like a thief near the house of the righteous, do not plunder their dwelling place;
verses.textEnEsv: Lie not in wait as a wicked man against the dwelling of the righteous; do no violence to his home;
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not lie in wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous; Do not plunder his resting place;
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t wait in ambush at the home of the godly, and don’t raid the house where the godly live.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not lie in ambush, you wicked person, against the home of the righteous; Do not destroy his resting place;
verses.textEn: Do not lurk like a thief near the house of the righteous, do not plunder their dwelling place;

verses.textZh: 因为义人虽然七次跌倒，仍能再起来； 但恶人必在祸患中绊倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为义人虽然七次跌倒，仍能再起来； 但恶人必在祸患中绊倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，义人虽七次跌倒，仍必兴起； 恶人却被祸患倾倒。
verses.textEnNiv: for though the righteous fall seven times, they rise again, but the wicked stumble when calamity strikes.
verses.textEnEsv: for the righteous falls seven times and rises again, but the wicked stumble in times of calamity.
verses.textEnNkjv: For a righteous man may fall seven times And rise again, But the wicked shall fall by calamity.
verses.textEnNlt: The godly may trip seven times, but they will get up again. But one disaster is enough to overthrow the wicked.
verses.textEnNasb: For a righteous person falls seven times and rises again, But the wicked stumble in time of disaster.
verses.textEn: for though the righteous fall seven times, they rise again, but the wicked stumble when calamity strikes.

verses.textZh: 你的仇敌跌倒的时候，你不要欢喜； 他绊倒的时候，你心里不可欢乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的仇敌跌倒的时候，你不要欢喜； 他绊倒的时候，你心里不可欢乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 你仇敌跌倒，你不要欢喜； 他倾倒，你心不要快乐；
verses.textEnNiv: Do not gloat when your enemy falls; when they stumble, do not let your heart rejoice,
verses.textEnEsv: Do not rejoice when your enemy falls, and let not your heart be glad when he stumbles,
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not rejoice when your enemy falls, And do not let your heart be glad when he stumbles;
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t rejoice when your enemies fall; don’t be happy when they stumble.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not rejoice when your enemy falls, And do not let your heart rejoice when he stumbles,
verses.textEn: Do not gloat when your enemy falls; when they stumble, do not let your heart rejoice,

verses.textZh: 恐怕耶和华看见了，就不喜悦， 把他的怒气从仇敌的身上，转到你的身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恐怕耶和华看见了，就不喜悦， 把他的怒气从仇敌的身上，转到你的身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 恐怕耶和华看见就不喜悦， 将怒气从仇敌身上转过来。
verses.textEnNiv: or the Lord will see and disapprove and turn his wrath away from them.
verses.textEnEsv: lest the Lord see it and be displeased, and turn away his anger from him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lest the Lord see it, and it displease Him, And He turn away His wrath from him.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord will be displeased with you and will turn his anger away from them.
verses.textEnNasb: Otherwise, the Lord will see and be displeased, And turn His anger away from him.
verses.textEn: or the Lord will see and disapprove and turn his wrath away from them.

verses.textZh: 不要因作恶的人心怀不平， 也不要嫉妒恶人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要因作恶的人心怀不平， 也不要嫉妒恶人。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要为作恶的心怀不平， 也不要嫉妒恶人；
verses.textEnNiv: Do not fret because of evildoers or be envious of the wicked,
verses.textEnEsv: Fret not yourself because of evildoers, and be not envious of the wicked,
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not fret because of evildoers, Nor be envious of the wicked;
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t fret because of evildoers; don’t envy the wicked.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not get upset because of evildoers Or be envious of the wicked;
verses.textEn: Do not fret because of evildoers or be envious of the wicked,

verses.textZh: 因为恶人必没有好结局， 恶人的灯必要熄灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为恶人必没有好结局， 恶人的灯必要熄灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，恶人终不得善报； 恶人的灯也必熄灭。
verses.textEnNiv: for the evildoer has no future hope, and the lamp of the wicked will be snuffed out.
verses.textEnEsv: for the evil man has no future; the lamp of the wicked will be put out.
verses.textEnNkjv: For there will be no prospect for the evil man; The lamp of the wicked will be put out.
verses.textEnNlt: For evil people have no future; the light of the wicked will be snuffed out.
verses.textEnNasb: For there will be no future for the evil person; The lamp of the wicked will be put out.
verses.textEn: for the evildoer has no future hope, and the lamp of the wicked will be snuffed out.

verses.textZh: 我儿，你要敬畏耶和华，也要尊敬君王； 不要与叛逆的人结交。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我儿，你要敬畏耶和华，也要尊敬君王； 不要与叛逆的人结交。
verses.textZhCuv: 我儿，你要敬畏耶和华与君王， 不要与反复无常的人结交，
verses.textEnNiv: Fear the Lord and the king, my son, and do not join with rebellious officials,
verses.textEnEsv: My son, fear the Lord and the king, and do not join with those who do otherwise,
verses.textEnNkjv: My son, fear the Lord and the king; Do not associate with those given to change;
verses.textEnNlt: My child, fear the Lord and the king. Don’t associate with rebels,
verses.textEnNasb: My son, fear the Lord and the king; Do not get involved with those of high rank,
verses.textEn: Fear the Lord and the king, my son, and do not join with rebellious officials,

verses.textZh: 因为他们的刑罚必忽然临到； 耶和华与君王要施行的毁灭，谁能晓得呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们的刑罚必忽然临到； 耶和华与君王要施行的毁灭，谁能晓得呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们的灾难必忽然而起。 耶和华与君王所施行的毁灭， 谁能知道呢？
verses.textEnNiv: for those two will send sudden destruction on them, and who knows what calamities they can bring?
verses.textEnEsv: for disaster will arise suddenly from them, and who knows the ruin that will come from them both?
verses.textEnNkjv: For their calamity will rise suddenly, And who knows the ruin those two can bring?
verses.textEnNlt: for disaster will hit them suddenly. Who knows what punishment will come from the Lord and the king?
verses.textEnNasb: For their disaster will rise suddenly, And who knows the ruin that can come from both of them?
verses.textEn: for those two will send sudden destruction on them, and who knows what calamities they can bring?

verses.textZh: 以下也是智慧人的话： 审判的时候看人的情面是不对的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下也是智慧人的话： 审判的时候看人的情面是不对的。
verses.textZhCuv: 以下也是智慧人的箴言： 审判时看人情面是不好的。
verses.textEnNiv: These also are sayings of the wise: To show partiality in judging is not good:
verses.textEnEsv: These also are sayings of the wise. Partiality in judging is not good.
verses.textEnNkjv: These things also belong to the wise: Itis not good to show partiality in judgment.
verses.textEnNlt: Here are some further sayings of the wise: It is wrong to show favoritism when passing judgment.
verses.textEnNasb: These also are sayings of the wise: To show partiality in judgment is not good.
verses.textEn: These also are sayings of the wise: To show partiality in judging is not good:

verses.textZh: 对坏人说"你是好人"的， 万民都要咒骂他，万族都必憎恶他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对坏人说"你是好人"的， 万民都要咒骂他，万族都必憎恶他。
verses.textZhCuv: 对恶人说「你是义人」的， 这人万民必咒诅，列邦必憎恶。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever says to the guilty, "You are innocent," will be cursed by peoples and denounced by nations.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever says to the wicked, "You are in the right," will be cursed by peoples, abhorred by nations,
verses.textEnNkjv: He who says to the wicked, "You are righteous," Him the people will curse; Nations will abhor him.
verses.textEnNlt: A judge who says to the wicked, "You are innocent," will be cursed by many people and denounced by the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: One who says to the wicked, "You are righteous," Peoples will curse him, nations will scold him;
verses.textEn: Whoever says to the guilty, "You are innocent," will be cursed by peoples and denounced by nations.

verses.textZh: 指责坏人的，必得欢悦； 美福必临到他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 指责坏人的，必得欢悦； 美福必临到他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 责备恶人的，必得喜悦； 美好的福也必临到他。
verses.textEnNiv: But it will go well with those who convict the guilty, and rich blessing will come on them.
verses.textEnEsv: but those who rebuke the wicked will have delight, and a good blessing will come upon them.
verses.textEnNkjv: But those who rebuke thewicked will have delight, And a good blessing will come upon them.
verses.textEnNlt: But it will go well for those who convict the guilty; rich blessings will be showered on them.
verses.textEnNasb: But for those who rebuke the wicked there will be delight, And a good blessing will come upon them.
verses.textEn: But it will go well with those who convict the guilty, and rich blessing will come on them.

verses.textZh: 应对诚实的， 如同与别人亲嘴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 应对诚实的， 如同与别人亲嘴。
verses.textZhCuv: 应对正直的，犹如与人亲嘴。
verses.textEnNiv: An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever gives an honest answer kisses the lips.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who gives a right answer kisses the lips.
verses.textEnNlt: An honest answer is like a kiss of friendship.
verses.textEnNasb: One who gives a right answer Kisses the lips.
verses.textEn: An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.

verses.textZh: 你要在外面预备好你的工作， 在田间为自己准备妥当， 然后建造你的房屋。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要在外面预备好你的工作， 在田间为自己准备妥当， 然后建造你的房屋。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要在外头预备工料， 在田间办理整齐， 然后建造房屋。
verses.textEnNiv: Put your outdoor work in order and get your fields ready; after that, build your house.
verses.textEnEsv: Prepare your work outside; get everything ready for yourself in the field, and after that build your house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Prepare your outside work, Make it fit for yourself in the field; And afterward build your house.
verses.textEnNlt: Do your planning and prepare your fields before building your house.
verses.textEnNasb: Prepare your work outside, And make it ready for yourself in the field; Afterward, then, build your house.
verses.textEn: Put your outdoor work in order and get your fields ready; after that, build your house.

verses.textZh: 不可无故作证指控你的邻舍； 不可诬告他人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可无故作证指控你的邻舍； 不可诬告他人。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可无故作见证陷害邻舍， 也不可用嘴欺骗人。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not testify against your neighbor without cause— would you use your lips to mislead?
verses.textEnEsv: Be not a witness against your neighbor without cause, and do not deceive with your lips.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not be a witness against your neighbor without cause, For would you deceive with your lips?
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t testify against your neighbors without cause; don’t lie about them.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not be a witness against your neighbor for no reason, And do not deceive with your lips.
verses.textEn: Do not testify against your neighbor without cause— would you use your lips to mislead?

verses.textZh: 你不可说："人怎样待我，我也怎样待他； 我要照他所行的报复他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可说："人怎样待我，我也怎样待他； 我要照他所行的报复他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 不可说：人怎样待我，我也怎样待他； 我必照他所行的报复他。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not say, "I’ll do to them as they have done to me; I’ll pay them back for what they did."
verses.textEnEsv: Do not say, "I will do to him as he has done to me; I will pay the man back for what he has done."
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not say, "I will do to him just as he has done to me; I will render to the man according to his work."
verses.textEnNlt: And don’t say, "Now I can pay them back for what they’ve done to me! I’ll get even with them!"
verses.textEnNasb: Do not say, "I shall do the same to him as he has done to me; I will repay the person according to his work."
verses.textEn: Do not say, "I’ll do to them as they have done to me; I’ll pay them back for what they did."

verses.textZh: 我经过懒惰人的田地， 无知人的葡萄园；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我经过懒惰人的田地， 无知人的葡萄园；
verses.textZhCuv: 我经过懒惰人的田地、 无知人的葡萄园，
verses.textEnNiv: I went past the field of a sluggard, past the vineyard of someone who has no sense;
verses.textEnEsv: I passed by the field of a sluggard, by the vineyard of a man lacking sense,
verses.textEnNkjv: I went by the field of the lazy man, And by the vineyard of the man devoid of understanding;
verses.textEnNlt: I walked by the field of a lazy person, the vineyard of one with no common sense.
verses.textEnNasb: I passed by the field of a lazy one, And by the vineyard of a person lacking sense,
verses.textEn: I went past the field of a sluggard, past the vineyard of someone who has no sense;

verses.textZh: 只见到处长满蒺藜， 地面盖满刺草， 石墙也倒塌了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只见到处长满蒺藜， 地面盖满刺草， 石墙也倒塌了。
verses.textZhCuv: 荆棘长满了地皮， 刺草遮盖了田面， 石墙也坍塌了。
verses.textEnNiv: thorns had come up everywhere, the ground was covered with weeds, and the stone wall was in ruins.
verses.textEnEsv: and behold, it was all overgrown with thorns; the ground was covered with nettles, and its stone wall was broken down.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there it was, all overgrown with thorns; Its surface was covered with nettles; Its stone wall was broken down.
verses.textEnNlt: I saw that it was overgrown with nettles. It was covered with weeds, and its walls were broken down.
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, it was completely overgrown with weeds; Its surface was covered with weeds, And its stone wall was broken down.
verses.textEn: thorns had come up everywhere, the ground was covered with weeds, and the stone wall was in ruins.

verses.textZh: 我看了，就用心思想； 我见了，就领受了教训。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我看了，就用心思想； 我见了，就领受了教训。
verses.textZhCuv: 我看见就留心思想； 我看着就领了训诲。
verses.textEnNiv: I applied my heart to what I observed and learned a lesson from what I saw:
verses.textEnEsv: Then I saw and considered it; I looked and received instruction.
verses.textEnNkjv: When I saw it, I considered it well; I looked on itand received instruction:
verses.textEnNlt: Then, as I looked and thought about it, I learned this lesson:
verses.textEnNasb: When I saw, I reflected upon it; I looked, and received instruction.
verses.textEn: I applied my heart to what I observed and learned a lesson from what I saw:

verses.textZh: 再睡片时，打盹片时， 抱着手躺卧片时，
verses.textZhCnvs: 再睡片时，打盹片时， 抱着手躺卧片时，
verses.textZhCuv: 再睡片时，打盹片时， 抱着手躺卧片时，
verses.textEnNiv: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest—
verses.textEnEsv: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest,
verses.textEnNkjv: A little sleep, a little slumber, A little folding of the hands to rest;
verses.textEnNlt: A little extra sleep, a little more slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest—
verses.textEnNasb: "A little sleep, a little slumber, A little folding of the hands to rest,"
verses.textEn: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest—

verses.textZh: 你的贫穷就必像强盗来到， 你的缺乏就必像拿兵器的人来到。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的贫穷就必像强盗来到， 你的缺乏就必像拿兵器的人来到。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的贫穷就必如强盗速来， 你的缺乏仿佛拿兵器的人来到。
verses.textEnNiv: and poverty will come on you like a thief and scarcity like an armed man.
verses.textEnEsv: and poverty will come upon you like a robber, and want like an armed man.
verses.textEnNkjv: So shall your poverty come like a prowler, And your need like an armed man.
verses.textEnNlt: then poverty will pounce on you like a bandit; scarcity will attack you like an armed robber.
verses.textEnNasb: Then your poverty will come like a drifter, And your need like an armed man.
verses.textEn: and poverty will come on you like a thief and scarcity like an armed man.

verses.textZh: 以下也是所罗门的箴言，是犹大王希西家的人抄录的：
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下也是所罗门的箴言，是犹大王希西家的人抄录的：
verses.textZhCuv: 以下也是所罗门的箴言，是犹大王希西家的人所誊录的。
verses.textEnNiv: These are more proverbs of Solomon, compiled by the men of Hezekiah king of Judah:
verses.textEnEsv: These also are proverbs of Solomon which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied.
verses.textEnNkjv: These also are proverbs of Solomon which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied:
verses.textEnNlt: These are more proverbs of Solomon, collected by the advisers of King Hezekiah of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: These also are proverbs of Solomon which the men of Hezekiah, king of Judah, transcribed.
verses.textEn: These are more proverbs of Solomon, compiled by the men of Hezekiah king of Judah:

verses.textZh: 把事隐藏，是神的荣耀； 把事察清，是君王的光荣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把事隐藏，是神的荣耀； 把事察清，是君王的光荣。
verses.textZhCuv: 将事隐秘乃神的荣耀； 将事察清乃君王的荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.
verses.textEnEsv: It is the glory of God to conceal things, but the glory of kings is to search things out.
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis the glory of God to conceal a matter, But the glory of kings is to search out a matter.
verses.textEnNlt: It is God’s privilege to conceal things and the king’s privilege to discover them.
verses.textEnNasb: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter, But the glory of kings is to search out a matter.
verses.textEn: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.

verses.textZh: 人不知天有多高，地有多厚， 君王的心也照样测不透。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人不知天有多高，地有多厚， 君王的心也照样测不透。
verses.textZhCuv: 天之高，地之厚， 君王之心也测不透。
verses.textEnNiv: As the heavens are high and the earth is deep, so the hearts of kings are unsearchable.
verses.textEnEsv: As the heavens for height, and the earth for depth, so the heart of kings is unsearchable.
verses.textEnNkjv: As the heavens for height and the earth for depth, So the heart of kings is unsearchable.
verses.textEnNlt: No one can comprehend the height of heaven, the depth of the earth, or all that goes on in the king’s mind!
verses.textEnNasb: As the heavens for height and the earth for depth, So the heart of kings is unsearchable.
verses.textEn: As the heavens are high and the earth is deep, so the hearts of kings are unsearchable.

verses.textZh: 除去银子的渣滓， 银匠就可以做出器皿；
verses.textZhCnvs: 除去银子的渣滓， 银匠就可以做出器皿；
verses.textZhCuv: 除去银子的渣滓就有银子出来， 银匠能以做器皿。
verses.textEnNiv: Remove the dross from the silver, and a silversmith can produce a vessel;
verses.textEnEsv: Take away the dross from the silver, and the smith has material for a vessel;
verses.textEnNkjv: Take away the dross from silver, And it will go to the silversmith for jewelry.
verses.textEnNlt: Remove the impurities from silver, and the sterling will be ready for the silversmith.
verses.textEnNasb: Take away the impurities from the silver, And there comes out a vessel for the smith;
verses.textEn: Remove the dross from the silver, and a silversmith can produce a vessel;

verses.textZh: 除去君王面前的坏人， 他的王位就可以靠公义坚立。
verses.textZhCnvs: 除去君王面前的坏人， 他的王位就可以靠公义坚立。
verses.textZhCuv: 除去王面前的恶人， 国位就靠公义坚立。
verses.textEnNiv: remove wicked officials from the king’s presence, and his throne will be established through righteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: take away the wicked from the presence of the king, and his throne will be established in righteousness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Take away the wicked from before the king, And his throne will be established in righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: Remove the wicked from the king’s court, and his reign will be made secure by justice.
verses.textEnNasb: Take away the wicked before the king, And his throne will be established in righteousness.
verses.textEn: remove wicked officials from the king’s presence, and his throne will be established through righteousness.

verses.textZh: 你在君王面前，不可妄自尊大； 也不可擅自站立在大人物中间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你在君王面前，不可妄自尊大； 也不可擅自站立在大人物中间。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要在王面前妄自尊大； 不要在大人的位上站立。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not exalt yourself in the king’s presence, and do not claim a place among his great men;
verses.textEnEsv: Do not put yourself forward in the king’s presence or stand in the place of the great,
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not exalt yourself in the presence of the king, And do not stand in the place of the great;
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t demand an audience with the king or push for a place among the great.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not boast in the presence of the king, And do not stand in the same place as great people;
verses.textEn: Do not exalt yourself in the king’s presence, and do not claim a place among his great men;

verses.textZh: 宁可让人对你说："请上座！" 胜过在你觐见的显贵面前， 被人叫你退下去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 宁可让人对你说："请上座！" 胜过在你觐见的显贵面前， 被人叫你退下去。
verses.textZhCuv: 宁可有人说：请你上来， 强如在你觐见的王子面前叫你退下。
verses.textEnNiv: it is better for him to say to you, "Come up here," than for him to humiliate you before his nobles. What you have seen with your eyes
verses.textEnEsv: for it is better to be told, "Come up here," than to be put lower in the presence of a noble. What your eyes have seen
verses.textEnNkjv: For itis better that he say to you, "Come up here," Than that you should be put lower in the presence of the prince, Whom your eyes have seen.
verses.textEnNlt: It’s better to wait for an invitation to the head table than to be sent away in public disgrace. Just because you’ve seen something,
verses.textEnNasb: For it is better that it be said to you, "Come up here," Than for you to be placed lower in the presence of the prince, Whom your eyes have seen.
verses.textEn: it is better for him to say to you, "Come up here," than for him to humiliate you before his nobles. What you have seen with your eyes

verses.textZh: 不可轻率出去与人争讼； 否则，你的邻舍若使你受辱， 结果你要怎么办呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可轻率出去与人争讼； 否则，你的邻舍若使你受辱， 结果你要怎么办呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 不要冒失出去与人争竞， 免得至终被他羞辱， 你就不知道怎样行了。
verses.textEnNiv: do not bring hastily to court, for what will you do in the end if your neighbor puts you to shame?
verses.textEnEsv: do not hastily bring into court, for what will you do in the end, when your neighbor puts you to shame?
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not go hastily to court; For what will you do in the end, When your neighbor has put you to shame?
verses.textEnNlt: don’t be in a hurry to go to court. For what will you do in the end if your neighbor deals you a shameful defeat?
verses.textEnNasb: Do not go out hastily to argue your case; Otherwise, what will you do in the end, When your neighbor humiliates you?
verses.textEn: do not bring hastily to court, for what will you do in the end if your neighbor puts you to shame?

verses.textZh: 如果有纷争，只与你的邻舍一人争论好了； 不可揭发别人的秘密，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有纷争，只与你的邻舍一人争论好了； 不可揭发别人的秘密，
verses.textZhCuv: 你与邻舍争讼， 要与他一人辩论， 不可泄漏人的密事，
verses.textEnNiv: If you take your neighbor to court, do not betray another’s confidence,
verses.textEnEsv: Argue your case with your neighbor himself, and do not reveal another’s secret,
verses.textEnNkjv: Debate your case with your neighbor, And do not disclose the secret to another;
verses.textEnNlt: When arguing with your neighbor, don’t betray another person’s secret.
verses.textEnNasb: Argue your case with your neighbor, And do not reveal the secret of another,
verses.textEn: If you take your neighbor to court, do not betray another’s confidence,

verses.textZh: 恐怕听见的人辱骂你， 你的恶名就不能脱掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恐怕听见的人辱骂你， 你的恶名就不能脱掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 恐怕听见的人骂你， 你的臭名就难以脱离。
verses.textEnNiv: or the one who hears it may shame you and the charge against you will stand.
verses.textEnEsv: lest he who hears you bring shame upon you, and your ill repute have no end.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lest he who hears it expose your shame, And your reputation be ruined.
verses.textEnNlt: Others may accuse you of gossip, and you will never regain your good reputation.
verses.textEnNasb: Or one who hears it will put you to shame, And the evil report about you will not pass away.
verses.textEn: or the one who hears it may shame you and the charge against you will stand.

verses.textZh: 一句话说得合宜， 就像金苹果镶在银的器物上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一句话说得合宜， 就像金苹果镶在银的器物上。
verses.textZhCuv: 一句话说得合宜， 就如金苹果在银网子里。
verses.textEnNiv: Like apples of gold in settings of silver is a ruling rightly given.
verses.textEnEsv: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in a setting of silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: A word fitly spoken islike apples of gold In settings of silver.
verses.textEnNlt: Timely advice is lovely, like golden apples in a silver basket.
verses.textEnNasb: Like apples of gold in settings of silver, Is a word spoken at the proper time.
verses.textEn: Like apples of gold in settings of silver is a ruling rightly given.

verses.textZh: 智慧人的责备在听从的人耳中， 好象金耳环和精金的饰物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧人的责备在听从的人耳中， 好象金耳环和精金的饰物。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧人的劝戒，在顺从的人耳中， 好像金耳环和精金的妆饰。
verses.textEnNiv: Like an earring of gold or an ornament of fine gold is the rebuke of a wise judge to a listening ear.
verses.textEnEsv: Like a gold ring or an ornament of gold is a wise reprover to a listening ear.
verses.textEnNkjv: Like an earring of gold and an ornament of fine gold Is a wise rebuker to an obedient ear.
verses.textEnNlt: To one who listens, valid criticism is like a gold earring or other gold jewelry.
verses.textEnNasb: Like an earring of gold and a jewelry piece of fine gold, Is a wise person who offers rebukes to a listening ear.
verses.textEn: Like an earring of gold or an ornament of fine gold is the rebuke of a wise judge to a listening ear.

verses.textZh: 忠信的使者对那些差遣他的人来说， 好象在收割的时候，有冰雪的凉气， 使主人精神舒畅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 忠信的使者对那些差遣他的人来说， 好象在收割的时候，有冰雪的凉气， 使主人精神舒畅。
verses.textZhCuv: 忠信的使者叫差他的人心里舒畅， 就如在收割时有冰雪的凉气。
verses.textEnNiv: Like a snow-cooled drink at harvest time is a trustworthy messenger to the one who sends him; he refreshes the spirit of his master.
verses.textEnEsv: Like the cold of snow in the time of harvest is a faithful messenger to those who send him; he refreshes the soul of his masters.
verses.textEnNkjv: Like the cold of snow in time of harvest Is a faithful messenger to those who send him, For he refreshes the soul of his masters.
verses.textEnNlt: Trustworthy messengers refresh like snow in summer. They revive the spirit of their employer.
verses.textEnNasb: Like the cold of snow in the time of harvest Is a faithful messenger to those who send him, For he refreshes the soul of his masters.
verses.textEn: Like a snow-cooled drink at harvest time is a trustworthy messenger to the one who sends him; he refreshes the spirit of his master.

verses.textZh: 空夸送礼却没有实行的人， 就像无雨的风云。
verses.textZhCnvs: 空夸送礼却没有实行的人， 就像无雨的风云。
verses.textZhCuv: 空夸赠送礼物的， 好像无雨的风云。
verses.textEnNiv: Like clouds and wind without rain is one who boasts of gifts never given.
verses.textEnEsv: Like clouds and wind without rain is a man who boasts of a gift he does not give.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever falsely boasts of giving Islike clouds and wind without rain.
verses.textEnNlt: A person who promises a gift but doesn’t give it is like clouds and wind that bring no rain.
verses.textEnNasb: Like clouds and wind without rain Is a person who boasts of his gifts falsely.
verses.textEn: Like clouds and wind without rain is one who boasts of gifts never given.

verses.textZh: 恒久忍耐可以劝服掌权的人， 柔和的舌头，可以折断骨头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恒久忍耐可以劝服掌权的人， 柔和的舌头，可以折断骨头。
verses.textZhCuv: 恒常忍耐可以劝动君王； 柔和的舌头能折断骨头。
verses.textEnNiv: Through patience a ruler can be persuaded, and a gentle tongue can break a bone.
verses.textEnEsv: With patience a ruler may be persuaded, and a soft tongue will break a bone.
verses.textEnNkjv: By long forbearance a ruler is persuaded, And a gentle tongue breaks a bone.
verses.textEnNlt: Patience can persuade a prince, and soft speech can break bones.
verses.textEnNasb: Through patience a ruler may be persuaded, And a gentle tongue breaks bone.
verses.textEn: Through patience a ruler can be persuaded, and a gentle tongue can break a bone.

verses.textZh: 你找到蜂蜜，吃够就好了； 免得吃得过多，就呕吐出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你找到蜂蜜，吃够就好了； 免得吃得过多，就呕吐出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 你得了蜜吗？只可吃够而已， 恐怕你过饱就呕吐出来。
verses.textEnNiv: If you find honey, eat just enough— too much of it, and you will vomit.
verses.textEnEsv: If you have found honey, eat only enough for you, lest you have your fill of it and vomit it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Have you found honey? Eat only as much as you need, Lest you be filled with it and vomit.
verses.textEnNlt: Do you like honey? Don’t eat too much, or it will make you sick!
verses.textEnNasb: Have you found honey? Eat only what you need, So that you do not have it in excess and vomit it.
verses.textEn: If you find honey, eat just enough— too much of it, and you will vomit.

verses.textZh: 你的脚要少进邻舍的家； 免得他厌烦你，就憎恶你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的脚要少进邻舍的家； 免得他厌烦你，就憎恶你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的脚要少进邻舍的家， 恐怕他厌烦你，恨恶你。
verses.textEnNiv: Seldom set foot in your neighbor’s house— too much of you, and they will hate you.
verses.textEnEsv: Let your foot be seldom in your neighbor’s house, lest he have his fill of you and hate you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Seldom set foot in your neighbor’s house, Lest he become weary of you and hate you.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t visit your neighbors too often, or you will wear out your welcome.
verses.textEnNasb: Let your foot rarely be in your neighbor’s house, Or he will become weary of you and hate you.
verses.textEn: Seldom set foot in your neighbor’s house— too much of you, and they will hate you.

verses.textZh: 作假见证陷害邻舍的人， 就像大锤、快刀和利箭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 作假见证陷害邻舍的人， 就像大锤、快刀和利箭。
verses.textZhCuv: 作假见证陷害邻舍的， 就是大槌，是利刀，是快箭。
verses.textEnNiv: Like a club or a sword or a sharp arrow is one who gives false testimony against a neighbor.
verses.textEnEsv: A man who bears false witness against his neighbor is like a war club, or a sword, or a sharp arrow.
verses.textEnNkjv: A man who bears false witness against his neighbor Islike a club, a sword, and a sharp arrow.
verses.textEnNlt: Telling lies about others is as harmful as hitting them with an ax, wounding them with a sword, or shooting them with a sharp arrow.
verses.textEnNasb: Like a club, a sword, and a sharp arrow Is a person who gives false testimony against his neighbor.
verses.textEn: Like a club or a sword or a sharp arrow is one who gives false testimony against a neighbor.

verses.textZh: 遭遇灾难的时候，倚靠奸诈的人， 就像倚靠坏牙和不稳的脚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 遭遇灾难的时候，倚靠奸诈的人， 就像倚靠坏牙和不稳的脚。
verses.textZhCuv: 患难时倚靠不忠诚的人， 好像破坏的牙，错骨缝的脚。
verses.textEnNiv: Like a broken tooth or a lame foot is reliance on the unfaithful in a time of trouble.
verses.textEnEsv: Trusting in a treacherous man in time of trouble is like a bad tooth or a foot that slips.
verses.textEnNkjv: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble Islike a bad tooth and a foot out of joint.
verses.textEnNlt: Putting confidence in an unreliable person in times of trouble is like chewing with a broken tooth or walking on a lame foot.
verses.textEnNasb: Like a bad tooth and an unsteady foot Is confidence in a treacherous person in time of trouble.
verses.textEn: Like a broken tooth or a lame foot is reliance on the unfaithful in a time of trouble.

verses.textZh: 对着悲伤的心灵唱歌， 就像冷天脱衣服，又像碱上倒酸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对着悲伤的心灵唱歌， 就像冷天脱衣服，又像碱上倒酸。
verses.textZhCuv: 对伤心的人唱歌， 就如冷天脱衣服， 又如硷上倒醋。
verses.textEnNiv: Like one who takes away a garment on a cold day, or like vinegar poured on a wound, is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever sings songs to a heavy heart is like one who takes off a garment on a cold day, and like vinegar on soda.
verses.textEnNkjv: Like one who takes away a garment in cold weather, Andlike vinegar on soda, Is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Singing cheerful songs to a person with a heavy heart is like taking someone’s coat in cold weather or pouring vinegar in a wound.
verses.textEnNasb: Like one who takes off a garment on a cold day, or like vinegar on soda, Is one who sings songs to a troubled heart.
verses.textEn: Like one who takes away a garment on a cold day, or like vinegar poured on a wound, is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.

verses.textZh: 如果你的仇敌饿了，就给他食物吃； 如果渴了，就给他水喝，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你的仇敌饿了，就给他食物吃； 如果渴了，就给他水喝，
verses.textZhCuv: 你的仇敌若饿了，就给他饭吃； 若渴了，就给他水喝；
verses.textEnNiv: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat; if he is thirsty, give him water to drink.
verses.textEnEsv: If your enemy is hungry, give him bread to eat, and if he is thirsty, give him water to drink,
verses.textEnNkjv: If your enemy is hungry, give him bread to eat; And if he is thirsty, give him water to drink;
verses.textEnNlt: If your enemies are hungry, give them food to eat. If they are thirsty, give them water to drink.
verses.textEnNasb: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat; And if he is thirsty, give him water to drink;
verses.textEn: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat; if he is thirsty, give him water to drink.

verses.textZh: 因为你这样作，就是把炭火堆在他的头上， 耶和华必还报你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你这样作，就是把炭火堆在他的头上， 耶和华必还报你。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，你这样行就是把炭火堆在他的头上； 耶和华也必赏赐你。
verses.textEnNiv: In doing this, you will heap burning coals on his head, and the Lord will reward you.
verses.textEnEsv: for you will heap burning coals on his head, and the Lord will reward you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For so you will heap coals of fire on his head, And the Lord will reward you.
verses.textEnNlt: You will heap burning coals of shame on their heads, and the Lord will reward you.
verses.textEnNasb: For you will heap burning coals on his head, And the Lord will reward you.
verses.textEn: In doing this, you will heap burning coals on his head, and the Lord will reward you.

verses.textZh: 北风带来雨水； 暗中毁谤人的舌头，使人怒容满面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 北风带来雨水； 暗中毁谤人的舌头，使人怒容满面。
verses.textZhCuv: 北风生雨， 谗谤人的舌头也生怒容。
verses.textEnNiv: Like a north wind that brings unexpected rain is a sly tongue—which provokes a horrified look.
verses.textEnEsv: The north wind brings forth rain, and a backbiting tongue, angry looks.
verses.textEnNkjv: The north wind brings forth rain, And a backbiting tongue an angry countenance.
verses.textEnNlt: As surely as a north wind brings rain, so a gossiping tongue causes anger!
verses.textEnNasb: The north wind brings rain, And a gossiping tongue brings an angry face.
verses.textEn: Like a north wind that brings unexpected rain is a sly tongue—which provokes a horrified look.

verses.textZh: 宁可住在房顶的一角， 也不跟吵闹的妇人同住一间房屋。
verses.textZhCnvs: 宁可住在房顶的一角， 也不跟吵闹的妇人同住一间房屋。
verses.textZhCuv: 宁可住在房顶的角上， 不在宽阔的房屋与争吵的妇人同住。
verses.textEnNiv: Better to live on a corner of the roof than share a house with a quarrelsome wife.
verses.textEnEsv: It is better to live in a corner of the housetop than in a house shared with a quarrelsome wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis better to dwell in a corner of a housetop, Than in a house shared with a contentious woman.
verses.textEnNlt: It’s better to live alone in the corner of an attic than with a quarrelsome wife in a lovely home.
verses.textEnNasb: It is better to live on a corner of the roof, Than in a house shared with a contentious woman.
verses.textEn: Better to live on a corner of the roof than share a house with a quarrelsome wife.

verses.textZh: 来自远方的好消息， 好象疲乏的人得喝凉水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 来自远方的好消息， 好象疲乏的人得喝凉水。
verses.textZhCuv: 有好消息从远方来， 就如拿凉水给口渴的人喝。
verses.textEnNiv: Like cold water to a weary soul is good news from a distant land.
verses.textEnEsv: Like cold water to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.
verses.textEnNkjv: As cold water to a weary soul, So is good news from a far country.
verses.textEnNlt: Good news from far away is like cold water to the thirsty.
verses.textEnNasb: Like cold water to a weary soul, So is good news from a distant land.
verses.textEn: Like cold water to a weary soul is good news from a distant land.

verses.textZh: 义人在恶人面前屈服， 好象混浊了的水泉、污染了的水井。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人在恶人面前屈服， 好象混浊了的水泉、污染了的水井。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人在恶人面前退缩， 好像趟浑之泉，弄浊之井。
verses.textEnNiv: Like a muddied spring or a polluted well are the righteous who give way to the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: Like a muddied spring or a polluted fountain is a righteous man who gives way before the wicked.
verses.textEnNkjv: A righteous man who falters before the wicked Islike a murky spring and a polluted well.
verses.textEnNlt: If the godly give in to the wicked, it’s like polluting a fountain or muddying a spring.
verses.textEnNasb: Like a trampled spring and a polluted well, So is a righteous person who gives way before the wicked.
verses.textEn: Like a muddied spring or a polluted well are the righteous who give way to the wicked.

verses.textZh: 吃蜜过多是不好的； 追寻自己的荣耀，也是不好的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 吃蜜过多是不好的； 追寻自己的荣耀，也是不好的。
verses.textZhCuv: 吃蜜过多是不好的； 考究自己的荣耀也是可厌的。
verses.textEnNiv: It is not good to eat too much honey, nor is it honorable to search out matters that are too deep.
verses.textEnEsv: It is not good to eat much honey, nor is it glorious to seek one’s own glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis not good to eat much honey; So to seek one’s own glory isnot glory.
verses.textEnNlt: It’s not good to eat too much honey, and it’s not good to seek honors for yourself.
verses.textEnNasb: It is not good to eat much honey, Nor is it glory to search out one’s own glory.
verses.textEn: It is not good to eat too much honey, nor is it honorable to search out matters that are too deep.

verses.textZh: 人若不控制自己的心， 就像没有城墙，毁坏了的城一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人若不控制自己的心， 就像没有城墙，毁坏了的城一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 人不制伏自己的心， 好像毁坏的城邑没有墙垣。
verses.textEnNiv: Like a city whose walls are broken through is a person who lacks self-control.
verses.textEnEsv: A man without self-control is like a city broken into and left without walls.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever has no rule over his own spirit Islike a city broken down, without walls.
verses.textEnNlt: A person without self-control is like a city with broken-down walls.
verses.textEnNasb: Like a city that is broken into and without walls So is a person who has no self-control over his spirit.
verses.textEn: Like a city whose walls are broken through is a person who lacks self-control.

verses.textZh: 夏天落雪，收割时下雨，都不合宜； 照样，愚昧人获得尊荣，也不合宜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 夏天落雪，收割时下雨，都不合宜； 照样，愚昧人获得尊荣，也不合宜。
verses.textZhCuv: 夏天落雪，收割时下雨，都不相宜； 愚昧人得尊荣也是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: Like snow in summer or rain in harvest, honor is not fitting for a fool.
verses.textEnEsv: Like snow in summer or rain in harvest, so honor is not fitting for a fool.
verses.textEnNkjv: As snow in summer and rain in harvest, So honor is not fitting for a fool.
verses.textEnNlt: Honor is no more associated with fools than snow with summer or rain with harvest.
verses.textEnNasb: Like snow in summer and like rain in harvest, So honor is not fitting for a fool.
verses.textEn: Like snow in summer or rain in harvest, honor is not fitting for a fool.

verses.textZh: 麻雀怎样飞来飞去，燕子怎样翻飞； 照样，无故的咒诅也不会临到人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 麻雀怎样飞来飞去，燕子怎样翻飞； 照样，无故的咒诅也不会临到人。
verses.textZhCuv: 麻雀往来，燕子翻飞； 这样，无故的咒诅也必不临到。
verses.textEnNiv: Like a fluttering sparrow or a darting swallow, an undeserved curse does not come to rest.
verses.textEnEsv: Like a sparrow in its flitting, like a swallow in its flying, a curse that is causeless does not alight.
verses.textEnNkjv: Like a flitting sparrow, like a flying swallow, So a curse without cause shall not alight.
verses.textEnNlt: Like a fluttering sparrow or a darting swallow, an undeserved curse will not land on its intended victim.
verses.textEnNasb: Like a sparrow in its flitting, like a swallow in its flying, So a curse without cause does not come to rest.
verses.textEn: Like a fluttering sparrow or a darting swallow, an undeserved curse does not come to rest.

verses.textZh: 鞭子是为了打马，嚼环是为了勒驴； 刑杖是为了打愚昧人的背。
verses.textZhCnvs: 鞭子是为了打马，嚼环是为了勒驴； 刑杖是为了打愚昧人的背。
verses.textZhCuv: 鞭子是为打马，辔头是为勒驴； 刑杖是为打愚昧人的背。
verses.textEnNiv: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the backs of fools!
verses.textEnEsv: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the back of fools.
verses.textEnNkjv: A whip for the horse, A bridle for the donkey, And a rod for the fool’s back.
verses.textEnNlt: Guide a horse with a whip, a donkey with a bridle, and a fool with a rod to his back!
verses.textEnNasb: A whip is for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, And a rod for the back of fools.
verses.textEn: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the backs of fools!

verses.textZh: 不要照着愚昧人的愚妄回答他， 免得你像他一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要照着愚昧人的愚妄回答他， 免得你像他一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要照愚昧人的愚妄话回答他， 恐怕你与他一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not answer a fool according to his folly, or you yourself will be just like him.
verses.textEnEsv: Answer not a fool according to his folly, lest you be like him yourself.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not answer a fool according to his folly, Lest you also be like him.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t answer the foolish arguments of fools, or you will become as foolish as they are.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not answer a fool according to his foolishness, Or you will also be like him.
verses.textEn: Do not answer a fool according to his folly, or you yourself will be just like him.

verses.textZh: 要照着愚昧人的愚妄回答他， 免得他自以为有智慧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要照着愚昧人的愚妄回答他， 免得他自以为有智慧。
verses.textZhCuv: 要照愚昧人的愚妄话回答他， 免得他自以为有智慧。
verses.textEnNiv: Answer a fool according to his folly, or he will be wise in his own eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Answer a fool according to his folly, Lest he be wise in his own eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: Be sure to answer the foolish arguments of fools, or they will become wise in their own estimation.
verses.textEnNasb: Answer a fool as his foolishness deserves, So that he will not be wise in his own eyes.
verses.textEn: Answer a fool according to his folly, or he will be wise in his own eyes.

verses.textZh: 藉愚昧人的手传递信息的， 是自断己足，自寻烦恼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 藉愚昧人的手传递信息的， 是自断己足，自寻烦恼。
verses.textZhCuv: 藉愚昧人手寄信的， 是砍断自己的脚，自受 损害。
verses.textEnNiv: Sending a message by the hands of a fool is like cutting off one’s feet or drinking poison.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever sends a message by the hand of a fool cuts off his own feet and drinks violence.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who sends a message by the hand of a fool Cuts off hisown feet and drinks violence.
verses.textEnNlt: Trusting a fool to convey a message is like cutting off one’s feet or drinking poison!
verses.textEnNasb: One who sends a message by the hand of a fool Chops off his own feet and drinks violence.
verses.textEn: Sending a message by the hands of a fool is like cutting off one’s feet or drinking poison.

verses.textZh: 箴言在愚昧人口中， 就像瘸子的腿，虚悬无用。
verses.textZhCnvs: 箴言在愚昧人口中， 就像瘸子的腿，虚悬无用。
verses.textZhCuv: 瘸子的脚空存无用； 箴言在愚昧人的口中也是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: Like the useless legs of one who is lame is a proverb in the mouth of a fool.
verses.textEnEsv: Like a lame man’s legs, which hang useless, is a proverb in the mouth of fools.
verses.textEnNkjv: Like the legs of the lame that hang limp Is a proverb in the mouth of fools.
verses.textEnNlt: A proverb in the mouth of a fool is as useless as a paralyzed leg.
verses.textEnNasb: Like useless legs to one who cannot walk, So is a proverb in the mouths of fools.
verses.textEn: Like the useless legs of one who is lame is a proverb in the mouth of a fool.

verses.textZh: 把荣耀给愚昧人的， 就像人把石子系在投石器上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把荣耀给愚昧人的， 就像人把石子系在投石器上。
verses.textZhCuv: 将尊荣给愚昧人的， 好像人把石子包在机弦里。
verses.textEnNiv: Like tying a stone in a sling is the giving of honor to a fool.
verses.textEnEsv: Like one who binds the stone in the sling is one who gives honor to a fool.
verses.textEnNkjv: Like one who binds a stone in a sling Is he who gives honor to a fool.
verses.textEnNlt: Honoring a fool is as foolish as tying a stone to a slingshot.
verses.textEnNasb: Like one who binds a stone in a sling, So is one who gives honor to a fool.
verses.textEn: Like tying a stone in a sling is the giving of honor to a fool.

verses.textZh: 箴言在愚昧人口中， 就像荆棘在醉汉手里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 箴言在愚昧人口中， 就像荆棘在醉汉手里。
verses.textZhCuv: 箴言在愚昧人的口中， 好像荆棘刺入醉汉的手。
verses.textEnNiv: Like a thornbush in a drunkard’s hand is a proverb in the mouth of a fool.
verses.textEnEsv: Like a thorn that goes up into the hand of a drunkard is a proverb in the mouth of fools.
verses.textEnNkjv: Like a thorn that goes into the hand of a drunkard Is a proverb in the mouth of fools.
verses.textEnNlt: A proverb in the mouth of a fool is like a thorny branch brandished by a drunk.
verses.textEnNasb: Like a thorn that sticks in the hand of a heavy drinker, So is a proverb in the mouths of fools.
verses.textEn: Like a thornbush in a drunkard’s hand is a proverb in the mouth of a fool.

verses.textZh: 雇用愚昧人和过路人的， 就像胡乱射伤众人的弓箭手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雇用愚昧人和过路人的， 就像胡乱射伤众人的弓箭手。
verses.textZhCuv: 雇愚昧人的，与雇过路人的， 就像射伤众人的弓箭手。
verses.textEnNiv: Like an archer who wounds at random is one who hires a fool or any passer-by.
verses.textEnEsv: Like an archer who wounds everyone is one who hires a passing fool or drunkard.
verses.textEnNkjv: The great God who formed everything Gives the fool his hire and the transgressor his wages.
verses.textEnNlt: An employer who hires a fool or a bystander is like an archer who shoots at random.
verses.textEnNasb: Like an archer who wounds everyone, So is one who hires a fool or hires those who pass by.
verses.textEn: Like an archer who wounds at random is one who hires a fool or any passer-by.

verses.textZh: 愚昧人一再重复他的愚妄， 正像狗转过来，吃自己所吐的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚昧人一再重复他的愚妄， 正像狗转过来，吃自己所吐的。
verses.textZhCuv: 愚昧人行愚妄事，行了又行， 就如狗转过来吃它所吐的。
verses.textEnNiv: As a dog returns to its vomit, so fools repeat their folly.
verses.textEnEsv: Like a dog that returns to his vomit is a fool who repeats his folly.
verses.textEnNkjv: As a dog returns to his own vomit, So a fool repeats his folly.
verses.textEnNlt: As a dog returns to its vomit, so a fool repeats his foolishness.
verses.textEnNasb: Like a dog that returns to its vomit, So is a fool who repeats his foolishness.
verses.textEn: As a dog returns to its vomit, so fools repeat their folly.

verses.textZh: 你见过自以为有智慧的人吗？ 愚昧人比他更有指望。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你见过自以为有智慧的人吗？ 愚昧人比他更有指望。
verses.textZhCuv: 你见自以为有智慧的人吗？ 愚昧人比他更有指望。
verses.textEnNiv: Do you see a person wise in their own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for them.
verses.textEnEsv: Do you see a man who is wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? Thereis more hope for a fool than for him.
verses.textEnNlt: There is more hope for fools than for people who think they are wise.
verses.textEnNasb: Do you see a person wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
verses.textEn: Do you see a person wise in their own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for them.

verses.textZh: 懒惰人说："路上有狮子， 广场上也有狮子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 懒惰人说："路上有狮子， 广场上也有狮子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 懒惰人说：道上有猛狮， 街上有壮狮。
verses.textEnNiv: A sluggard says, "There’s a lion in the road, a fierce lion roaming the streets!"
verses.textEnEsv: The sluggard says, "There is a lion in the road! There is a lion in the streets!"
verses.textEnNkjv: The lazy man says, "Thereis a lion in the road! A fierce lion is in the streets!"
verses.textEnNlt: The lazy person claims, "There’s a lion on the road! Yes, I’m sure there’s a lion out there!"
verses.textEnNasb: A lazy one says, "There is a lion on the road! A lion is in the public square!"
verses.textEn: A sluggard says, "There’s a lion in the road, a fierce lion roaming the streets!"

verses.textZh: 懒惰人在床上翻动， 就像门绕着门铰转动一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 懒惰人在床上翻动， 就像门绕着门铰转动一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 门在枢纽转动， 懒惰人在床上也是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: As a door turns on its hinges, so a sluggard turns on his bed.
verses.textEnEsv: As a door turns on its hinges, so does a sluggard on his bed.
verses.textEnNkjv: As a door turns on its hinges, So does the lazy man on his bed.
verses.textEnNlt: As a door swings back and forth on its hinges, so the lazy person turns over in bed.
verses.textEnNasb: As the door turns on its hinges, So does a lazy one on his bed.
verses.textEn: As a door turns on its hinges, so a sluggard turns on his bed.

verses.textZh: 懒惰人把手放在盘子里， 连拿食物送回口边也觉得劳累。
verses.textZhCnvs: 懒惰人把手放在盘子里， 连拿食物送回口边也觉得劳累。
verses.textZhCuv: 懒惰人放手在盘子里， 就是向口撤回也以为劳乏。
verses.textEnNiv: A sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.
verses.textEnEsv: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; it wears him out to bring it back to his mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: The lazy man buries his hand in the bowl; It wearies him to bring it back to his mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: Lazy people take food in their hand but don’t even lift it to their mouth.
verses.textEnNasb: A lazy one buries his hand in the dish; He is weary of bringing it to his mouth again.
verses.textEn: A sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.

verses.textZh: 懒惰人看自己， 比七个善于应对的人更有智慧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 懒惰人看自己， 比七个善于应对的人更有智慧。
verses.textZhCuv: 懒惰人看自己比七个善于应对的人更有智慧。
verses.textEnNiv: A sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven people who answer discreetly.
verses.textEnEsv: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who can answer sensibly.
verses.textEnNkjv: The lazy manis wiser in his own eyes Than seven men who can answer sensibly.
verses.textEnNlt: Lazy people consider themselves smarter than seven wise counselors.
verses.textEnNasb: A lazy one is wiser in his own eyes Than seven people who can give a discreet answer.
verses.textEn: A sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven people who answer discreetly.

verses.textZh: 过路的人被激怒，去干涉与自己无关的争执， 就像人揪住狗的耳朵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过路的人被激怒，去干涉与自己无关的争执， 就像人揪住狗的耳朵。
verses.textZhCuv: 过路被事激动，管理不干己的争竞， 好像人揪住狗耳。
verses.textEnNiv: Like one who grabs a stray dog by the ears is someone who rushes into a quarrel not their own.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever meddles in a quarrel not his own is like one who takes a passing dog by the ears.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who passes by and meddles in a quarrel not his own Islike one who takes a dog by the ears.
verses.textEnNlt: Interfering in someone else’s argument is as foolish as yanking a dog’s ears.
verses.textEnNasb: Like one who takes a dog by the ears, So is one who passes by and meddles with strife not belonging to him.
verses.textEn: Like one who grabs a stray dog by the ears is someone who rushes into a quarrel not their own.

verses.textZh: 却说："我不过是开玩笑罢了。" 他就像疯狂的人， 投掷火把、利箭和杀人的武器。
verses.textZhCnvs: 却说："我不过是开玩笑罢了。" 他就像疯狂的人， 投掷火把、利箭和杀人的武器。
verses.textZhCuv: 我岂不是戏耍吗？ 他就像疯狂的人抛掷火把、利箭， 与杀人的兵器 。
verses.textEnNiv: Like a maniac shooting flaming arrows of death
verses.textEnEsv: Like a madman who throws firebrands, arrows, and death
verses.textEnNkjv: Like a madman who throws firebrands, arrows, and death,
verses.textEnNlt: Just as damaging as a madman shooting a deadly weapon
verses.textEnNasb: Like a maniac who shoots Flaming arrows, arrows, and death,
verses.textEn: Like a maniac shooting flaming arrows of death

verses.textZh: 没有柴，火就熄灭； 没有搬弄是非的人，纷争就平息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有柴，火就熄灭； 没有搬弄是非的人，纷争就平息。
verses.textZhCuv: 火缺了柴就必熄灭； 无人传舌，争竞便止息。
verses.textEnNiv: is one who deceives their neighbor and says, "I was only joking!"
verses.textEnEsv: is the man who deceives his neighbor and says, "I am only joking!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Is the man who deceives his neighbor, And says, "I was only joking!"
verses.textEnNlt: is someone who lies to a friend and then says, "I was only joking."
verses.textEnNasb: So is a person who deceives his neighbor, And says, "Was I not joking?"
verses.textEn: is one who deceives their neighbor and says, "I was only joking!"

verses.textZh: 好争竞的人，煽动争端， 就像余烬上加炭，火上加柴一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好争竞的人，煽动争端， 就像余烬上加炭，火上加柴一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 好争竞的人煽惑争端， 就如余火加炭，火上加柴一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Without wood a fire goes out; without a gossip a quarrel dies down.
verses.textEnEsv: For lack of wood the fire goes out, and where there is no whisperer, quarreling ceases.
verses.textEnNkjv: Where thereis no wood, the fire goes out; And where thereis no talebearer, strife ceases.
verses.textEnNlt: Fire goes out without wood, and quarrels disappear when gossip stops.
verses.textEnNasb: For lack of wood the fire goes out, And where there is no gossiper, quarreling quiets down.
verses.textEn: Without wood a fire goes out; without a gossip a quarrel dies down.

verses.textZh: 搬弄是非的人的言语如同美食； 深入人的脏腑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 搬弄是非的人的言语如同美食； 深入人的脏腑。
verses.textZhCuv: 传舌人的言语，如同美食， 深入人的心腹。
verses.textEnNiv: As charcoal to embers and as wood to fire, so is a quarrelsome person for kindling strife.
verses.textEnEsv: As charcoal to hot embers and wood to fire, so is a quarrelsome man for kindling strife.
verses.textEnNkjv: As charcoal is to burning coals, and wood to fire, So is a contentious man to kindle strife.
verses.textEnNlt: A quarrelsome person starts fights as easily as hot embers light charcoal or fire lights wood.
verses.textEnNasb: Like charcoal to hot embers and wood to fire, So is a contentious person to kindle strife.
verses.textEn: As charcoal to embers and as wood to fire, so is a quarrelsome person for kindling strife.

verses.textZh: 嘴唇火热，心却奸恶， 就像包上银渣的瓦器。
verses.textZhCnvs: 嘴唇火热，心却奸恶， 就像包上银渣的瓦器。
verses.textZhCuv: 火热的嘴，奸恶的心， 好像银渣包的瓦器。
verses.textEnNiv: The words of a gossip are like choice morsels; they go down to the inmost parts.
verses.textEnEsv: The words of a whisperer are like delicious morsels; they go down into the inner parts of the body.
verses.textEnNkjv: The words of a talebearer are like tasty trifles, And they go down into the inmost body.
verses.textEnNlt: Rumors are dainty morsels that sink deep into one’s heart.
verses.textEnNasb: The words of a gossiper are like dainty morsels, And they go down into the innermost parts of the body.
verses.textEn: The words of a gossip are like choice morsels; they go down to the inmost parts.

verses.textZh: 憎恶人的用话语掩饰自己， 心里却存着诡诈。
verses.textZhCnvs: 憎恶人的用话语掩饰自己， 心里却存着诡诈。
verses.textZhCuv: 怨恨人的，用嘴粉饰， 心里却藏着诡诈；
verses.textEnNiv: Like a coating of silver dross on earthenware are fervent lips with an evil heart.
verses.textEnEsv: Like the glaze covering an earthen vessel are fervent lips with an evil heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: Fervent lips with a wicked heart Arelike earthenware covered with silver dross.
verses.textEnNlt: Smooth words may hide a wicked heart, just as a pretty glaze covers a clay pot.
verses.textEnNasb: Like an earthenware vessel overlaid with silver impurities Are burning lips and a wicked heart.
verses.textEn: Like a coating of silver dross on earthenware are fervent lips with an evil heart.

verses.textZh: 他的话语虽然动听，你不可信他， 因为他心里有七样可厌恶的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的话语虽然动听，你不可信他， 因为他心里有七样可厌恶的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用甜言蜜语，你不可信他， 因为他心中有七样可憎恶的。
verses.textEnNiv: Enemies disguise themselves with their lips, but in their hearts they harbor deceit.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever hates disguises himself with his lips and harbors deceit in his heart;
verses.textEnNkjv: He who hates, disguises it with his lips, And lays up deceit within himself;
verses.textEnNlt: People may cover their hatred with pleasant words, but they’re deceiving you.
verses.textEnNasb: One who hates disguises it with his lips, But he harbors deceit in his heart.
verses.textEn: Enemies disguise themselves with their lips, but in their hearts they harbor deceit.

verses.textZh: 他的怨恨虽然以诡诈掩饰， 但他的邪恶必在大会中显露出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的怨恨虽然以诡诈掩饰， 但他的邪恶必在大会中显露出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他虽用诡诈遮掩自己的怨恨， 他的邪恶必在会中显露。
verses.textEnNiv: Though their speech is charming, do not believe them, for seven abominations fill their hearts.
verses.textEnEsv: when he speaks graciously, believe him not, for there are seven abominations in his heart;
verses.textEnNkjv: When he speaks kindly, do not believe him, For thereare seven abominations in his heart;
verses.textEnNlt: They pretend to be kind, but don’t believe them. Their hearts are full of many evils.
