verses.textEnNasb: When he speaks graciously, do not believe him, Because there are seven abominations in his heart.
verses.textEn: Though their speech is charming, do not believe them, for seven abominations fill their hearts.

verses.textZh: 挖掘陷坑的，自己必掉在其中； 辊石头的，石头必辊回自己身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 挖掘陷坑的，自己必掉在其中； 辊石头的，石头必辊回自己身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 挖陷坑的，自己必掉在其中； 滚石头的，石头必反滚在他身上。
verses.textEnNiv: Their malice may be concealed by deception, but their wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.
verses.textEnEsv: though his hatred be covered with deception, his wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thoughhis hatred is covered by deceit, His wickedness will be revealed before the assembly.
verses.textEnNlt: While their hatred may be concealed by trickery, their wrongdoing will be exposed in public.
verses.textEnNasb: Though his hatred covers itself with deception, His wickedness will be revealed in the assembly.
verses.textEn: Their malice may be concealed by deception, but their wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.

verses.textZh: 虚谎的舌头憎恶被它伤害的人； 谄媚的口造成败坏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虚谎的舌头憎恶被它伤害的人； 谄媚的口造成败坏。
verses.textZhCuv: 虚谎的舌恨他所压伤的人； 谄媚的口败坏人的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever digs a pit will fall into it; if someone rolls a stone, it will roll back on them.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever digs a pit will fall into it, and a stone will come back on him who starts it rolling.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever digs a pit will fall into it, And he who rolls a stone will have it roll back on him.
verses.textEnNlt: If you set a trap for others, you will get caught in it yourself. If you roll a boulder down on others, it will crush you instead.
verses.textEnNasb: One who digs a pit will fall into it, And one who rolls a stone, it will come back on him.
verses.textEn: Whoever digs a pit will fall into it; if someone rolls a stone, it will roll back on them.

verses.textZh: 虚谎的舌恨它所压伤的人；谄媚的口败坏人的事。
verses.textEnNiv: A lying tongue hates those it hurts, and a flattering mouth works ruin.
verses.textEnEsv: A lying tongue hates its victims, and a flattering mouth works ruin.
verses.textEnNkjv: A lying tongue hates thosewhoare crushed by it, And a flattering mouth works ruin.
verses.textEnNlt: A lying tongue hates its victims, and flattering words cause ruin.
verses.textEnNasb: A lying tongue hates those it crushes, And a flattering mouth works ruin.
verses.textEn: A lying tongue hates those it hurts, and a flattering mouth works ruin.
verses.textZhCn: 虚谎的舌恨它所压伤的人；谄媚的口败坏人的事。

verses.textZh: 不要为明日自夸， 因为今天要发生甚么事，你尚且不知道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要为明日自夸， 因为今天要发生甚么事，你尚且不知道。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要为明日自夸， 因为一日要生何事，你尚且不能知道。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not boast about tomorrow, for you do not know what a day may bring.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not boast about tomorrow, for you do not know what a day may bring.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not boast about tomorrow, For you do not know what a day may bring forth.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t brag about tomorrow, since you don’t know what the day will bring.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not boast about tomorrow, For you do not know what a day may bring.
verses.textEn: Do not boast about tomorrow, for you do not know what a day may bring.

verses.textZh: 让外人夸奖你，不可自己夸奖自己； 让别人称赞你，不可自己称赞自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 让外人夸奖你，不可自己夸奖自己； 让别人称赞你，不可自己称赞自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 要别人夸奖你，不可用口自夸； 等外人称赞你，不可用嘴自称。
verses.textEnNiv: Let someone else praise you, and not your own mouth; an outsider, and not your own lips.
verses.textEnEsv: Let another praise you, and not your own mouth; a stranger, and not your own lips.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let another man praise you, and not your own mouth; A stranger, and not your own lips.
verses.textEnNlt: Let someone else praise you, not your own mouth— a stranger, not your own lips.
verses.textEnNasb: Let another praise you, and not your own mouth; A stranger, and not your own lips.
verses.textEn: Let someone else praise you, and not your own mouth; an outsider, and not your own lips.

verses.textZh: 石头重，沙土也重， 愚妄人的怒气比这两样更重。
verses.textZhCnvs: 石头重，沙土也重， 愚妄人的怒气比这两样更重。
verses.textZhCuv: 石头重，沙土沉， 愚妄人的恼怒比这两样更重。
verses.textEnNiv: Stone is heavy and sand a burden, but a fool’s provocation is heavier than both.
verses.textEnEsv: A stone is heavy, and sand is weighty, but a fool’s provocation is heavier than both.
verses.textEnNkjv: A stone is heavy and sand is weighty, But a fool’s wrath is heavier than both of them.
verses.textEnNlt: A stone is heavy and sand is weighty, but the resentment caused by a fool is even heavier.
verses.textEnNasb: A stone is heavy and the sand weighty, But the provocation of a fool is heavier than both of them.
verses.textEn: Stone is heavy and sand a burden, but a fool’s provocation is heavier than both.

verses.textZh: 烈怒虽然凶残，暴怒又好象狂澜， 人还可以忍受； 但面对嫉妒，谁能站立得住呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 烈怒虽然凶残，暴怒又好象狂澜， 人还可以忍受； 但面对嫉妒，谁能站立得住呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 忿怒为残忍，怒气为狂澜， 惟有嫉妒，谁能敌得住呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Anger is cruel and fury overwhelming, but who can stand before jealousy?
verses.textEnEsv: Wrath is cruel, anger is overwhelming, but who can stand before jealousy?
verses.textEnNkjv: Wrath is cruel and anger a torrent, But who is able to stand before jealousy?
verses.textEnNlt: Anger is cruel, and wrath is like a flood, but jealousy is even more dangerous.
verses.textEnNasb: Wrath is fierce and anger is a flood, But who can stand before jealousy?
verses.textEn: Anger is cruel and fury overwhelming, but who can stand before jealousy?

verses.textZh: 坦白的责备， 胜过暗中的爱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 坦白的责备， 胜过暗中的爱。
verses.textZhCuv: 当面的责备强如背地的爱情。
verses.textEnNiv: Better is open rebuke than hidden love.
verses.textEnEsv: Better is open rebuke than hidden love.
verses.textEnNkjv: Open rebuke is better Than love carefully concealed.
verses.textEnNlt: An open rebuke is better than hidden love!
verses.textEnNasb: Better is open rebuke Than love that is concealed.
verses.textEn: Better is open rebuke than hidden love.

verses.textZh: 爱你的人加的创伤是出于忠诚； 恨你的人却与你连连亲吻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 爱你的人加的创伤是出于忠诚； 恨你的人却与你连连亲吻。
verses.textZhCuv: 朋友加的伤痕出于忠诚； 仇敌连连亲嘴却是多余。
verses.textEnNiv: Wounds from a friend can be trusted, but an enemy multiplies kisses.
verses.textEnEsv: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; profuse are the kisses of an enemy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Faithful are the wounds of a friend, But the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.
verses.textEnNlt: Wounds from a sincere friend are better than many kisses from an enemy.
verses.textEnNasb: Faithful are the wounds of a friend, But deceitful are the kisses of an enemy.
verses.textEn: Wounds from a friend can be trusted, but an enemy multiplies kisses.

verses.textZh: 吃饱的人连蜂房的蜜也厌恶； 饥饿的人连一切苦的东西都觉得甘甜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 吃饱的人连蜂房的蜜也厌恶； 饥饿的人连一切苦的东西都觉得甘甜。
verses.textZhCuv: 人吃饱了，厌恶蜂房的蜜； 人饥饿了，一切苦物都觉甘甜。
verses.textEnNiv: One who is full loathes honey from the comb, but to the hungry even what is bitter tastes sweet.
verses.textEnEsv: One who is full loathes honey, but to one who is hungry everything bitter is sweet.
verses.textEnNkjv: A satisfied soul loathes the honeycomb, But to a hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.
verses.textEnNlt: A person who is full refuses honey, but even bitter food tastes sweet to the hungry.
verses.textEnNasb: A satisfied person despises honey, But to a hungry person any bitter thing is sweet.
verses.textEn: One who is full loathes honey from the comb, but to the hungry even what is bitter tastes sweet.

verses.textZh: 离家的人到处飘泊， 好象离巢的雀鸟到处游飞一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 离家的人到处飘泊， 好象离巢的雀鸟到处游飞一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 人离本处飘流， 好像雀鸟离窝游飞。
verses.textEnNiv: Like a bird that flees its nest is anyone who flees from home.
verses.textEnEsv: Like a bird that strays from its nest is a man who strays from his home.
verses.textEnNkjv: Like a bird that wanders from its nest Is a man who wanders from his place.
verses.textEnNlt: A person who strays from home is like a bird that strays from its nest.
verses.textEnNasb: Like a bird that wanders from its nest, So is a person who wanders from his home.
verses.textEn: Like a bird that flees its nest is anyone who flees from home.

verses.textZh: 膏油和香料使人心畅快， 朋友真诚的劝勉也使人觉得甘甜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 膏油和香料使人心畅快， 朋友真诚的劝勉也使人觉得甘甜。
verses.textZhCuv: 膏油与香料使人心喜悦； 朋友诚实的劝教也是如此甘美。
verses.textEnNiv: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart, and the pleasantness of a friend springs from their heartfelt advice.
verses.textEnEsv: Oil and perfume make the heart glad, and the sweetness of a friend comes from his earnest counsel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Ointment and perfume delight the heart, And the sweetness of a man’s friend givesdelight by hearty counsel.
verses.textEnNlt: The heartfelt counsel of a friend is as sweet as perfume and incense.
verses.textEnNasb: Oil and perfume make the heart glad, And a person’s advice is sweet to his friend.
verses.textEn: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart, and the pleasantness of a friend springs from their heartfelt advice.

verses.textZh: 你的朋友和你父亲的朋友，你都不可离弃； 在你遭遇患难的日子，不可进你兄弟的家。 在附近的邻舍胜过在远方的兄弟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的朋友和你父亲的朋友，你都不可离弃； 在你遭遇患难的日子，不可进你兄弟的家。 在附近的邻舍胜过在远方的兄弟。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的朋友和父亲的朋友， 你都不可离弃。 你遭难的日子，不要上弟兄的家去； 相近的邻舍强如远方的弟兄。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not forsake your friend or a friend of your family, and do not go to your relative’s house when disaster strikes you— better a neighbor nearby than a relative far away.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not forsake your friend and your father’s friend, and do not go to your brother’s house in the day of your calamity. Better is a neighbor who is near than a brother who is far away.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not forsake your own friend or your father’s friend, Nor go to your brother’s house in the day of your calamity; Better is a neighbor nearby than a brother far away.
verses.textEnNlt: Never abandon a friend— either yours or your father’s. When disaster strikes, you won’t have to ask your brother for assistance. It’s better to go to a neighbor than to a brother who lives far away.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not abandon your friend or your father’s friend, And do not go to your brother’s house on the day of your disaster; Better is a neighbor who is near than a brother far away.
verses.textEn: Do not forsake your friend or a friend of your family, and do not go to your relative’s house when disaster strikes you— better a neighbor nearby than a relative far away.

verses.textZh: 我儿，你要作智慧人，使我的心快乐， 我也可以回答那羞辱我的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我儿，你要作智慧人，使我的心快乐， 我也可以回答那羞辱我的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我儿，你要作智慧人，好叫我的心欢喜， 使我可以回答那讥诮我的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart; then I can answer anyone who treats me with contempt.
verses.textEnEsv: Be wise, my son, and make my heart glad, that I may answer him who reproaches me.
verses.textEnNkjv: My son, be wise, and make my heart glad, That I may answer him who reproaches me.
verses.textEnNlt: Be wise, my child, and make my heart glad. Then I will be able to answer my critics.
verses.textEnNasb: Be wise, my son, and make my heart glad, So that I may reply to one who taunts me.
verses.textEn: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart; then I can answer anyone who treats me with contempt.

verses.textZh: 精明人看见灾祸，就躲藏起来； 愚蒙人反往前走，自取祸害。
verses.textZhCnvs: 精明人看见灾祸，就躲藏起来； 愚蒙人反往前走，自取祸害。
verses.textZhCuv: 通达人见祸藏躲； 愚蒙人前往受害。
verses.textEnNiv: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verses.textEnEsv: The prudent sees danger and hides himself, but the simple go on and suffer for it.
verses.textEnNkjv: A prudent man foresees evil and hides himself; The simple pass on and are punished.
verses.textEnNlt: A prudent person foresees danger and takes precautions. The simpleton goes blindly on and suffers the consequences.
verses.textEnNasb: A prudent person sees evil and hides himself; But the naive proceed, and pay the penalty.
verses.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.

verses.textZh: 谁为陌生人作保证人，就拿去谁的衣服； 谁替妓女作保证人，谁就要作担保。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁为陌生人作保证人，就拿去谁的衣服； 谁替妓女作保证人，谁就要作担保。
verses.textZhCuv: 谁为生人作保，就拿谁的衣服； 谁为外女作保，谁就承当。
verses.textEnNiv: Take the garment of one who puts up security for a stranger; hold it in pledge if it is done for an outsider.
verses.textEnEsv: Take a man’s garment when he has put up security for a stranger, and hold it in pledge when he puts up security for an adulteress.
verses.textEnNkjv: Take the garment of him who is surety for a stranger, And hold it in pledge when he is surety for a seductress.
verses.textEnNlt: Get security from someone who guarantees a stranger’s debt. Get a deposit if he does it for foreigners.
verses.textEnNasb: Take his garment when he becomes a guarantor for a stranger; And for a foreign woman seize a pledge from him.
verses.textEn: Take the garment of one who puts up security for a stranger; hold it in pledge if it is done for an outsider.

verses.textZh: 清晨起来大声为邻舍祝福的， 就等于是咒诅他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 清晨起来大声为邻舍祝福的， 就等于是咒诅他。
verses.textZhCuv: 清晨起来，大声给朋友祝福的， 就算是咒诅他。
verses.textEnNiv: If anyone loudly blesses their neighbor early in the morning, it will be taken as a curse.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever blesses his neighbor with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, will be counted as cursing.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who blesses his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, It will be counted a curse to him.
verses.textEnNlt: A loud and cheerful greeting early in the morning will be taken as a curse!
verses.textEnNasb: One who blesses his friend with a loud voice early in the morning, It will be considered a curse to him.
verses.textEn: If anyone loudly blesses their neighbor early in the morning, it will be taken as a curse.

verses.textZh: 下大雨的时候不断滴漏； 就像吵闹的妇人一样；
verses.textZhCnvs: 下大雨的时候不断滴漏； 就像吵闹的妇人一样；
verses.textZhCuv: 大雨之日连连滴漏， 和争吵的妇人一样；
verses.textEnNiv: A quarrelsome wife is like the dripping of a leaky roof in a rainstorm;
verses.textEnEsv: A continual dripping on a rainy day and a quarrelsome wife are alike;
verses.textEnNkjv: A continual dripping on a very rainy day And a contentious woman are alike;
verses.textEnNlt: A quarrelsome wife is as annoying as constant dripping on a rainy day.
verses.textEnNasb: A constant dripping on a day of steady rain And a contentious woman are alike;
verses.textEn: A quarrelsome wife is like the dripping of a leaky roof in a rainstorm;

verses.textZh: 谁要拦阻她，就像拦阻风， 也像右手抓油。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁要拦阻她，就像拦阻风， 也像右手抓油。
verses.textZhCuv: 想拦阻她的，便是拦阻风， 也是右手抓油。
verses.textEnNiv: restraining her is like restraining the wind or grasping oil with the hand.
verses.textEnEsv: to restrain her is to restrain the wind or to grasp oil in one’s right hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever restrains her restrains the wind, And grasps oil with his right hand.
verses.textEnNlt: Stopping her complaints is like trying to stop the wind or trying to hold something with greased hands.
verses.textEnNasb: He who would restrain her restrains the wind, And grasps oil with his right hand.
verses.textEn: restraining her is like restraining the wind or grasping oil with the hand.

verses.textZh: 铁磨铁，磨得锋利； 朋友互相切磋，才智 也变得敏锐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 铁磨铁，磨得锋利； 朋友互相切磋，才智 也变得敏锐。
verses.textZhCuv: 铁磨铁，磨出刃来； 朋友相感 也是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: As iron sharpens iron, so one person sharpens another.
verses.textEnEsv: Iron sharpens iron, and one man sharpens another.
verses.textEnNkjv: As iron sharpens iron, So a man sharpens the countenance of his friend.
verses.textEnNlt: As iron sharpens iron, so a friend sharpens a friend.
verses.textEnNasb: As iron sharpens iron, So one person sharpens another.
verses.textEn: As iron sharpens iron, so one person sharpens another.

verses.textZh: 照料无花果树的，必吃树上的果子； 事奉主人的，必得尊荣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 照料无花果树的，必吃树上的果子； 事奉主人的，必得尊荣。
verses.textZhCuv: 看守无花果树的，必吃树上的果子； 敬奉主人的，必得尊荣。
verses.textEnNiv: The one who guards a fig tree will eat its fruit, and whoever protects their master will be honored.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever tends a fig tree will eat its fruit, and he who guards his master will be honored.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever keeps the fig tree will eat its fruit; So he who waits on his master will be honored.
verses.textEnNlt: As workers who tend a fig tree are allowed to eat the fruit, so workers who protect their employer’s interests will be rewarded.
verses.textEnNasb: One who tends the fig tree will eat its fruit, And one who cares for his master will be honored.
verses.textEn: The one who guards a fig tree will eat its fruit, and whoever protects their master will be honored.

verses.textZh: 水怎样映照人面， 人的心思也怎样反映其人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 水怎样映照人面， 人的心思也怎样反映其人。
verses.textZhCuv: 水中照脸，彼此相符； 人与人，心也相对。
verses.textEnNiv: As water reflects the face, so one’s life reflects the heart.
verses.textEnEsv: As in water face reflects face, so the heart of man reflects the man.
verses.textEnNkjv: As in water face reflects face, So a man’s heart reveals the man.
verses.textEnNlt: As a face is reflected in water, so the heart reflects the real person.
verses.textEnNasb: As in water a face reflects the face, So the heart of a person reflects the person.
verses.textEn: As water reflects the face, so one’s life reflects the heart.

verses.textZh: 阴间和灭亡不会满足， 人的眼目也是一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 阴间和灭亡不会满足， 人的眼目也是一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 阴间和灭亡永不满足； 人的眼目也是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: Death and Destruction are never satisfied, and neither are human eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied, and never satisfied are the eyes of man.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hell and Destruction are never full; So the eyes of man are never satisfied.
verses.textEnNlt: Just as Death and Destruction are never satisfied, so human desire is never satisfied.
verses.textEnNasb: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied, Nor are the eyes of a person ever satisfied.
verses.textEn: Death and Destruction are never satisfied, and neither are human eyes.

verses.textZh: 用锅炼银，用炉炼金； 人的称赞也试炼人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 用锅炼银，用炉炼金； 人的称赞也试炼人。
verses.textZhCuv: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金， 人的称赞也试炼人。
verses.textEnNiv: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verses.textEnEsv: The crucible is for silver, and the furnace is for gold, and a man is tested by his praise.
verses.textEnNkjv: The refining pot is for silver and the furnace for gold, And a man isvalued by what others say of him.
verses.textEnNlt: Fire tests the purity of silver and gold, but a person is tested by being praised.
verses.textEnNasb: The crucible is for silver and the furnace for gold, And each is tested by the praise accorded him.
verses.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.

verses.textZh: 你虽然用杵把愚妄人与碎谷一同捣在臼中， 他的愚妄还是离不了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你虽然用杵把愚妄人与碎谷一同捣在臼中， 他的愚妄还是离不了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 你虽用杵将愚妄人与打碎的麦子一同捣在臼中， 他的愚妄还是离不了他。
verses.textEnNiv: Though you grind a fool in a mortar, grinding them like grain with a pestle, you will not remove their folly from them.
verses.textEnEsv: Crush a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with crushed grain, yet his folly will not depart from him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with crushed grain, Yet his foolishness will not depart from him.
verses.textEnNlt: You cannot separate fools from their foolishness, even though you grind them like grain with mortar and pestle.
verses.textEnNasb: Though you pound the fool in a mortar with a pestle along with crushed grain, His foolishness still will not leave him.
verses.textEn: Though you grind a fool in a mortar, grinding them like grain with a pestle, you will not remove their folly from them.

verses.textZh: 你要清楚知道你羊群的景况， 专心照料你的牛群。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要清楚知道你羊群的景况， 专心照料你的牛群。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要详细知道你羊群的景况， 留心料理你的牛群；
verses.textEnNiv: Be sure you know the condition of your flocks, give careful attention to your herds;
verses.textEnEsv: Know well the condition of your flocks, and give attention to your herds,
verses.textEnNkjv: Be diligent to know the state of your flocks, And attend to your herds;
verses.textEnNlt: Know the state of your flocks, and put your heart into caring for your herds,
verses.textEnNasb: Know well the condition of your flocks, And pay attention to your herds;
verses.textEn: Be sure you know the condition of your flocks, give careful attention to your herds;

verses.textZh: 因为财富不是永恒的， 冠冕也不能存到万代。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为财富不是永恒的， 冠冕也不能存到万代。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为资财不能永有， 冠冕岂能存到万代？
verses.textEnNiv: for riches do not endure forever, and a crown is not secure for all generations.
verses.textEnEsv: for riches do not last forever; and does a crown endure to all generations?
verses.textEnNkjv: For riches are not forever, Nor does a crown endure to all generations.
verses.textEnNlt: for riches don’t last forever, and the crown might not be passed to the next generation.
verses.textEnNasb: For riches are not forever, Nor does a crown endure to all generations.
verses.textEn: for riches do not endure forever, and a crown is not secure for all generations.

verses.textZh: 干草割去，嫩草又出现， 山上的野草也都收集起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 干草割去，嫩草又出现， 山上的野草也都收集起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 干草割去，嫩草发现， 山上的菜蔬也被收敛。
verses.textEnNiv: When the hay is removed and new growth appears and the grass from the hills is gathered in,
verses.textEnEsv: When the grass is gone and the new growth appears and the vegetation of the mountains is gathered,
verses.textEnNkjv: When the hay is removed, and the tender grass shows itself, And the herbs of the mountains are gathered in,
verses.textEnNlt: After the hay is harvested and the new crop appears and the mountain grasses are gathered in,
verses.textEnNasb: When the grass disappears, the new growth is seen, And the herbs of the mountains are gathered in,
verses.textEn: When the hay is removed and new growth appears and the grass from the hills is gathered in,

verses.textZh: 羊羔的毛可以给你作衣服， 山羊可以作买田地的价银。
verses.textZhCnvs: 羊羔的毛可以给你作衣服， 山羊可以作买田地的价银。
verses.textZhCuv: 羊羔之毛是为你作衣服； 山羊是为作田地的价值，
verses.textEnNiv: the lambs will provide you with clothing, and the goats with the price of a field.
verses.textEnEsv: the lambs will provide your clothing, and the goats the price of a field.
verses.textEnNkjv: The lambs willprovide your clothing, And the goats the price of a field;
verses.textEnNlt: your sheep will provide wool for clothing, and your goats will provide the price of a field.
verses.textEnNasb: The lambs will be for your clothing, And the goats will bring the price of a field,
verses.textEn: the lambs will provide you with clothing, and the goats with the price of a field.

verses.textZh: 山羊奶足够作你的食物， 也足够作你一家的食物， 并且足够维持你众婢女的生活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 山羊奶足够作你的食物， 也足够作你一家的食物， 并且足够维持你众婢女的生活。
verses.textZhCuv: 并有母山羊奶够你吃， 也够你的家眷吃， 且够养你的婢女。
verses.textEnNiv: You will have plenty of goats’ milk to feed your family and to nourish your female servants.
verses.textEnEsv: There will be enough goats’ milk for your food, for the food of your household and maintenance for your girls.
verses.textEnNkjv: Youshallhave enough goats’ milk for your food, For the food of your household, And the nourishment of your maidservants.
verses.textEnNlt: And you will have enough goats’ milk for yourself, your family, and your servant girls.
verses.textEnNasb: And there will be enough goats’ milk for your food, For the food of your household, And sustenance for your attendants.
verses.textEn: You will have plenty of goats’ milk to feed your family and to nourish your female servants.

verses.textZh: 恶人虽然没有人追赶，仍然逃跑； 义人却像狮子，放胆无惧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人虽然没有人追赶，仍然逃跑； 义人却像狮子，放胆无惧。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人虽无人追赶也逃跑； 义人却胆壮像狮子。
verses.textEnNiv: The wicked flee though no one pursues, but the righteous are as bold as a lion.
verses.textEnEsv: The wicked flee when no one pursues, but the righteous are bold as a lion.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wicked flee when no one pursues, But the righteous are bold as a lion.
verses.textEnNlt: The wicked run away when no one is chasing them, but the godly are as bold as lions.
verses.textEnNasb: The wicked flee when no one is pursuing, But the righteous are bold as a lion.
verses.textEn: The wicked flee though no one pursues, but the righteous are as bold as a lion.

verses.textZh: 国家因有过犯，领袖就经常更换； 依赖聪明知识俱备的人，国家才可以长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 国家因有过犯，领袖就经常更换； 依赖聪明知识俱备的人，国家才可以长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 邦国因有罪过，君王就多更换； 因有聪明知识的人，国必长存。
verses.textEnNiv: When a country is rebellious, it has many rulers, but a ruler with discernment and knowledge maintains order.
verses.textEnEsv: When a land transgresses, it has many rulers, but with a man of understanding and knowledge, its stability will long continue.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because of the transgression of a land, many are its princes; But by a man of understanding and knowledge Right will be prolonged.
verses.textEnNlt: When there is moral rot within a nation, its government topples easily. But wise and knowledgeable leaders bring stability.
verses.textEnNasb: Due to a wrongdoing of a land its leaders are many, But by a person of understanding and knowledge, so it endures.
verses.textEn: When a country is rebellious, it has many rulers, but a ruler with discernment and knowledge maintains order.

verses.textZh: 穷人欺压贫寒人， 就像暴雨冲没粮食。
verses.textZhCnvs: 穷人欺压贫寒人， 就像暴雨冲没粮食。
verses.textZhCuv: 穷人欺压贫民， 好像暴雨冲没粮食。
verses.textEnNiv: A ruler who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain that leaves no crops.
verses.textEnEsv: A poor man who oppresses the poor is a beating rain that leaves no food.
verses.textEnNkjv: A poor man who oppresses the poor Islike a driving rain which leaves no food.
verses.textEnNlt: A poor person who oppresses the poor is like a pounding rain that destroys the crops.
verses.textEnNasb: A poor man who oppresses the helpless Is like a driving rain which leaves no food.
verses.textEn: A ruler who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain that leaves no crops.

verses.textZh: 离弃律法的，称赞恶人； 遵守律法的，却与恶人相争。
verses.textZhCnvs: 离弃律法的，称赞恶人； 遵守律法的，却与恶人相争。
verses.textZhCuv: 违弃律法的，夸奖恶人； 遵守律法的，却与恶人相争。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who forsake instruction praise the wicked, but those who heed it resist them.
verses.textEnEsv: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked, but those who keep the law strive against them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked, But such as keep the law contend with them.
verses.textEnNlt: To reject the law is to praise the wicked; to obey the law is to fight them.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who abandon the Law praise the wicked, But those who keep the Law strive against them.
verses.textEn: Those who forsake instruction praise the wicked, but those who heed it resist them.

verses.textZh: 坏人不知公正是甚么， 寻求耶和华的却完全明白。
verses.textZhCnvs: 坏人不知公正是甚么， 寻求耶和华的却完全明白。
verses.textZhCuv: 坏人不明白公义； 惟有寻求耶和华的，无不明白。
verses.textEnNiv: Evildoers do not understand what is right, but those who seek the Lord understand it fully.
verses.textEnEsv: Evil men do not understand justice, but those who seek the Lord understand it completely.
verses.textEnNkjv: Evil men do not understand justice, But those who seek the Lord understand all.
verses.textEnNlt: Evil people don’t understand justice, but those who follow the Lord understand completely.
verses.textEnNasb: Evil people do not understand justice, But those who seek the Lord understand everything.
verses.textEn: Evildoers do not understand what is right, but those who seek the Lord understand it fully.

verses.textZh: 行为完全的穷人， 胜过行事狡诈的财主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 行为完全的穷人， 胜过行事狡诈的财主。
verses.textZhCuv: 行为纯正的穷乏人 胜过行事乖僻的富足人。
verses.textEnNiv: Better the poor whose walk is blameless than the rich whose ways are perverse.
verses.textEnEsv: Better is a poor man who walks in his integrity than a rich man who is crooked in his ways.
verses.textEnNkjv: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity Than one perverse inhis ways, though he be rich.
verses.textEnNlt: Better to be poor and honest than to be dishonest and rich.
verses.textEnNasb: Better is a poor person who walks in his integrity, Than a person who is crooked, though he is rich.
verses.textEn: Better the poor whose walk is blameless than the rich whose ways are perverse.

verses.textZh: 谨守训诲的，是聪明的人； 与贪食的人作伴的，却使父亲蒙羞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谨守训诲的，是聪明的人； 与贪食的人作伴的，却使父亲蒙羞。
verses.textZhCuv: 谨守律法的，是智慧之子； 与贪食人作伴的，却羞辱其父。
verses.textEnNiv: A discerning son heeds instruction, but a companion of gluttons disgraces his father.
verses.textEnEsv: The one who keeps the law is a son with understanding, but a companion of gluttons shames his father.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever keeps the law is a discerning son, But a companion of gluttons shames his father.
verses.textEnNlt: Young people who obey the law are wise; those with wild friends bring shame to their parents.
verses.textEnNasb: He who keeps the Law is a discerning son, But he who is a companion of gluttons humiliates his father.
verses.textEn: A discerning son heeds instruction, but a companion of gluttons disgraces his father.

verses.textZh: 凡是借着高息厚利增加自己财富的， 就是为那恩待穷人的人积蓄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是借着高息厚利增加自己财富的， 就是为那恩待穷人的人积蓄。
verses.textZhCuv: 人以厚利加增财物， 是给那怜悯穷人者积蓄的。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever increases wealth by taking interest or profit from the poor amasses it for another, who will be kind to the poor.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever multiplies his wealth by interest and profit gathers it for him who is generous to the poor.
verses.textEnNkjv: One who increases his possessions by usury and extortion Gathers it for him who will pity the poor.
verses.textEnNlt: Income from charging high interest rates will end up in the pocket of someone who is kind to the poor.
verses.textEnNasb: One who increases his wealth by interest of any kind, Collects it for one who is gracious to the poor.
verses.textEn: Whoever increases wealth by taking interest or profit from the poor amasses it for another, who will be kind to the poor.

verses.textZh: 转身不听训诲的， 他的祷告也是可厌恶的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 转身不听训诲的， 他的祷告也是可厌恶的。
verses.textZhCuv: 转耳不听律法的， 他的祈祷也为可憎。
verses.textEnNiv: If anyone turns a deaf ear to my instruction, even their prayers are detestable.
verses.textEnEsv: If one turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.
verses.textEnNkjv: One who turns away his ear from hearing the law, Even his prayer is an abomination.
verses.textEnNlt: God detests the prayers of a person who ignores the law.
verses.textEnNasb: One who turns his ear away from listening to the Law, Even his prayer is an abomination.
verses.textEn: If anyone turns a deaf ear to my instruction, even their prayers are detestable.

verses.textZh: 诱惑正直人走上邪路的， 必掉在自己所挖的坑里； 完全人却必承受福气。
verses.textZhCnvs: 诱惑正直人走上邪路的， 必掉在自己所挖的坑里； 完全人却必承受福气。
verses.textZhCuv: 诱惑正直人行恶道的，必掉在自己的坑里； 惟有完全人必承受福分。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever leads the upright along an evil path will fall into their own trap, but the blameless will receive a good inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever misleads the upright into an evil way will fall into his own pit, but the blameless will have a goodly inheritance.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, He himself will fall into his own pit; But the blameless will inherit good.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who lead good people along an evil path will fall into their own trap, but the honest will inherit good things.
verses.textEnNasb: One who leads the upright astray in an evil way Will himself fall into his own pit, But the blameless will inherit good.
verses.textEn: Whoever leads the upright along an evil path will fall into their own trap, but the blameless will receive a good inheritance.

verses.textZh: 财主自以为有智慧， 聪明的穷人却能看透他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 财主自以为有智慧， 聪明的穷人却能看透他。
verses.textZhCuv: 富足人自以为有智慧， 但聪明的贫穷人能将他查透。
verses.textEnNiv: The rich are wise in their own eyes; one who is poor and discerning sees how deluded they are.
verses.textEnEsv: A rich man is wise in his own eyes, but a poor man who has understanding will find him out.
verses.textEnNkjv: The rich man is wise in his own eyes, But the poor who has understanding searches him out.
verses.textEnNlt: Rich people may think they are wise, but a poor person with discernment can see right through them.
verses.textEnNasb: The rich person is wise in his own eyes, But the poor who has understanding sees through him.
verses.textEn: The rich are wise in their own eyes; one who is poor and discerning sees how deluded they are.

verses.textZh: 义人得胜的时候，有极大的荣耀； 恶人兴起的时候，人就躲避。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人得胜的时候，有极大的荣耀； 恶人兴起的时候，人就躲避。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人得志，有大荣耀； 恶人兴起，人就躲藏。
verses.textEnNiv: When the righteous triumph, there is great elation; but when the wicked rise to power, people go into hiding.
verses.textEnEsv: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory, but when the wicked rise, people hide themselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the righteous rejoice, thereis great glory; But when the wicked arise, men hide themselves.
verses.textEnNlt: When the godly succeed, everyone is glad. When the wicked take charge, people go into hiding.
verses.textEnNasb: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory, But when the wicked rise, people hide themselves.
verses.textEn: When the righteous triumph, there is great elation; but when the wicked rise to power, people go into hiding.

verses.textZh: 遮掩自己过犯的，必不亨通； 承认并离弃过犯的，必蒙怜悯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 遮掩自己过犯的，必不亨通； 承认并离弃过犯的，必蒙怜悯。
verses.textZhCuv: 遮掩自己罪过的，必不亨通； 承认离弃罪过的，必蒙怜恤。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever conceals their sins does not prosper, but the one who confesses and renounces them finds mercy.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever conceals his transgressions will not prosper, but he who confesses and forsakes them will obtain mercy.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who covers his sins will not prosper, But whoever confesses and forsakes them will have mercy.
verses.textEnNlt: People who conceal their sins will not prosper, but if they confess and turn from them, they will receive mercy.
verses.textEnNasb: One who conceals his wrongdoings will not prosper, But one who confesses and abandons them will find compassion.
verses.textEn: Whoever conceals their sins does not prosper, but the one who confesses and renounces them finds mercy.

verses.textZh: 常存戒惧之心的，这人就为有福； 心里刚硬的，必陷在祸患里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 常存戒惧之心的，这人就为有福； 心里刚硬的，必陷在祸患里。
verses.textZhCuv: 常存敬畏的，便为有福； 心存刚硬的，必陷在祸患里。
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed is the one who always trembles before God, but whoever hardens their heart falls into trouble.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed is the one who fears the Lord always, but whoever hardens his heart will fall into calamity.
verses.textEnNkjv: Happy is the man who is always reverent, But he who hardens his heart will fall into calamity.
verses.textEnNlt: Blessed are those who fear to do wrong, but the stubborn are headed for serious trouble.
verses.textEnNasb: How blessed is the person who fears always, But one who hardens his heart will fall into disaster.
verses.textEn: Blessed is the one who always trembles before God, but whoever hardens their heart falls into trouble.

verses.textZh: 残暴的统治者辖制贫民， 就像吼叫的狮子，又像饥饿觅食的熊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 残暴的统治者辖制贫民， 就像吼叫的狮子，又像饥饿觅食的熊。
verses.textZhCuv: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民， 好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。
verses.textEnNiv: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verses.textEnEsv: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a poor people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Like a roaring lion and a charging bear Is a wicked ruler over poor people.
verses.textEnNlt: A wicked ruler is as dangerous to the poor as a roaring lion or an attacking bear.
verses.textEnNasb: Like a roaring lion and a rushing bear Is a wicked ruler over a poor people.
verses.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.

verses.textZh: 昏庸的君主必多行强暴， 憎恶不义之财的，必享长寿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 昏庸的君主必多行强暴， 憎恶不义之财的，必享长寿。
verses.textZhCuv: 无知的君多行暴虐； 以贪财为可恨的，必年长日久。
verses.textEnNiv: A tyrannical ruler practices extortion, but one who hates ill-gotten gain will enjoy a long reign.
verses.textEnEsv: A ruler who lacks understanding is a cruel oppressor, but he who hates unjust gain will prolong his days.
verses.textEnNkjv: A ruler who lacks understanding is a great oppressor, But he who hates covetousness will prolong his days.
verses.textEnNlt: A ruler with no understanding will oppress his people, but one who hates corruption will have a long life.
verses.textEnNasb: A leader who is a great oppressor lacks understanding, But a person who hates unjust gain will prolong his days.
verses.textEn: A tyrannical ruler practices extortion, but one who hates ill-gotten gain will enjoy a long reign.

verses.textZh: 背负流人血之罪的， 必逃跑至死，人不可帮助他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 背负流人血之罪的， 必逃跑至死，人不可帮助他。
verses.textZhCuv: 背负流人血之罪的，必往坑里奔跑， 谁也不可拦阻他。
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone tormented by the guilt of murder will seek refuge in the grave; let no one hold them back.
verses.textEnEsv: If one is burdened with the blood of another, he will be a fugitive until death; let no one help him.
verses.textEnNkjv: A man burdened with bloodshed will flee into a pit; Let no one help him.
verses.textEnNlt: A murderer’s tormented conscience will drive him into the grave. Don’t protect him!
verses.textEnNasb: A person who is burdened with the guilt of human blood Will be a fugitive until death; no one is to support him!
verses.textEn: Anyone tormented by the guilt of murder will seek refuge in the grave; let no one hold them back.

verses.textZh: 行为完全的，必蒙拯救； 行事狡诈的，必立刻跌倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 行为完全的，必蒙拯救； 行事狡诈的，必立刻跌倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 行动正直的，必蒙拯救； 行事弯曲的，立时跌倒。
verses.textEnNiv: The one whose walk is blameless is kept safe, but the one whose ways are perverse will fall into the pit.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever walks in integrity will be delivered, but he who is crooked in his ways will suddenly fall.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever walks blamelessly will be saved, But hewhois perverse inhis ways will suddenly fall.
verses.textEnNlt: The blameless will be rescued from harm, but the crooked will be suddenly destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: One who walks blamelessly will receive help, But one who is crooked will fall all at once.
verses.textEn: The one whose walk is blameless is kept safe, but the one whose ways are perverse will fall into the pit.

verses.textZh: 耕种自己田地的，必有充足粮食； 追求虚幻的，必饱受穷乏之苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耕种自己田地的，必有充足粮食； 追求虚幻的，必饱受穷乏之苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 耕种自己田地的，必得饱食； 追随虚浮的，足受穷乏。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who work their land will have abundant food, but those who chase fantasies will have their fill of poverty.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever works his land will have plenty of bread, but he who follows worthless pursuits will have plenty of poverty.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who tills his land will have plenty of bread, But he who follows frivolity will have poverty enough!
verses.textEnNlt: A hard worker has plenty of food, but a person who chases fantasies ends up in poverty.
verses.textEnNasb: One who works his land will have plenty of food, But one who follows empty pursuits will have plenty of poverty.
verses.textEn: Those who work their land will have abundant food, but those who chase fantasies will have their fill of poverty.

verses.textZh: 忠实的人必有大福； 急于发财的，不免受罚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 忠实的人必有大福； 急于发财的，不免受罚。
verses.textZhCuv: 诚实人必多得福； 想要急速发财的，不免受罚。
verses.textEnNiv: A faithful person will be richly blessed, but one eager to get rich will not go unpunished.
verses.textEnEsv: A faithful man will abound with blessings, but whoever hastens to be rich will not go unpunished.
verses.textEnNkjv: A faithful man will abound with blessings, But he who hastens to be rich will not go unpunished.
verses.textEnNlt: The trustworthy person will get a rich reward, but a person who wants quick riches will get into trouble.
verses.textEnNasb: A faithful person will abound with blessings, But one who hurries to be rich will not go unpunished.
verses.textEn: A faithful person will be richly blessed, but one eager to get rich will not go unpunished.

verses.textZh: 看人的情面是不对的； 但有人为了一点食物，竟然犯法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看人的情面是不对的； 但有人为了一点食物，竟然犯法。
verses.textZhCuv: 看人的情面乃为不好； 人因一块饼枉法也为不好。
verses.textEnNiv: To show partiality is not good— yet a person will do wrong for a piece of bread.
verses.textEnEsv: To show partiality is not good, but for a piece of bread a man will do wrong.
verses.textEnNkjv: To show partiality is not good, Because for a piece of bread a man will transgress.
verses.textEnNlt: Showing partiality is never good, yet some will do wrong for a mere piece of bread.
verses.textEnNasb: To show partiality is not good, Because for a piece of bread a man will do wrong.
verses.textEn: To show partiality is not good— yet a person will do wrong for a piece of bread.

verses.textZh: 吝啬的人急切求财 ， 却不知穷乏快要临到。
verses.textZhCnvs: 吝啬的人急切求财 ， 却不知穷乏快要临到。
verses.textZhCuv: 人有恶眼想要急速发财， 却不知穷乏必临到他身。
verses.textEnNiv: The stingy are eager to get rich and are unaware that poverty awaits them.
verses.textEnEsv: A stingy man hastens after wealth and does not know that poverty will come upon him.
verses.textEnNkjv: A man with an evil eye hastens after riches, And does not consider that poverty will come upon him.
verses.textEnNlt: Greedy people try to get rich quick but don’t realize they’re headed for poverty.
verses.textEnNasb: A person with an evil eye hurries after wealth And does not know that poverty will come upon him.
verses.textEn: The stingy are eager to get rich and are unaware that poverty awaits them.

verses.textZh: 责备人的，终必得人喜悦， 胜过那用舌头谄媚人的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 责备人的，终必得人喜悦， 胜过那用舌头谄媚人的。
verses.textZhCuv: 责备人的，后来蒙人喜悦， 多于那用舌头谄媚人的。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever rebukes a person will in the end gain favor rather than one who has a flattering tongue.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than he who flatters with his tongue.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who rebukes a man will find more favor afterward Than he who flatters with the tongue.
verses.textEnNlt: In the end, people appreciate honest criticism far more than flattery.
verses.textEnNasb: One who rebukes a person will afterward find more favor Than one who flatters with the tongue.
verses.textEn: Whoever rebukes a person will in the end gain favor rather than one who has a flattering tongue.

verses.textZh: 偷窃自己父母财物， 并说："这不是罪过"的， 这人是与强盗一伙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 偷窃自己父母财物， 并说："这不是罪过"的， 这人是与强盗一伙。
verses.textZhCuv: 偷窃父母的，说：这不是罪， 此人就是与强盗同类。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever robs their father or mother and says, "It’s not wrong," is partner to one who destroys.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever robs his father or his mother and says, "That is no transgression," is a companion to a man who destroys.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever robs his father or his mother, And says, "Itis no transgression," The same is companion to a destroyer.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who steals from his father and mother and says, "What’s wrong with that?" is no better than a murderer.
verses.textEnNasb: He who robs his father or his mother And says, "There is no wrong done," Is the companion of a person who destroys.
verses.textEn: Whoever robs their father or mother and says, "It’s not wrong," is partner to one who destroys.

verses.textZh: 贪心的人，必引起纷争； 倚靠耶和华的，必得丰裕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 贪心的人，必引起纷争； 倚靠耶和华的，必得丰裕。
verses.textZhCuv: 心中贪婪的，挑起争端； 倚靠耶和华的，必得丰裕。
verses.textEnNiv: The greedy stir up conflict, but those who trust in the Lord will prosper.
verses.textEnEsv: A greedy man stirs up strife, but the one who trusts in the Lord will be enriched.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who is of a proud heart stirs up strife, But he who trusts in the Lord will be prospered.
verses.textEnNlt: Greed causes fighting; trusting the Lord leads to prosperity.
verses.textEnNasb: An arrogant person stirs up strife, But one who trusts in the Lord will prosper.
verses.textEn: The greedy stir up conflict, but those who trust in the Lord will prosper.

verses.textZh: 自恃聪明的，是愚昧人； 凭着智慧行事的，必蒙拯救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 自恃聪明的，是愚昧人； 凭着智慧行事的，必蒙拯救。
verses.textZhCuv: 心中自是的，便是愚昧人； 凭智慧行事的，必蒙拯救。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who trust in themselves are fools, but those who walk in wisdom are kept safe.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever trusts in his own mind is a fool, but he who walks in wisdom will be delivered.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who trusts in his own heart is a fool, But whoever walks wisely will be delivered.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who trust their own insight are foolish, but anyone who walks in wisdom is safe.
verses.textEnNasb: One who trusts in his own heart is a fool, But one who walks wisely will flee to safety.
verses.textEn: Those who trust in themselves are fools, but those who walk in wisdom are kept safe.

verses.textZh: 赒济穷人的，必不致缺乏； 闭眼不理他们的，必多受咒诅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 赒济穷人的，必不致缺乏； 闭眼不理他们的，必多受咒诅。
verses.textZhCuv: 周济贫穷的，不致缺乏； 佯为不见的，必多受咒诅。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who give to the poor will lack nothing, but those who close their eyes to them receive many curses.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever gives to the poor will not want, but he who hides his eyes will get many a curse.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who gives to the poor will not lack, But he who hides his eyes will have many curses.
verses.textEnNlt: Whoever gives to the poor will lack nothing, but those who close their eyes to poverty will be cursed.
verses.textEnNasb: One who gives to the poor will never lack anything, But one who shuts his eyes will have many curses.
verses.textEn: Those who give to the poor will lack nothing, but those who close their eyes to them receive many curses.

verses.textZh: 恶人兴起的时候，人就躲避； 恶人灭亡的时候，义人就增多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人兴起的时候，人就躲避； 恶人灭亡的时候，义人就增多。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人兴起，人就躲藏； 恶人败亡，义人增多。
verses.textEnNiv: When the wicked rise to power, people go into hiding; but when the wicked perish, the righteous thrive.
verses.textEnEsv: When the wicked rise, people hide themselves, but when they perish, the righteous increase.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the wicked arise, men hide themselves; But when they perish, the righteous increase.
verses.textEnNlt: When the wicked take charge, people go into hiding. When the wicked meet disaster, the godly flourish.
verses.textEnNasb: When the wicked rise, people hide themselves; But when they perish, the righteous increase.
verses.textEn: When the wicked rise to power, people go into hiding; but when the wicked perish, the righteous thrive.

verses.textZh: 人屡次受责备，仍然硬着颈项， 他必突然毁灭，无法挽救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人屡次受责备，仍然硬着颈项， 他必突然毁灭，无法挽救。
verses.textZhCuv: 人屡次受责罚，仍然硬着颈项； 他必顷刻败坏，无法可治。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever remains stiff-necked after many rebukes will suddenly be destroyed—without remedy.
verses.textEnEsv: He who is often reproved, yet stiffens his neck, will suddenly be broken beyond healing.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who is often rebuked, and hardens his neck, Will suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.
verses.textEnNlt: Whoever stubbornly refuses to accept criticism will suddenly be destroyed beyond recovery.
verses.textEnNasb: A person often rebuked who becomes obstinate Will suddenly be broken beyond remedy.
verses.textEn: Whoever remains stiff-necked after many rebukes will suddenly be destroyed—without remedy.

verses.textZh: 义人增多的时候，人民就喜乐； 恶人掌权的时候，人民就叹息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人增多的时候，人民就喜乐； 恶人掌权的时候，人民就叹息。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人增多，民就喜乐； 恶人掌权，民就叹息。
verses.textEnNiv: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verses.textEnEsv: When the righteous increase, the people rejoice, but when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice; But when a wicked man rules, the people groan.
verses.textEnNlt: When the godly are in authority, the people rejoice. But when the wicked are in power, they groan.
verses.textEnNasb: When the righteous increase, the people rejoice, But when a wicked person rules, people groan.
verses.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.

verses.textZh: 喜爱智慧的，使父亲喜乐； 亲近妓女的，耗尽家财。
verses.textZhCnvs: 喜爱智慧的，使父亲喜乐； 亲近妓女的，耗尽家财。
verses.textZhCuv: 爱慕智慧的，使父亲喜乐； 与妓女结交的，却浪费钱财。
verses.textEnNiv: A man who loves wisdom brings joy to his father, but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.
verses.textEnEsv: He who loves wisdom makes his father glad, but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever loves wisdom makes his father rejoice, But a companion of harlots wastes his wealth.
verses.textEnNlt: The man who loves wisdom brings joy to his father, but if he hangs around with prostitutes, his wealth is wasted.
verses.textEnNasb: A man who loves wisdom makes his father glad, But he who involves himself with prostitutes wastes his wealth.
verses.textEn: A man who loves wisdom brings joy to his father, but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.

verses.textZh: 君王以公正使国坚立； 收受贿赂的，使国覆亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 君王以公正使国坚立； 收受贿赂的，使国覆亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 王藉公平，使国坚定； 索要贿赂，使国倾败。
verses.textEnNiv: By justice a king gives a country stability, but those who are greedy for bribes tear it down.
verses.textEnEsv: By justice a king builds up the land, but he who exacts gifts tears it down.
verses.textEnNkjv: The king establishes the land by justice, But he who receives bribes overthrows it.
verses.textEnNlt: A just king gives stability to his nation, but one who demands bribes destroys it.
verses.textEnNasb: The king gives stability to the land by justice, But a person who takes bribes ruins it.
verses.textEn: By justice a king gives a country stability, but those who are greedy for bribes tear it down.

verses.textZh: 谄媚邻舍的人， 是在他的脚下张设网罗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谄媚邻舍的人， 是在他的脚下张设网罗。
verses.textZhCuv: 谄媚邻舍的， 就是设网罗绊他的脚。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who flatter their neighbors are spreading nets for their feet.
verses.textEnEsv: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.
verses.textEnNkjv: A man who flatters his neighbor Spreads a net for his feet.
verses.textEnNlt: To flatter friends is to lay a trap for their feet.
verses.textEnNasb: A man who flatters his neighbor Is spreading a net for his steps.
verses.textEn: Those who flatter their neighbors are spreading nets for their feet.

verses.textZh: 恶人因为过犯，陷于网罗； 义人却欢呼喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人因为过犯，陷于网罗； 义人却欢呼喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人犯罪，自陷网罗； 惟独义人欢呼喜乐。
verses.textEnNiv: Evildoers are snared by their own sin, but the righteous shout for joy and are glad.
verses.textEnEsv: An evil man is ensnared in his transgression, but a righteous man sings and rejoices.
verses.textEnNkjv: By transgression an evil man is snared, But the righteous sings and rejoices.
verses.textEnNlt: Evil people are trapped by sin, but the righteous escape, shouting for joy.
verses.textEnNasb: By wrongdoing an evil person is ensnared, But the righteous sings and rejoices.
verses.textEn: Evildoers are snared by their own sin, but the righteous shout for joy and are glad.

verses.textZh: 义人关注穷人的冤情； 恶人却不分辨实情。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人关注穷人的冤情； 恶人却不分辨实情。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人知道查明穷人的案； 恶人没有聪明，就不得而知。
verses.textEnNiv: The righteous care about justice for the poor, but the wicked have no such concern.
verses.textEnEsv: A righteous man knows the rights of the poor; a wicked man does not understand such knowledge.
verses.textEnNkjv: The righteous considers the cause of the poor, But the wicked does not understand such knowledge.
verses.textEnNlt: The godly care about the rights of the poor; the wicked don’t care at all.
verses.textEnNasb: The righteous is concerned for the rights of the poor; The wicked does not understand such concern.
verses.textEn: The righteous care about justice for the poor, but the wicked have no such concern.

verses.textZh: 好讥笑人的煽动全城骚乱， 智慧人却止息众怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好讥笑人的煽动全城骚乱， 智慧人却止息众怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 亵慢人煽惑通城； 智慧人止息众怒。
verses.textEnNiv: Mockers stir up a city, but the wise turn away anger.
verses.textEnEsv: Scoffers set a city aflame, but the wise turn away wrath.
verses.textEnNkjv: Scoffers set a city aflame, But wise men turn away wrath.
verses.textEnNlt: Mockers can get a whole town agitated, but the wise will calm anger.
verses.textEnNasb: Arrogant people inflame a city, But wise people turn away anger.
verses.textEn: Mockers stir up a city, but the wise turn away anger.

verses.textZh: 智慧人与愚妄人争讼， 愚妄人只会咆哮或嘲笑，总不能安静。
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧人与愚妄人争讼， 愚妄人只会咆哮或嘲笑，总不能安静。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧人与愚妄人相争， 或怒或笑，总不能使他止息。
verses.textEnNiv: If a wise person goes to court with a fool, the fool rages and scoffs, and there is no peace.
verses.textEnEsv: If a wise man has an argument with a fool, the fool only rages and laughs, and there is no quiet.
verses.textEnNkjv: If a wise man contends with a foolish man, Whether thefool rages or laughs, thereis no peace.
verses.textEnNlt: If a wise person takes a fool to court, there will be ranting and ridicule but no satisfaction.
verses.textEnNasb: When a wise person has a controversy with a foolish person, The foolish person either rages or laughs, and there is no rest.
verses.textEn: If a wise person goes to court with a fool, the fool rages and scoffs, and there is no peace.

verses.textZh: 好流人血的恨恶完全人， 并寻索正直人的性命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好流人血的恨恶完全人， 并寻索正直人的性命。
verses.textZhCuv: 好流人血的，恨恶完全人， 索取正直人的性命。
verses.textEnNiv: The bloodthirsty hate a person of integrity and seek to kill the upright.
verses.textEnEsv: Bloodthirsty men hate one who is blameless and seek the life of the upright.
verses.textEnNkjv: The bloodthirsty hate the blameless, But the upright seek his well-being.
verses.textEnNlt: The bloodthirsty hate blameless people, but the upright seek to help them.
verses.textEnNasb: People of bloodshed hate the blameless person, But the upright are concerned for his life.
verses.textEn: The bloodthirsty hate a person of integrity and seek to kill the upright.

verses.textZh: 愚昧人把怒气尽情发泄， 智慧人却抑制怒气。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚昧人把怒气尽情发泄， 智慧人却抑制怒气。
verses.textZhCuv: 愚妄人怒气全发； 智慧人忍气含怒。
verses.textEnNiv: Fools give full vent to their rage, but the wise bring calm in the end.
verses.textEnEsv: A fool gives full vent to his spirit, but a wise man quietly holds it back.
verses.textEnNkjv: A fool vents all his feelings, But a wise man holds them back.
verses.textEnNlt: Fools vent their anger, but the wise quietly hold it back.
verses.textEnNasb: A fool always loses his temper, But a wise person holds it back.
verses.textEn: Fools give full vent to their rage, but the wise bring calm in the end.

verses.textZh: 如果掌权者听信谎言， 他所有的臣仆必都是坏人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果掌权者听信谎言， 他所有的臣仆必都是坏人。
verses.textZhCuv: 君王若听谎言， 他一切臣仆都是奸恶。
verses.textEnNiv: If a ruler listens to lies, all his officials become wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: If a ruler listens to falsehood, all his officials will be wicked.
verses.textEnNkjv: If a ruler pays attention to lies, All his servants become wicked.
verses.textEnNlt: If a ruler pays attention to liars, all his advisers will be wicked.
verses.textEnNasb: If a ruler pays attention to falsehood, All his ministers become wicked.
verses.textEn: If a ruler listens to lies, all his officials become wicked.

verses.textZh: 世上有穷人，也有欺压人的， 两者的眼睛都蒙耶和华光照。
verses.textZhCnvs: 世上有穷人，也有欺压人的， 两者的眼睛都蒙耶和华光照。
verses.textZhCuv: 贫穷人、强暴人在世相遇； 他们的眼目都蒙耶和华光照。
verses.textEnNiv: The poor and the oppressor have this in common: The Lord gives sight to the eyes of both.
verses.textEnEsv: The poor man and the oppressor meet together; the Lord gives light to the eyes of both.
verses.textEnNkjv: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: The Lord gives light to the eyes of both.
verses.textEnNlt: The poor and the oppressor have this in common— the Lord gives sight to the eyes of both.
verses.textEnNasb: The poor person and the oppressor have this in common: The Lord gives light to the eyes of both.
verses.textEn: The poor and the oppressor have this in common: The Lord gives sight to the eyes of both.

verses.textZh: 如果君王诚实地审判穷人； 他的国位必永远坚立。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果君王诚实地审判穷人； 他的国位必永远坚立。
verses.textZhCuv: 君王凭诚实判断穷人； 他的国位必永远坚立。
verses.textEnNiv: If a king judges the poor with fairness, his throne will be established forever.
verses.textEnEsv: If a king faithfully judges the poor, his throne will be established forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: The king who judges the poor with truth, His throne will be established forever.
verses.textEnNlt: If a king judges the poor fairly, his throne will last forever.
verses.textEnNasb: If a king judges the poor with truth, His throne will be established forever.
verses.textEn: If a king judges the poor with fairness, his throne will be established forever.

verses.textZh: 杖责和管教能使人有智慧， 放纵的孩子使母亲蒙羞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 杖责和管教能使人有智慧， 放纵的孩子使母亲蒙羞。
verses.textZhCuv: 杖打和责备能加增智慧； 放纵的儿子使母亲羞愧。
verses.textEnNiv: A rod and a reprimand impart wisdom, but a child left undisciplined disgraces its mother.
verses.textEnEsv: The rod and reproof give wisdom, but a child left to himself brings shame to his mother.
verses.textEnNkjv: The rod and rebuke give wisdom, But a child left tohimself brings shame to his mother.
verses.textEnNlt: To discipline a child produces wisdom, but a mother is disgraced by an undisciplined child.
verses.textEnNasb: The rod and a rebuke give wisdom, But a child who gets his own way brings shame to his mother.
verses.textEn: A rod and a reprimand impart wisdom, but a child left undisciplined disgraces its mother.

verses.textZh: 恶人增多的时候，过犯也必增多； 义人必看见他们倾覆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人增多的时候，过犯也必增多； 义人必看见他们倾覆。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人加多，过犯也加多， 义人必看见他们跌倒。
verses.textEnNiv: When the wicked thrive, so does sin, but the righteous will see their downfall.
verses.textEnEsv: When the wicked increase, transgression increases, but the righteous will look upon their downfall.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increases; But the righteous will see their fall.
verses.textEnNlt: When the wicked are in authority, sin flourishes, but the godly will live to see their downfall.
verses.textEnNasb: When the wicked increase, wrongdoing increases; But the righteous will see their downfall.
verses.textEn: When the wicked thrive, so does sin, but the righteous will see their downfall.

verses.textZh: 管教你的儿子，他必使你得安息； 也必使你的心得喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 管教你的儿子，他必使你得安息； 也必使你的心得喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 管教你的儿子，他就使你得安息， 也必使你心里喜乐。
verses.textEnNiv: Discipline your children, and they will give you peace; they will bring you the delights you desire.
verses.textEnEsv: Discipline your son, and he will give you rest; he will give delight to your heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: Correct your son, and he will give you rest; Yes, he will give delight to your soul.
verses.textEnNlt: Discipline your children, and they will give you peace of mind and will make your heart glad.
verses.textEnNasb: Correct your son, and he will give you comfort; He will also delight your soul.
verses.textEn: Discipline your children, and they will give you peace; they will bring you the delights you desire.

verses.textZh: 没有启示，人民就没有法纪； 遵守律法的，就为有福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有启示，人民就没有法纪； 遵守律法的，就为有福。
verses.textZhCuv: 没有异象 ，民就放肆； 惟遵守律法的，便为有福。
verses.textEnNiv: Where there is no revelation, people cast off restraint; but blessed is the one who heeds wisdom’s instruction.
verses.textEnEsv: Where there is no prophetic vision the people cast off restraint, but blessed is he who keeps the law.
verses.textEnNkjv: Where thereis no revelation, the people cast off restraint; But happy is he who keeps the law.
verses.textEnNlt: When people do not accept divine guidance, they run wild. But whoever obeys the law is joyful.
verses.textEnNasb: Where there is no vision, the people are unrestrained, But happy is one who keeps the Law.
verses.textEn: Where there is no revelation, people cast off restraint; but blessed is the one who heeds wisdom’s instruction.

verses.textZh: 只用言语，不能使奴仆受管教； 他虽然明白，却没有反应。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只用言语，不能使奴仆受管教； 他虽然明白，却没有反应。
verses.textZhCuv: 只用言语，仆人不肯受管教； 他虽然明白，也不留意。
verses.textEnNiv: Servants cannot be corrected by mere words; though they understand, they will not respond.
verses.textEnEsv: By mere words a servant is not disciplined, for though he understands, he will not respond.
verses.textEnNkjv: A servant will not be corrected by mere words; For though he understands, he will not respond.
verses.textEnNlt: Words alone will not discipline a servant; the words may be understood, but they are not heeded.
verses.textEnNasb: A slave will not be instructed by words alone; For though he understands, there will be no response.
verses.textEn: Servants cannot be corrected by mere words; though they understand, they will not respond.

verses.textZh: 你见过言语急躁的人吗？ 愚昧人比他更有指望。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你见过言语急躁的人吗？ 愚昧人比他更有指望。
verses.textZhCuv: 你见言语急躁的人吗？ 愚昧人比他更有指望。
verses.textEnNiv: Do you see someone who speaks in haste? There is more hope for a fool than for them.
verses.textEnEsv: Do you see a man who is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you see a man hasty in his words? Thereis more hope for a fool than for him.
verses.textEnNlt: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who speaks without thinking.
verses.textEnNasb: Do you see a person who is hasty with his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
verses.textEn: Do you see someone who speaks in haste? There is more hope for a fool than for them.

verses.textZh: 如果人从小娇纵仆人， 结果必带来忧愁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果人从小娇纵仆人， 结果必带来忧愁。
verses.textZhCuv: 人将仆人从小娇养， 这仆人终久必成了他的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: A servant pampered from youth will turn out to be insolent.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever pampers his servant from childhood will in the end find him his heir.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who pampers his servant from childhood Will have him as a son in the end.
verses.textEnNlt: A servant pampered from childhood will become a rebel.
verses.textEnNasb: One who pampers his slave from childhood Will in the end find him to be rebellious.
verses.textEn: A servant pampered from youth will turn out to be insolent.

verses.textZh: 容易发怒的人，引起纷争； 脾气暴烈的人，多有过犯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 容易发怒的人，引起纷争； 脾气暴烈的人，多有过犯。
verses.textZhCuv: 好气的人挑启争端； 暴怒的人多多犯罪。
verses.textEnNiv: An angry person stirs up conflict, and a hot-tempered person commits many sins.
verses.textEnEsv: A man of wrath stirs up strife, and one given to anger causes much transgression.
verses.textEnNkjv: An angry man stirs up strife, And a furious man abounds in transgression.
verses.textEnNlt: An angry person starts fights; a hot-tempered person commits all kinds of sin.
verses.textEnNasb: An angry person stirs up strife, And a hot-tempered person abounds in wrongdoing.
verses.textEn: An angry person stirs up conflict, and a hot-tempered person commits many sins.

verses.textZh: 人的骄傲必使他卑微； 心里谦卑的，必得尊荣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人的骄傲必使他卑微； 心里谦卑的，必得尊荣。
verses.textZhCuv: 人的高傲必使他卑下； 心里谦逊的，必得尊荣。
verses.textEnNiv: Pride brings a person low, but the lowly in spirit gain honor.
verses.textEnEsv: One’s pride will bring him low, but he who is lowly in spirit will obtain honor.
verses.textEnNkjv: A man’s pride will bring him low, But the humble in spirit will retain honor.
verses.textEnNlt: Pride ends in humiliation, while humility brings honor.
verses.textEnNasb: A person’s pride will bring him low, But a humble spirit will obtain honor.
verses.textEn: Pride brings a person low, but the lowly in spirit gain honor.

verses.textZh: 与盗贼分赃的，是恨恶自己的性命； 他虽然听见要他起誓作证的声音， 却不说话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 与盗贼分赃的，是恨恶自己的性命； 他虽然听见要他起誓作证的声音， 却不说话。
verses.textZhCuv: 人与盗贼分赃，是恨恶自己的性命； 他听见叫人发誓的声音，却不言语。
verses.textEnNiv: The accomplices of thieves are their own enemies; they are put under oath and dare not testify.
verses.textEnEsv: The partner of a thief hates his own life; he hears the curse, but discloses nothing.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever is a partner with a thief hates his own life; He swears to tell the truth, but reveals nothing.
verses.textEnNlt: If you assist a thief, you only hurt yourself. You are sworn to tell the truth, but you dare not testify.
verses.textEnNasb: One who is a partner with a thief hates his own life; He hears the oath but tells nothing.
verses.textEn: The accomplices of thieves are their own enemies; they are put under oath and dare not testify.

verses.textZh: 惧怕人的，必陷入网罗； 倚靠耶和华的，必得安全。
verses.textZhCnvs: 惧怕人的，必陷入网罗； 倚靠耶和华的，必得安全。
verses.textZhCuv: 惧怕人的，陷入网罗； 惟有倚靠耶和华的，必得安稳。
verses.textEnNiv: Fear of man will prove to be a snare, but whoever trusts in the Lord is kept safe.
verses.textEnEsv: The fear of man lays a snare, but whoever trusts in the Lord is safe.
verses.textEnNkjv: The fear of man brings a snare, But whoever trusts in the Lord shall be safe.
verses.textEnNlt: Fearing people is a dangerous trap, but trusting the Lord means safety.
verses.textEnNasb: The fear of man brings a snare, But one who trusts in the Lord will be protected.
verses.textEn: Fear of man will prove to be a snare, but whoever trusts in the Lord is kept safe.

verses.textZh: 很多人求掌权者的情面， 但各人的判决是出于耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 很多人求掌权者的情面， 但各人的判决是出于耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 求王恩的人多； 定人事乃在耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Many seek an audience with a ruler, but it is from the Lord that one gets justice.
verses.textEnEsv: Many seek the face of a ruler, but it is from the Lord that a man gets justice.
verses.textEnNkjv: Many seek the ruler’s favor, But justice for man comes from the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Many seek the ruler’s favor, but justice comes from the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Many seek the ruler’s favor, But justice for mankind comes from the Lord.
verses.textEn: Many seek an audience with a ruler, but it is from the Lord that one gets justice.

verses.textZh: 不义的人是义人所厌恶的； 行为正直的人是恶人所厌恶的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不义的人是义人所厌恶的； 行为正直的人是恶人所厌恶的。
verses.textZhCuv: 为非作歹的，被义人憎嫌； 行事正直的，被恶人憎恶。
verses.textEnNiv: The righteous detest the dishonest; the wicked detest the upright.
verses.textEnEsv: An unjust man is an abomination to the righteous, but one whose way is straight is an abomination to the wicked.
verses.textEnNkjv: An unjust man is an abomination to the righteous, And hewhois upright in the way is an abomination to the wicked.
verses.textEnNlt: The righteous despise the unjust; the wicked despise the godly.
verses.textEnNasb: An unjust person is an abomination to the righteous, And one who is upright in the way is an abomination to the wicked.
verses.textEn: The righteous detest the dishonest; the wicked detest the upright.

verses.textZh: 雅基的儿子亚古珥的话，是神的默示。 这人对以铁，对以铁和乌甲宣讲：
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅基的儿子亚古珥的话，是神的默示。 这人对以铁，对以铁和乌甲宣讲：
verses.textZhCuv: 雅基的儿子亚古珥的言语就是真言。 这人对以铁和乌甲说：
verses.textEnNiv: The sayings of Agur son of Jakeh—an inspired utterance. This man’s utterance to Ithiel: "I am weary, God, but I can prevail.
verses.textEnEsv: The words of Agur son of Jakeh. The oracle. The man declares, I am weary, O God; I am weary, O God, and worn out.
verses.textEnNkjv: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, his utterance. This man declared to Ithiel—to Ithiel and Ucal:
verses.textEnNlt: The sayings of Agur son of Jakeh contain this message. I am weary, O God; I am weary and worn out, O God.
verses.textEnNasb: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, the pronouncement. The man declares to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ucal:
verses.textEn: The sayings of Agur son of Jakeh—an inspired utterance. This man’s utterance to Ithiel: "I am weary, God, but I can prevail.

verses.textZh: "我比众人更愚顽， 也没有聪明。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我比众人更愚顽， 也没有聪明。
verses.textZhCuv: 我比众人更蠢笨， 也没有人的聪明。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely I am only a brute, not a man; I do not have human understanding.
verses.textEnEsv: Surely I am too stupid to be a man. I have not the understanding of a man.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely I am more stupid than any man, And do not have the understanding of a man.
verses.textEnNlt: I am too stupid to be human, and I lack common sense.
verses.textEnNasb: I am certainly more stupid than any man, And I do not have the understanding of a man;
verses.textEn: Surely I am only a brute, not a man; I do not have human understanding.

verses.textZh: 我没有学习智慧， 也不晓得有关至圣者的知识。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我没有学习智慧， 也不晓得有关至圣者的知识。
verses.textZhCuv: 我没有学好智慧， 也不认识至圣者。
verses.textEnNiv: I have not learned wisdom, nor have I attained to the knowledge of the Holy One.
verses.textEnEsv: I have not learned wisdom, nor have I knowledge of the Holy One.
verses.textEnNkjv: I neither learned wisdom Nor have knowledge of the Holy One.
verses.textEnNlt: I have not mastered human wisdom, nor do I know the Holy One.
verses.textEnNasb: Nor have I learned wisdom, Nor do I have the knowledge of the Holy One.
verses.textEn: I have not learned wisdom, nor have I attained to the knowledge of the Holy One.

verses.textZh: 谁升上天，又降下来呢？ 谁收聚风在掌中呢？ 谁包水在衣服里呢？ 谁立定地的四极呢？ 他的名字叫甚么？他儿子的名字叫甚么？ 你知道吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁升上天，又降下来呢？ 谁收聚风在掌中呢？ 谁包水在衣服里呢？ 谁立定地的四极呢？ 他的名字叫甚么？他儿子的名字叫甚么？ 你知道吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 谁升天又降下来？ 谁聚风在掌握中？ 谁包水在衣服里？ 谁立定地的四极？ 他名叫什么？ 他儿子名叫什么？ 你知道吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Who has gone up to heaven and come down? Whose hands have gathered up the wind? Who has wrapped up the waters in a cloak? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is the name of his son? Surely you know!
verses.textEnEsv: Who has ascended to heaven and come down? Who has gathered the wind in his fists? Who has wrapped up the waters in a garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son’s name? Surely you know!
verses.textEnNkjv: Who has ascended into heaven, or descended? Who has gathered the wind in His fists? Who has bound the waters in a garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is His name, and what is His Son’s name, If you know?
verses.textEnNlt: Who but God goes up to heaven and comes back down? Who holds the wind in his fists? Who wraps up the oceans in his cloak? Who has created the whole wide world? What is his name—and his son’s name? Tell me if you know!
verses.textEnNasb: Who has ascended into heaven and descended? Who has gathered the wind in His fists? Who has wrapped the waters in His garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is His name or His Son’s name? Surely you know!
verses.textEn: Who has gone up to heaven and come down? Whose hands have gathered up the wind? Who has wrapped up the waters in a cloak? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is the name of his son? Surely you know!

verses.textZh: 神所说的话句句都是炼净的， 投靠他的，他就作他们的盾牌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神所说的话句句都是炼净的， 投靠他的，他就作他们的盾牌。
verses.textZhCuv: 神的言语句句都是炼净的； 投靠他的，他便作他们的盾牌。
verses.textEnNiv: "Every word of God is flawless; he is a shield to those who take refuge in him.
verses.textEnEsv: Every word of God proves true; he is a shield to those who take refuge in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Every word of God is pure; He is a shield to those who put their trust in Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Every word of God proves true. He is a shield to all who come to him for protection.
verses.textEnNasb: Every word of God is pure; He is a shield to those who take refuge in Him.
verses.textEn: "Every word of God is flawless; he is a shield to those who take refuge in him.

verses.textZh: 他的话语，你不可增添； 恐怕他责备你，你就表明是说谎的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的话语，你不可增添； 恐怕他责备你，你就表明是说谎的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的言语，你不可加添， 恐怕他责备你，你就显为说谎言的。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not add to his words, or he will rebuke you and prove you a liar.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not add to his words, lest he rebuke you and you be found a liar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not add to His words, Lest He rebuke you, and you be found a liar.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not add to his words, or he may rebuke you and expose you as a liar.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not add to His words Or He will rebuke you, and you will be proved a liar.
verses.textEn: Do not add to his words, or he will rebuke you and prove you a liar.

verses.textZh: 我有两件事求你， 在我死去以前，求你答应我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我有两件事求你， 在我死去以前，求你答应我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我求你两件事， 在我未死之先，不要不赐给我：
verses.textEnNiv: "Two things I ask of you, Lord ; do not refuse me before I die:
verses.textEnEsv: Two things I ask of you; deny them not to me before I die:
verses.textEnNkjv: Two things I request of You (Deprive me not before I die):
verses.textEnNlt: O God, I beg two favors from you; let me have them before I die.
verses.textEnNasb: Two things I have asked of You; Do not refuse me before I die:
verses.textEn: "Two things I ask of you, Lord ; do not refuse me before I die:

verses.textZh: 求你使虚假和谎言远离我； 不要使我贫穷，也不要使我富裕， 只要给我需用的食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你使虚假和谎言远离我； 不要使我贫穷，也不要使我富裕， 只要给我需用的食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你使虚假和谎言远离我； 使我也不贫穷也不富足； 赐给我需用的饮食，
verses.textEnNiv: Keep falsehood and lies far from me; give me neither poverty nor riches, but give me only my daily bread.
verses.textEnEsv: Remove far from me falsehood and lying; give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with the food that is needful for me,
verses.textEnNkjv: Remove falsehood and lies far from me; Give me neither poverty nor riches— Feed me with the food allotted to me;
verses.textEnNlt: First, help me never to tell a lie. Second, give me neither poverty nor riches! Give me just enough to satisfy my needs.
verses.textEnNasb: Keep deception and lies far from me, Give me neither poverty nor riches; Feed me with the food that is my portion,
verses.textEn: Keep falsehood and lies far from me; give me neither poverty nor riches, but give me only my daily bread.

verses.textZh: 免得我吃饱了，就不认你，说： ‘耶和华是谁？’ 又恐怕我贫穷，就偷窃， 污渎了我神的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 免得我吃饱了，就不认你，说： ‘耶和华是谁？’ 又恐怕我贫穷，就偷窃， 污渎了我神的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 恐怕我饱足不认你，说： 耶和华是谁呢？ 又恐怕我贫穷就偷窃， 以致亵渎我神的名。
verses.textEnNiv: Otherwise, I may have too much and disown you and say, ‘Who is the Lord ?’ Or I may become poor and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.
verses.textEnEsv: lest I be full and deny you and say, "Who is the Lord ?" or lest I be poor and steal and profane the name of my God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lest I be full and deny You, And say, "Who is the Lord?" Or lest I be poor and steal, And profane the name of my God.
verses.textEnNlt: For if I grow rich, I may deny you and say, "Who is the Lord ?" And if I am too poor, I may steal and thus insult God’s holy name.
verses.textEnNasb: So that I will not be full and deny You and say, "Who is the Lord?" And that I will not become impoverished and steal, And profane the name of my God.
verses.textEn: Otherwise, I may have too much and disown you and say, ‘Who is the Lord ?’ Or I may become poor and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.

verses.textZh: "不要向主人诽谤他的仆人， 恐怕他咒诅你，你就判为有罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: "不要向主人诽谤他的仆人， 恐怕他咒诅你，你就判为有罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 你不要向主人谗谤仆人， 恐怕他咒诅你，你便算为有罪。
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not slander a servant to their master, or they will curse you, and you will pay for it.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not slander a servant to his master, lest he curse you, and you be held guilty.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not malign a servant to his master, Lest he curse you, and you be found guilty.
verses.textEnNlt: Never slander a worker to the employer, or the person will curse you, and you will pay for it.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not slander a slave to his master, Or he will curse you and you will be found guilty.
verses.textEn: "Do not slander a servant to their master, or they will curse you, and you will pay for it.

verses.textZh: 有一种人 咒诅父亲， 又不给母亲祝福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一种人 咒诅父亲， 又不给母亲祝福。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一宗人 ，咒诅父亲， 不给母亲祝福。
verses.textEnNiv: "There are those who curse their fathers and do not bless their mothers;
verses.textEnEsv: There are those who curse their fathers and do not bless their mothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thereis a generation that curses its father, And does not bless its mother.
verses.textEnNlt: Some people curse their father and do not thank their mother.
verses.textEnNasb: There is a kind of person who curses his father And does not bless his mother.
verses.textEn: "There are those who curse their fathers and do not bless their mothers;

verses.textZh: 有一种人自以为清洁， 却没有洗去自己的污秽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一种人自以为清洁， 却没有洗去自己的污秽。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一宗人，自以为清洁， 却没有洗去自己的污秽。
verses.textEnNiv: those who are pure in their own eyes and yet are not cleansed of their filth;
verses.textEnEsv: There are those who are clean in their own eyes but are not washed of their filth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thereis a generation thatis pure in its own eyes, Yet is not washed from its filthiness.
verses.textEnNlt: They are pure in their own eyes, but they are filthy and unwashed.
verses.textEnNasb: There is a kind who is pure in his own eyes, Yet is not washed from his filthiness.
verses.textEn: those who are pure in their own eyes and yet are not cleansed of their filth;

verses.textZh: 有一种人眼目多么高傲， 他们的眼睛，长在顶上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一种人眼目多么高傲， 他们的眼睛，长在顶上。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一宗人，眼目何其高傲， 眼皮也是高举。
verses.textEnNiv: those whose eyes are ever so haughty, whose glances are so disdainful;
verses.textEnEsv: There are those—how lofty are their eyes, how high their eyelids lift!
verses.textEnNkjv: Thereis a generation—oh, how lofty are their eyes! And their eyelids are lifted up.
verses.textEnNlt: They look proudly around, casting disdainful glances.
verses.textEnNasb: There is a kind—oh how lofty are his eyes! And his eyelids are raised in arrogance.
verses.textEn: those whose eyes are ever so haughty, whose glances are so disdainful;

verses.textZh: 有一种人牙如剑， 齿如刀， 要吞灭地上的困苦人 和世人中的贫穷人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一种人牙如剑， 齿如刀， 要吞灭地上的困苦人 和世人中的贫穷人。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一宗人，牙如剑，齿如刀， 要吞灭地上的困苦人和世间的穷乏人。
verses.textEnNiv: those whose teeth are swords and whose jaws are set with knives to devour the poor from the earth and the needy from among mankind.
verses.textEnEsv: There are those whose teeth are swords, whose fangs are knives, to devour the poor from off the earth, the needy from among mankind.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thereis a generation whose teeth arelike swords, And whose fangs arelike knives, To devour the poor from off the earth, And the needy from among men.
verses.textEnNlt: They have teeth like swords and fangs like knives. They devour the poor from the earth and the needy from among humanity.
verses.textEnNasb: There is a kind of person whose teeth are like swords And his jaw teeth like knives, To devour the poor from the earth And the needy from among mankind.
verses.textEn: those whose teeth are swords and whose jaws are set with knives to devour the poor from the earth and the needy from among mankind.

verses.textZh: 水蛭有两个女儿，常说：‘给我！给我！’ 不知足的东西有三样， 连总不说‘够了’的共有四样，
verses.textZhCnvs: 水蛭有两个女儿，常说：‘给我！给我！’ 不知足的东西有三样， 连总不说‘够了’的共有四样，
verses.textZhCuv: 蚂蟥有两个女儿， 常说：给呀，给呀！ 有三样不知足的， 连不说「够的」共有四样：
verses.textEnNiv: "The leech has two daughters. ‘Give! Give!’ they cry. "There are three things that are never satisfied, four that never say, ‘Enough!’:
verses.textEnEsv: The leech has two daughters: Give and Give. Three things are never satisfied; four never say, "Enough":
verses.textEnNkjv: The leech has two daughters— Give and Give! There are three thingsthat are never satisfied, Four never say, "Enough!":
verses.textEnNlt: The leech has two suckers that cry out, "More, more!" There are three things that are never satisfied— no, four that never say, "Enough!":
verses.textEnNasb: The leech has two daughters: "Give" and "Give." There are three things that will not be satisfied, Four that will not say, "Enough":
verses.textEn: "The leech has two daughters. ‘Give! Give!’ they cry. "There are three things that are never satisfied, four that never say, ‘Enough!’:

verses.textZh: 就是阴间、不能生育的妇人、 水源不足之地 和总不说‘够了’的火。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是阴间、不能生育的妇人、 水源不足之地 和总不说‘够了’的火。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是阴间和石胎， 浸水不足的地，并火。
verses.textEnNiv: the grave, the barren womb, land, which is never satisfied with water, and fire, which never says, ‘Enough!’
verses.textEnEsv: Sheol, the barren womb, the land never satisfied with water, and the fire that never says, "Enough."
verses.textEnNkjv: The grave, The barren womb, The earth that is not satisfied with water— And the fire never says, "Enough!"
verses.textEnNlt: the grave, the barren womb, the thirsty desert, the blazing fire.
verses.textEnNasb: Sheol, the infertile womb, Earth that is never satisfied with water, And fire that never says, "Enough."
verses.textEn: the grave, the barren womb, land, which is never satisfied with water, and fire, which never says, ‘Enough!’

verses.textZh: 嘲笑父亲， 藐视年老母亲的， 他的眼必被谷中的乌鸦啄出来， 给雏鹰所吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 嘲笑父亲， 藐视年老母亲的， 他的眼必被谷中的乌鸦啄出来， 给雏鹰所吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 戏笑父亲、藐视而不听从母亲的， 他的眼睛必为谷中的乌鸦啄出来，为鹰雏所吃。
verses.textEnNiv: "The eye that mocks a father, that scorns an aged mother, will be pecked out by the ravens of the valley, will be eaten by the vultures.
