verses.textEnEsv: The eye that mocks a father and scorns to obey a mother will be picked out by the ravens of the valley and eaten by the vultures.
verses.textEnNkjv: The eye that mocks his father, And scorns obedience to his mother, The ravens of the valley will pick it out, And the young eagles will eat it.
verses.textEnNlt: The eye that mocks a father and despises a mother’s instructions will be plucked out by ravens of the valley and eaten by vultures.
verses.textEnNasb: The eye that mocks a father And scorns a mother, The ravens of the valley will pick it out, And the young eagles will eat it.
verses.textEn: "The eye that mocks a father, that scorns an aged mother, will be pecked out by the ravens of the valley, will be eaten by the vultures.

verses.textZh: 我测不透的奇事有三样， 连我不知道的，共有四样：
verses.textZhCnvs: 我测不透的奇事有三样， 连我不知道的，共有四样：
verses.textZhCuv: 我所测不透的奇妙有三样， 连我所不知道的共有四样：
verses.textEnNiv: "There are three things that are too amazing for me, four that I do not understand:
verses.textEnEsv: Three things are too wonderful for me; four I do not understand:
verses.textEnNkjv: There are three thingswhich are too wonderful for me, Yes, four which I do not understand:
verses.textEnNlt: There are three things that amaze me— no, four things that I don’t understand:
verses.textEnNasb: There are three things which are too wonderful for me, Four which I do not understand:
verses.textEn: "There are three things that are too amazing for me, four that I do not understand:

verses.textZh: 就是鹰在空中飞翔之道， 蛇在盘石上爬行之道， 船在海中航行之道， 男与女交合之道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是鹰在空中飞翔之道， 蛇在盘石上爬行之道， 船在海中航行之道， 男与女交合之道。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是鹰在空中飞的道； 蛇在磐石上爬的道； 船在海中行的道； 男与女交合的道。
verses.textEnNiv: the way of an eagle in the sky, the way of a snake on a rock, the way of a ship on the high seas, and the way of a man with a young woman.
verses.textEnEsv: the way of an eagle in the sky, the way of a serpent on a rock, the way of a ship on the high seas, and the way of a man with a virgin.
verses.textEnNkjv: The way of an eagle in the air, The way of a serpent on a rock, The way of a ship in the midst of the sea, And the way of a man with a virgin.
verses.textEnNlt: how an eagle glides through the sky, how a snake slithers on a rock, how a ship navigates the ocean, how a man loves a woman.
verses.textEnNasb: The way of the eagle in the sky, The way of a snake on a rock, The way of a ship in the middle of the sea, And the way of a man with a virgin.
verses.textEn: the way of an eagle in the sky, the way of a snake on a rock, the way of a ship on the high seas, and the way of a man with a young woman.

verses.textZh: 淫妇的行径是这样的： 她吃了，把嘴一抹， 就说：‘我没有作错事。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 淫妇的行径是这样的： 她吃了，把嘴一抹， 就说：‘我没有作错事。’
verses.textZhCuv: 淫妇的道也是这样： 她吃了，把嘴一擦就说： 我没有行恶。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is the way of an adulterous woman: She eats and wipes her mouth and says, ‘I’ve done nothing wrong.’
verses.textEnEsv: This is the way of an adulteress: she eats and wipes her mouth and says, "I have done no wrong."
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the way of an adulterous woman: She eats and wipes her mouth, And says, "I have done no wickedness."
verses.textEnNlt: An adulterous woman consumes a man, then wipes her mouth and says, "What’s wrong with that?"
verses.textEnNasb: This is the way of an adulterous woman: She eats and wipes her mouth, And says, "I have done no wrong."
verses.textEn: "This is the way of an adulterous woman: She eats and wipes her mouth and says, ‘I’ve done nothing wrong.’

verses.textZh: 使地震动的事有三样， 连地也担当不起的，共有四样：
verses.textZhCnvs: 使地震动的事有三样， 连地也担当不起的，共有四样：
verses.textZhCuv: 使地震动的有三样， 连地担不起的共有四样：
verses.textEnNiv: "Under three things the earth trembles, under four it cannot bear up:
verses.textEnEsv: Under three things the earth trembles; under four it cannot bear up:
verses.textEnNkjv: For three things the earth is perturbed, Yes, for four it cannot bear up:
verses.textEnNlt: There are three things that make the earth tremble— no, four it cannot endure:
verses.textEnNasb: Under three things the earth quakes, And under four, it cannot endure:
verses.textEn: "Under three things the earth trembles, under four it cannot bear up:

verses.textZh: 就是奴仆作王， 愚顽人吃得饱，
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是奴仆作王， 愚顽人吃得饱，
verses.textZhCuv: 就是仆人作王； 愚顽人吃饱；
verses.textEnNiv: a servant who becomes king, a godless fool who gets plenty to eat,
verses.textEnEsv: a slave when he becomes king, and a fool when he is filled with food;
verses.textEnNkjv: For a servant when he reigns, A fool when he is filled with food,
verses.textEnNlt: a slave who becomes a king, an overbearing fool who prospers,
verses.textEnNasb: Under a slave when he becomes king, And a fool when he is satisfied with food,
verses.textEn: a servant who becomes king, a godless fool who gets plenty to eat,

verses.textZh: 被人厌恶的女子出嫁， 婢女接替主母的地位。
verses.textZhCnvs: 被人厌恶的女子出嫁， 婢女接替主母的地位。
verses.textZhCuv: 丑恶的女子出嫁； 婢女接续主母。
verses.textEnNiv: a contemptible woman who gets married, and a servant who displaces her mistress.
verses.textEnEsv: an unloved woman when she gets a husband, and a maidservant when she displaces her mistress.
verses.textEnNkjv: A hateful woman when she is married, And a maidservant who succeeds her mistress.
verses.textEnNlt: a bitter woman who finally gets a husband, a servant girl who supplants her mistress.
verses.textEnNasb: Under an unloved woman when she gets a husband, And a female servant when she dispossesses her mistress.
verses.textEn: a contemptible woman who gets married, and a servant who displaces her mistress.

verses.textZh: 地上有四样小东西， 非常聪明：
verses.textZhCnvs: 地上有四样小东西， 非常聪明：
verses.textZhCuv: 地上有四样小物，却甚聪明：
verses.textEnNiv: "Four things on earth are small, yet they are extremely wise:
verses.textEnEsv: Four things on earth are small, but they are exceedingly wise:
verses.textEnNkjv: There are four thingswhich are little on the earth, But they are exceedingly wise:
verses.textEnNlt: There are four things on earth that are small but unusually wise:
verses.textEnNasb: Four things are small on the earth, But they are exceedingly wise:
verses.textEn: "Four things on earth are small, yet they are extremely wise:

verses.textZh: 蚂蚁是微小的昆虫， 却能在夏天预备粮食。
verses.textZhCnvs: 蚂蚁是微小的昆虫， 却能在夏天预备粮食。
verses.textZhCuv: 蚂蚁是无力之类， 却在夏天预备粮食。
verses.textEnNiv: Ants are creatures of little strength, yet they store up their food in the summer;
verses.textEnEsv: the ants are a people not strong, yet they provide their food in the summer;
verses.textEnNkjv: The ants are a people not strong, Yet they prepare their food in the summer;
verses.textEnNlt: Ants—they aren’t strong, but they store up food all summer.
verses.textEnNasb: The ants are not a strong people, But they prepare their food in the summer;
verses.textEn: Ants are creatures of little strength, yet they store up their food in the summer;

verses.textZh: 石貛并不是强壮的动物， 却能在岩石中做窟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 石貛并不是强壮的动物， 却能在岩石中做窟。
verses.textZhCuv: 沙番是软弱之类， 却在磐石中造房。
verses.textEnNiv: hyraxes are creatures of little power, yet they make their home in the crags;
verses.textEnEsv: the rock badgers are a people not mighty, yet they make their homes in the cliffs;
verses.textEnNkjv: The rock badgers are a feeble folk, Yet they make their homes in the crags;
verses.textEnNlt: Hyraxes —they aren’t powerful, but they make their homes among the rocks.
verses.textEnNasb: The rock hyraxes are not a mighty people, Yet they make their houses in the rocks;
verses.textEn: hyraxes are creatures of little power, yet they make their home in the crags;

verses.textZh: 蝗虫没有君王， 却能成群列队出发。
verses.textZhCnvs: 蝗虫没有君王， 却能成群列队出发。
verses.textZhCuv: 蝗虫没有君王， 却分队而出。
verses.textEnNiv: locusts have no king, yet they advance together in ranks;
verses.textEnEsv: the locusts have no king, yet all of them march in rank;
verses.textEnNkjv: The locusts have no king, Yet they all advance in ranks;
verses.textEnNlt: Locusts—they have no king, but they march in formation.
verses.textEnNasb: The locusts have no king, Yet all of them go out in ranks;
verses.textEn: locusts have no king, yet they advance together in ranks;

verses.textZh: 壁虎虽可以用手捕捉， 却住在王宫中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 壁虎虽可以用手捕捉， 却住在王宫中。
verses.textZhCuv: 守宫用爪抓墙， 却住在王宫。
verses.textEnNiv: a lizard can be caught with the hand, yet it is found in kings’ palaces.
verses.textEnEsv: the lizard you can take in your hands, yet it is in kings’ palaces.
verses.textEnNkjv: The spider skillfully grasps with its hands, And it is in kings’ palaces.
verses.textEnNlt: Lizards—they are easy to catch, but they are found even in kings’ palaces.
verses.textEnNasb: The lizard you may grasp with the hands, Yet it is in kings’ palaces.
verses.textEn: a lizard can be caught with the hand, yet it is found in kings’ palaces.

verses.textZh: 步伐威武的东西有三样， 连行走威武的，共有四样：
verses.textZhCnvs: 步伐威武的东西有三样， 连行走威武的，共有四样：
verses.textZhCuv: 步行威武的有三样， 连行走威武的共有四样：
verses.textEnNiv: "There are three things that are stately in their stride, four that move with stately bearing:
verses.textEnEsv: Three things are stately in their tread; four are stately in their stride:
verses.textEnNkjv: There are three thingswhich are majestic in pace, Yes, four which are stately in walk:
verses.textEnNlt: There are three things that walk with stately stride— no, four that strut about:
verses.textEnNasb: There are three things which are stately in their march, Even four which are stately when they walk:
verses.textEn: "There are three things that are stately in their stride, four that move with stately bearing:

verses.textZh: 就是在百兽中最威猛的狮子， 牠面对任何野兽，也不会退缩；
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是在百兽中最威猛的狮子， 牠面对任何野兽，也不会退缩；
verses.textZhCuv: 就是狮子－乃百兽中最为猛烈、无所躲避的，
verses.textEnNiv: a lion, mighty among beasts, who retreats before nothing;
verses.textEnEsv: the lion, which is mightiest among beasts and does not turn back before any;
verses.textEnNkjv: A lion, whichis mighty among beasts And does not turn away from any;
verses.textEnNlt: the lion, king of animals, who won’t turn aside for anything,
verses.textEnNasb: The lion, which is mighty among animals And does not retreat from anything,
verses.textEn: a lion, mighty among beasts, who retreats before nothing;

verses.textZh: 还有高视阔步的 雄鸡和公山羊， 以及率领军兵的君王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有高视阔步的 雄鸡和公山羊， 以及率领军兵的君王。
verses.textZhCuv: 猎狗，公山羊，和无人能敌的君王。
verses.textEnNiv: a strutting rooster, a he-goat, and a king secure against revolt.
verses.textEnEsv: the strutting rooster, the he-goat, and a king whose army is with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: A greyhound, A male goat also, And a king whose troops are with him.
verses.textEnNlt: the strutting rooster, the male goat, a king as he leads his army.
verses.textEnNasb: The strutting rooster or the male goat, And a king when his army is with him.
verses.textEn: a strutting rooster, a he-goat, and a king secure against revolt.

verses.textZh: 如果你行事愚昧，自高自大， 或是心怀恶计，就要用手掩口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你行事愚昧，自高自大， 或是心怀恶计，就要用手掩口。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若行事愚顽，自高自傲， 或是怀了恶念，就当用手捂口。
verses.textEnNiv: "If you play the fool and exalt yourself, or if you plan evil, clap your hand over your mouth!
verses.textEnEsv: If you have been foolish, exalting yourself, or if you have been devising evil, put your hand on your mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: If you have been foolish in exalting yourself, Or if you have devised evil, putyour hand on your mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: If you have been a fool by being proud or plotting evil, cover your mouth in shame.
verses.textEnNasb: If you have been foolish in exalting yourself, Or if you have plotted evil, put your hand on your mouth.
verses.textEn: "If you play the fool and exalt yourself, or if you plan evil, clap your hand over your mouth!

verses.textZh: 搅动牛乳必生出乳酪， 紧压鼻子必压出血来， 激起怒气必产生纷争。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 搅动牛乳必生出乳酪， 紧压鼻子必压出血来， 激起怒气必产生纷争。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摇牛奶必成奶油； 扭鼻子必出血。 照样，激动怒气必起争端。
verses.textEnNiv: For as churning cream produces butter, and as twisting the nose produces blood, so stirring up anger produces strife."
verses.textEnEsv: For pressing milk produces curds, pressing the nose produces blood, and pressing anger produces strife.
verses.textEnNkjv: For as the churning of milk produces butter, And wringing the nose produces blood, So the forcing of wrath produces strife.
verses.textEnNlt: As the beating of cream yields butter and striking the nose causes bleeding, so stirring up anger causes quarrels.
verses.textEnNasb: For the churning of milk produces butter, And pressing the nose produces blood; So the churning of anger produces strife.
verses.textEn: For as churning cream produces butter, and as twisting the nose produces blood, so stirring up anger produces strife."

verses.textZh: 利慕伊勒王的话，是神的默示， 是他母亲教训他的：
verses.textZhCnvs: 利慕伊勒王的话，是神的默示， 是他母亲教训他的：
verses.textZhCuv: 利慕伊勒王的言语，是他母亲教训他的真言。
verses.textEnNiv: The sayings of King Lemuel—an inspired utterance his mother taught him.
verses.textEnEsv: The words of King Lemuel. An oracle that his mother taught him:
verses.textEnNkjv: The words of King Lemuel, the utterance which his mother taught him:
verses.textEnNlt: The sayings of King Lemuel contain this message, which his mother taught him.
verses.textEnNasb: The words of King Lemuel, the pronouncement which his mother taught him:
verses.textEn: The sayings of King Lemuel—an inspired utterance his mother taught him.

verses.textZh: "我儿， 我腹中生的儿啊！ 我许愿所得的儿啊，我要对你说甚么呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: "我儿， 我腹中生的儿啊！ 我许愿所得的儿啊，我要对你说甚么呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我的儿啊，我腹中生的儿啊， 我许愿得的儿啊！我当怎样教训你呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Listen, my son! Listen, son of my womb! Listen, my son, the answer to my prayers!
verses.textEnEsv: What are you doing, my son? What are you doing, son of my womb? What are you doing, son of my vows?
verses.textEnNkjv: What, my son? And what, son of my womb? And what, son of my vows?
verses.textEnNlt: O my son, O son of my womb, O son of my vows,
verses.textEnNasb: What, my son? And what, son of my womb? And what, son of my vows?
verses.textEn: Listen, my son! Listen, son of my womb! Listen, my son, the answer to my prayers!

verses.textZh: 不要把你的精力给妇女， 也不要有败坏君王的行为。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要把你的精力给妇女， 也不要有败坏君王的行为。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要将你的精力给妇女； 也不要有败坏君王的行为。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not spend your strength on women, your vigor on those who ruin kings.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not give your strength to women, your ways to those who destroy kings.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not give your strength to women, Nor your ways to that which destroys kings.
verses.textEnNlt: do not waste your strength on women, on those who ruin kings.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not give your strength to women, Or your ways to that which destroys kings.
verses.textEn: Do not spend your strength on women, your vigor on those who ruin kings.

verses.textZh: 利慕伊勒啊！君王不可喝酒； 君王千万不可喝酒； 掌权的不可贪饮烈酒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利慕伊勒啊！君王不可喝酒； 君王千万不可喝酒； 掌权的不可贪饮烈酒。
verses.textZhCuv: 利慕伊勒啊，君王喝酒，君王喝酒不相宜； 王子说浓酒在那里也不相宜；
verses.textEnNiv: It is not for kings, Lemuel— it is not for kings to drink wine, not for rulers to crave beer,
verses.textEnEsv: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, or for rulers to take strong drink,
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis not for kings, O Lemuel, Itis not for kings to drink wine, Nor for princes intoxicating drink;
verses.textEnNlt: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, to guzzle wine. Rulers should not crave alcohol.
verses.textEnNasb: It is not for kings, Lemuel, It is not for kings to drink wine, Or for rulers to desire intoxicating drink,
verses.textEn: It is not for kings, Lemuel— it is not for kings to drink wine, not for rulers to crave beer,

verses.textZh: 恐怕喝了酒，就忘记律例， 把困苦人的一切案件都颠倒了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恐怕喝了酒，就忘记律例， 把困苦人的一切案件都颠倒了。
verses.textZhCuv: 恐怕喝了就忘记律例， 颠倒一切困苦人的是非。
verses.textEnNiv: lest they drink and forget what has been decreed, and deprive all the oppressed of their rights.
verses.textEnEsv: lest they drink and forget what has been decreed and pervert the rights of all the afflicted.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lest they drink and forget the law, And pervert the justice of all the afflicted.
verses.textEnNlt: For if they drink, they may forget the law and not give justice to the oppressed.
verses.textEnNasb: Otherwise they will drink and forget what is decreed, And pervert the rights of all the needy.
verses.textEn: lest they drink and forget what has been decreed, and deprive all the oppressed of their rights.

verses.textZh: 要把烈酒给将要灭亡的人喝； 把酒给心里愁苦的人喝；
verses.textZhCnvs: 要把烈酒给将要灭亡的人喝； 把酒给心里愁苦的人喝；
verses.textZhCuv: 可以把浓酒给将亡的人喝， 把清酒给苦心的人喝，
verses.textEnNiv: Let beer be for those who are perishing, wine for those who are in anguish!
verses.textEnEsv: Give strong drink to the one who is perishing, and wine to those in bitter distress;
verses.textEnNkjv: Give strong drink to him who is perishing, And wine to those who are bitter of heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Alcohol is for the dying, and wine for those in bitter distress.
verses.textEnNasb: Give intoxicating drink to one who is perishing, And wine to one whose life is bitter.
verses.textEn: Let beer be for those who are perishing, wine for those who are in anguish!

verses.textZh: 让他喝了，就忘记自己的贫穷， 也不再记念自己的烦恼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 让他喝了，就忘记自己的贫穷， 也不再记念自己的烦恼。
verses.textZhCuv: 让他喝了，就忘记他的贫穷， 不再记念他的苦楚。
verses.textEnNiv: Let them drink and forget their poverty and remember their misery no more.
verses.textEnEsv: let them drink and forget their poverty and remember their misery no more.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let him drink and forget his poverty, And remember his misery no more.
verses.textEnNlt: Let them drink to forget their poverty and remember their troubles no more.
verses.textEnNasb: Let him drink and forget his poverty, And remember his trouble no more.
verses.textEn: Let them drink and forget their poverty and remember their misery no more.

verses.textZh: 你要为不能自辩的人开口说话， 为所有贫苦的人伸冤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要为不能自辩的人开口说话， 为所有贫苦的人伸冤。
verses.textZhCuv: 你当为哑巴 开口， 为一切孤独的伸冤。
verses.textEnNiv: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute.
verses.textEnEsv: Open your mouth for the mute, for the rights of all who are destitute.
verses.textEnNkjv: Open your mouth for the speechless, In the cause of all whoare appointed to die.
verses.textEnNlt: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves; ensure justice for those being crushed.
verses.textEnNasb: Open your mouth for the people who cannot speak, For the rights of all the unfortunate.
verses.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute.

verses.textZh: 你要开口说话，秉公审判， 为困苦和穷乏的人伸冤。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要开口说话，秉公审判， 为困苦和穷乏的人伸冤。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你当开口按公义判断， 为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。
verses.textEnNiv: Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verses.textEnEsv: Open your mouth, judge righteously, defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Open your mouth, judge righteously, And plead the cause of the poor and needy.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, speak up for the poor and helpless, and see that they get justice.
verses.textEnNasb: Open your mouth, judge righteously, And defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verses.textEn: Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.

verses.textZh: 有才德的妻子，谁能得着呢？ 她的价值远胜过红宝石。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有才德的妻子，谁能得着呢？ 她的价值远胜过红宝石。
verses.textZhCuv: 才德的妇人谁能得着呢？ 她的价值远胜过珍珠。
verses.textEnNiv: A wife of noble character who can find? She is worth far more than rubies.
verses.textEnEsv: An excellent wife who can find? She is far more precious than jewels.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who can find a virtuous wife? For her worth is far above rubies.
verses.textEnNlt: Who can find a virtuous and capable wife? She is more precious than rubies.
verses.textEnNasb: An excellent wife, who can find her? For her worth is far above jewels.
verses.textEn: A wife of noble character who can find? She is worth far more than rubies.

verses.textZh: 她丈夫心里倚靠她， 就不会缺少收入。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她丈夫心里倚靠她， 就不会缺少收入。
verses.textZhCuv: 她丈夫心里倚靠她， 必不缺少利益；
verses.textEnNiv: Her husband has full confidence in her and lacks nothing of value.
verses.textEnEsv: The heart of her husband trusts in her, and he will have no lack of gain.
verses.textEnNkjv: The heart of her husband safely trusts her; So he will have no lack of gain.
verses.textEnNlt: Her husband can trust her, and she will greatly enrich his life.
verses.textEnNasb: The heart of her husband trusts in her, And he will have no lack of gain.
verses.textEn: Her husband has full confidence in her and lacks nothing of value.

verses.textZh: 她一生的年日， 只带给丈夫益处，没有害处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她一生的年日， 只带给丈夫益处，没有害处。
verses.textZhCuv: 她一生使丈夫有益无损。
verses.textEnNiv: She brings him good, not harm, all the days of her life.
verses.textEnEsv: She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.
verses.textEnNkjv: She does him good and not evil All the days of her life.
verses.textEnNlt: She brings him good, not harm, all the days of her life.
verses.textEnNasb: She does him good and not evil All the days of her life.
verses.textEn: She brings him good, not harm, all the days of her life.

verses.textZh: 她搜求羊毛和细麻， 乐意亲手作工。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她搜求羊毛和细麻， 乐意亲手作工。
verses.textZhCuv: 她寻找羊绒和麻， 甘心用手做工。
verses.textEnNiv: She selects wool and flax and works with eager hands.
verses.textEnEsv: She seeks wool and flax, and works with willing hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: She seeks wool and flax, And willingly works with her hands.
verses.textEnNlt: She finds wool and flax and busily spins it.
verses.textEnNasb: She looks for wool and linen, And works with her hands in delight.
verses.textEn: She selects wool and flax and works with eager hands.

verses.textZh: 她好象一队商船， 从远方运来食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她好象一队商船， 从远方运来食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 她好像商船从远方运粮来，
verses.textEnNiv: She is like the merchant ships, bringing her food from afar.
verses.textEnEsv: She is like the ships of the merchant; she brings her food from afar.
verses.textEnNkjv: She is like the merchant ships, She brings her food from afar.
verses.textEnNlt: She is like a merchant’s ship, bringing her food from afar.
verses.textEnNasb: She is like merchant ships; She brings her food from afar.
verses.textEn: She is like the merchant ships, bringing her food from afar.

verses.textZh: 天还未亮，她就起来， 把食物分给家人， 把当作的工分派众婢女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天还未亮，她就起来， 把食物分给家人， 把当作的工分派众婢女。
verses.textZhCuv: 未到黎明她就起来， 把食物分给家中的人， 将当做的工分派婢女。
verses.textEnNiv: She gets up while it is still night; she provides food for her family and portions for her female servants.
verses.textEnEsv: She rises while it is yet night and provides food for her household and portions for her maidens.
verses.textEnNkjv: She also rises while it is yet night, And provides food for her household, And a portion for her maidservants.
verses.textEnNlt: She gets up before dawn to prepare breakfast for her household and plan the day’s work for her servant girls.
verses.textEnNasb: And she rises while it is still night And gives food to her household, And portions to her attendants.
verses.textEn: She gets up while it is still night; she provides food for her family and portions for her female servants.

verses.textZh: 她选择了一块田，就把它买下来， 用自己双手赚得的收入栽种葡萄园。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她选择了一块田，就把它买下来， 用自己双手赚得的收入栽种葡萄园。
verses.textZhCuv: 她想得田地就买来； 用手所得之利栽种葡萄园。
verses.textEnNiv: She considers a field and buys it; out of her earnings she plants a vineyard.
verses.textEnEsv: She considers a field and buys it; with the fruit of her hands she plants a vineyard.
verses.textEnNkjv: She considers a field and buys it; From her profits she plants a vineyard.
verses.textEnNlt: She goes to inspect a field and buys it; with her earnings she plants a vineyard.
verses.textEnNasb: She considers a field and buys it; From her earnings she plants a vineyard.
verses.textEn: She considers a field and buys it; out of her earnings she plants a vineyard.

verses.textZh: 她以能力束腰， 使自己的膀臂有力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她以能力束腰， 使自己的膀臂有力。
verses.textZhCuv: 她以能力束腰， 使膀臂有力。
verses.textEnNiv: She sets about her work vigorously; her arms are strong for her tasks.
verses.textEnEsv: She dresses herself with strength and makes her arms strong.
verses.textEnNkjv: She girds herself with strength, And strengthens her arms.
verses.textEnNlt: She is energetic and strong, a hard worker.
verses.textEnNasb: She surrounds her waist with strength And makes her arms strong.
verses.textEn: She sets about her work vigorously; her arms are strong for her tasks.

verses.textZh: 她知道自己的经营获利， 她的灯终夜不灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她知道自己的经营获利， 她的灯终夜不灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 她觉得所经营的有利； 她的灯终夜不灭。
verses.textEnNiv: She sees that her trading is profitable, and her lamp does not go out at night.
verses.textEnEsv: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp does not go out at night.
verses.textEnNkjv: She perceives that her merchandise is good, And her lamp does not go out by night.
verses.textEnNlt: She makes sure her dealings are profitable; her lamp burns late into the night.
verses.textEnNasb: She senses that her profit is good; Her lamp does not go out at night.
verses.textEn: She sees that her trading is profitable, and her lamp does not go out at night.

verses.textZh: 她伸手拿着卷线竿， 手掌握着纺锤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她伸手拿着卷线竿， 手掌握着纺锤。
verses.textZhCuv: 她手拿捻线竿， 手把纺线车。
verses.textEnNiv: In her hand she holds the distaff and grasps the spindle with her fingers.
verses.textEnEsv: She puts her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.
verses.textEnNkjv: She stretches out her hands to the distaff, And her hand holds the spindle.
verses.textEnNlt: Her hands are busy spinning thread, her fingers twisting fiber.
verses.textEnNasb: She stretches out her hands to the distaff, And her hands grasp the spindle.
verses.textEn: In her hand she holds the distaff and grasps the spindle with her fingers.

verses.textZh: 她张手赒济困苦人， 伸手帮助穷乏人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她张手赒济困苦人， 伸手帮助穷乏人。
verses.textZhCuv: 她张手周济困苦人， 伸手帮补穷乏人。
verses.textEnNiv: She opens her arms to the poor and extends her hands to the needy.
verses.textEnEsv: She opens her hand to the poor and reaches out her hands to the needy.
verses.textEnNkjv: She extends her hand to the poor, Yes, she reaches out her hands to the needy.
verses.textEnNlt: She extends a helping hand to the poor and opens her arms to the needy.
verses.textEnNasb: She extends her hand to the poor, And she stretches out her hands to the needy.
verses.textEn: She opens her arms to the poor and extends her hands to the needy.

verses.textZh: 她不因下雪为自己的家人担心， 因为她全家都穿著温暖的朱红色衣服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她不因下雪为自己的家人担心， 因为她全家都穿著温暖的朱红色衣服。
verses.textZhCuv: 她不因下雪为家里的人担心， 因为全家都穿着朱红衣服。
verses.textEnNiv: When it snows, she has no fear for her household; for all of them are clothed in scarlet.
verses.textEnEsv: She is not afraid of snow for her household, for all her household are clothed in scarlet.
verses.textEnNkjv: She is not afraid of snow for her household, For all her household is clothed with scarlet.
verses.textEnNlt: She has no fear of winter for her household, for everyone has warm clothes.
verses.textEnNasb: She is not afraid of the snow for her household, For all her household are clothed with scarlet.
verses.textEn: When it snows, she has no fear for her household; for all of them are clothed in scarlet.

verses.textZh: 她为自己做床毯， 她的衣服是细麻和紫色布料做的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她为自己做床毯， 她的衣服是细麻和紫色布料做的。
verses.textZhCuv: 她为自己制作绣花毯子； 她的衣服是细麻和紫色布做的。
verses.textEnNiv: She makes coverings for her bed; she is clothed in fine linen and purple.
verses.textEnEsv: She makes bed coverings for herself; her clothing is fine linen and purple.
verses.textEnNkjv: She makes tapestry for herself; Her clothing is fine linen and purple.
verses.textEnNlt: She makes her own bedspreads. She dresses in fine linen and purple gowns.
verses.textEnNasb: She makes coverings for herself; Her clothing is fine linen and purple.
verses.textEn: She makes coverings for her bed; she is clothed in fine linen and purple.

verses.textZh: 她丈夫与本地的长老在城门口同坐， 是众人都认识的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她丈夫与本地的长老在城门口同坐， 是众人都认识的。
verses.textZhCuv: 她丈夫在城门口与本地的长老同坐， 为众人所认识。
verses.textEnNiv: Her husband is respected at the city gate, where he takes his seat among the elders of the land.
verses.textEnEsv: Her husband is known in the gates when he sits among the elders of the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Her husband is known in the gates, When he sits among the elders of the land.
verses.textEnNlt: Her husband is well known at the city gates, where he sits with the other civic leaders.
verses.textEnNasb: Her husband is known in the gates, When he sits among the elders of the land.
verses.textEn: Her husband is respected at the city gate, where he takes his seat among the elders of the land.

verses.textZh: 她做细麻布衣服出售， 又供应腰带给商人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她做细麻布衣服出售， 又供应腰带给商人。
verses.textZhCuv: 她做细麻布衣裳出卖， 又将腰带卖与商家。
verses.textEnNiv: She makes linen garments and sells them, and supplies the merchants with sashes.
verses.textEnEsv: She makes linen garments and sells them; she delivers sashes to the merchant.
verses.textEnNkjv: She makes linen garments and sells them, And supplies sashes for the merchants.
verses.textEnNlt: She makes belted linen garments and sashes to sell to the merchants.
verses.textEnNasb: She makes linen garments and sells them, And supplies belts to the tradesmen.
verses.textEn: She makes linen garments and sells them, and supplies the merchants with sashes.

verses.textZh: 她以能力和威仪为衣服， 想到日后的幸福就欢笑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她以能力和威仪为衣服， 想到日后的幸福就欢笑。
verses.textZhCuv: 能力和威仪是她的衣服； 她想到日后的景况就喜笑。
verses.textEnNiv: She is clothed with strength and dignity; she can laugh at the days to come.
verses.textEnEsv: Strength and dignity are her clothing, and she laughs at the time to come.
verses.textEnNkjv: Strength and honor are her clothing; She shall rejoice in time to come.
verses.textEnNlt: She is clothed with strength and dignity, and she laughs without fear of the future.
verses.textEnNasb: Strength and dignity are her clothing, And she smiles at the future.
verses.textEn: She is clothed with strength and dignity; she can laugh at the days to come.

verses.textZh: 她开口就说出智慧的话； 她的舌头上充满慈爱的训诲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她开口就说出智慧的话； 她的舌头上充满慈爱的训诲。
verses.textZhCuv: 她开口就发智慧； 她舌上有仁慈的法则。
verses.textEnNiv: She speaks with wisdom, and faithful instruction is on her tongue.
verses.textEnEsv: She opens her mouth with wisdom, and the teaching of kindness is on her tongue.
verses.textEnNkjv: She opens her mouth with wisdom, And on her tongue is the law of kindness.
verses.textEnNlt: When she speaks, her words are wise, and she gives instructions with kindness.
verses.textEnNasb: She opens her mouth in wisdom, And the teaching of kindness is on her tongue.
verses.textEn: She speaks with wisdom, and faithful instruction is on her tongue.

verses.textZh: 她监管一切家务， 从不白吃闲饭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她监管一切家务， 从不白吃闲饭。
verses.textZhCuv: 她观察家务， 并不吃闲饭。
verses.textEnNiv: She watches over the affairs of her household and does not eat the bread of idleness.
verses.textEnEsv: She looks well to the ways of her household and does not eat the bread of idleness.
verses.textEnNkjv: She watches over the ways of her household, And does not eat the bread of idleness.
verses.textEnNlt: She carefully watches everything in her household and suffers nothing from laziness.
verses.textEnNasb: She watches over the activities of her household, And does not eat the bread of idleness.
verses.textEn: She watches over the affairs of her household and does not eat the bread of idleness.

verses.textZh: 她的儿女都起来称她是有福的， 她的丈夫也称赞她，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 她的儿女都起来称她是有福的， 她的丈夫也称赞她，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 她的儿女起来称她有福； 她的丈夫也称赞她，
verses.textEnNiv: Her children arise and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praises her:
verses.textEnEsv: Her children rise up and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praises her:
verses.textEnNkjv: Her children rise up and call her blessed; Her husband also, and he praises her:
verses.textEnNlt: Her children stand and bless her. Her husband praises her:
verses.textEnNasb: Her children rise up and bless her; Her husband also, and he praises her, saying:
verses.textEn: Her children arise and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praises her:

verses.textZh: "有才德的女子很多， 但你比她们更超卓。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "有才德的女子很多， 但你比她们更超卓。"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：才德的女子很多， 惟独你超过一切。
verses.textEnNiv: "Many women do noble things, but you surpass them all."
verses.textEnEsv: "Many women have done excellently, but you surpass them all."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Many daughters have done well, But you excel them all."
verses.textEnNlt: "There are many virtuous and capable women in the world, but you surpass them all!"
verses.textEnNasb: "Many daughters have done nobly, But you excel them all."
verses.textEn: "Many women do noble things, but you surpass them all."

verses.textZh: 艳丽是虚假的，美容是虚浮的； 唯有敬畏耶和华的妇女，必得称赞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 艳丽是虚假的，美容是虚浮的； 唯有敬畏耶和华的妇女，必得称赞。
verses.textZhCuv: 艳丽是虚假的，美容是虚浮的； 惟敬畏耶和华的妇女必得称赞。
verses.textEnNiv: Charm is deceptive, and beauty is fleeting; but a woman who fears the Lord is to be praised.
verses.textEnEsv: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain, but a woman who fears the Lord is to be praised.
verses.textEnNkjv: Charm is deceitful and beauty is passing, But a woman who fears the Lord, she shall be praised.
verses.textEnNlt: Charm is deceptive, and beauty does not last; but a woman who fears the Lord will be greatly praised.
verses.textEnNasb: Charm is deceitful and beauty is vain, But a woman who fears the Lord, she shall be praised.
verses.textEn: Charm is deceptive, and beauty is fleeting; but a woman who fears the Lord is to be praised.

verses.textZh: 愿她享受自己手所作的成果； 愿她的工作在城门口使她受称赞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿她享受自己手所作的成果； 愿她的工作在城门口使她受称赞。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿她享受操作所得的； 愿她的工作在城门口荣耀她。
verses.textEnNiv: Honor her for all that her hands have done, and let her works bring her praise at the city gate.
verses.textEnEsv: Give her of the fruit of her hands, and let her works praise her in the gates.
verses.textEnNkjv: Give her of the fruit of her hands, And let her own works praise her in the gates.
verses.textEnNlt: Reward her for all she has done. Let her deeds publicly declare her praise.
verses.textEnNasb: Give her the product of her hands, And let her works praise her in the gates.
verses.textEn: Honor her for all that her hands have done, and let her works bring her praise at the city gate.
